local local_class = newclass('RedHoodSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = RedHood @
		Comment = 파티에 들어오는 빨간 모자. @
		Index = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress


	self.red_hood = nil

	self.see_ending = false
	self.elvira_voice_id = 12

	self.red_hood_name = "red_hood"

	self.finish_door_name = "finish_door"
	self.red_hood_zone_name = "red_hood_zone"

	self.marker_name = "red_hood"

	self.branch_name1 = "red_hood_talk_branch_3"
	self.branch_name2 = "red_hood_talk_branch_4"

	self.red_hood_card_name = "redhood"
	self.red_hood_card_title = "red_hood_character_title"
	self.red_hood_card_subtitle = "red_hood_character_subtitle"
	self.red_hood_card_description = "red_hood_character_description"

	quest_icon.PreLoad()
end

function local_class:enter()

	if stage.Name ~= "substage_1_9" then return true end

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.red_hood = get_character(self.red_hood_name)
	self.red_hood.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()

	if stage.Name == "substage_1_8" then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(25.5, 0, 21.5))
	elseif stage.Name == "substage_1_9" then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.red_hood)
		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.red_hood)
	end

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.red_hood = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave then return end
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.red_hood_zone_name then
		if not self.see_ending then
			self.see_ending = true
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.red_hood_come_up, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.red_hood) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_red_hood, self))
	end
end

function local_class:red_hood_come_up()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.red_hood)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:come_up_red_hood())
	coroutine.yield(self:ending())
end

function local_class:talk_with_red_hood()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.red_hood)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	character_util.align_party(self.red_hood, "left")
	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:talk_with_red_hood())
	coroutine.yield(self:ending())
end

function local_class:ending()
	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "ending")

	local loop_out = false

	while not loop_out do
		local wait = true
		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name1),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Intellect,
			Callback = function()
				loop_out = true
				wait = false
			end})
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.branch_name2),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Forced,
			Callback = function()
				loop_out = false
				wait = false
			end})

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.red_hood, branches)

		while wait do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if not loop_out then
			coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:loop_talk())
		end
	end

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:complete_talk())

	coroutine.yield(self:red_hood_theatre())

	camera_util.move_async({1, 0, 40}, 0.5, {ignorecameragrids = true})

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.finish_door_name, false))

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.5))

	camera_util.move(user_party_leader.Position, 0.5)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	music_player.StageBgmState = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field
	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:red_hood_theatre()
	local char_spec = CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId
	local alreadyhascharacter = user:GetCharacter(char_spec.Redhood, true) ~= nil
	local red_hood = self.red_hood

	coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0, false, false, false))

	local ismaxparty = user_party.Count >= user.Party.MaxLimitCharacterCount

	local character_theatre_data = CS.Oak.CharacterTheatreData()
	character_theatre_data.Character = red_hood
	character_theatre_data.CardName = self.red_hood_card_name
	character_theatre_data.Title = game_string:GetString(self.red_hood_card_title)
	character_theatre_data.Subtitle = game_string:GetString(self.red_hood_card_subtitle)
	character_theatre_data.Desc = game_string:GetString(self.red_hood_card_description)
	character_theatre_data.IsMaxParty = ismaxparty
	character_theatre_data.AlreadyHasInParty = alreadyhascharacter
	character_theatre_data.VoiceId = self.elvira_voice_id
	character_theatre_data.VoiceType = CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.JoinParty

	local isended_threatre = false

	CS.Oak.NewCharacterTheatre.ShowThreatre(character_theatre_data, function()
		isended_threatre = true
	end)

	while not isended_threatre do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	red_hood:HideWeapon(false, 'event')

	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()

	if not ismaxparty and not alreadyhascharacter then
		local getted_character = user:GetCharacter(char_spec.Redhood)
		CS.Oak.AddHeroStageLogic.Execute(red_hood, getted_character, user, user_party)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('RinShopMainPostSection')
--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = post @
		QuestName = RinShopMain @
		Comment =  린 도시락 가게 메인 퀘스트 완료 후 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 루프 존에 들어갔는지 저장
	self.enter_loop_zone = false

	-- 타일맵 존 이름
	self.loop_event_zone_name = 'loop'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:load_resource()
	return util.cs_generator(quest_util.load_resource, self)
end

function local_class:on_load_resource_routine()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if user_party_leader ~= e.FieldObject then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.loop_event_zone_name then
		if not self.enter_loop_zone then
			self.enter_loop_zone = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.go_back_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave == false then return end
	if user_party_leader ~= e.FieldObject then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.loop_event_zone_name then
		if self.enter_loop_zone then
			self.enter_loop_zone = false

			CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:EnableMeshRenderer(false)
		end
	end
end

-- 이승으로 돌아가는 이벤트, 틴트 처리
function local_class:go_back_event()
	local start_x = 23
	local dist = 30

	local play_sfx = false

	CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:EnableMeshRenderer(true)

	while self.enter_loop_zone do
		local cur_mod = (user_party_leader.Position.x - start_x) / dist

		if cur_mod < 0 then
			cur_mod = 0
		elseif not play_sfx and cur_mod >= 0.7 then
			play_sfx = true

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_holy_03', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		elseif cur_mod >= 1 then
			break
		end

		CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:SetFadeColor(unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, cur_mod }))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:SetFadeColor(unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, 1 }))

	-- 루프 존을 벗어나지 않고 while문 종료된 경우 이승으로 돌아간 것이므로 스테이지 클리어
	if self.enter_loop_zone then
		field_ui_manager:Hide()

		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		CS.Oak.Game.Instance:StageToLobby(true)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:custom_intro()

	local bike = get_character('bike')

	character_util.set_emotion(lynn, { name = 'blush' })
	screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local typing_text_asset_bundle_name = "ui/prologue"
	local typing_text_asset_name = "typing_text"
	local text_resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local typing_text = nil

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync,
			text_resholder, typing_text_asset_bundle_name, typing_text_asset_name, function(prefab)
				typing_text = CS.NGUITools.AddChild(
						stage.UIRoot.gameObject, prefab):GetComponent(typeof(CS.UITypingText))

				typing_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 100, 1, 110);
				typing_text.Widget.topAnchor.relative = 0;
				typing_text.Widget:UpdateAnchors()
				typing_text.Label.fontSize = 64
				typing_text.Label.alignment = CS.NGUIText.Alignment.Center
			end)

	typing_text.Label.color = unity_class.color.white

	-- [프롤로그]
	-- 오토바이를 탄 린이 blush 표정으로 하늘을 날고 있음 (슬로우 모션 - 절벽에서 다이빙한 상황)
	-- 화면 하단에 자막으로 "왜 나만 항상..." 이라고 나온 후 하얗게 페이드 아웃.
	camera_util.move(vector(3000, 0, 0), 0)
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_bike_somersault_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	screen_util.fade_out_async(self.fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--screen_util.fade_in_async(self.fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, "linear")
	--wait_for_sec(3.5)
	camera_util.move(vector(-40, 0, -12), 0)

	-- 달을 향해 날아가는 린
	local fly_to_the_moon_duration = 2.3
	wait_for_sec(1.0)
	screen_util.fade_in(self.fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, "linear")
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = 'ondemand/v2_9_rinshop/audio:bgm_lynn_sad', state = 'field' })
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 0 })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.fo_move_curve, self,
					bike, bike.Position + vector(4, 0, 1.1), 0, fly_to_the_moon_duration + 0.8))

	-- 시간 줄이기
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.3, 'slowdown')

	wait_for_sec(1.2)

	local text_fade = function(text, duration)
		local cur_time = 0
		text.Label.alpha = 0
		while cur_time < duration do
			cur_time = cur_time + unity_class.time.unscaledDeltaTime
			text.Label.alpha = cur_time / duration
			if text.Label.alpha >= 1 then break end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		text.Label.alpha = 1
	end
	-- 왜 나만 항상...
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, typing_text:SetTypedText(game_string:GetString(self.main_script .. 'monologue'), 1000, 0, 3.5))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(text_fade, typing_text, 1))
	--
	wait_for_sec(fly_to_the_moon_duration - 1.3)

	-- 그래.. 어릴 때부터 난…
	screen_util.fade_out_async(self.fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('slowdown')
	camera_util.move(vector(3000, 0, 0), 0)
	wait_for_sec(1.3)
	--690
	typing_text.Widget:SetAnchor(stage.UIRoot.gameObject, 1, 0, 1, 110);
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			typing_text:SetTypedText(game_string:GetString('rin_shop_main_monologue_2'), 1000, 0, 3.5))
	screen_util.fade_in_async(self.fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, "linear")
	wait_for_sec(3.5)

	screen_util.fade_out_async(self.fade_duration, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	camera_util.move(vector(-40, 0, -12), 0)

	text_resholder:Dispose()

	lynn.transform.parent = nil
	lynn.Transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 0, 0)
	lynn.Transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local well = get_field_object('well')
	local customer_1 = self.get_customer(2)
	local titan_pc = self.get_customer('pc_teatan')
	local bike = get_character('bike')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, well) and not self.has_water_bowl
			and self.current_progress == self.stage_custom_state.childhood then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.well_interact_event, self))

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, customer_1)
			and self.current_progress == self.stage_custom_state.grown_up_lynn then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('customer_table_1')
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_interact_customer_1, self))

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, titan_pc)
			and self.current_progress == self.stage_custom_state.grown_up_lynn then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('customer_table_1')
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('customer_table_2')
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.titan_pc_aggro, self))

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, bike) then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('bike')
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.on_interact_bike, self))
		--sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.reaper_saved_lynn, self)
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'restaurant' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_baby_lynn()) and e.FullEnter
			and self.has_water_bowl then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sapa_jungpa_fight, self))

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lynn_save_kid, self))
	end
end

function local_class:fo_move_curve(fo, end_position, height, duration, play_sfx)
	local start_position = fo.Position
	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed <= duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height

	}

	-- 상인과 대화 저장
	self.is_talk_with_merchant = false

	self.merchant = nil

	self.soylent_recipe_unlock = 'soylent_red_recipe_unlock_event'
end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.merchant = get_character(self.merchant_name)

end

function local_class:start()
	-- 뇌물 레벨 3 이상이면 수상한 상인이 상점에 방문
	if self.controller:return_data().ShopLevel >= self.merchant_condition then
		self.current_progress = self.progress_state.merchant

end

	end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.merchant) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_merchant, self)
	end

	-- 뇌물 레벨 3 이상이면 수상한 상인이 상점에 방문
	if e.Success then
		self.controller:load_minigame()

function local_class:talk_with_merchant()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.merchant)

	party_util.align_party(self.merchant, 'down', 1)

	local clap_sfx

	if not self.is_talk_with_merchant then
		self.is_talk_with_merchant = true

		character_util.set_anim(self.merchant, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.merchant, { name = 'smile' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.merchant, { key = self.main_script..1, skip = true })

				{ sfx_name = '01_clap_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.set_anim(self.merchant, { name = 'clap' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.merchant, { key = self.main_script..2, skip = true })

		clap_sfx:FadeOut()

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_rustle_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.set_anim(self.merchant, { name = 'question', loop = false })
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.merchant)

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.merchant, { key = self.main_script..3, skip = true })

		character_util.set_anim(self.merchant, { name = 'cast' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.merchant, { name = 'doyagao' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.merchant, { key = self.main_script..4, skip = true })
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.merchant)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.merchant, { key = self.main_script..5, skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(self.merchant)

	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { self.main_script..6, 'mercy' },{ self.main_script..7, 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_clap_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.set_anim(self.merchant, { name = 'clap' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.merchant, { name = 'doyagao' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.merchant, { key = self.main_script..9, skip = true })

		clap_sfx:FadeOut()

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_throw_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		character_util.set_anim(self.merchant, { name = 'throw', loop = false })
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.merchant)

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = self.merchant.Position,
		                                           target = user_party_leader.Position, itemid = self.recipe_item_id,
		                                           notforinven = true })

		character_util.remove_anim(self.merchant)

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		local item_placeholder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
		item_placeholder.ItemId = self.recipe_item_id
		item_placeholder.NotForInventory = true

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.coroutine(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent(item_placeholder,
				'rin_shop_main_soylent_red_recipe_subtitle', 'rin_shop_main_soylent_red_recipe_description')))

		self.merchant.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

		-- 다음 섹션으로
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	else
		character_util.set_anim(self.merchant, { name = 'bomb_idle' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.merchant, { key = self.main_script..8, skip = true })

		character_util.remove_emotion(self.merchant)

		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.merchant)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent), 'on_mini_game_start_event')

	self.worker_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.worker_num do
		self.worker_list:Add(get_character(self.worker_name..i))
	end

	self.reporter_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.reporter_num do
		self.reporter_list:Add(get_character(self.reporter_name..i))
	end

	self.merchant = get_character(self.merchant_name)
	character_util.set_position(self.merchant, vector(158.5, 0, -22))
	character_util.set_direction(self.merchant, 'down')

	self.interactable_pea = get_field_object(self.interactable_pea_name)
	self.interactable_pea.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()

	return true
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		return self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if user_party_leader ~= e.FieldObject then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.conveyor_belt_event_zone_name_1 then
		if not self.see_conveyor_belt_event_1 then
			self.see_conveyor_belt_event_1 = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.conveyor_belt_event_1, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.conveyor_belt_event_zone_name_2 then
		if not self.see_conveyor_belt_event_2 then
			self.see_conveyor_belt_event_2 = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.conveyor_belt_event_2, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.vomit_event_zone_name then
		if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_vomit_event then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_vomit_event

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.vomit_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.battle_event_zone_name then
		if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.fight_with_merchant then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.fight_with_merchant

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.fight_with_merchant_event, self)
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.secret_event_zone_name then
		if not self.enter_secret_path and self.current_progress == self.progress_state.fight_with_merchant then
			self.enter_secret_path = true

			-- 공장 SFX 페이드 아웃
			self.controller:fade_out_factory_sfx()

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.secret_path, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.reporter_event_zone_name then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_state.see_pea_event then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_reporter_event

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.reporter_event, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave == false then return end
	if user_party_leader ~= e.FieldObject then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.secret_event_zone_name then
		if self.enter_secret_path and self.current_progress == self.progress_state.fight_with_merchant then
			-- 아래로 걸어서 나간 경우만 취소
			if user_party_leader.Position.z < -14 then
				self.enter_secret_path = false

				-- 공장 SFX 페이드 인
				self.controller:fade_in_factory_sfx()

				CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:EnableMeshRenderer(false)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.interactable_pea) then
		if self.current_progress < self.progress_state.see_pea_event then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_state.see_pea_event

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_pea_event, self)
		elseif self.current_progress >= self.progress_state.see_pea_event then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_with_pea_repeat_event, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.merchant) then
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.merchant, { key = self.main_script..56 })
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.boss_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_boss_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_mini_game_start_event(e)
	-- 이전 섹션에서 시작했을 때 미니게임 시작되면 캐셔들 활성화
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 3 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.activate_cashiers, self))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent))

	self.worker_list = nil
	self.reporter_list = nil

	self.merchant = nil

	self.interactable_pea = nil
end

-- 비밀 공간 틴트 처리
function local_class:secret_path()
	local start_z = -14.5
	local dist = 10

	CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:EnableMeshRenderer(true)

	while self.enter_secret_path do
		local cur_mod = (user_party_leader.Position.z - start_z) / dist

		if cur_mod < 0 then
			cur_mod = 0
		elseif cur_mod > 1 then
			cur_mod = 1
		end

		CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:SetFadeColor(unity_color({ 0, 0, 0, cur_mod * 0.7 }))

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

		return self:on_zone_leave_event(e)

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)

	if user_party_leader ~= e.FieldObject then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

		if not self.enter_loop_zone then
			self.enter_loop_zone = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.go_back_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.farewell_event_zone_name then
		if not self.see_farewell_event then
			self.see_farewell_event = true

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.farewell_event, self)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave == false then return end
	if user_party_leader ~= e.FieldObject then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.loop_event_zone_name then
		if self.enter_loop_zone then

	end

function local_class:go_back_event()
	local start_x = 23
	local dist = 30

	local play_sfx = false

	CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:EnableMeshRenderer(true)

	while self.enter_loop_zone do
		local cur_mod = (user_party_leader.Position.x - start_x) / dist

		if cur_mod < 0 then
			cur_mod = 0
		elseif not play_sfx and cur_mod >= 0.7 then
			play_sfx = true

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_holy_03', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		elseif cur_mod >= 1 then
			break
		end

		CS.Oak.FadeScreenTransition.Instance:SetFadeColor(unity_color({ 1, 1, 1, cur_mod }))

		coroutine.yield(nil)

local local_class = newclass('RunningAwayGnomeSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = RunningAwayGnome @

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- npc 이름

	self.gnome_name = 'running_away_gnome'
	self.player_bug_name = 'hiding_bug'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.near_gnome_zone_name = 'near_running_away_gnome'

	-- 마커 이름
	self.gnome_pos_marker_name = 'running_away_gnome_pos'

	-- 그리드 이름
	self.grid_name = 'running_away_gnome_grid'

	-- 기믹 이름
	self.star_piece_name = 'running_away_gnome_star_piece'

	self.progress_enum = {
		none = 1,
		run_away_gnome = 2,
		catch_gnome = 3

	self.current_progress = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.none

	local bug = get_character(self.bug_name)
	local gnome = get_character(self.gnome_name)

	self:setting()

	character_util.set_active_shadow(gnome, false)

	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(bug, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(gnome, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))

	self.progress_enum = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.near_gnome_zone_name) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none then
			self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_distance, self))

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.run_away_gnome, self))
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if e.CameraGrid.name == self.grid_name then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, get_character(self.player_bug_name)) then
			-- 노움이 이동이 끝났을 때 이벤트 그리드를 들어오면 노움 위치 리셋
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.run_away_gnome then
				self.current_progress = self.current_progress -1

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					wait_for_sec(0.2)

					character_util.stop(get_character(self.gnome_name))
					character_util.stop(get_character(self.bug_name))

					self:setting()
				end))
			end

			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 도망가는 노움
function local_class:run_away_gnome()
	local bug = get_character(self.bug_name)
	local gnome = get_character(self.gnome_name)

	local dir = vector_util.to_direction(gnome.Position - user_party.Leader.Position)

	local move_speed = 9

	local diff
	if dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		diff = 10
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		diff = 105
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		diff = 38
	elseif dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		diff = 17
	end

	local end_pos_diff = diff * direction_util.to_vector3(dir)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_flying_bug_01')
	character_util.set_anim(bug, { name = 'fly' })

	-- 노움 점프
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local locked_dir = vector_util.to_direction(-1 * direction_util.to_vector3(dir))
		gnome:SetLockedDirection(gnome, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(locked_dir, 11))
		character_util.set_emotion(gnome, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.normal_jump_async(gnome)

		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.run_away_gnome then
			character_util.remove_emotion(gnome)
			gnome:RemoveLockedDirection(gnome)
			character_util.set_emotion(gnome, { 'smile' })
		end
	end))

	character_util.move_waypoint(gnome, gnome.Position + end_pos_diff, move_speed)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(bug, bug.Position + end_pos_diff, move_speed, false,
		nil, 'flying')
end

-- 플레이와 노움의 거리를 체크
function local_class:check_distance()
	local leader = get_character(self.player_bug_name)
	local bug = get_character(self.bug_name)

	while self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.run_away_gnome do
		-- 근접 했으면 노움 잡음
		if (leader.Position - bug.Position).sqrMagnitude < 0.5 then
			self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

			character_util.stop(bug)
			character_util.stop(get_character(self.gnome_name))

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.catch_gnome, self))

			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

-- 노움을 잡음
function local_class:catch_gnome()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local bug = get_character(self.bug_name)
	local gnome = get_character(self.gnome_name)
	local leader = get_character(self.player_bug_name)

	character_util.remove_emotion(gnome)

	character_util.set_emotion(gnome, { name = 'attack' })

	local dir = bug.Direction

	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, dir)
	character_util.set_direction(leader, dir)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_comic_01')
	camera_util.shake(0.5, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, 0.5, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	-- 아야야...
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gnome, { key = 'running_away_gnome_1', skip = true })

	-- 잠깐 잠깐! 알았어, 알았다고!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gnome, { key = 'running_away_gnome_2', skip = true })

	local end_pos = leader.Position + 2 * direction_util.to_vector3(dir)
	local move_speed = 3
	local last_dir = vector_util.to_direction(-1 * direction_util.to_vector3(dir))

	-- 플레이어 앞으로 이동
	character_util.set_anim(bug, { name = 'fly' })

	character_util.move_waypoint(gnome, end_pos + 0.3 * unity_class.vector3.forward,
		move_speed, nil, nil, nil, last_dir)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(bug, end_pos, move_speed, false, nil, 'flying', last_dir)

	character_util.set_anim(bug, { name = 'fly_idle' })
	-- 나를 잡다니..!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gnome, { key = 'running_away_gnome_3', skip = true })

	-- 그런 스피드라면 웃는얼굴님께 대항하는것도 쉬운 일이었겠네.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gnome, { key = 'running_away_gnome_4', skip = true })

	-- 그렇게 나쁜 녀석처럼 보이진 않는데.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gnome, { key = 'running_away_gnome_5', skip = true })

	-- 어쨌든 날 잡았으니 이걸 선물로 줄게.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gnome, { key = 'running_away_gnome_6', skip = true })

	-- 스타피스 드랍
	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
	if leader.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		star_piece.Position = leader.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
	else
		star_piece.Position = leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)
	end
	message_system:Send(
		star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(gnome.Position + vector(0, 1, 0), false))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 그렇게 빠르니 이런저런 물체에 부딪혀 보는게 좋아.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gnome, { key = 'running_away_gnome_7', skip = true })

	-- 한번 해보라고. 알겠지?!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gnome, { key = 'running_away_gnome_8', skip = true })

	move_speed = 11

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_flying_bug_01')
	character_util.set_anim(bug, { name = 'fly' })

	character_util.move_waypoint(gnome, gnome.Position + 18 * direction_util.to_vector3(dir), move_speed)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(bug, bug.Position + 18 * direction_util.to_vector3(dir), move_speed,
		false, nil, 'flying')

	gnome.Position = vector(99, 0, 99)
	bug.Position = vector(99, 0, 99)
	character_util.set_active_state(gnome, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(bug, 'disabled')

	camera_util.move_async(leader.Position, 1, { end_target = leader })

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	-- 폭탄 벌레를 타고 있기 때문에 파티원들 stop
	party_util.stop()
end

function local_class:setting()
	local bug = get_character(self.bug_name)
	local gnome = get_character(self.gnome_name)

	local marker = field:GetMarker(self.gnome_pos_marker_name).position

	bug.Position = marker
	gnome.Position = bug.Position + 0.3 * unity_class.vector3.forward

	gnome:RemoveLockedDirection(gnome)

	character_util.set_direction(bug, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(gnome, 'right')

	character_util.set_anim(bug, { name = 'fly_idle' })

	character_util.set_emotion(gnome, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(gnome, { name = 'seat' })

	bug.SpineController.ShadowOffsetY = -2.5
end

return local_class

    end

    self.controller = nil

    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        if e.Target == self.sapaGatekeeper1 or e.Target == self.sapaGatekeeper2 then
            speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.potman, self.talkName)
        elseif e.Target == self.sapa then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.starttest, self))
        end
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:starttest()
    yield_return(self.controller.scene, "start_test")

    local waitForBranch = true
    local start = false

    local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

    branches:Add({
        Text = game_string:GetString("sapa_studio_7"),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
        Callback = function()
            waitForBranch = false
            start = true
        end})
    branches:Add({
        Text = game_string:GetString("sapa_studio_10"),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Forced,
        Callback = function()
            waitForBranch = false
        end
    })

    local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
    choice_state.Branchs = branches
    choice_state.Talker = user_party_leader
    ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

    while waitForBranch do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    if start then
        yield_return(self.controller.scene, "start_test_1")

        local i = 1
        while true do
            if user_party.Count == 1 then
                break;
            end

            character_util.convert_to_npc(user_party[i])
        end

        self.sapa.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
        self.sapa.Interactable.Talk = "sapa_studio_11"
    else
        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sapa, {key = "sapa_studio_11", skip = true})
    end

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

    quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.sapaGatekeeper2)

    self.controller = nil
    self.quest_spec = nil
    self.sapaGatekeeper1 = nil
    self.sapaGatekeeper2 = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
        if e.FullEnter and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader and e.Zone.Name == self.zoneName then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enterstudio, self))
        end
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:enterstudio()
    field_ui_manager:Hide()

    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.sapaGatekeeper1)
    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.sapaGatekeeper2)

    local pos = vector(-21.5, 0, 132)
    character_util.align_party(pos, "down")

    if user_party_leader.Costume ~= nil and user_party_leader.Costume.CostumeSpec.Id == 10064 then
        local isAccepted = false
        local waitForBranch = true

        if not self.skipRequest then
            yield_return(self.controller.scene, "quest_open")
            self.skipRequest = true
        end

        CS.Oak.IQuestEventControllerExtensions.ProcessQuestRequest(nil, self.quest_spec.QuestId, function(accepted_in)
            waitForBranch = false
            isAccepted = accepted_in
        end)

        while (waitForBranch) do
            coroutine.yield(nil)
        end

        if isAccepted then
            floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party_leader, self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)
            screen_util.quest_accept_event()
            yield_return(self.substageMap, "OpenStage")
            yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
        else
            yield_return(self.controller.scene, "go_back")
            screen_util.quest_decline_Event()

            quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.sapaGatekeeper1)
            quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.sapaGatekeeper2)
        end

    else
        yield_return(self.controller.scene, "blocked")
        yield_return(self.controller.scene, "go_back")
    end

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

    self.smokeEffectPool = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        if e.Target == self.sapa then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.starttest, self))
        end
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
        if e.FullEnter and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader then
            if e.Zone.Name == "event1" and self.innerProgress == 5then
                self.innerProgress = 6
                coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.clear, self))
            end
            for i=1, 4 do
                local eventName = string.format("battle%d", i)
                if e.Zone.Name == eventName and self.innerProgress == i then
                    self.innerProgress = i + 1
                    coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.before_test, self, i))
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
        if e.BattleGroupName == "battle3" then
            self:debuff_off()
        end
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:starttest()
    yield_return(self.controller.scene, "start_test")

    local waitForBranch = true
    local start = false

    local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

    branches:Add({
        Text = game_string:GetString("sapa_studio_7"),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
        Callback = function()
            waitForBranch = false
            start = true
        end})
    branches:Add({
        Text = game_string:GetString("sapa_studio_10"),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Forced,
        Callback = function()
            waitForBranch = false
        end
    })

    local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
    choice_state.Branchs = branches
    choice_state.Talker = user_party_leader
    ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

    while waitForBranch do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    if start then
        yield_return(self.controller.scene, "start_test_1")

        local i = 1
        while true do
            if user_party.Count == 1 then
                break;
            end

            character_util.convert_to_npc(user_party[i])
        end

        self.sapa.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
        self.sapa.Interactable.Talk = "sapa_studio_11"
        self.innerProgress = 1
    else
        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.sapa, {key = "sapa_studio_11", skip = true})
    end

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:before_test(e)

    yield_return(self.controller.scene, scene_name)

    local monster = nil
    local characters = character_manager:GetAllMonsters()
    for i = 0, characters.Count - 1 do
        local battle_name = string.format("battle_%d", e)
        if string.match(characters[i].Name, battle_name) then
            monster = characters[i]
            monster.FieldObjectController.DontFight = false
        end
    end

    command_util.execute_monster_notice(monster, user_party_leader, "battle")
end

function local_class:throw_smoke()
    self.shoot_helper:ShootTargetPosition(user_party_leader.Position, unity_class.vector3.zero, 0, nil, false)

end

function local_class:start()

    local kid_a = self.controller.get_kid_a()
    local kid_b = self.controller.get_kid_b()
    local sick_kid = self.controller.get_sick_kid()
    character_util.add_listener(kid_a, self)
    character_util.add_listener(kid_b, self)
    -- 친구들이 잔디밭에 있네요. 나도 빨리 나아서 같이 놀고 싶어…
    sick_kid.Interactable.Talk = 'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_34'
    character_util.set_anim(sick_kid, {name = 'idle', loop = false})

    -- start_info 테이블을 받아서 npc들 초기 설정
    self.controller:init_npc(self.start_info)

    -- 꽃밭의 꽃 받기
    local objs = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(self.flower_garden_center_pos, 2.5, 1)
    for i = 0, objs.Count - 1 do
        local fo = objs.Values[i]
        if string.find(fo.Name, 'obj_flower') then
            table.insert(self.controller.flowers, fo)
            fo.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
        end
    end

    -- 꽃밭 상호작용 용 invisible_wall 테이블에 캐싱
    for i = 1, 5 do
        local fo = self.get_invisible_wall_flower_garden(i)
        fo.Position = vector(130 + i, 0, -21)
        table.insert(self.invisible_wall_flower_garden, fo)
    end

    --region 돌맹이 생성
    for i = 1, 4 do
        -- 아이템 스프라이트 생성
        local rock_pos = self.rock_pos[i]
        local rock = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = rock_pos, itemid = self.controller.item_id.rock,
                                                 notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})
        table.insert(self.rock_items, rock)
    end
    --endregion
end

--region event

function local_class:on_event(e)
    if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        return self:on_interact_event(e)
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
    if self.is_event_running == true then return false end

    local kid_a = self.controller.get_kid_a()
    local kid_b = self.controller.get_kid_b()
    local interact_kids = lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid_a) or lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, kid_b)

    -- 꽃밭과 상호작용 체크
    local interacting_flower_garden = false
    for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.invisible_wall_flower_garden) do
        if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.invisible_wall_flower_garden[i]) then
            interacting_flower_garden = true
            break
        end
    end

    if self.controller.current_progress < self.controller.progress.accept and interact_kids == true then
        sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.event_begin, self)
    elseif self.controller.current_progress == self.controller.progress.accept and interact_kids == true then
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.kid_one_line_talk, self, e.Target))
    elseif interacting_flower_garden then
        sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_flower_garden, self)
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
    if e.Getter == user_party.Leader then
        if e.Item.ItemId == self.controller.item_id.soil_potion then
            if self.activity[self.activity_enum.soil_potion] == self.activity_progress.none then
                self.activity[self.activity_enum.soil_potion] = self.activity_progress.obtained
            end
        elseif e.Item.ItemId == self.controller.item_id.water then
            if self.activity[self.activity_enum.water] == self.activity_progress.none then
                self.activity[self.activity_enum.water] = self.activity_progress.obtained
            end
        end
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
    local grid_name = e.CameraGrid.name

    for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.house_camera_grid_names) do
        if self.house_camera_grid_names[i] == grid_name then
            if self.quest_marker_on then
                quest_marker_util.remove('flower_garden_marker')
            end
            break

function local_class:interact_flower_garden()
    self.is_event_running = true
    local enum = self.activity_enum

    -- 선택지 정보 테이블: 대사, 성향, ans 넘버
    local choice_info = {
        -- 물을 뿌린다.
        {'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_20', CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy, enum.water},
        -- 영양제를 뿌린다.
        {'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_21', CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy, enum.soil_potion},
        -- 돌을 치운다.
        {'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_21_1', CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy, enum.field_clean},
        -- 그만둔다.
        {'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_22', CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal, enum.none}
    }

    -- 실제로 표시할 선택지 테이블에 선택지 담기
    local display_choice = {}
    for i = 1, table_util.get_size(self.activity) do
        if self.activity[i] == self.activity_progress.obtained then
            table.insert(display_choice, choice_info[i])
        end
    end

    if table_util.get_size(display_choice) == 0 then
        if self.activity[enum.water] ~= self.activity_progress.cleared and
                self.activity[enum.soil_potion] ~= self.activity_progress.cleared then
            -- 꽃을 피우기 위해선 토양에 영양과 수분이 필요할 것 같다.
            field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_59'})
        elseif self.activity[enum.water] ~= self.activity_progress.cleared then
            -- 꽃을 피우기 위해선 토양에 수분이 필요할 것 같다.
            field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_57'})
        elseif self.activity[enum.soil_potion] ~= self.activity_progress.cleared then
            -- 꽃을 피우기 위해선 토양에 영양이 필요할 것 같다.
            field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'shortstory_bari_flower_garden_58'})
        end
    else
        -- 마지막 선택지 '그만둔다' 추가
        table.insert(display_choice, choice_info[table_util.get_size(choice_info)])

        local wait = true
        local ans = -1

        local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
        for i = 1, table_util.get_size(display_choice) do
            local info = display_choice[i]
            branches:Add({
                Text = game_string:GetString(info[1]),
                Tendency = info[2],
                Callback = function()
                    wait = false
                    ans = info[3]
                end
            })
        end

        ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(nil, branches)

        while wait do
            coroutine.yield(nil)
        end

        if ans ~= enum.none then
            self.activity[ans] = self.activity_progress.cleared
            if ans == enum.water then
                self:throw_event(self.controller.item_id.water, self.water_splash_effect, 1, 1)
            elseif ans == enum.soil_potion then
                self:throw_event(self.controller.item_id.soil_potion, self.soil_potion_effect, 1, 1)
            elseif ans == enum.field_clean then
                self:pick_rock_event()
            end
        end

        self:event_clear()
    end

    self.is_event_running = false
end

function local_class:consume_rock(i)
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_pet_trap_deactivate_01')
    self.rock_items[i]:ConsumeComplete()
    local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.rock_disappear_effect):Instantiate(self.rock_items[i].Position)
    table.insert(self.effects, effect)
    wait_for_sec(0.5)
end

-- 물, 토양 포션 던지는 이벤트 입장
function local_class:throw_event(item_id, effect_name, throw_num, item_scale)
    local bari = user_party.Leader

    wait_for_sec(0.5)
    -- 아이템 던지는 횟수 만큼 연출 진행
    for i = 1, throw_num do
        character_util.set_anim(bari, {name = 'release', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle', sfx_name = '01_throw_01'})
        local throw_pos = self.flower_garden_center_pos

        local item = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = bari.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.25), target = throw_pos,
                                                 itemid = item_id, notforinven = true,
                                                 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', showoncharacter = false, sprscale = item_scale })

        while true do
            local dis = throw_pos:SqrDistance(item.Position)
            if dis < 0.1 then
                break
            end
            coroutine.yield(nil)
        end

        character_util.remove_anim(bari)
        drop_item_util.dispose_item(item)

        self:play_effects(effect_name)
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    self:nurture_complete_reaction()
end

-- 꽃밭 중심에서 밖으로 나아가는 이팩트 패턴
function local_class:spread_out_pattern(effect_name)
    local range = 1
    local cur_idx = 0
    local flowers = self.controller.flowers
    local flowers_num = table_util.get_size(flowers)
    local should_stop = false

    while true do
        for i = 1, range do
            local idx = i + cur_idx
            if idx > flowers_num then
                should_stop = true
                break
            end
            local fo = flowers[idx]
            local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(effect_name):Instantiate(fo.Position)
            table.insert(self.effects, effect)
        end
        if should_stop then
            break
        end
        cur_idx = range
        range = range + 4
        wait_for_sec(0.25)
    end
end

function local_class:play_effects(effect_name)
    if effect_name == self.water_splash_effect then
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dive_01')
        local effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(effect_name):Instantiate(self.flower_garden_center_pos)
        table.insert(self.effects, effect)
    elseif effect_name == self.soil_potion_effect then
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_get_heal_01')
        music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_magic_heal_02')
        self:spread_out_pattern(effect_name)
    end
end

	self.flower_girl.Interactable.Talk = 'shortstory_bari_main_s4_post_' .. ((erased > 0) and 0 or 1)

end

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.grave) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_grave, self))
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.portrait) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_portrait, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

			false, self.flower_girl)
	character_util.add_listener(self.flower_girl, self.controller)

	self.intro_flower_seen = false
	self.before_event = true

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == self.controller.quest_progress.InnerProgress then

	end

function local_class:start()

function local_class:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.flower_girl) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.flower_girl_s1, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent)) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'village_entrance' and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.bari) and self.before_event then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.block_entrance, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')

function local_class:start()

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s2', 7000501,
				false, self.girl_entrance)
	else
		self.girl_entrance.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.warm_effect)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.flower_girl_magic_end_effect)
end

function local_class:quest_check()
	local play_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000502)
	local painter_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000503)
	local president_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000504)

	if play_quest == nil or not play_quest.IsComplete then
		all_clear = false
	end
	if painter_quest == nil or not painter_quest.IsComplete then
		all_clear = false
	end

		all_clear = false

function local_class:exit()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent)) then
		if e.Params[0] == 'memory_scene_start' then
			-- Play Scene
			self.request_target = e.Sender
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.remove_scene, self))
			return true
		elseif e.Params[0] == 'quest_clear' then
			if self:quest_check() then
				self.girl_entrance.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s2', 7000501,
						false, self.girl_entrance)
				return true
			end
		elseif e.Params[0] == 'memory_scene_end' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.flower_girl) then
			self.external_memory_scene = false
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent)) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'flower_girl_entrance' and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.bari) then
			if not self:quest_check() then
				return false
			end
			if self.first_event then
				self.first_event = false
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.main_s2_0, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.flower_girl) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.main_s2_1, self)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.girl_entrance) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.girl_entrance_interact, self)
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.external_memory_scene then return false end
	if not self:quest_check() then return false end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s2', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('flower_girl_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s2', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('painter_house_exit'))

				false, get_field_object('friends_house_exit'))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.external_memory_scene then return false end

end

function local_class:remove_scene()
	local latest = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.controller.quest_progress, 'latest_cleared_quest')

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	if latest == nil or latest == -1 then
		yield_return_func(self.remove_pre_scene, self)
	elseif latest == 1 then
		yield_return_func(self.remove_play_scene, self)
	elseif latest == 2 then
		yield_return_func(self.remove_painter_scene, self)
	elseif latest == 3 then
		yield_return_func(self.remove_president_scene, self)
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryBariMainSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryBariMain @
		Comment = 바리 section 3 @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.talk_name = 'shortstory_bari_main_s3_'

	self.path_loop = false
	self.loop_reset_call = false

	self.after_loop = false

	self.flower_count = 0

	self.interact_flower_event = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PlayerGatherEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')

	self.bari = self.controller.bari()
	self.mayreel = self.controller.mayreel()
	self.flower_girl = self.controller.flower_girl()
	self.flower_interact = {
		get_field_object('edelweiss_1'),
		get_field_object('edelweiss_2'),
		get_field_object('edelweiss_3')}

	for i = 1, 3 do
		self.flower_interact[i].Position = self.flower_interact[i].Position + vector(0, 0.15, 0)
	end

	self.girl_entrance = get_field_object('flower_girl_house_entrance')
	self.girl_entrance_interactable = self.girl_entrance.Interactable
	self.girl_entrance.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	local entrance = field:GetMarker('path_entrance')

	character_util.set_position(self.flower_girl, entrance.position + vector(0, 0, 3))
	character_util.set_direction(self.flower_girl, 'down')

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s3', 7000501,
			false, self.flower_girl)
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.PlayerGatherEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'path_entrance' and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.bari) and not self.path_loop and e.FullEnter and not self.after_loop then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.main_s3_0, self)
		elseif e.Zone.Name == 'path_loop_zone' and
				lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.bari) and self.path_loop and e.FullEnter then
			self.loop_reset_call = true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.bari) and self.after_loop then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'path_entrance' then
				local threshold = field:GetMarker('path_entrance').position.z
				if self.bari.Position.z > threshold then
					self.controller.next_bgm_queue = 'mute'
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.update_bgm, self.controller))
				else
					self.controller.next_bgm_queue = 'field'
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.update_bgm, self.controller))
				end
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'edelweiss_exit' then
				local threshold = field:GetMarker('path_end_point').position.z + 4.5
				if self.bari.Position.z > threshold then
					self.controller.next_bgm_queue = 'flower'
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.update_bgm, self.controller))
				else
					self.controller.next_bgm_queue = 'mute'
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.update_bgm, self.controller))
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.PlayerGatherEvent) then
		for i = 1, 3 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Gatherable, self.flower_interact[i]) then
				self:get_flower(i)
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.girl_entrance) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(field_ui_util.show_narration_async, {key = self.talk_name .. 'house'})
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') then
		if self.interact_flower_event then
			for i = 1, #self.flower_interact do
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('bari_main_s3_' .. i)
			end
		end
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s3', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('flower_girl_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') then
		if self.interact_flower_event then
			for i = 1, #self.flower_interact do
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('bari_main_s3_' .. i)
			end
		end
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s3', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('painter_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
		if self.interact_flower_event then
			for i = 1, #self.flower_interact do
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('bari_main_s3_' .. i)
			end
		end
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s3', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('friends_house_exit'))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') or
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') or
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
		if self.interact_flower_event then
			for i = 1, #self.flower_interact do
				if self.flower_interact[i].ActiveState ~= CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
					ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s3_' .. i, 7000501,
							false, self.flower_interact[i])
				end
			end
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('bari_main_s3')
		else
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s3', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, self.flower_girl)
		end
	end
end

	self.flower_count =	self.flower_count + 1

	character_util.set_anim(self.bari, {name = 'walk', loop = true, scale = 0.7})
	character_util.set_anim(self.flower_girl, {name = 'walk', loop = true, scale = 0.7})
	character_util.set_anim(self.mayreel, {name = 'walk', loop = true, scale = 0.7})
	character_util.set_direction(self.bari, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(self.flower_girl, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(self.mayreel, 'up')
	local end_pos = field:GetMarker('loop_end_point').position
	while self.path_loop do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if self.bari.Position.z >= end_pos.z then
			self:reset_positions(self.bari.Position.z - end_pos.z)
		else
			character_util.set_position(self.bari, self.bari.Position + vector(0, 0, 2 * dt))
			character_util.set_position(self.flower_girl, self.flower_girl.Position + vector(0, 0, 2 * dt))
			character_util.set_position(self.mayreel, self.mayreel.Position + vector(0, 0, 2 * dt))
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.bari)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.flower_girl)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.mayreel)
end

function local_class:reset_positions(dt)
	dt = lua_helper.get_or_default(dt, 0)
	local loop_pos = field:GetMarker('path_loop_point').position
	character_util.set_position(self.bari, loop_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, dt))
	character_util.set_position(self.flower_girl, loop_pos + vector(0.5, 0, dt))
	character_util.set_position(self.mayreel, loop_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -1.2 + dt))
	camera_util.move_async(self.bari.Position, 0, {end_target = self.bari, ignorecameragrids = true})
	self.loop_reset_call = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.bari) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'altar_zone' and self.first_event then
				self.first_event = false
				self.mayreel_run = false
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.main_s4_0, self))
				return true
			end
			if e.Zone.Name == 'edelweiss_exit' and self.mayreel_run and self.first_event then
				self.mayreel_run = false
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mayreel_first, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if e.FullLeave and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.bari) and self.first_event then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'path_entrance' then
				local threshold = field:GetMarker('path_entrance').position.z
				if self.bari.Position.z > threshold then
					self.controller.next_bgm_queue = 'mute'
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.update_bgm, self.controller))
				else
					self.controller.next_bgm_queue = 'field'
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.update_bgm, self.controller))
				end
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'edelweiss_exit' and not self.mayreel_run then
				local threshold = field:GetMarker('path_end_point').position.z + 4.5
				if self.bari.Position.z > threshold then
					self.controller.next_bgm_queue = 'flower'
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.update_bgm, self.controller))
				else
					self.controller.next_bgm_queue = 'mute'
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.update_bgm, self.controller))
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if self.on_going_event then return end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.grave) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_grave, self))
			return true
		end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.portrait) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_portrait, self))
			return true
		end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.flower_girl) then
			if not self.mayreel_run then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.main_s4_pre, self))
			end
			return true
		end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.girl_entrance) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(field_ui_util.show_narration_async, {key = 'shortstory_bari_main_s3_house'})
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s4_end', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('flower_girl_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s4_end', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('painter_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s4_end', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('friends_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'final_grid') then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('bari_main_s4_end')
		if not self.seen_grave then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s4_grave', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, self.grave)
		end

			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s4_portrait', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, self.portrait)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') or
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') or
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
		if not self.mayreel_run and self.first_event then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s4_end', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, self.flower_girl)
		else
			if self.first_event then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('bari_main_s4_end', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
						false, self.mayreel)
			else
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('bari_main_s4_end', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, self.grave.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))
			end
		end
	end
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'final_grid') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('bari_main_s4_end', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, self.grave.Position + vector(1, 0, 0))
		if not self.seen_grave then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('bari_main_s4_grave')
		end
		if not self.seen_portrait then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('bari_main_s4_portrait')
		end
	end
end

		return (math.cos((t - s) / d * math.pi) + 1) / 2
	end

	local ease_out = function(t, s, d)
		return (math.cos(math.pi * ((t - s) / d + 1)) + 1) / 2
	end

	local ease_inout = function(progress)
		return (1 - math.cos(progress * math.pi)) / 2
	end

function local_class:let_memoir_go(t, index, pos, act_set)
	if act_set == nil then
		t[index] = self:let_memoir_only(pos)
	else
		self:let_memoir_go_routine(t, index, pos,
				table.unpack(act_set))

	end
end

function local_class:let_memoir_only(pos)
	local memory_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_bari_memory_light_start'):Instantiate(pos + vector(0, 1, 0))
	memory_fx.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)

	return memory_fx
end

function local_class:str_to_vector(direction_str)
	if type_util.is_string(direction_str) then
		if direction_str == 'left' then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Left
		elseif direction_str == 'right' then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Right
		elseif direction_str == 'up' then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		elseif direction_str == 'down' then
			return CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		else
			return CS.Oak.Direction.None
		end
	end
end

function local_class:let_memoir_go_routine(table, index, pos, bari_anim, bari_emo, bari_dir, helena_anim, helena_emo, helena_dir, pos_dir, life_time)
	local count = 0
	for _, _ in pairs(self.optimized_bari) do
		count = count + 1
	end
	local ii = index
	while ii > count do ii = ii - count end
	local bari = self.optimized_bari['bari_' .. ii]
	local helena = self.optimized_helena['helena_' .. ii]
	local bari_pos = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(self:str_to_vector(pos_dir)) * 0.5
	local helena_pos = CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(self:str_to_vector(pos_dir)) * -0.5
	life_time = lua_helper.get_or_default(life_time, 0.5)

	bari.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	helena.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(bari, {name = bari_anim}, {name = bari_emo})
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(helena, {name = helena_anim}, {name = helena_emo})
	character_util.set_direction(bari, bari_dir)
	character_util.set_direction(helena, helena_dir)
	bari.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false
	helena.SpineController.IsShadowActive = false

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(bari, { 'start_field_fade', 'immediate'}))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(helena, { 'start_field_fade', 'immediate'}))
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(bari, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(helena, 0, 0)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	bari.Position = pos + bari_pos
	helena.Position = pos + helena_pos

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(bari, 1, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(helena, 1, 1)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(bari, { 'start_field_sepia', '1'}))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(helena, { 'start_field_sepia', '1'}))

	wait_for_sec(1 + life_time)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_flower_ball_02', 0.7)
	local memory_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_bari_memory_light_start'):Instantiate(pos + vector(0, 1, 0))
	memory_fx.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(bari, 0, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(helena, 0, 1)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(bari, { 'end_field_sepia', '1'}))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(helena, { 'end_field_sepia', '1'}))

	table[index] = memory_fx
end

function local_class:pray_granted(memory_fx, t)
	local duration = lua_helper.get_or_default(t, 3)
	local timer = 0
	local origin = memory_fx.transform.position
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_flower_ball_03', 0.7)
	while timer < duration do
		memory_fx.transform.position = origin + vector(0, 1, 0) * timer * timer
		memory_fx.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) * (duration - timer) / duration
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	memory_fx:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class
