local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryBariPainterPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = ShortStoryBariPainter @
		Comment = 바리 pre @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.talk_name = 'shortstory_bari_painter_pre_'

	self.after_pre_event = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent), 'minigame_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'minigame_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	self.painter = self.controller.painter()

	self.bari = self.controller.bari()
	self.mayreel = self.controller.mayreel()
end

function local_class:start()
	local painter_pos = field:GetMarker('painter_pos').position
	local painter = self.controller.painter()

	self.main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000501)
	if self.main_quest ~= nil and self.main_quest.InnerProgress == 1 then
		-- PS-6463 관련으로 self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId에서 메인 퀘스트 아이디인 7000501로 변경.
		-- 스테이지 맵에 표시되는 마커들은 해당 마커를 사용하는 퀘스트가 활성화 되어 퀘스트 프로그래스가 존재하는 경우에만 생성된다.
		-- 따라서 Pre 섹션일 경우, 미니맵과 스테이지에는 마커가 표시 되지만, 스테이지 맵에는 표시 되지 않는다.
		-- 다른 서브 퀘스트에서 아래 코드를 복붙하고 변형해서 사용할 때에는, 해당 퀘스트 ID로 넘겨 주어야한다.
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('painter_quest_pre', 7000501,
				false, self.painter)
	end

	character_util.set_position(painter, painter_pos + vector(0, 0, -1), false)

	character_util.set_direction(painter, 'down')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent), 'minigame_start_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'minigame_end_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:minigame_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == 'mayreel_trampoline_game' then
		if self.after_pre_event then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('painter_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, get_field_object('painter_house_entrance'))
		else
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('painter_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, self.painter)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:minigame_start_event(e)
	if e.Name == 'mayreel_trampoline_game' then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('painter_quest_pre')
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) and not e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.mayreel) and e.Zone.Name == 'painter_zone' and not self.after_pre_event then
			self.after_pre_event = true
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.painter_pre_0, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('painter_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, get_field_object('flower_girl_house_exit'))
		end
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('painter_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, self.painter)
		end
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('painter_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, get_field_object('friends_house_exit'))
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
		if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') or
				type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') or
				type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
			if self.after_pre_event then
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('painter_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
						false, get_field_object('painter_house_entrance'))
			else
				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('painter_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
						false, self.painter)
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.painter) then

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.painter_pre_1, self))
		end
	end
	return false
end

	self.mayreel = self.controller.mayreel()

function local_class:minigame_end_event(e)

	end

function local_class:minigame_start_event(e)
	if e.Name == 'mayreel_trampoline_game' then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('painter_quest_pre')
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) and self.qte_result == self.qte_result_type.waiting then
		if self.qte_status == self.qte_type.touch then
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown then
				self.touch_count = self.touch_count + 1
				self:painter_action()
				if self.touch_count >= self.touch_goal then
					self.qte_result = self.qte_result_type.success
				end
				return true
			end
		else
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
				if self.qte_status == self.qte_type.left then
					self.qte_result = self.qte_result_type.success
				else
					self.qte_result = self.qte_result_type.fail
				end
				return true
			elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
				if self.qte_status == self.qte_type.right then
					self.qte_result = self.qte_result_type.success
				else
					self.qte_result = self.qte_result_type.fail
				end
				return true
			elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
				if self.qte_status == self.qte_type.up then
					self.qte_result = self.qte_result_type.success
				else
					self.qte_result = self.qte_result_type.fail
				end
				return true
			elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
				if self.qte_status == self.qte_type.down then
					self.qte_result = self.qte_result_type.success
				else
					self.qte_result = self.qte_result_type.fail
				end
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.painter) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.painting_scene, self, false))
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if self.on_drawing_event then return false end
		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'painter_house' then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('painter_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, self.painter)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
		if self.on_drawing_event then return false end
		if e.CameraGrid.name == 'painter_house' then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('painter_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, self.painter_entrance)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent)) then
		if e.Params[0] == 'memory_scene_end' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.painter) then
			self.external_memory_scene = false
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:qte_wait(duration)
	self.qte_result = self.qte_result_type.waiting
	self.on_qte_event = true
	self.touch_count = 0

	local limit = lua_helper.get_or_default(duration, self.qte_default_time_limit)
	local timer = 0

	while self.qte_result == self.qte_result_type.waiting do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		if timer > limit then
			self.qte_result = self.qte_result_type.fail
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.qte_status = self.qte_type.none
	self.on_qte_event = false
end

function local_class:set_animation_n_times_then_async(target, data)
    local name = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'name')
    local scale = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'scale', 1)
    local count = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'count', 1)
    local delay = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'delay', 0)
    local upper = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'upper', false)
    local sfx = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'sfx') -- 애니메이션 키 프레임 마다 호출될 sfx명 혹은 콜백 함수
    local keep_anim = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'keep_anim', false)
    local after_anim = lua_helper.get_value(data, 'after_anim', nil)

    if name == nil then return end

    local anim_duration = spine_util.get_animation_duration(target, name) / scale

    character_util.set_anim(target, { name = name, loop = count > 1, scale = scale, sfx_name = sfx, upper = upper })

    for _ = 1, count do
        coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(anim_duration))
    end

    if not keep_anim then
        character_util.remove_anim(target, upper)
    end

    if delay > 0 then
        coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(delay))
    end

    if after_anim ~= nil then
        character_util.set_anim(target, { name = after_anim })
    end
end

function local_class:get_fixed_camera_pos_during_ally_event()
    local fixed_y = 0
    local screen_size = CS.ScreenUtil.GetMainGameViewSize()
    local width = screen_size.x
    local height = screen_size.y
    local ratio = width / height
    width = ratio * 9
    height = ratio * 9

    if ratio >= 16/9 then
        return vector(84.5 + (21 - width) * 0.5, fixed_y, -55.5)
    else
        return vector(87, fixed_y, -55.5)
    end

    party_util.align_to_target(foreigner, 'up')

    -- bari_foreigner : 우리 귀여운 애기들한테 어떻게 그런…

function local_class:plant_attack_mayreel()

    local plant = self.get_plant(1)

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_02')
    character_util.set_anim(plant, { name = 'attack', loop = false })
    wait_for_sec(0.693)
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_01')
    character_util.spine_pulse_color(mayreel, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.667)
    character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(mayreel)
    character_util.spine_damage_squish(mayreel, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.33)
    character_util.normal_jump(mayreel, '01_small_jump_01')
    wait_for_sec(0.3)
    character_util.set_anim(self.get_plant(1), { name = 'idle' })
end

function local_class:plant_attack_foreigner()
    local foreigner = self.get_foreigner()

    -- spine_damage_red_pulse 쓰면 화면에 나올 때까지 안보임.
    -- spine_pulse_color 사용해서 임의로 유지 시간 길게 해줘야함.
    character_util.spine_pulse_color(foreigner, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.667)
    character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(foreigner)
    character_util.spine_damage_squish(foreigner, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

    character_util.set_emotion(foreigner, { name = 'damaged' })
    character_util.set_anim(foreigner, { name = 'katana_damaged' })

    local knock_back_info = CS.Oak.KnockBackInfo()
    knock_back_info.type = CS.Oak.KnockBackType.Physics
    knock_back_info.stun = true
    knock_back_info.direction = vector(-1, 0, 0)
    knock_back_info.impactForce = 15000
    knock_back_info.impactTime = 0.05
    knock_back_info.muCoefficient = CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient

    local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(foreigner, knock_back_info)
    foreigner.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_creature_01')

    foreigner.SpineController:Shake(0.1, 0.9)
end

function local_class:pick_up_plant(target, destination)
    local duration = 0.25
    local time_passed = 0
    local target_origin_pos = target.Position
    local origin_size = 0.3
    local target_size = 0

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
    while (time_passed < duration) do
        local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInQuad(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
        local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(target_origin_pos, destination, progress)
        local current_size = origin_size * (1 - progress) + target_size * progress;

        target.Position = current_pos

        character_util.set_scale_factor(target, 'inhale', current_size);

        time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end
    local bari = user_party.Leader
    local dummy_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
            { pos = target.Position, target = bari.Position,
              itemid = 20333, notforinven = true, sprscale = 0, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
    dummy_item.ConsumeTarget = bari

    character_util.set_active_state(target, 'disabled')
    character_util.set_position(target, vector(999, 0, 999))
    character_util.remove_scale_factor(target, 'inhale')
    character_util.remove_scale_factor(target, 'magic')

    wait_for_sec(0.3)
    dummy_item:ConsumeComplete()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryBariPlayPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = ShortStoryBariPlay @
		Comment = 바리 pre @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.talk_name = 'shortstory_bari_play_pre_'

	self.first_talk = true

	self.shop = nil
	self.external_memory_scene = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'external_scene_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	local sis_pos = field:GetMarker('sister_pos').position
	local bro_pos = field:GetMarker('brother_pos').position
	local sister = self.controller.sister()
	local brother = self.controller.brother()
	self.shop = get_field_object('shop_interact')

	self.main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000501)
	if self.main_quest ~= nil and self.main_quest.InnerProgress == 1 then
		-- PS-6463 관련으로 self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId에서 메인 퀘스트 아이디인 7000501로 변경.
		-- 스테이지 맵에 표시되는 마커들은 해당 마커를 사용하는 퀘스트가 활성화 되어 퀘스트 프로그래스가 존재하는 경우에만 생성된다.
		-- 따라서 Pre 섹션일 경우, 미니맵과 스테이지에는 마커가 표시 되지만, 스테이지 맵에는 표시 되지 않는다.
		-- 다른 서브 퀘스트에서 아래 코드를 복붙하고 변형해서 사용할 때에는, 해당 퀘스트 ID로 넘겨주자.
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('play_quest_pre', 7000501,
				false, self.shop)
	end

	character_util.set_position(sister, sis_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5), false)
	character_util.set_position(brother, bro_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5), false)
	self.shop.Position = sis_pos + vector(0, 0, -1)

	character_util.set_direction(sister, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(brother, 'left')

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(brother, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'damaged'})

	self.shop.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'external_scene_event')

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if e.Target == self.shop then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sister_s1, self))
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:external_scene_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent)) then
		if e.Params[0] == 'memory_scene_start' then
			self.external_memory_scene = true
			return true
		elseif e.Params[0] == 'memory_scene_end' then
			self.external_memory_scene = false
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.external_memory_scene then return false end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('play_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('flower_girl_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('play_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('painter_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('play_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('friends_house_exit'))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.external_memory_scene then return false end
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') or
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') or
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('play_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, self.shop)
	end
end

function local_class:sister_s1()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('play_quest_pre')

	local sister = self.controller.sister()
	local brother = self.controller.brother()

	local bari = self.controller.bari()
	local mayreel = self.controller.mayreel()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(sister, self.controller)

	character_util.move_to(bari, self.shop.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 1, nil, true, true)
	character_util.move_to_async(mayreel, self.shop.Position + vector(1, 0, -1.5), 1, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(bari, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(mayreel, 'up')

	if self.first_talk then
		-- 어서오세요! 꽃잎 레몬 쥬스가 30골드랍니다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_emotion(sister, {name = 'smile'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sister, {key = self.talk_name .. 0, skip = true})

		-- 놀자아~! 누나랑 놀고 싶단 말이야~~~!!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(brother, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'damaged'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(brother, {key = self.talk_name .. 1, skip = true})

		-- 손님 계신 거 안 보여? 너 진짜 혼난다!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		character_util.set_direction(sister, 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(sister, {name = 'tired'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sister, {key = self.talk_name .. 2, skip = true})

		-- 놀자! 놀자! 놀자! 놀자아아아~!!!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')
		character_util.normal_double_jump(brother, true)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(brother, {key = self.talk_name .. 3, skip = true})

		-- 어후! 얘 관심 좀 다른 데로 돌려줬으면 소원이 없겠네!
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		character_util.set_direction(sister, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(sister, {name = 'damaged'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sister, {key = self.talk_name .. 4, skip = true})

		character_util.show_emoticon_async(bari, nil, 'question')

		-- 혹시 그 소원…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bari, {key = self.talk_name .. 5, skip = true})

		-- 행복한 추억을 대가로 지불할 수 있을 정도로 간절한가요?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bari, {key = self.talk_name .. 6, skip = true})

		-- 아, 물론이죠. 저 지금 폭발하기 일보직전이거든요.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(sister, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(sister, {name = 'attack'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sister, {key = self.talk_name .. 7, skip = true})

		-- 그렇다면…
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sister)
		character_util.set_direction(bari, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(mayreel, 'left')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bari, {key = self.talk_name .. 8, skip = true})

		self.first_talk = false
	end

	-- 선택지 : 소원을 들어준다.(이벤트 이어짐) / 거절한다. (대화 종료)
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({{self.talk_name..9, 'mercy'}, {self.talk_name..10, 'normal'}})

	if result == 2 then
		character_util.set_direction(sister, 'down')
		character_util.set_direction(brother, 'left')

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sister)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(brother, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'damaged'})

		character_util.add_listener(self.controller.sister(), self.controller)

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('play_quest_pre', 7000501,
				false, sister)

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()

		return
	end

	-- 어?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(brother, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(brother)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(brother, {key = self.talk_name .. 11, skip = true})

	character_util.set_direction(bari, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(mayreel, 'right')

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(brother,  {
		vector(brother.Position.x, 0, mayreel.Position.z),
		mayreel.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0)}, 3, true, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(brother, true)

	-- 우와아, 귀여워라! 엄청 폭신폭신해!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_interact_tree_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(brother, {name = 'shoot'}, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.shake(mayreel, 0.03, 0.3)

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryBariPlaySection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryBariPlay @
		Comment = 바리 section 1 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.talk_name = 'shortstory_bari_play_1_'

	self.minigame_clear = false

	self.external_memory_scene = false

	self.marker_pos = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'external_scene_event')

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_starpiece_in_character')

	local center = field:GetZone('trampoline_goal').Bounds.center
	self.marker_pos = vector(center.x, 0, center.z)

	-- 퀘스트 최초 진행시
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 0 then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent.Create('mayreel_trampoline_game'))
		return
	end

	self:set_kid()

	local sis_pos = field:GetMarker('sister_pos').position
	local sister = self.controller.sister()
	local brother = self.controller.brother()

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('play_quest_pre', 7000502,
			false, brother)

	character_util.set_position(sister, sis_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5), false)

	character_util.set_direction(sister, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(brother, 'right')

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(brother, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'tired'})
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'external_scene_event')

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent)) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.brother()) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.brother_s2, self))
			--self:release_kid()
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.sister()) and self.minigame_clear then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.sister_s3, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent)) then
		if e.Name == 'mayreel_trampoline_game' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.minigame_end_event, self, e))
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent)) then
		if e.Params[0] == 'memory_scene_end' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.controller.sister()) then
			self.external_memory_scene = false
		elseif e.Params[0] == 'pre_play_scene_start' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.minigame_pre_play_scene, self, e))
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:external_scene_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent)) then
		if e.Params[0] == 'memory_scene_start' then
			self.external_memory_scene = true
			return true
		elseif e.Params[0] == 'memory_scene_end' then
			self.external_memory_scene = false
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:minigame_end_event(e)
	local brother = self.controller.brother()
	local mayreel = get_character('mayreel')
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(brother, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(mayreel, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
	quest_marker_util.remove('flower_garden_center')

	if e.Success then
		self:release_kid()
		party_util.align_to_target(brother, 'left', 0, 'linear')
		self.minigame_clear = true
		character_util.add_listener(self.controller.sister(), self.controller)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.sister_s2, self))
	else
		self:set_kid()
		party_util.align_to_target(brother, 'down', 0, 'linear')
		camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('play_quest_pre', 7000502,
				false, brother)

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black)
		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.external_memory_scene then return false end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('play_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('flower_girl_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('play_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('painter_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('play_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('friends_house_exit'))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.external_memory_scene then return false end
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') or
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') or
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
		if self.minigame_clear then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('play_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, self.controller.sister())
		else
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('play_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, self.controller.brother())
		end
	end
end

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(sister, { 'end_field_fade'}))
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	--바리 (right, sleep_deep -> idle) : 끝났습니다…
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bari)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bari, {key = self.talk_name .. 35, skip = true})

	--셴시 소녀 (left, question) : 으음… 뭐가 변했는지 모르겠지만…
	character_util.set_emotion(sister, {name = 'idle'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sister, {key = self.talk_name .. 36, skip = true})

	--셴시 소녀 (left, smile) : 소원 이뤄주셔서 감사합니다.
	character_util.set_emotion(sister, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sister, {key = self.talk_name .. 37, skip = true})

	--꼬마 (left, smile) : 폭신폭신한 양아, 아까 나랑 놀아줘서 고마워!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(kid, {key = self.talk_name .. 38, skip = true})

	--메이릴 (frown) : 힘줄 말풍선
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bari)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sister)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid)
	character_util.set_emotion(sister, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.set_emotion(kid, {name = 'smile'})

	---바리 뒤로 물러나며 셴시 소녀가 다시 가판대에 서고,
	--바리는 컨트롤 풀리며 이벤트 종료.

	party_util.align_party(bari.Position, 'down', 1, 'linear')
	character_util.move_to(kid, kid.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), nil, 3, true, true)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(sister, {
		sister.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
		sis_pos,
		sis_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
	},3, false, nil, nil, 'down')

	if choose_result == 1 then
		character_util.set_emotion(sister, { name = 'tired' })
	end

	for _, npc in ipairs(extras_1) do
		npc.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	end

	for _, npc in ipairs(extras_2) do
		npc.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	end

	helena.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	sister.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	kid.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	bari.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	mayreel.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false

	sister.Interactable.Talk = 'shortstory_bari_play_post_0'

	local qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000501)
	quest_util.set_custom_state(qp, 'latest_cleared_quest', 1)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, choose_result - 1)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryBariPresidentPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = ShortStoryBariPresident @
		Comment = 바리 pre @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.talk_name = 'shortstory_bari_president_pre_'

	self.on_first_talk = true
	self.external_memory_scene = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent), 'minigame_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'minigame_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'external_scene_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	self.president = self.controller.president()
	self.bari = self.controller.bari()
	self.mayreel = self.controller.mayreel()
	self.greedy_man = self.controller.greedy_man()
	self.greedy_woman = self.controller.greedy_woman()

	self.greedy_man.Interactable.Talk = 'shortstory_bari_president_s1_0_2'
	self.greedy_woman.Interactable.Talk = 'shortstory_bari_president_s1_0_1'

	character_util.add_listener(self.president, self.controller)
end

function local_class:start()
	local president_pos = field:GetMarker('president_pos').position
	local greedy_pos = field:GetMarker('greedy_pos').position

	self.main_quest = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000501)
	if self.main_quest ~= nil and  self.main_quest.InnerProgress == 1 then
		-- PS-6463 관련으로 self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId에서 메인 퀘스트 아이디인 7000501로 변경.
		-- 스테이지 맵에 표시되는 마커들은 해당 마커를 사용하는 퀘스트가 활성화 되어 퀘스트 프로그래스가 존재하는 경우에만 생성된다.
		-- 따라서 Pre 섹션일 경우, 미니맵과 스테이지에는 마커가 표시 되지만, 스테이지 맵에는 표시 되지 않는다.
		-- 다른 서브 퀘스트에서 아래 코드를 복붙하고 변형해서 사용할 때에는, 해당 퀘스트 ID로 넘겨 주어야한다.
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_pre', 7000501,
				false, self.president)
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.president, president_pos, false)
	character_util.set_direction(self.president, 'down')

	character_util.set_position(self.greedy_woman, greedy_pos, false)
	character_util.set_direction(self.greedy_woman, 'up')
	character_util.set_position(self.greedy_man, greedy_pos + vector(3.5, 0, 0), false)
	character_util.set_direction(self.greedy_man, 'right')

	local pickAxeName = 'pickaxe_bronze_sword'

	self.greedy_man.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', pickAxeName)
	--self.greedy_man:HideWeapon(true)
	--self.greedy_man:HideWeapon(false)

	character_util.set_anim(self.greedy_man, { name = 'twohand_attack', scale = 1, sfx_name = '01_interact_tree_01' })

	--self.bari.Position = self.president.Position + vector(2, 0, -2)
	--self.mayreel.Position = self.president.Position + vector(1, 0, -2)
end


function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent), 'minigame_start_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'minigame_end_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'external_scene_event')

end

function local_class:minigame_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == 'mayreel_trampoline_game' then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, self.president)
	end
end

function local_class:minigame_start_event(e)
	if e.Name == 'mayreel_trampoline_game' then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('president_quest_pre')
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.president) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.president_pre_s0, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:external_scene_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent)) then
		if e.Params[0] == 'memory_scene_start' then
			self.external_memory_scene = true
			return true
		elseif e.Params[0] == 'memory_scene_end' then
			self.external_memory_scene = false
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.external_memory_scene then return false end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('flower_girl_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('painter_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('friends_house_exit'))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.external_memory_scene then return false end
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') or
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') or
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, self.president)
	end
end


function local_class:president_pre_s0()

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.president, self.controller)
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('president_quest_pre')

	character_util.set_direction(self.president, 'right')
	party_util.align_to_target(self.president, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	if self.on_first_talk then
		local entrance = field:GetMarker('president_traveler_entrance').position
		local guard_pos = field:GetMarker('guard_pos').position
		local spot = field:GetMarker('president_traveler_spot').position
		local traveler_1 = get_character('travelers_3')
		local traveler_2 = get_character('travelers_4')
		traveler_1.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'camera')

		traveler_1.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
		traveler_2.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

		--촌장 : 헬레나에 오신 걸 환영합니다. 저는 이 마을의 촌장입니다.
		character_util.set_emotion(self.president, {name = 'smile'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.president, {key = self.talk_name .. 0, skip = true})

		--바리 : 정말 아름다운 마을이네요, 촌장님.
		local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_02', loop = true})
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.bari, {name = 'clap', sfx_name = '01_clap_02' }, {name = 'smile'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.bari, {key = self.talk_name .. 1, skip = true})
		clap_sfx:Stop()

		--촌장 : 원래부터 아름다웠던 건 아니었습니다.
		character_util.remove_anim(self.bari)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.president)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.president, {key = self.talk_name .. 2, skip = true})

		--촌장 : 오래 전엔 꽃도 볼거리도 없는, 초라한 마을이었죠…
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.president)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.president, {key = self.talk_name .. 3, skip = true})

		--바리 (left, surprised) : 마을에 꽃이 없었다고요…?
		character_util.set_emotion(self.bari, {name = 'tired'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.bari, {key = self.talk_name .. 4, skip = true})

		--촌장 (right, smile) : 네. 이 꽃들은 전부 한 사람이 오랜 세월 심고 가꾼 겁니다.
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.president, {name = 'nod', count = 1})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.president, {key = self.talk_name .. 5, skip = true})

		local move_end = false
		character_util.set_position(traveler_1, entrance + vector(-1, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_position(traveler_2, entrance)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_to(traveler_1, vector(traveler_1.Position.x, 0, guard_pos.z),
					2, nil, true, true)
			character_util.move_to_async(traveler_2, vector(traveler_2.Position.x, 0, guard_pos.z),
					2, nil, true, true)
			move_end = true
		end))

		--촌장 (left, smile) : 아무것도 없던 마을이 그분의 꽃밭으로 유명해져서, 지금 같은 관광지가 된 거죠.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.president, {key = self.talk_name .. 6, skip = true})

		--촌장 (right) : 그래서 마을 이름도 그분의 이름을 따서…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.president, {key = self.talk_name .. 7, skip = true})

		--바리 (left) : 헬레나…
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.bari)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.bari, {key = self.talk_name .. 8, skip = true})

		--region 관광객 NPC 이벤트

		local crowd_buzz = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true})
		camera_util.move_async(spot, 1)

		while not move_end do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end


		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(traveler_1, {name = 'dualgun_attack', loop = false}, {name = 'idle'})
		character_util.set_direction(traveler_1, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(traveler_2, 'left')

		character_util.set_emotion(traveler_1, {name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_emotion(traveler_2, {name = 'smile'})

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim(traveler_1)

		character_util.move_to(traveler_1, traveler_1.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 1, nil, true, true)
		local kid_dash = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true})
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(traveler_2, {
			vector(traveler_2.Position.x, 0, spot.z), spot }, 5, nil, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
		kid_dash:FadeOut()
		character_util.set_direction(traveler_1, 'up')

		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(traveler_1, {name = 'cast', loop = false}, {name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(traveler_2, {name = 'get', loop = false}, {name = 'smile'})

		-- TODO: 사진찍는 이펙트 있으면 좋을듯? 혹은 SFX 로도 충분할수도
		wait_for_sec(0.7)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_shutter_01')
		screen_util.fade_in_async(0.2, unity_color({1, 1, 1, 0.35}))
		wait_for_sec(0.7)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(traveler_1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(traveler_2)

		kid_dash = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true})
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(traveler_2, {
			spot + vector(1, 0, 0),
			traveler_1.Position + vector(1, 0, 0) },
				5, nil, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
		kid_dash:FadeOut()
		character_util.set_direction(traveler_1, 'right')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(traveler_1, {name = 'dualgun_attack', loop = false}, {name = 'idle'})
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(traveler_2, {name = 'question', loop = false, sfX_name = '01_rustle_01'}, {name = 'idle'})

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.set_emotion(traveler_1, {name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_emotion(traveler_2, {name = 'smile'})

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(traveler_1, {name = 'success', count = 2, sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01'})
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(traveler_2, {name = 'success', count = 2})

		character_util.remove_anim(traveler_1)
		character_util.remove_anim(traveler_2)

		move_end = false

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_to(traveler_1, traveler_1.Position + vector(-8, 0, 0),
					1.5, nil, true, true)
			character_util.move_to_async(traveler_2, traveler_2.Position + vector(-8, 0, 0),
					1.5, nil, true, true)
			move_end = true
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(traveler_1)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(traveler_2)
		end))

		camera_util.move_async(self.bari.Position, 1, {end_target = self.bari})
		crowd_buzz:FadeOut(2.0)

		--endregion
		local travelers = {traveler_1, traveler_2}

		-- 촌장 : 제 기억에, 그분은 잃어버린 가족을 위해 꽃을 심었다고 들었습니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.president, {key = self.talk_name .. 9, skip = true})

		-- 촌장 (left, smile) : 꽃을 보고 언젠가 잃어버린 가족이 찾아오길 바랐죠.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.president, {key = self.talk_name .. 10, skip = true})

		-- 바리 : 그랬군요…
		character_util.set_emotion(self.bari, {name = 'tired'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.bari, {key = self.talk_name .. 11, skip = true})

		-- 촌장 : 하지만 마을이 유명해지니 탐욕스러운 자들이 나타나는군요.
		character_util.set_emotion(self.bari, {name = 'tired'})
		character_util.set_direction(self.president, 'left')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.president, {key = self.talk_name .. 12, skip = true})

		--카메라 이동해서, 이번에는 반대편에서 사진 찍는 관광객을 비춤.
		while not move_end do

function local_class:item_push(item, distance, duration)
	local origin = item.Position
	local timer = 0

	while timer < duration do
		item.Position = origin + distance * (timer / duration)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	item.Position = origin + distance
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

function local_class:item_push(item, distance, duration)
	local origin = item.Position
	local timer = 0

	while timer < duration do
		item.Position = origin + distance * (timer / duration)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	item.Position = origin + distance
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:external_scene_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent)) then
		if e.Params[0] == 'memory_scene_start' then
			self.external_memory_scene = true
			return true
		elseif e.Params[0] == 'memory_scene_end' then
			self.external_memory_scene = false
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.external_memory_scene then return false end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('flower_girl_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('painter_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('friends_house_exit'))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.external_memory_scene then return false end
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') or
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') or
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
		if self.first_talk then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, self.greedy_woman)
		else
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_pre', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
					false, self.shop_interact)
		end
	end
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryBariPresidentSection4')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryBariPresident @
		Comment = 바리 section 4 @
		Index = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.talk_name = 'shortstory_bari_president_s4_'
	self.external_memory_scene = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent), 'minigame_start_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'minigame_end_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')
	self.president = self.controller.president()
	self.bari = self.controller.bari()
	self.mayreel = self.controller.mayreel()
	self.greedy_man = self.controller.greedy_man()
	self.greedy_woman = self.controller.greedy_woman()

	local president_pos = field:GetMarker('president_pos').position

	character_util.set_position(self.president, president_pos, false)
	character_util.set_direction(self.president, 'down')

	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_s4', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
			false, self.president)
	character_util.add_listener(self.president, self.controller)
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameStartEvent), 'minigame_start_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.MiniGameEndEvent), 'minigame_end_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')

end

function local_class:minigame_end_event(e)
	if e.Name == 'mayreel_trampoline_game' then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_s4', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, self.president)
	end
end

function local_class:minigame_start_event(e)
	if e.Name == 'mayreel_trampoline_game' then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('president_quest_s4')
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.president) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.president_s4_0, self)
		end
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent)) then
		if e.Params[0] == 'memory_scene_end' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.president) then
			self.external_memory_scene = false
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if self.external_memory_scene then return false end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_s4', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('flower_girl_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_s4', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('painter_house_exit'))
	end
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_s4', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, get_field_object('friends_house_exit'))
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if self.external_memory_scene then return false end
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'flower_girl_house') or
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'painter_house') or
			type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'sick_friend_house') then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('president_quest_s4', self.controller.quest_spec.QuestId,
				false, self.president)
	end
end

	character_util.set_anim(helena, {name = 'idle', loop = false})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--
	--위 대사와 행동 완료되면 카메라가 다시 바리를 중심으로 이동. (또는 줌인)
	--나레이션 박스 : 어쩌면 중요한 기억일지도 모른다. 정말 대가로 받아도 될까?
	--선택지A : 세계수를 되살리는 것이 임무, 상관없다.
	--선택지B : 기억을 대신 지불한다.
	--


	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()

	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "SetNarration",
			game_string:GetString(self.talk_name .. 15), 0, 0)


	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { self.talk_name .. 16, 'normal' }, {self.talk_name .. 17, 'normal'} })

	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "HideAnimation")

	--선택지A 연출 : 바리 그대로 남긴 채 주변 페이드아웃(헬레나가 제일 먼저 사라지도록) -> 페이드인 되면 다시 촌장 앞으로.
	--
	--선택지B 연출 : 전부 페이드아웃 -> 남매 퀘스트가 첫번째라면 메이릴과 바리가 스테이지 초입 꽃밭을 감상하는 장면 몇 초,
	-- 이전 퀘스트가 있다면 이전 퀘스트 관련 기억 몇 초(세피아톤) 나온 뒤 다시 페이드아웃 -> 나레이션 박스 : 바리의 기억이 일부 사라졌다. -> 페이드인 되면 촌장 앞으로.
	--

	if choose_result == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_flower_ball_01')
		local memory_fx = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_bari_memory_light_start'):Instantiate(kid.Position + vector(0, 1.5, 0))
		memory_fx.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'end_field_sepia', '2'}))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(helena, { 'end_field_sepia', '2'}))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(kid, { 'end_field_sepia', '2'}))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'toggle_screen_distortion'}))

		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(memory_fx.transform, 'SpecialEvents')
		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.bari.Transform, 'SpecialEvents')
		coroutine.yield(nil)
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.bari)
		character_util.set_emotion(self.bari, {name = 'sleep_deep'})

		wait_for_sec(2)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
			local duration = 3
			local timer = 0
			local origin = memory_fx.transform.position
			while timer < duration do
				memory_fx.transform.position = origin + vector(0, 1, 0) * timer * timer
				memory_fx.transform.localScale = vector(0.5, 0.5, 0.5) * (duration - timer) / duration
				timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end
			CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(memory_fx.transform, 'Default')
			memory_fx:Dispose()
		end))
		wait_for_sec(2.5)

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'toggle_screen_distortion'}))
		CS.Utils.ChangeLayersRecursively(self.bari.Transform, 'Default')
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.bari)
		character_util.set_emotion(self.bari, {name = 'sleep_deep'})

		camera_util.move_async(self.bari.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0), 1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(helena)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(helena, 1, 0)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(kid, 1, 0)
		character_util.set_direction(self.bari, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(self.bari, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
		character_util.set_position(self.bari, self.president.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), false)
		character_util.set_position(helena, vector(999, 0, 999))
		character_util.set_position(kid, vector(999, 0, 999))
		camera_util.move_async(self.bari.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0), 0)
	else

		self.external_memory_scene = true

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(helena, { 'end_field_fade', 'immediate'}))
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(kid, { 'start_field_fade', 'immediate'}))

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.president, { 'memory_scene_start'}))
	end

	if self.external_memory_scene then
		while true do
			if not self.external_memory_scene then
				screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(kid)
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(helena)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(helena, 1, 0)
				character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(kid, 1, 0)
				character_util.set_direction(self.bari, 'left')
				character_util.set_emotion(self.bari, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
				character_util.set_position(self.bari, self.president.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), false)
				character_util.set_position(self.mayreel, self.president.Position + vector(2.5, 0, 0), false)
				character_util.set_position(helena, vector(999, 0, 999))
				character_util.set_position(kid, vector(999, 0, 999))
				camera_util.move_async(self.bari.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0), 0)

				screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
				break
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.bari, { 'end_field_fade'}))
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.president, 'right')

	--선택지 연출 후 셴시 소녀 앞에서 이벤트 이어짐.

	for _, npc in ipairs(extras) do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(npc, { 'end_field_fade'}))
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/v2_14_bari/audio:bgm_bari_theme', state = 'field', mix = 2})
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'end_field_fade'}))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.mayreel, { 'end_field_fade'}))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.president, { 'end_field_fade'}))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(kid, { 'end_field_fade'}))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(helena, { 'end_field_fade'}))
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.bari)

	--바리 (right, sleep_deep) : 끝났습니다…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.bari, {key = self.talk_name .. 18, skip = true})
	--촌장 (left, idle) 음?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.president, {key = self.talk_name .. 19, skip = true})
	--촌장 (left, smile) 아아… 네, 그럼 꽃의 마을 헬레나. 잘 부탁드립니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.president, {key = self.talk_name .. 20, skip = true})

	character_util.set_direction(self.president, 'down')
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)


	for _, npc in ipairs(extras) do
		npc.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	end

	helena.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	self.president.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	kid.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	self.bari.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
	self.mayreel.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false

	local qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000501)
	quest_util.set_custom_state(qp, 'latest_cleared_quest', 3)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, choose_result - 1)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryBariQuizPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = pre @
		QuestName = ShortStoryBariQuiz @
		Comment = 바리 단편집 헬레나 퀴즈 행사 퀘스트 @

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller

	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 프리섹션 용 npc
	self.get_quiz_pre_crowd = function(index) return get_character('quiz_crowd_pre_' .. index) end

	-- 퀴즈 진행자 이벤트 존 이름
	self.quiz_mc_event_zone_name = 'quiz_mc_pre_section_zone'

	-- 모자 대화 이벤트 존 이름
	self.crowd_event_zone_name = 'quiz_crowd_pre_section_zone'

	-- 모자 대화 이벤트를 보았는지?
	self.is_show_talk_event = false

	-- 퀴즈 진행자 이벤트를 보았는지?
	self.is_show_quiz_mc_event = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.quiz_mc_event_zone_name) and not self.is_show_quiz_mc_event then
		self.is_show_quiz_mc_event = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_pre_section_event, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.crowd_event_zone_name) and not self.is_show_talk_event then
		self.is_show_talk_event = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_crowd, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:talk_crowd()
	local pre_crowd_1 = self.get_quiz_pre_crowd(1)
	local pre_crowd_2 = self.get_quiz_pre_crowd(2)

	pre_crowd_1.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	pre_crowd_2.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	-- 엄마, 저기서 퀴즈 행사 한대! 우리도 가보자!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(pre_crowd_1, { key = 'shortstory_bari_quiz_pre_1' })

	-- 퀴즈 진행자 이벤트 시작중이라면 더 이상 대화 진행하지 않도록 수정
	if self.is_show_quiz_mc_event then
		self:set_interactable(pre_crowd_1, pre_crowd_2)
		return
	end

	-- 그래, 아빠 화장실에서 나오면 같이 가보자.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(pre_crowd_2, { key = 'shortstory_bari_quiz_pre_2' })
	self:set_interactable(pre_crowd_1, pre_crowd_2)
end

function local_class:set_interactable(pre_crowd_1, pre_crowd_2)
	pre_crowd_1.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
	pre_crowd_1.Interactable.Talk = 'shortstory_bari_quiz_pre_1'

	pre_crowd_2.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable()
	pre_crowd_2.Interactable.Talk = 'shortstory_bari_quiz_pre_2'
end

function local_class:show_pre_section_event()
	local crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })
	local quiz_mc = self.controller.get_quiz_mc()
	local bari = user_party.Leader
	local mayreel = get_character('mayreel')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_clap_02')
	-- 카메라를 quiz_mc 쪽으로 이동
	camera_util.move_async(quiz_mc.Position, 0.5)

	-- 헬레나를 관광 중이신 관광객 대상으로 퀴즈 이벤트를 진행하고 있습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_spotlight_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(quiz_mc, { name = 'shoot' }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(quiz_mc, { key = 'shortstory_bari_quiz_pre_4', skip = true })

	-- 문제를 4개 이상 맞추신 분께는 특별한 상품이 주어지니 도전해보세요!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	character_util.set_anim(quiz_mc, { name = 'get' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(quiz_mc, { key = 'shortstory_bari_quiz_pre_5', skip = true })

	-- 카메라 원복
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(quiz_mc)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	-- 메이릴, 우리도 한번 참여해 볼까요?
	local direction = bari.Position.x > mayreel.Position.x and 'left' or 'right'
	character_util.set_direction(bari, direction)
	character_util.set_emotion(bari, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bari, { key = 'shortstory_bari_quiz_pre_6', skip = true })

	-- 메이릴 두번 점프
	character_util.set_emotion(mayreel, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.normal_double_jump(mayreel, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(mayreel, nil, 'heart')
	character_util.remove_emotion(bari)
	character_util.remove_emotion(mayreel)

	-- 퀘스트 활성화
	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
	crowd_sfx:FadeOut(2)
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()

function local_class:exit()

	-- 터치 이벤트를 구독중이라면 구독해지
	if self.is_subscribe_touch_event then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.is_subscribe_touch_event = false
	end

	self:dispose_mayreel_emoticon()
	self:stop_crowd_sfx()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 퀴즈 사회자와 상호작용 했을 때
	local quiz_mc = self.controller.get_quiz_mc()
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, quiz_mc) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_quiz_mc, self, quiz_mc)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	-- 터치 이벤트 (qte) 가 들어왔을때 스와이프를 위로 했을 경우
	if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
		self.qte_complete = true
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:interact_quiz_mc(quiz_mc)
	-- 퀴즈 사회자 옆으로 정렬
	local quiz_mc_box = self.controller.get_quiz_mc_box()
	party_util.align_party(quiz_mc_box.Position, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	-- 자아~ 헬레나 봄맞이 축제, 오늘은 퀴즈 코너 이어가고 있는데요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_direction(quiz_mc, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(quiz_mc, { name = 'basket_idle' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(quiz_mc, { key = 'shortstory_bari_quiz_1', skip = true })

	-- 네 문제를 맞히는 분께는 경품을 드립니다!
	character_util.set_anim(quiz_mc, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(quiz_mc, { key = 'shortstory_bari_quiz_2', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(quiz_mc)

	-- 문제를 듣고, 정답 아시는 분은 손을 들어서 답해주시면 됩니다.
	character_util.set_emotion(quiz_mc, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(quiz_mc, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(quiz_mc, { key = 'shortstory_bari_quiz_3', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(quiz_mc)

	-- 선택지 ) 참여한다. / 그만둔다.
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'shortstory_bari_quiz_choose_1', 'mercy' },
	                                                      { 'shortstory_bari_quiz_choose_2', 'normal' } })

	-- 거절할 시 리턴
	if choose_result == 2 then return end

	self:start_quiz_show(quiz_mc)
end

function local_class:start_quiz_show(quiz_mc)
	-- 터치 이벤트 구독
	self.is_subscribe_touch_event = true
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	-- 바리 가져오기
	local bari = user_party.Leader
	local mayreel = get_character('mayreel')

	-- 군중 세팅
	local crowds = {}
	for i = 1, self.crowd_count do
		local crowd = self.get_quiz_crowd(i)
		table.insert(crowds, crowd)
	end

	-- 바리 끄덕끄덕
	character_util.nod_twice(bari)

	-- 바리와 메이릴 자리로 이동
	local bari_quiz_pos = self.get_bari_quiz_pos().position
	character_util.move_waypoint(mayreel, bari_quiz_pos + unity_class.vector3.left, 4, false, nil, nil, 'right', true)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(bari, bari_quiz_pos, 4, false, nil, nil, 'right', true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 첫번째 문제
	local is_clear = self:first_quiz(quiz_mc, bari, mayreel, crowds)
	if not is_clear then return end
	self:success_quiz(quiz_mc, bari, mayreel, crowds, false)

	-- 두번째 문제
	is_clear = self:second_quiz(quiz_mc, bari, mayreel, crowds)
	if not is_clear then return end
	self:success_quiz(quiz_mc, bari, mayreel, crowds, false)

	-- 세번째 문제
	is_clear = self:third_quiz(quiz_mc, bari, mayreel, crowds)
	if not is_clear then return end
	self:success_quiz(quiz_mc, bari, mayreel, crowds, false)

	-- 네번째 문제
	is_clear = self:fourth_quiz(quiz_mc, bari, mayreel, crowds)
	if not is_clear then return end
	self:success_quiz(quiz_mc, bari, mayreel, crowds, true)

	-- 군중들 박수 쳐주며 스마일
	for i = 1, #crowds do
		character_util.set_direction(crowds[i], 'right')
		character_util.set_emotion(crowds[i], { name = 'smile' })
		if i > 3 then
			character_util.set_anim(crowds[i], { name = 'clap' })
		end
	end

	-- 바리 awesome
	character_util.set_direction(bari, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(mayreel, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(bari, { name = 'awesome' })
	character_util.show_emoticon(mayreel, nil, 'happy')

	-- 축하드립니다! 네 문제 모두 맞히셨습니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_clap_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_coop_mvp_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(quiz_mc, { name = 'clap' }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(quiz_mc, { key = 'shortstory_bari_quiz_26', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(quiz_mc)

	-- 자, 약속대로 우승자에게 경품을 전달하겠습니다.
	character_util.remove_emotion(bari)
	character_util.set_emotion(bari, { smile = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(quiz_mc, { key = 'shortstory_bari_quiz_27', skip = true })

	-- 스타피스 드랍 및 이팩트 dispose
	self.controller:dispose_star_piece_effect()
	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, quiz_mc.Position, nil)
	wait_for_sec(3)

	-- 우리 꽃의 마을 헬레나, 자주 찾아주시고, 널리 알려주십시오!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim(quiz_mc, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(quiz_mc, { key = 'shortstory_bari_quiz_28', skip = true })

	-- 퀘스트 클리어
	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false, false)
	self:stop_crowd_sfx()

	-- 관객들 이모션 애니메이션 삭제
	for i = 1, #crowds do
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(crowds[i])
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(quiz_mc)
	character_util.remove_emotion(bari)
end

-- 바리가 퀴즈 정답을 말할 때 액션
function local_class:action_bari_quiz(bari, mayreel, is_correct_answer)
	-- 카메라 원래대로 돌리고 난 뒤
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.55)

	character_util.remove_emotion(mayreel)
	character_util.remove_anim(bari)
	wait_for_sec(0.15)

	-- 바리가 정답을 말하는 연출
	character_util.set_direction(bari, 'right')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(bari, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

	--  self.mayreel_emoticon이 nil일리는 없겠지만 방어 코드
	local emoticon_key = is_correct_answer and 'happy' or 'silence'
	local sfx_key = is_correct_answer and '03_dialogue_emphasize_01' or '03_dialogue_tipsy_01'
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(sfx_key)

	if self.mayreel_emoticon ~= nil then
		self.mayreel_emoticon:ShowOn(mayreel, unity_class.vector3.one, character_util.get_emoticon_type(emoticon_key), nil)
	else
		character_util.show_emoticon(mayreel, nil, emoticon_key)
	end

	-- 정답, 오답에 따른 다른 연출
	if is_correct_answer then
		character_util.set_emotion(bari, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_emotion(mayreel, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.normal_double_jump(mayreel, true)
		wait_for_sec(1.4)
	else
		character_util.set_emotion(bari, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_emotion(mayreel, { name = 'frown' })
		wait_for_sec(2)
	end

	self.mayreel_emoticon = nil
	character_util.remove_emotion(mayreel)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(bari)
end

-- 손드는 qte 연출
function local_class:start_qte(quiz_mc, bari, mayreel, crown, index, wrong_answer_key)
	self.qte_complete = false
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe("up")

	-- qte 시간 계산, qte 시간 안에 성공하면 이팩트를 연출해 준다.
	local qte_delay = 0
	local qte_time = 1.5
	while qte_delay < qte_time do
		if self.qte_complete then
			yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, qte_time - qte_delay)
			break
		end

		qte_delay = qte_delay + unity_class.time.unscaledDeltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	-- qte에 실패 하면 다른 사람에게 기회가 한번 간다.
	if not self.qte_complete then
		self:fail_qte(quiz_mc, bari, mayreel, crown, index, wrong_answer_key)
	else
		character_util.set_emotion(bari, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.normal_double_jump(bari, true)
	end

	-- 가운데에 계신 여성분께 기회를 드리겠습니다!
	character_util.remove_anim(quiz_mc)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(quiz_mc, { key = "shortstory_bari_quiz_29", skip = true })
end

-- qte 실패
function local_class:fail_qte(quiz_mc, bari, mayreel, crown, index, wrong_answer_key)
	character_util.remove_anim(quiz_mc)
	character_util.normal_double_jump(crown, '01_player_jump_01')

	-- 바리와 메이릴이 저요저요 하는쪽을 바라본다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(bari, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_emotion(mayreel, { name = 'frown' })
	character_util.show_emoticon(mayreel, nil, 'angry')

	-- 저요! 저요!
	character_util.set_emotion(crown, { name = 'smile' })

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'bob_linda_meet_first') then
		if self.current_progress == self.section_progress.none then
			self.current_progress = self.section_progress.first_meet
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.show_bob_linda_talk, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'bob_quest_out_zone') and
			self.current_progress >= self.section_progress.choice_present then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.bob_help_talk, self)
		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'thief_run_zone') and
			self.current_progress == self.section_progress.request_bob then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.thief_run
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.thief_run_routine, self))
		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'thief_puzzle_1') and
			self.current_progress == self.section_progress.talk_linda then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.first_puzzle
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.first_puzzle, self)
		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'bob_puzzle_out_zone') and
			self.current_progress == self.section_progress.first_puzzle then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.linda_help_talk, self)
		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'thief_puzzle_2') and
			self.current_progress == self.section_progress.first_puzzle_clear then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.second_puzzle
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.second_puzzle, self)
		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'thief_puzzle_3') and
			self.current_progress == self.section_progress.second_puzzle then
		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.thief_meet
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.thief_meet, self)
		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, get_party_leader(), 'linda_meet_zone') and
			self.current_progress == self.section_progress.thief_run then
			self.current_progress = self.section_progress.talk_linda
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.linda_meet_talk, self)
			return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_bob()) then
		if self.current_progress == self.section_progress.first_meet or
				self.current_progress == self.section_progress.first_talk then
			self.current_progress = self.section_progress.first_talk
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_bob, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local store = self.get_store(i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, store) then
			if self.current_progress == self.section_progress.choice_present then
				self.current_progress = self.section_progress.request_bob
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.select_present, self, i)
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.switch_list do
		if e.IsTurningOn and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, self.switch_list[i]) then
			command_util.execute_burn(get_party_leader(), self.brazier_list[i], false)
			self.brazier_on = self.brazier_on | (self.brazier_check.one << (i - 1))
			-- 화로가 다 켜진다면
			if self.brazier_on == self.brazier_check.all and
					self.current_progress == self.section_progress.first_puzzle then
				self.current_progress = self.section_progress.first_puzzle_clear
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.first_puzzle_clear, self)
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'bob_thief_battle' then
		sp_util.play_battle_end_screenplay(self.battle_end, self)
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:talk_bob()
	local bob = self.get_bob()
	local leader = get_party_leader()

	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('field', 0.5)

	-- 밥 루틴 제거
	character_util.stop(bob)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(bob)

	party_util.align_party(bob, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	--밥 밥 (down, idle, question) : 어떤 선물이 좋으려나…?
	character_util.set_direction(bob, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(bob, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bob, { key = 'short_story_lina_bob_linda_9', skip = true })

	--밥 밥 (down, idle, question) : 머리빗…? 오르골…? 수통…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bob, { key = 'short_story_lina_bob_linda_10', skip = true })

	--리나 (right, idle, cast2) : 이봐, 무슨 고민이라도?
	character_util.look_at(leader, bob)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'short_story_lina_bob_linda_11', skip = true })

	--밥 (left, idle) : 어어… 선배에게 어떤 선물을 할지 생각 중이었어요.
	character_util.look_at(bob, leader)
	self:speech_and_nod(bob, 'short_story_lina_bob_linda_12')

	--리나 (right, idle, question) : 선배에게… 선물?
	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'short_story_lina_bob_linda_13', skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	--밥 (left, smile) : 저는 가디언 훈련병인데, 훈련 기간 동안 신세를 많이 졌거든요.
	character_util.set_emotion(bob, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bob, { key = 'short_story_lina_bob_linda_14', skip = true })

	--밥 (left, idle) : 그 보답으로 작은 선물이라도 전하고 싶은데, 뭘로 할지 정말 고민이네요.
	character_util.remove_emotion(bob)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bob, { key = 'short_story_lina_bob_linda_15', skip = true })

	--밥 (left, idle) : 괜찮으시다면 선물 고르는 걸 도와주시겠어요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bob, { key = 'short_story_lina_bob_linda_16', skip = true })

	--밥 (left, idle) : 여자들은 어떤 선물을 좋아할지, 도무지 모르겠어요.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(bob, { key = 'short_story_lina_bob_linda_16_1', skip = true })

	-- 훈련병을 도와준다.
	-- 고민하도록 둔다. (선택 시 컨트롤 풀림, 다시 상호 작용 가능)
	local choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { 'short_story_lina_bob_linda_17', 'mercy' }, { 'short_story_lina_bob_linda_18', 'brutal' } })

	if choose_result == 1 then
		character_util.remove_relate_event(bob, self.controller)

		--리나 (right, wink, attack) : 좋아! 내가 멋진 걸로 골라줄게.
		local wait_anim = true

		local end_anim = function()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(leader, { name = 'cross_arm' }, { name = 'wink' })

			wait_for_sec(0.2)

			wait_anim = false
		end
		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(leader,
			{ name = 'basket_attack', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01', end_call_func = end_anim })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'short_story_lina_bob_linda_19', skip = true })

		while wait_anim do
			coroutine.yield()
		end

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		local main_qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000801)

		if main_qp ~= nil and main_qp.InnerProgress >= 4 and main_qp.InnerProgress <= 6 then
			self.eva_party_check = true

			local eva = self.get_eva()
			character_util.convert_to_npc(eva)

			--에바 (idle) : 가디언 선발 시험 전 훈련병에게 관여하는 건 금지라서.
			character_util.set_direction(leader, 'left')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'short_story_lina_bob_linda_183', skip = true })

			--에바 (idle) : 난 나중에 다시 합류할게.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(eva, { key = 'short_story_lina_bob_linda_184', skip = true })

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(eva, eva.Position - vector(8,0,0),
					4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')

			character_util.set_position(eva, vector(999,0,999))
		end

		self.current_progress = self.section_progress.choice_present

		for i = 1, 3 do
			self.get_store(i).Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

function local_class:shake_3d_object_routine(fo, duration, magnitude)
	magnitude = lua_helper.get_or_default(magnitude, 1)

	local origin_pos = fo.Position
	local pos_list = {
		vector(-0.02, 0, 0),
		vector(-0.01, 0, 0),
		vector(0, 0, 0),
		vector(0.01, 0, 0),
		vector(0.02, 0, 0)
	}

	local cur_idx = 3
	local dif = 1
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		cur_idx = cur_idx + dif
		if cur_idx > 5 then
			cur_idx = 5
			dif = -1
		elseif cur_idx < 1 then
			cur_idx = 1
			dif = 1
		end

		fo.Position = origin_pos + (pos_list[cur_idx] * magnitude)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	fo.Position = origin_pos
end

function local_class:battle_end()

	local xellos = self.get_xellos()

	for i = 1, 3 do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create('bob_thief_battle_gate_'..i, true))
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	party_util.remove_animation()
	party_util.remove_emotion()

	character_util.convert_to_npc(bob)
	character_util.convert_to_npc(linda)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local cur_thief = self.get_thief(i)

		character_util.convert_to_npc(cur_thief)
		character_util.reset_all_state(cur_thief)

		local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
		heal_info.sender = nil
		heal_info.target = cur_thief
		heal_info.heal = cur_thief.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
		heal_info.isRevive = true
		heal_info.skipEffect = true
		command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

		if i % 2 == 1 then
			character_util.set_direction(cur_thief, 'left')
		else
			character_util.set_direction(cur_thief, 'right')
		end

		character_util.set_position(cur_thief, field:GetMarker('thief_end_pos_'.. i + 4).position)
		character_util.set_anim(cur_thief, { name = 'dead', scale = 5, loop = false })

		e.Target.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.get_bartender(), { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_8_11' })
