function local_class:dragon_talon_qte(fo)
	local touch_info = self.talon_qte_infos:get_current_touch_info()

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_touch_event')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_style_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(touch_info.type)
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.5, 'qte')

	if self.talon_qte_infos.current_index == 3 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
	end
	CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.Shout(fo, touch_info.talk_key, false)

	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed < touch_info.time do
		if touch_info.success then
			CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(touch_info.sfx)
			break
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	wait_for_sec(touch_info.time - time_passed)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(fo)

	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('qte')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self.talon_qte_infos:progress_index()
end

	character_util.remove_group_emotion(hunters)

	--사냥꾼 (left, doyagao) : 지상 최강의 생물이 드래곤이라니, 정말 웃기는군.

			nil, 'doyagao', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_29')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

	character_util.play_speech_action(hunter_1, nil,
			'attack', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_29_1')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')

			'attack', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_29_2')

	character_util.set_emotion(hunter_2, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.shake(hunter_1, 0.03, 0.4)
	character_util.shake(hunter_2, 0.03, 0.4)
	character_util.play_speech_action(hunter_1, nil,
			'tired', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_29_3')
	character_util.stop_shake(hunter_1)
	character_util.stop_shake(hunter_2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	--사냥꾼 1, 2 (left, attack) : [shout] 쉬버링 흰 . 토 . 끼 . 라 . 고!

	character_util.set_emotion(hunter_1, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_emotion(hunter_2, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(hunter_2,
			{key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_30', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')

	hunter_1.Interactable.Talk = 'shortstory_dragon_oneline_3'
	hunter_2.Interactable.Talk = 'shortstory_dragon_oneline_4'

	if self.talk_count == 2 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_poacher, self))
	else
		-- PS-7836 계단에 뛰어내릴 수 있는 현상 수정
		self.get_bartender_stair(1).EntityGroup = self.get_bartender_stair(1).EntityGroup | CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
		self.get_bartender_stair(2).EntityGroup = self.get_bartender_stair(2).EntityGroup | CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle

end

function local_class:talk_with_poacher()
	local poacher = self.get_guest(self.poacher_index)
	local train = self.get_train()
	local bar_exit = self.get_bar_exit()
	local neva = self.get_neva()
	local dragon_boy = self.get_dragon_boy()
	local bartender_stair_1 = self.get_bartender_stair(1)
	local bartender_stair_2 = self.get_bartender_stair(2)

	character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.move_to_async(neva, vector(-0.5,1,3.5), 1, nil, true, true)

	-- 네바 (right, scared) : 이대론 안돼… 단서가 모두 끊겨버렸어...

	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'scared' })

	-- 네바 (right, idle, question) : 이럴때 숙모라면 어떻게 했을까?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'right')
	character_util.remove_emotion(neva)
	character_util.set_anim(neva, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_32_2', skip = true })

	-- 네바 (right, sleep_deep, question) : 숙모라면...우리 부족원들은...본능적으로 행동하지...
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_32_3', skip = true })

	-- 네바 (right, sleep_deep, question) : 내가 가장 잘 아는...그 녀석의 채취를 떠올려보자…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_32_4', skip = true })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		dragon_boy.Position = vector(-9,0,-2)
		character_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, { name = 'awesome' })

		wp_util.move_way_points_async(dragon_boy,
				{waypoints = {vector(6, 0, -2)
				, vector(6, 0, -4)}, speed = 4, run = true, play_sfx = true})

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.jump_move(dragon_boy, vector(4,1,-4.5), 2, 2)
		character_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, { name = 'victory_extra' })
	end))
	-- 기르가스가 돌아다니다가 탁자 위로 올라감
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(2)

		character_util.set_direction(bartender_stair_1, 'down')
		character_util.set_direction(bartender_stair_2, 'down')
		character_util.normal_jump(bartender_stair_1, true)
		character_util.normal_jump(bartender_stair_2, true)
		character_util.set_emotion(bartender_stair_1, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_emotion(bartender_stair_2, { name = 'attack' })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		wp_util.move_way_points(bartender_stair_1,
				{waypoints = {vector(-1, 0, -2)
				, vector(3, 0, -2)
				, vector(3, 0, -4)}, speed = 4, run = true, play_sfx = true})

		wp_util.move_way_points_async(bartender_stair_2,
				{waypoints = {vector(0, 0, -2)
				, vector(6, 0, -2)
				, vector(6, 0, -4)}, speed = 4, run = true, play_sfx = true})

		wait_for_sec(0.2)

		character_util.set_direction(bartender_stair_1, 'right')
		character_util.set_direction(bartender_stair_2, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(bartender_stair_1, { name = 'cast'}, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(bartender_stair_2, { name = 'cast'}, { name = 'scared' })
	end))

	music_player_util.play_stage_music(

	camera_util.move_async(neva.Position + vector(0,-1,-3), 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_02')

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 네바 (down, sleep_deep, 1회 jump) : 이 냄새!

	-- 네바 (right, sleep_deep, sing) : 그래 이 냄새!...

	local move_talk = function(fo, wp_data, talk_key)
		local move_end = false
		local wp_count = 1	-- 웨이포인트가 한 개 인것으로 가정
		wp_data.callback = function(wp_index)
			move_end = wp_count == (wp_index + 1)
			if move_end then
				character_util.remove_anim(fo)
			end
		end
		character_util.set_anim(fo, {name = 'katana_walk'})
		wp_util.move_way_points(fo, wp_data)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(fo, {key = talk_key, skip = true})

		while not move_end do
			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end

	neva.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	character_util.set_anim(neva, {name = 'sing'})

		character_util.remove_anim(bartender_stair_2)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')

		wp_util.move_way_points(dragon_boy, {waypoints = {
			vector(-0.5, 0, -7),
			vector(-0.5, 0, -13)
		}, speed = 5, run = true, play_sfx = true})

		wp_util.move_way_points(bartender_stair_1,
				{waypoints = {vector(2, 0, -4)
				, vector(2, 0, -7)
				, vector(-0.5, 0, -7)
				, vector(-0.5, 0, -13)}, speed = 5, run = true})

		wp_util.move_way_points(bartender_stair_2,
				{waypoints = {vector(6, 0, -7)
				, vector(-0.5, 0, -7)
				, vector(-0.5, 0, -13)}, speed = 5, run = true})

		wait_for_sec(5)

		dragon_boy.Position = vector(999,0,999)
		bartender_stair_1.Position = vector(999,0,999)
		bartender_stair_2.Position = vector(999,0,999)
	end))

	wait_for_sec(3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	--네바 (right, greed, release 1회) : [shout] 여기다!
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	character_util.set_anim(neva, {name = 'release', loop = false})
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva, nil, 'greed',
			{key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_32_7', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim(neva)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	--우측 테이블에는 아무도 없는 상황.

			'tired', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_32_8')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	character_util.set_emotion(neva, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva, {name = 'question', loop = false},
			nil, 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_32_9')

	--이후 네바 left, sleep_deep, katana_walk로 진행.. 카메라는 네바를 담으며 테이블 3 까지 빠르게 이동.
	local neva_target_pos = vector(-4, 0, -4)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva, {name = 'question', loop = false},

			'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_37')

	--네바 (left, question, 살짝 줌 인) : 그렇다면…
	twinkle_effect:Dispose()
	camera_util.resize_to(3.5, 0.7)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva, {name = 'question', loop = false},
			nil, 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_38')

	--네바 (right, attack, release 1회 후 정지) : 당신은 캔터베리 아니면 셴 시를 돌아다녔다는 거야!

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(poacher, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva, {name = 'release', loop = false},
			'attack', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_38_1')
	neva:HideWeapon(false)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(poacher, true)

	character_util.set_emotion(poacher, {name = 'scared'})

	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	self.controller:remove_field_tint(1)

	--도마뱀 밀렵꾼 : (scared)

	--character_util.set_emotion(poacher, {name = 'scared'})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

	--도마뱀 밀렵꾼 (left, scared) : 대체 그걸 어떻게…

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, {key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_39', skip = true})

	--네바 대사 중 도마뱀 밀렵꾼은 주위 4방향 둘러본 뒤 주점 밖으로 나가버린다.

	character_util.set_direction(poacher, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(poacher, 0, 1)

	--네바 (left, attack) : 당신이 드래곤을 쫓고 있었다는 증거지! (NPC 있던 곳 가리키며)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva, {name = 'release', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},

	--네바, idle 표정으로 4방향 둘러본 뒤, surprised 표정으로 1회 점프.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'right')

	self.get_bar_table(2).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	--플레이어 컨트롤 복귀. 주점 밖으로 마커 출력.
	self.is_marked_to_poacher = true

function local_class:exit_bar()
	local poacher = self.get_guest(self.poacher_index)
	character_util.shake(poacher, 0.03, 99999)
	quest_marker_util.remove('chasing_poacher')

	self.controller:teleport_party_to_marker('bar_exit', function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_intro_steampunk_01')
	end)

	--주점 밖으로 나올 시 대사 이벤트 진행
	--네바 down을 바라보며 대사 실행
	--네바 (down, attack) : 서두르지 않으면 놓치겠어!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(user_party.Leader,
			{key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_40_1', skip = true})
end

function local_class:poacher_run()
	local poacher = self.get_guest(self.poacher_index)
	local train = self.get_train()
	local neva = self.get_neva()

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(neva)

	quest_marker_util.remove('chasing_poacher')

	--기차 근처에 접근하면 트리거 이벤트 진행.
	--카메라 도마뱀 밀렵꾼이 중심으로 오도록 하단으로 이동.
	camera_util.move_async(poacher.Position, 0.8)
	--도마뱀 밀렵꾼. up을 바라보며 1회 jump. 이후 scared 표정을 지으며 하단 열차에 탑승.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(poacher)
	character_util.stop_shake(poacher)
	poacher.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	character_util.set_emotion(poacher, {name = 'scared'})
	--도마뱀 밀렵꾼. up을 바라보며 1회 jump.
	character_util.normal_jump_async(poacher, '01_player_jump_01')

	--밀렵꾼 (up, idle, release) : 따… 따라오지 마!
	character_util.play_speech_action(poacher, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'},
			nil, 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_40_2')
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(poacher, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(poacher,
			{waypoints = train.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5), speed = 6, run = true})

	character_util.remove_emotion(poacher)
	self.controller:ride_train(poacher, train, false)
	train.SpineController:SetSortingLayer(nil, 0)

	--카메라 밖으로 떠나는 열차를 보여주고, mad 표정으로 1회 jump 한 네바도 동시에 보여준다.
	local train_move_dur = 2
	local train_target = vector(train.Position.x, 0, 88)
	local train_speed = (train_target - train.Position).magnitude / train_move_dur
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_train_01')
	wp_util.move_way_points(train, {waypoints = train_target, speed = train_speed})
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.normal_double_jump(neva, '01_player_jump_01')

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- 네바 (down, greed) : 좋아..해보자는 거지!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 2})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva,
			nil, 'greed', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_41')

	--네바는 우측의 선로 옆 공간으로 달려감. 이때 카메라 앵글은 선로와 네바를 대칭으로 보여줄 수 있는 위치까지 우측으로 이동.
	local wp_x_pos = 33.5
	local neva_speed_1 = 7
	local jump_height = 1.2

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_ride', state = 'event', mix = 2.0})

	if neva.Position.z > 105.5 then
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(neva,
				{waypoints = vector(wp_x_pos, 0, 105.5), speed = neva_speed_1, run = true})
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(neva, vector(wp_x_pos, 1, 100), neva_speed_1, jump_height, true)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	self.train_finish = false

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'train_run_away', train)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.train_move, self))
end

function local_class:fail_neva()
	local train = self.get_train()
	local neva = self.get_neva()
	local train_last_pos = field:GetMarker('train_1_2').position
	local train_move_done = false
	local poacher = self.get_guest(self.poacher_index)

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(neva)

	wp_util.move_way_points(train, {waypoints = train_last_pos, speed = 6, callback = function()
		train_move_done = true
	end })

	while lua_helper.type_compare(neva.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterForcedDashState) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, {name = 'surprise'})

	camera_util.move_async(train_last_pos + vector(0, 0, -2), 1)

	while train_move_done == false do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	if self.train_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.train_loop_sfx:FadeOut(1)
	end
	self.train_loop_sfx = nil

	character_util.set_emotion(poacher, {name = 'scared'})
	self.controller:alight_train(poacher, train, 'down', false)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	wp_util.move_way_points(poacher, {waypoints = {
		vector(train.Position.x, 0, 60.5),
		vector(19.5, 0, 60.5),
		vector(19.5, 0, 50)
	}, speed = 7, run = true})

	-- 안돼! 마지막 단서가…
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 2.0})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva,
			{ key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_41_1', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout',
			  world_pos = train.Position
					  + vector(train.Position.x < neva.Position.x and 3 or -5, 0, -0.7) })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.stop(poacher)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(poacher)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(poacher, 0, 0)

	character_util.set_position(neva, vector(35, 1, 100))
	character_util.set_position(train, vector(train.Position.x, 0, 88))
	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(neva)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_ride', state = 'event', mix = 2.0})
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0.5, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self.train_finish = false
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.train_move, self))
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(neva,
			{key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_40_1', skip = true})
end

function local_class:train_move()
	local train = self.get_train()
	local train_last_pos = field:GetMarker('train_1_2').position

	self.train_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{sfx_name = '01_train_02', loop = true, parent = train,
			 type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'npcs'})

	wp_util.move_way_points_async(train,
			{ waypoints = train_last_pos + vector(0, 0, 6), speed = 2 })

	if not self.train_finish then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.fail_neva, self)
	else
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(train, {waypoints = train_last_pos, speed = 2 })
		self.neva_finish = true
	end
end

function local_class:finish_neva()
	local poacher = self.get_guest(self.poacher_index)
	local train = self.get_train()
	local neva = self.get_neva()
	local train_last_pos = field:GetMarker('train_1_2').position
	local neva_speed_1 = 6
	local custom_move_wp = function(fo, target_pos, duration, min_speed, last_direction)
		local speed = math.max((fo.Position - target_pos).magnitude / duration, min_speed)
		wp_util.move_way_points_async(fo,
				{waypoints = target_pos, speed = speed, last_direction = last_direction})
	end

	self.train_finish = true

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(neva)
	quest_marker_util.remove('train_run_away')

	character_util.set_anim(neva, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_to_async(neva,
			vector(neva.Position.x > 33.5 and 34 or 33, 1, 68), nil, 7)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(neva, { name = 'embarrassed' },  { name = 'surprise' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_accelerate_01')
	character_util.move_to_async(neva, vector(neva.Position.x, 1, 67), nil, 10)
	character_util.remove_emotion(neva)
	character_util.set_anim(neva, { name = 'get', loop = false })
	character_util.jump_move(neva, vector(neva.Position.x, 0, 60), 10, 1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(neva)

	--도망가는 밀렵꾼을 가로막는 네바.
	--#3에 네바가 도착하면 곧바로 left로 달린 뒤 열차 출구에 멈춰서 up을 바라봄.
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(neva, {waypoints = {vector(train_last_pos.x, 0, neva.Position.z),
													  vector(train_last_pos.x, 0, train_last_pos.z - 2.5)},
										 speed = neva_speed_1, run = true, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up})

	character_util.stop(train)
	custom_move_wp(train, train_last_pos, 1.5, 2, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)
	if self.train_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.train_loop_sfx:FadeOut(2.0)
	end
	self.train_loop_sfx = nil

	camera_util.move(neva.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5), 1)

	self.controller:alight_train(poacher, train, 'down', false)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', mix = 2.0})

	character_util.set_emotion(poacher, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.normal_jump(poacher, '01_player_jump_01')

	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	--네바 (up) : 이봐, 도망칠 필요 없잖아?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, {key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_42', skip = true})

	--네바 (up) : 단지 드래곤에 대한 정보를 얻으려는 것 뿐이야. 피차 힘 빼지 말자고.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, {key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_43', skip = true})

	--도마뱀 밀렵꾼 (down, scared) : 시, 신고하려는 거 아니었어?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(poacher, {name = 'scared'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(poacher, {key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_44', skip = true})

	--네바 (up) : 신고? 뭘? 누구한테?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, {key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_45', skip = true})

	--도마뱀 밀렵꾼 (down, tired) : 썬게이저 도마뱀이랑 비어디 드래곤 포획 금지 기간이잖아…
	character_util.play_speech_action(poacher, nil,
			'tired', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_46')

	--네바 (left, question) : 잠깐, 썬게이저 도마뱀? 비어디 드래곤…?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_newinfo_01')
	neva.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	character_util.set_anim(neva, {name = 'question', loop = false})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, {key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_47', skip = true})

	--도마뱀 밀렵꾼 (down, doyagao) : 외형은 드래곤을 쏙 빼닮았는데 성격은 순해서 수요가 많아.
	character_util.play_speech_action(poacher, nil,
			'doyagao', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_48')

	--도마뱀 밀렵꾼 (down) : 그래서 수사관들 몰래 가져오고 있었는데…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(poacher, {key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_48_1', skip = true})

	neva.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, {key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_49', skip = true})

	camera_util.move(neva.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 1)
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(neva, {waypoints = neva.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), speed = 1})

	--네바 (down, tired) : 드래곤의 비늘 냄새가 아니라…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, {key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_50', skip = true})

	--도마뱀 밀렵꾼 좌, 하, 우 를 차례로 바라봄.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	poacher.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	wait_for_sec(0.8)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	poacher.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	wait_for_sec(0.8)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	poacher.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	--도마뱀 밀렵꾼 (down, surprised) : 잠깐! 여, 여긴…!

	character_util.set_emotion(poacher, {name = 'surprise'})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(poacher, {key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_51', skip = true})

	neva.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(neva, nil, 'question')

	--도마뱀 밀렵꾼 (down, surprise) : 빌리 패거리의 구역이잖아?!

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(poacher, {name = 'cast'},
			'damaged', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_53')

	--상단의 기차를 탄 밀렵꾼. 그대로 출발하여 카메라 밖으로 사라짐.
	self.controller:ride_train(poacher, train, false)
	poacher.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	train.LockedDirection = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_train_01')
	wp_util.move_way_points(train, {waypoints = field:GetMarker('train_1_1').position, speed = 6})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.move(neva.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), 1, {end_target = neva})

	--기차 다시 부를 수 있는 스위치는 없음.
	--열차가 사라지면 네바 down으로 1타일 걸어온 후 sleep_deep 표정과 question 동작 진행. 해당 상태에서 (...)말풍선 출력.
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(neva, {waypoints = neva.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), speed = 2})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	neva.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
	character_util.set_anim(neva, {name = 'question', loop = false})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(neva, nil, 'silence')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_newinfo_01')
	--네바 (down, attack, question) : 드래곤 냄새가 더 진해졌잖아?
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva, nil, 'attack', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_54')
	character_util.remove_anim(neva)

	--네바 (down, smile, question) : 게다가 이건… 아주 낯익은 냄새야!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, {key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_55', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(neva)

	--네바 (down, smile, get) : 셴과 쉬버링에서 맡았던 바로 그 냄새라고!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva,
			{name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01'},
			'smile', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s1_56')

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

return local_class

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')

	-- 아이템 세팅
	for key, info in pairs(self.clue_infos) do
		self.clue_infos[key].item = drop_item_util.create_item({
				itemid = info.item_id,
				pos = info.get_drop_pos(),
				notforinven = true,
				lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
				skip_text = true,
			})
	end

	for i = 1, #self.mafia_1_infos do
		local mafia = self.get_mafia(1, i)
		self.mafia_1_infos[i].fo = mafia
	end

	local shooting_mafias = { self.mafia_1_infos[1].fo }

	for i = 1, #self.mafia_2_infos do
		local mafia = self.get_mafia(2, i)

		-- 미리 리스트로 변경해놓음
		local info = self.mafia_2_infos[i]
		info.fo = mafia
		info.start_pos = self.get_mafia_2_guard_pos(i, 1)

		if info.type == 'direction' then
			info.direction_list = self:convert_array_to_list(info.directions, CS.Oak.Direction)
		elseif info.type == 'waypoint' then
			local waypoints = {}
			for wp = 1, info.waypoint_count do
				waypoints[wp] = self.get_mafia_2_guard_pos(i, wp)
			end

			info.waypoints_list = self:convert_array_to_list(waypoints, unity_class.vector3)
		end

		shooting_mafias[i + 1] = mafia

		if i < 5 then
			local zone_name = 'mafia_hit_' .. i
			self.hit_zone_info_dic[zone_name] = {
				fo = mafia,
				state = self.hit_event_state.idle,
				talk_key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_0_' .. i
			}
		end
	end

	self.get_fx_twinkle()

	-- ShootHelper 미리 로드해놓음
	local pattern_info = { columns = 1 }
	local proj_data = game_data_service.GetData('ProjectileData')
	local proj_spec = proj_data:GetSpec('rifle_bullet_long_dist'):Clone()

	for i = 1, #shooting_mafias do
		local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, shooting_mafias[i])
		self.shoot_helpers[i] = CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
				ps, proj_spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset)
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key,
			self.clue_infos.dragon_scale.get_drop_pos(), true)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))

	for _, info in pairs(self.clue_infos) do
		if info.item ~= nil then
			drop_item_util.dispose_item(info.item)
		end
	end

	if is_unity_null(self.twinkle_effect) == false then
		self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.twinkle_effect = nil


	if is_unity_null(self.black_smoke_effect) == false then
		self.black_smoke_effect:Dispose()
	end
	self.black_smoke_effect = nil

	if self.fire_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.fire_loop_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.fire_loop_sfx = nil

	if self.gas_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.gas_loop_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.gas_loop_sfx = nil

	if self.timer_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.timer_loop_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.timer_loop_sfx = nil

	self.clue_infos = nil
	self.mafia_1_infos = nil
	self.mafia_2_infos = nil
	self.shoot_helpers = nil

	if self.game_timer ~= nil then
		self.game_timer:Dispose()
		self.game_timer = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

	return false

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_warehouse_entrance())
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.after_find_scale then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_find_powder
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.move_to_warehouse, self)
		return true

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_warehouse_entrance_2())
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.observing_1 then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.after_observing_1
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_warehouse_2, self)

		return true

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_warehouse_exit())
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.in_smoke then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.observing_2
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.escape_warehouse, self)
		return true

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_warehouse_back_entrance()) then
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(user_party.Leader)
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(user_party.Leader, {key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_20_5'})
		return true

	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_train())
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.observing_2 then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.after_observing_2
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.board_train, self)
		return true

	else
		for i = 1, 3 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_farm_signboard(i)) then
				speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(e.Target)
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(e.Target, {key = 'shortstory_dragon_narration_' .. i})
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.clue_infos.dragon_scale.active_zone_name)
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_find_scale then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.after_find_scale
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.find_dragon_scale, self)
		return true

	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.clue_infos.explosive_powder.active_zone_name)
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_find_powder then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_observing_1
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.find_explosive_powder, self)
		return true

	elseif e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader)
			and self.current_event_state < self.event_state.before_find_powder then
		local info = self.hit_zone_info_dic[e.Zone.Name]
		if info ~= nil and info.state == self.hit_event_state.idle then
			info.state = self.hit_event_state.knock_backed
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mafia_hit_neva, self, info)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == self.mafia_1_detect_key and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.observing_1
			and self.mafia_1_state == self.mafia_state.observing then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detected_by_mafia_1, self, e.Sender)
		return true

	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == self.mafia_2_detect_key and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.observing_2
			and self.mafia_2_state == self.mafia_state.observing then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.detected_by_mafia_2, self, e.Sender)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_global_timer_alarm_event(e)
	if e.TimerId == CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer then
		if e.IsComplete == true and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.in_smoke then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.timer_over, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:convert_array_to_list(array, type)
	local list = create_generic_list(type)
	for i = 1, #array do
		list:Add(array[i])
	end

	return list
end

function local_class:mafia_hit_neva(info)
	local neva = self.get_neva()

	--마피아 공통 대사 (up) : 어이!
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(info.fo)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	neva.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(info.fo,
			{key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_0', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})

	character_util.set_anim(info.fo, {name = 'attack', loop = false})

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, {name = 'damaged'})
	local knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info('physics', true, vector(0, 0, 1),
			13000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
	command_util.publish_knock_back(neva.Owner, neva, knockback_info, neva.Position)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(neva)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(neva)

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	character_util.remove_anim(info.fo)
	character_util.set_anim(info.fo, {name = 'sword_idle'})

	while lua_helper.type_compare(neva.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(neva)

	--마피아 1 (up) : 몰래 들어와봤자 훔칠 것도 없어.
	--마피아 2 (up) : 표지판 안보여? 저리 꺼져!
	--마피아 3 (up) : 더 이상 들어오지 않는 게 좋을 거다.
	--마피아 4 (up) : 독초들이니 함부로 만지지 마.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(info.fo, info.talk_key)
	info.state = self.hit_event_state.idle
end

function local_class:find_dragon_scale()
	local clue_pos = self.clue_infos.dragon_scale.get_drop_pos()
	local neva = self.get_neva()
	local tint_npcs = {}

	quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)
	for _, info in pairs(self.hit_zone_info_dic) do
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(info.fo)
		table.insert(tint_npcs, info.fo)
	end

	wp_util.move_way_points_async(neva, {waypoints = clue_pos + vector(1, 0, 0), speed = 2})
	neva.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--네바 비늘 스프라이트 우측에 정렬. left 방향, surprise 표정으로 1회 짧게 jump.
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.normal_jump(neva, '01_player_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	--네바 : (left, sleep_deep, cross_arm)
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, {name = 'sleep_deep'})
	character_util.set_anim(neva, {name = 'cross_arm'})

	--네바를 제외하고 배경만 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{name = 'ondemand/v2_14_dragon/audio:bgm_neva_event', state = 'event', mix = 2.0})
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SetBackgroundColorEvent.Create(CS.UnityEngine.Color32(0, 0, 0, 255), 1))
	camera_util.resize_to(3, 1)
	--self.controller:add_field_tint(1, nil, {items = { self.clue_infos.dragon_scale.item }})
	self.controller:add_field_tint(1, nil, {npcs = tint_npcs})

	-- 네바 줌인, FX_Object_Twinkle 이펙트가 비늘에 지속적으로 출연.
	self.twinkle_effect = self.get_fx_twinkle():Instantiate(clue_pos)

	--네바 (left, blush, sing) : 이 미려하고 우아한 광택!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_lights_01')
	character_util.set_anim(neva, {name = 'sing'})
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva, nil,
			'blush', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_1')

	--네바 : 매끈하면서도 날카로운 표면!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva, nil,
			'greed', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_2')

	--네바 : 그리고… 그윽하게 스며있는 유황의 향!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva, nil,
			'awesome', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_3')
	character_util.remove_anim(neva)

	--네바 (left, surprise, 짧게 jump) : 이건 분명 어린 드래곤의 비늘!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, {name = 'smile'})
	character_util.normal_jump(neva, '01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva, 'cast2',
			nil, 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_4')

	--배경 페이드인, 줌 복귀.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', mix = 2.0})
	self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
	self.twinkle_effect = nil
	camera_util.resize_to_default(1)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SetBackgroundColorEvent.Create(CS.UnityEngine.Color32(255, 255, 255, 255), 0))
	self.controller:remove_field_tint(1)

	local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
	character_util.set_anim(neva, {name = 'eat'})
	wait_for_sec(0.6)
	self.clue_infos.dragon_scale.item.State = CS.Oak.DropItem.LootState.FixLooter
	self.clue_infos.dragon_scale.item.ConsumeTarget = neva
	self.clue_infos.dragon_scale.item = nil
	wait_for_sec(0.6)
	character_util.remove_anim(neva)
	equipping_sfx:Stop()

	--네바 (left, greed, idle) : 근처에 다른 흔적이 또 있을지도…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva, nil,
			'greed', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_5')

	--이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀. B 통로에 마킹 출력
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key, entrance, true)
end

function local_class:mafia_1_observing_routine()
	local time_passed = {}
	for i = 1, #self.mafia_1_infos do
		local info = self.mafia_1_infos[i]
		info.prev_pos = info.start_pos
		time_passed[i] = 0
		info.current_wp_index = 1
	end
	local neva_stats = self.get_neva().FieldObjectStatsBehaviour

	while self.mafia_1_state == self.mafia_state.observing and neva_stats.IsDead == false do
		for i = 1, #self.mafia_1_infos do
			local info = self.mafia_1_infos[i]
			local wp_info = info:get_cur_wp_info()
			local state_changed = false
			local remain_move_dist = 0

			if wp_info ~= nil then
				if wp_info.state == 'walk' then
					local wp_dif = wp_info.target_pos - info.prev_pos
					local target_dif = wp_info.target_pos - info.fo.transform.position
					local move_dist = unity_class.time.deltaTime * info.move_speed
					local move_dif = wp_dif.normalized * move_dist

					-- 타겟 웨이포인트를 지나가는 경우
					local dist_dif = move_dist - target_dif.magnitude
					if dist_dif >= 0 then
						info.fo.Position = wp_info.target_pos
						character_util.remove_anim(info.fo)

						remain_move_dist = dist_dif
						state_changed = true
					else
						info.fo.Position = info.fo.transform.position + move_dif
					end
				elseif wp_info.state == 'stop' then
					time_passed[i] = time_passed[i] + unity_class.time.deltaTime

					if time_passed[i] >= wp_info.delay then
						state_changed = true
					end
				end

				-- 스테이트가 변경되었을 때
				if state_changed then
					info.prev_pos = info.fo.transform.position
					info:progress_index()

					local cur_wp_info = info:get_cur_wp_info()
					if cur_wp_info ~= nil then
						if cur_wp_info.state == 'walk' then
							-- 이전 움직임에 남은 거리만큼 이동시켜줌
							local target_dif = cur_wp_info.target_pos - info.fo.transform.position
							local move_dif = target_dif.normalized * remain_move_dist
							info.fo.Position = info.fo.transform.position + move_dif

							info.fo.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(target_dif)
							character_util.set_anim(info.fo, {name = 'rifle_walk'})

						elseif cur_wp_info.state == 'stop' then
							info.fo.Direction = cur_wp_info.target_dir
							time_passed[i] = 0
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

function local_class:start_timer()
	field_ui_manager:SetUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.EventTimer)

	self.game_timer = CS.Oak.InGameTimer.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, 20)
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAddEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, self.game_timer))
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent), 'on_global_timer_alarm_event')
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStartEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer, true))
	self.timer_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{sfx_name = '02_gimmick_ticking_loop_01', loop = true,
			 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
end

function local_class:stop_timer()
	message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerRemoveEvent.Create(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerId.SingleGameTimer))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.GlobalTimerAlarmEvent))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.EventTimerStopEvent.Instance)
	if self.game_timer ~= nil then
		self.game_timer:Dispose()
		self.game_timer = nil
	end

	if self.timer_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.timer_loop_sfx:Stop()
		self.timer_loop_sfx = nil
	end
end

		info.fo.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
		info.fo.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'basic_rifle')

			buff_manager:AddBuff(info.fo, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, info.fo, 'speed_down_persistent', 30, false, false)
		end
	end

	self:start_mafia_2_observing()
	self:stop_timer()

	self.black_smoke_effect = self.controller.get_fx_black_smoke()
			:Instantiate(self.get_warehouse_back_entrance().Position + vector(-0.2, 0, 0))
	self.black_smoke_effect.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(-65, 0, 0)

	character_util.remove_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	if self.gas_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.gas_loop_sfx:Stop()

		end

	end)

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key, train, true)

function local_class:board_train()
	local train = self.get_train()
	local neva = self.get_neva()
	local boss = self.mafia_1_infos[1].fo
	local mafias = { boss, }

	train.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)

	for i = 1, #self.mafia_1_infos do
		local mafia = self.mafia_1_infos[i].fo
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(mafia)
		mafia.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
	end

	for i = 1, #self.mafia_2_infos do
		local mafia = self.mafia_2_infos[i].fo
		mafia.FieldObjectController = CS.Oak.NPCCharacterController()
		mafias[i + 1] = mafia

		if self.mafia_2_infos[i].type == 'waypoint' then
			buff_manager:RemoveBuff(mafia, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, mafia, 'speed_down_persistent')
		end
	end

	--시야를 피해 열차에 상호작용하면 이벤트 시작.
	character_util.set_emotion(boss, {name = 'mad'})

	character_util.look_at(mafias[3], neva)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(mafias[3], '01_hit_npc_01')

	wp_util.move_way_points_async(mafias[3],
			{waypoints = self.get_mafia_target_pos(3, 1), speed = 6, run = true})

	--상단 풀밭을 도는 마피아 NPC. 1번 위치에 정렬.
	--마피아 : [shout] 저기 있다!
	--surprise 표정의 네바가 down을 바라보며 짧게 jump.
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.4)
	character_util.stop(neva)
	character_util.remove_anim(neva)
	neva.Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	mafias[3].Direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.normal_jump(neva, '01_player_jump_01')

	for i = 1, #self.mafia_2_infos do
		if i ~= 2 then
			character_util.look_at(self.mafia_2_infos[i].fo, neva)
		end
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_boss_intro', mix = 2, state = 'event'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(mafias[3],
			{key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_22', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})

	--카메라 해당 앵글이 나오는 지점까지 좌측으로 이동
	local cam_move_dur = 1.5
	camera_util.move(vector(29, 0, 60), cam_move_dur)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')

	--부하 마피아들이 일제히 하단에서 등장. 이후 해당 위치에서 right를 보며 (!) 말풍선을 출력.
	local move_done_count = 1	-- 위쪽 돌고 있는 마피아(3)는 이미 이동이 끝남
	local move_speed = 5
	local move_done_cb = function()
		move_done_count = move_done_count + 1
	end
	local emoticons = {}

	-- 카메라 무브가 끝나기 전에 나오지 못하도록 함 (1, 2)
	boss.Position = self.get_mafia_target_pos(1, 1)
			+ vector(-cam_move_dur * move_speed - 2, 0, 0)
	mafias[2].Position = self.get_mafia_target_pos(2, 1)
			+ vector(-cam_move_dur * move_speed - 2, 0, 0)

	for i = 1, 2 do
		wp_util.move_way_points(mafias[i], {waypoints = self.get_mafia_target_pos(i, 1),
										speed = move_speed, run = true, callback = move_done_cb})
	end

	for i = 4, #mafias do
		local mafia = mafias[i]
		local target_pos = self.get_mafia_target_pos(i, 1)

		if i ~= 6 and i ~= 4 then
			mafia.Position = target_pos + vector(0, 0, -5)
		end

		wp_util.move_way_points(mafia,
				{waypoints = target_pos, speed = move_speed, run = true, callback = function()
					move_done_cb()
					table.insert(emoticons,
							character_util.show_emoticon(mafia, nil, 'notice'))
				end, last_direction = CS.Oak.Direction.Right})
	end

	while move_done_count < #mafias do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--빌리가 좌측에서 mad 표정으로 등장.
	--보스 빌리 (right, mad)  : [shout] 이 쥐새끼같은 놈!
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_male_shout_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(boss,
			{key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_23', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})

	for _, emoticon in pairs(emoticons) do
		emoticon:Clear()
	end

	--배치된 마피아들 일제히 run 하여 지정된 위치에 배치. 이때 카메라는 우측으로 이동하며 이들을 따라가듯 움직임.
	local move_dur = 2

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
	for i = 1, #mafias do
		mafias[i].OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self:custom_move_wp(mafias[i], self.get_mafia_target_pos(i, 2), move_dur,
				true, 4, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)
	end

	camera_util.move(neva.Position, move_dur * 0.7)

	wait_for_sec(move_dur * 0.7)

	local boarding_dur = move_dur * 0.3
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(neva)
	self.controller:ride_train(neva, train, false)
	neva.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	local walls = {}

	for i = 1, 6 do
		walls[i] = self.get_disturbing_wall(i)
		walls[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	--네바가 앵글에 보일 때 쯤 열차에 탑승. 이후 둘러싸는 마피아들.
	--마피아들 배치된 위치에서 일제히 기관총 사격하는 순간 열차 출발함.
	local train_move_done = false
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_train_01')
	wp_util.move_way_points(train, {waypoints = field:GetMarker('train_2_2').position, speed = 4,
									callback = function()
										train_move_done = true
									end})

	for count = 1, 4 do
		camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.3)
		for i = 1, #mafias do
			character_util.remove_anim(mafias[i])

			if count ~= 4 then
				character_util.set_anim(mafias[i], {name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false})
			else
				character_util.set_anim(mafias[i], {name = 'rifle_shoot', loop = false, remove_after = 0.333})
			end

			self.shoot_helpers[i]:ShootTargetObject(train, vector(0, 0, 0.3), -1, true, 0)

			if i % 2 == 1 then
				wait_for_sec(0.1)
			end
		end
	end

	--열차가 그리드 밖으로 사라질 때까지 카메라 앵글 고정.
	while not train_move_done do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	--보스 빌리 (right, mad, jingak) : 이게 끝이라고 생각 마라!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_01')
	character_util.remove_group_anim(mafias)
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.5)
	character_util.play_speech_action(boss, {name = 'jingak', loop = false},
			nil, {key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_24', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_gun_ready_01')

	--대사 종료 후 페이드 아웃, 이후 식당가 그리드에 접근하는 열차 보여주면서 페이드 인.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', mix = 2.0})
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	for i = 1, #mafias do
		mafias[i].OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
		mafias[i].ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end

	for i = 1, #walls do
		walls[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	end

	camera_util.move_async(train.Position + vector(2, 0, 0.5), 0.1)
	train.Position = field:GetMarker('train_2_1').position

	screen_util.fade_in(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local train_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{ sfx_name = '01_train_02', fade_in_time = 1.5, loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	wp_util.move_way_points_async(train, {waypoints = field:GetMarker('train_2_2').position, speed = 4})
	train_sfx:FadeOut(2)

	neva.Position = train.Position + vector(1, 0, 0.5)
	neva.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, {name = 'damaged'})

	self.controller:alight_train(neva, train, 'right', true)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim(neva, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.move_to_async(neva, neva.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), nil, 4, nil, nil)

	--열차에서 내리면 네바의 독백

	-- 휴…죽을 뻔 했네. 하지만…
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(neva, { name = 'cast' }, { name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_25', skip = true })

	-- 네바 (right, attack, cross_arm) : 드래곤이 왜 여기까지 온 거지…?
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(neva, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_26', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(neva)
	-- 네바 (right, idle, cross_arm) : 무사히 빠져나간 것 같아 다행이지만…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_27', skip = true })

	-- 네바 (right, smile, sing) : …흐음? 희미하게 드래곤 냄새가…
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(neva, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_28', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(neva, {name = 'sing', scale = 0, mix_duration = 999})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	-- 네바 (right, tired, sing 정지) : 근데 음식 냄새가 너무 심해…어디인지 잘 모르겠어…
	character_util.play_speech_action(neva, nil,
			'tired', 'shortstory_dragon_main_s2_29')

	character_util.remove_anim(neva)

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if hit_info.target ~= nil then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(hit_info.position)
	end
end

function local_class:custom_move_wp(fo, waypoint, duration, run, min_speed, last_direction)
	local dist = (fo.Position - waypoint).magnitude
	local speed = math.max(dist / duration, min_speed)
	wp_util.move_way_points(fo,
			{waypoints = waypoint, speed = speed, run = run, last_direction = last_direction})
end

return local_class

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_npc_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_npc_interact_event(e)
	if self.talk_callbacks[e.Target] ~= nil then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_npc, self, e.Target))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_restaurant_signboard()) and self.is_first_interact_signboard then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_restaurant_signboard, self)
		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.talked_with_npc and
		type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_back_exit()) then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.leave_restaurant, self)

		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_train()) then
		-- 되돌아가면 벌집이 될 거야…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(user_party.Leader, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s3_1' })
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.is_restaurant_setting and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'restaurant_setting') then

		self.is_restaurant_setting = true
		self:restaurant_setting()

		return true
	end

	-- 식당 안에 들어왔을 때 이벤트
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'in_restaurant') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.enter_restaurant, self)

		return true
	end

	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.in_restaurant and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'restaurant_setting') then

		local worker_1 = self.get_worker_1()
		if not self.is_interacted_npc[worker_1] then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'section3_' .. worker_1.Name, worker_1)
		end

		local worker_2 = self.get_worker_2()
		if not self.is_interacted_npc[worker_2] then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'section3_' .. worker_2.Name, worker_2)
		end

		local guest = self.get_guest()
		if not self.is_interacted_npc[guest] then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'section3_' .. guest.Name, guest)
		end

		quest_marker_util.remove('section3_restaurant')

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneLeaveEvent
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.in_restaurant and
		type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'restaurant_setting') then

		local worker_1 = self.get_worker_1()
		if not self.is_interacted_npc[worker_1] then
			quest_marker_util.remove('section3_' .. worker_1.Name)
		end

		local worker_2 = self.get_worker_2()
		if not self.is_interacted_npc[worker_2] then
			quest_marker_util.remove('section3_' .. worker_2.Name)
		end

		local guest = self.get_guest()
		if not self.is_interacted_npc[guest] then
			quest_marker_util.remove('section3_' .. guest.Name)
		end

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller,
			'section3_restaurant', self.get_restaurant_exit_pos() + vector(0, 1, 1))

		return true
	end
	return false
end

--- CustomStageEvent
function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'caught_target' then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.talked_with_npc then
			self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.caught_by_chef
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.catch_by_chef, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

--- 레스토랑 안에 들어왔을 때 식당 내부 세팅
function local_class:restaurant_setting()
	-- 식당 안 주방장, 종업원, 손님 npc 세팅
	local worker_1 = self.get_worker_1()
	worker_1.Interactable.Talk = nil
	self.talk_callbacks[worker_1] = self.talk_with_worker_1
	character_util.add_listener(worker_1, self.controller)
	character_util.set_direction(worker_1, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(worker_1, { name = 'eat' })
	self.is_interacted_npc[worker_1] = false

	local worker_2 = self.get_worker_2()
	worker_2.Interactable.Talk = nil
	self.talk_callbacks[worker_2] = self.talk_with_worker_2
	character_util.add_listener(worker_2, self.controller)
	character_util.set_direction(worker_2, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(worker_2, { name = 'cry' })
	character_util.set_anim(worker_2, { name = 'cast2' })
	self.is_interacted_npc[worker_2] = false

	local guest = self.get_guest()
	guest.Interactable.Talk = nil
	self.talk_callbacks[guest] = self.talk_with_guest
	character_util.add_listener(guest, self.controller)
	character_util.set_direction(guest, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(guest, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(guest, { name = 'jingak' })
	self.is_interacted_npc[guest] = false

	local chef = self.get_chef()
	chef.Position = chef.Position + vector(-1, 0, -1.5)
	self.chef_reset_pos = chef.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(chef, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(chef, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(chef, { name = 'eat' })
	chef.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1.1, 0.75, 2))
	-- 참자… 참아… 진상들 상대하는 게 하루 이틀도 아니고…
	chef.Interactable.Talk = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s3_22'

	local assistant_1 = self.get_chef_assistant(1)
	character_util.set_emotion(assistant_1, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(assistant_1, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	local assistant_2 = self.get_chef_assistant(2)
	character_util.set_emotion(assistant_2, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(assistant_2, { name = 'eat' })

	self.controller:restaurant_item_setting()

	self.fire_effect = self.get_fire_effect_pool():Instantiate(
		self.get_restaurant_table_pos(1) + vector(0, 1.5, -0.5))

	-- 주방쪽 아이템 세팅
	self.chef_items = {}
	local chef_item_id = {
		self.controller.frypan_item_id,
		self.controller.knife_item_id,
		self.controller.whisker_item_id,
		self.controller.onion_item_id,
		self.controller.banquet_item_id,
		self.controller.tuna_item_id,
		self.controller.whisker_item_id,
		self.controller.frypan_item_id,
		self.controller.knife_item_id,
	}

	local chef_item_pos = self.get_chef_item_pos()
	local chef_item_pos_offset = {
		vector(0, 1, -0.5),
		vector(0, 1, -1.5),
		vector(0, 1, -2.5),
		vector(0, 1, -5),
		vector(0, 1, -6),
		vector(0, 1, -7),
		vector(0.7, 0, -3.7),
		vector(0.7, 0, -3.5),
		vector(0.3, 0, -3.7)
	}

	for i = 1, #chef_item_id do
		local scale = i < #chef_item_id - 2 and 0.7 or 0.5

		local drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{ pos = chef_item_pos + chef_item_pos_offset[i], itemid = chef_item_id[i],
			  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = scale })

		if i < #chef_item_id - 2 then
			drop_item.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 1, -0.03)
		else
			table.insert(self.chef_front_item, drop_item)
		end

		table.insert(self.chef_items, drop_item)
		table.insert(self.controller.restaurant_drop_items, drop_item)
	end
end

-- 레스토랑 안에 들어왔을 때 이벤트
function local_class:enter_restaurant()
	local neva = user_party.Leader

	local crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', loop = true })

	character_util.normal_jump(neva, '01_player_jump_01')
	-- 이 냄새는?!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s3_2', skip = true })

	-- 주변을 두리번 거리는 네바
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.set_anim(neva, { name = 'sing' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(neva)
	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'up')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	-- 여기야, 분명 이곳에 있었어!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s3_3', skip = true })

	local worker_1 = self.get_worker_1()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'section3_' .. worker_1.Name, worker_1)

	local worker_2 = self.get_worker_2()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'section3_' .. worker_2.Name, worker_2)

	local guest = self.get_guest()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'section3_' .. guest.Name, guest)

	crowd_sfx:FadeOut(1)
end

--- 식당을 떠났을 때 이벤트
function local_class:leave_restaurant()
	-- 현재 배틀 강제 종료
	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	local chef = self.get_chef()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(chef)

	self.get_back_entrance().Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ state = 'combat', name = 'bgm_battle_normal' })
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async(
		{ state = 'field', name = 'ondemand/v2_14_dragon/audio:bgm_neva_main' })

	local cb = function()
		-- bgm_transition: Event(bgm_ride) -> Field(bgm_neva_main), 2
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })
	end

	self.controller:teleport_party_to_marker('restaurant_back_exit', cb)

	quest_util.progress_section(self.controller)
end

--- 식당 안의 종업원, 주방장, 손님한테 말 걸었을 때 이벤트
function local_class:talk_with_npc(npc)
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	local neva = user_party.Leader

	character_util.remove_relate_event(npc, self.controller)

	quest_marker_util.remove('section3_' .. npc.Name)
	self.is_interacted_npc[npc] = true

	camera_util.move(npc.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0), 1)
	party_util.align_to_target(npc, 'left', 1)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_dragon_boy, self))

	-- 대화 연출
	self.talk_callbacks[npc](self, npc)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 세 명한테 전부 말을 걸기 전까지
	self.target_interact_count = self.target_interact_count - 1
	if self.target_interact_count > 0 then
		field_ui_manager:Show()
		party_util.reset_controllers()
		return
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_newinfo_01')
	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	character_util.set_anim(neva, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local worker_1 = self.get_worker_1()
	local worker_2 = self.get_worker_2()
	local guest = self.get_guest()
	local chef = self.get_chef()
	local assistant_1 = self.get_chef_assistant(1)
	local assistant_2 = self.get_chef_assistant(2)

	chef.Interactable.Talk = nil

	local restaurant_npcs = { worker_1, worker_2, guest, chef, assistant_1, assistant_2 }

	local table_2_drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = vector(999, 0, 999), itemid = self.controller.buldojang_item_id,
		  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.7 })

	table.insert(self.controller.restaurant_drop_items, table_2_drop_item)

	-- bgm_transition: Field(bgm_neva_main) -> Event(bgm_neva_event), 2
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
		{ name = 'ondemand/v2_14_dragon/audio:bgm_neva_event', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_05')

	-- 전체 페이드 아웃 + 줌인
	self.fire_effect.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	camera_util.resize_to(3, 1)
	self.controller:add_field_tint(1, nil, { npcs = restaurant_npcs, items = self.controller.restaurant_drop_items,
											 gos = { self.get_fireplace().transform:GetChild(0).gameObject, } })

	-- 페이트 아웃 때 세팅
	local table_2_pos = self.get_restaurant_table_pos(2)
	table_2_drop_item.Position =  table_2_pos + vector(0, 1, 0)
	table_2_drop_item.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 1, -0.03)

	-- 화면 밖에 있으면 틴트가 바로 적용되지 않아 잠시 꺼줌
	for _, v in pairs(restaurant_npcs) do
		character_util.set_active_state(v, 'disabled')
	end

	worker_2.Position = worker_2.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	worker_2.Interactable.Talk = nil

	worker_1.Position = worker_1.Position + vector(3, 0, 0)
	worker_1.Interactable.Talk = nil

	guest.Position = guest.Position + vector(4, 0, -1)
	guest.Interactable.Talk = nil

	chef.Position = chef.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)
	chef.Interactable.Talk = nil

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(assistant_1)
	character_util.set_direction(assistant_1, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(assistant_1, { name = 'tired' })

	character_util.remove_anim(assistant_2)
	assistant_2.Position = assistant_2.Position + vector(0, 0, 1.5)
	character_util.set_direction(assistant_2, 'left')

	character_util.remove_anim(guest)
	character_util.set_direction(guest, 'right')

	local worker_1_front_item = self.controller.restaurant_drop_items[4]
	worker_1_front_item.Position = worker_1.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)

	local restaurant_center_pos = self.get_restaurant_center_pos()
	neva.Position = restaurant_center_pos

	character_util.remove_anim(chef)

	character_util.set_anim(chef, { name = 'hold_loop', loop = false })
	for _, item in pairs(self.chef_front_item) do
		item:SetSortingLayer(true)
		item.Position = item.Position + vector(-0.5, 1.25, 0)
		item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 19, 0)
		item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero
	end

	-- 드래곤은 무슨 생각으로 이곳에 온 걸까…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s3_23', skip = true })

	-- 나라면… 아니 내가 드래곤이라면… 이곳에 왜 왔을까…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s3_24', skip = true })

	-- 그래…나는 드래곤이다…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s3_25', skip = true })

	for _, v in pairs(restaurant_npcs) do
		character_util.set_active_state(v, 'enabled')
	end

	self.fire_effect.gameObject:SetActive(true)

	local crowd_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_02', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })

	self.controller:remove_field_tint(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(neva)

	-- 나는 드래곤도 놀랄 마법의 국물이라는 광고를 보고 이곳에 오게 되었다.
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s3_26', skip = true }),
		util.cs_generator(
			character_util.move_waypoint_async, neva, table_2_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0), 1)
	})

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(neva, 0.7, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(neva, table_2_pos + vector(0.5, 1, 0), 0.5)

	character_util.set_anim(worker_1, { name = 'release' })

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', loop = true })

	character_util.set_anim(neva, { name = 'eat' })
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'damaged' })
	-- 처음 먹어보는 매콤하고 알싸한 맛.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s3_27', skip = true })

	eat_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.remove_emotion(neva)

	character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'awesome' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	-- 인간들의 뛰어난 음식 솜씨에 감탄사가 절로 나온다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s3_28', skip = true })

	-- 회전하며 던져지는 아이템 연출
	local drop_rotate_item_func = function(target, duration, end_pos, height, rotate_count)
		local time_passed = 0

		local start_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Position)
		local start_pos_y = target.SpriteTransform.localPosition.y

		target.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0, -0.03)

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
			target.Position = cur_pos

			local cur_rot_z = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 360 * rotate_count, progress)
			target.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, cur_rot_z)

			local cur_pos_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_pos_y, 0.05, progress)
			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI * progress) * height + cur_pos_y
			target.SpriteTransform.localPosition = vector(0, cur_y, 0)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	local drop_items = {}

	-- 아이템 여러 가지 던지는 여출
	local drop_item = function()
		local item_id = {
			self.controller.greenonion_item_id,
			self.controller.ham_item_id,
			self.controller.carrot_item_id,
			self.controller.broccoli_item_id
		}

		for i = 1, #item_id do
			local drop_item

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')

			-- 두 번째 아이템은 종업원1이 맞는 연출을 위해 따로 세팅
			if i == 2 then
				drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = neva.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0), itemid = item_id[i],
					  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.7, showoncharacter = true })

				drop_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.zero

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
					drop_rotate_item_func(drop_item, 0.4,
						worker_1.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.7), 2, 3)

					drop_item.ShadowTransform.localScale = 0.7 * unity_class.vector3.one

					character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(worker_1)

					character_util.set_emotion(worker_1, { name = 'surprise' })
					character_util.normal_jump(worker_1, '01_player_jump_01')

					self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(drop_item.Position + vector(0, 1, -0.5))

					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
					character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(worker_1)
					character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(worker_1)

					drop_rotate_item_func(drop_item, 0.4,
						worker_1.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0), 2, 3)

					drop_item:SetSortingLayer(false)
				end))

			else
				drop_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
					{ pos = neva.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0),
					  target = self.get_restaurant_item_pos(i + 11), itemid = item_id[i],
					  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.7 })
			end

			table.insert(drop_items, drop_item)
			table.insert(self.controller.restaurant_drop_items, drop_item)

			wait_for_sec(0.3)
		end
	end

	-- 동시에 나는 어리고 철이 없어 테이블을 난장판으로 만든다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_slide_01')
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(drop_item),
		util.cs_generator(
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s3_29', skip = true })
	})

	target.FieldObjectController.DontFight = true
	local origin_hit_box = target.Hitbox
	target.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1, 0.75, 2))

	command_util.execute_monster_notice(target, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
	target.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	target.Hitbox = origin_hit_box

function local_class:show_dragon_boy()
	local neva = user_party.Leader
	local dragon_boy = self.get_dragon_boy()
	local guard_1 = self.get_guard(1)
	local guard_2 = self.get_guard(2)
	local guard_3 = self.get_guard(3)
	local guard_4  = get_character('restaurant_guest_3')
	local guard_5  = get_character('restaurant_guest_2')

	local npc_origin_pos = {}
	npc_origin_pos[guard_1] = guard_1.Position
	npc_origin_pos[guard_2] = guard_2.Position
	npc_origin_pos[guard_3] = guard_3.Position
	npc_origin_pos[guard_4] = guard_4.Position
	npc_origin_pos[guard_5] = guard_5.Position

	local start_pos = vector(self.get_guard_start_pos().x, 0, neva.Position.z + 8)
	local end_pos = vector(self.get_guard_end_pos().x, 0, neva.Position.z - 8)

	local dash_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_dash_01', loop = true })

	if self.dragon_boy_event == 1 then
		-- 첫 번째
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_laugh_evil_01')

		character_util.set_active_state(dragon_boy, 'enabled')
		dragon_boy.Position = start_pos
		character_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, { name = 'awesome' })
		character_util.set_anim(dragon_boy,
			{ name = CS.Oak.CharacterExtensions.GetCustomRunAnimation(dragon_boy) })

		character_util.set_active_state(guard_1, 'enabled')
		guard_1.Position = start_pos + vector(0, 0, 2)
		character_util.set_direction(guard_1, 'down')
		table.insert(self.run_npcs, guard_1)

	elseif self.dragon_boy_event == 2 then
		-- 두 번째
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')

		dragon_boy.Position = end_pos
		character_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'up')
		character_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, { name = 'embarrassed' })

		guard_1.Position = end_pos + vector(0, 0, -2)
		character_util.set_direction(guard_1, 'up')

		guard_4.Position = end_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -3)
		character_util.set_direction(guard_4, 'up')
		table.insert(self.run_npcs, guard_4)

		guard_5.Position = end_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -3)
		character_util.set_direction(guard_5, 'up')
		table.insert(self.run_npcs, guard_5)
	else
		-- 세 번째
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dash_06')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_06')

		dragon_boy.Position = start_pos
		character_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, { name = 'scared' })
		character_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, { name = 'embarrassed' })

		guard_1.Position = start_pos + vector(0, 0, 2)
		character_util.set_direction(guard_1, 'down')

		guard_4.Position = start_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 3)
		character_util.set_direction(guard_4, 'down')

		guard_5.Position = start_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 3)
		character_util.set_direction(guard_5, 'down')

		character_util.set_active_state(guard_2, 'enabled')
		guard_2.Position = start_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 4)
		character_util.set_direction(guard_2, 'down')
		table.insert(self.run_npcs, guard_2)

		character_util.set_active_state(guard_3, 'enabled')
		guard_3.Position = start_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 4)
		character_util.set_direction(guard_3, 'down')
		table.insert(self.run_npcs, guard_3)
	end

	local pos = self.dragon_boy_event == 2 and start_pos or end_pos

	local move_end = 0

	-- 쫓아가는 npc 이동
	for _, npc in pairs(self.run_npcs) do
		local cb = function(_)
			move_end = move_end + 1
		end

		character_util.set_emotion(npc, { name = 'mad' })
		character_util.move_waypoint(npc, vector(npc.Position.x, 0, pos.z), 5, true,
			nil, nil, 'up', false, nil, cb)
	end

	character_util.move_to_async(dragon_boy, vector(dragon_boy.Position.x, 0, pos.z), nil, 5)

	dash_sfx:Stop()

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dragon_boy)
	dragon_boy.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	-- 쫓아가는 npc들 이동이 끝나기까지 대기
	while move_end < #self.run_npcs do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for _, npc in pairs(self.run_npcs) do
		npc.Position = npc_origin_pos[npc]
	end

	self.dragon_boy_event = self.dragon_boy_event + 1
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryDovahkiinMainSection4')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.get_neva = function() return get_character('neva') end
	self.get_dragon_boy = function() return get_character('dragon_boy') end

	self.get_sewer_entrance = function() return get_field_object('sewer_entrance') end

	self.event_state = {
		before_enter_sewer = 1,
		in_sewer = 2,
		done = 3,
	}
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_enter_sewer

	self.saying_cannot_enter = false

	self.entrance_fire_loop_sfx = nil
	self.aircraft_loop_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_custom_stage_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	self.entrance_fire_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{sfx_name = '01_fire_01', parent = get_field_object('factory_entrance_fire'),
			 loop = true, max_distance = 4, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'object'})
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if self.entrance_fire_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.entrance_fire_loop_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.entrance_fire_loop_sfx = nil

	if self.aircraft_loop_sfx ~= nil then
		self.aircraft_loop_sfx:Stop()
	end
	self.aircraft_loop_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_sewer_entrance())
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_enter_sewer then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.in_sewer
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_sewer, self))

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'dragon_boy_soup_run' and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.none then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.dragon_boy_running, self ))
		return true
	end

	if zone_name == 'witch_office' and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.see_dragon_boy_running then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_name, self.get_witch_desk(), true)
		return true
	end

	if zone_name == 'ignore_witch' and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.see_dragon_boy_running and e.FullEnter then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.blocking_ignore, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- MoveFieldObjectEvent
function local_class:on_move_fo_event(e)
	if self.following_witch_with_train and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.train) then

		self.witch.Direction = self.train.Direction

		if self.witch.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			self.witch.Position = self.train.Position + vector(-0.4, 2.5, 0.3)
		elseif self.witch.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
			self.witch.Position = self.train.Position + vector(0.4, 2.5, 0.3)
		else
			self.witch.Position = self.train.Position + vector(0, 2, 1.3)
		end

		-- 플레이어와 충돌했을 때
		if not (math.abs(self:get_overlapped_xz_area(user_party.Leader.Bounds, self.train.Bounds)) < constants.epsilon) and
			self.current_event_state == self.event_state.out_office then

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
				character_util.stop(self.train)

				local neva = user_party.Leader

				camera_util.move_async(stage_camera.transform.parent.position, 0)
				character_util.set_active_shadow(neva, false)

				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_teatan_scream_01')

				local duration = 1.5
				character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'damaged' })
				character_util.set_anim(neva, { name = 'embarrassed' })
				character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(neva)
				character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(neva)
				self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(neva.Position)
				character_util.spine_rotate(neva, 360 * 6, duration)
				if self.train.Direction == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
					sp_util.sine_move(neva,
						{ from = neva.Position, to = neva.Position + vector(-12, 0, 0),
						  duration = duration, height = 4 })
				else
					sp_util.sine_move(neva,
						{ from = neva.Position, to = neva.Position + vector(12, 0, 0),
						  duration = duration, height = 4 })
				end

				self:chasing_train_reset()
			end)
			return true
		end

		if not self.rocks then return false end

		-- 바위와 충돌했을 때
		for _, rock in pairs(self.rocks) do
			if rock.ActiveState == active_state('enabled') and
				not (math.abs(self:get_overlapped_xz_area(rock.Bounds, self.train.Bounds)) < constants.epsilon) then

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick
				damage_info.sender = self.train
				damage_info.target = rock
				damage_info.damage = 100

				command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

		if self.current_event_state == self.event_state.talk_with_witch then

			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.catch_by_witch, self)

		end
