function local_class:dragon_boy_running()
	local dragon_boy = self.get_dragon_boy()
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.see_dragon_boy_running

	dragon_boy.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	character_util.set_position(dragon_boy, self.dragon_boy_start_pos)
	character_util.remove_anim(dragon_boy)
	character_util.set_emotion(dragon_boy, { name = 'awesome' })

	character_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, { name = 'run' })
	character_util.move_waypoint(dragon_boy, {  self.dragon_boy_end_pos }, 4.5, true, nil, 'floor', 'down', true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_positive_01', parent = dragon_boy, type_priority = 'event' })
	-- 토마토 스프 냄새가 나!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dragon_boy, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_1', skip = false, life_time = 2, type_speed = 0 })
	-- 인간들이 만들 수 있는 최고의 음식!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(dragon_boy, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_2', skip = false, life_time = 2, type_speed = 0 })

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_anim(dragon_boy)
	character_util.set_position(dragon_boy, self.dragon_boy_belt_pos)
end

function local_class:blocking_ignore()
	local witch = self.get_witch()
	local neva = self.get_neva()

	character_util.set_direction(witch, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'left')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- 홀홀. 거기가 아니에요 아가씨
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_7', skip = true })

	character_util.move_to_async(neva, vector(42, 0, neva.Position.z), nil, 2.5, true, true)

	character_util.set_direction(witch, 'left')
end

function local_class:talk_with_witch()
	local witch = self.get_witch()
	local neva = self.get_neva()
	local dragon_boy = self.get_dragon_boy()
	local employee = { self.get_employee(1), self.get_employee(2), self.get_employee(3), self.get_employee(4)}
	local witch_signboard = self.get_witch_signboard()

	witch_signboard.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)

	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.talk_with_witch

	party_util.align_party(witch.Position + vector(-1,-0.5,0.1), 'left',1, 'linear')

	character_util.set_emotion(witch, { name = 'smile' })
	-- 오오, 멋진 바이킹 아가씨네요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_8', skip = true })

	local clap_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_02', loop = true})
	character_util.set_anim(witch, { name = 'clap' })
	-- 아주 잘 찾아왔어요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_9', skip = true})

	clap_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.set_anim(witch, { name = 'seat' })
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'tired' })
	-- 아… 저는…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_10', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(witch, { name = 'doyagao' })
	character_util.nod_twice(witch)
	-- 이 할미가 다 알아요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_11', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(witch, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'smile'})
	-- 가맹 문의를 하고 싶어 찾아왔죠?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_12', skip = true })

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(neva, nil, 'question')
	character_util.set_anim(witch, { name = 'seat' })
	-- 이 할미의 정성이 담긴 토마토 스프를 팔고 싶은 거잖아요. 홀홀홀.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_13', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(witch)
	-- FB 에 올라온 리뷰를 보고 찾아왔겠지만…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_14', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(witch, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'smile'})
	-- 이 할미 손맛은 다른 프랜차이즈에서 흉내를 못내요~
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_15', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(witch)
	character_util.set_anim(witch, { name = 'seat' })
	-- 아, 마녀 할미라고 해서 개구리를 넣지는 않…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_16', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'smile' })
	-- 아 저는 그러니까, 친구를 찾고 있거든요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_17', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim(neva, { name = 'cast' })
	-- 걔는 드래곤인데, 한 번도 만난 적은 없지만, 토마토 스프를 좋아하고…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(neva, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_18', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(neva)
	local sfx_phone = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_phone_receive_01', loop = true,
												  type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})

	character_util.remove_anim(witch)
	character_util.set_emotion(witch, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.normal_jump(witch, true)

	local follower_data = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('FollowerData')
	local employee_id = 55
	local spec = follower_data:GetSpec(employee_id)
	local portrait_name = spec.PortraitName
	local text = game_string:GetString('shortstory_dragon_main_s5_18_1')
	local sns_obj = CS.Oak.SNSMessage.Create('shortstory_dragon_main_s5_18_2', portrait_name, text)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSEvent.Create(sns_obj))

	camera_util.shake(0.02, 1.75)

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SNSTouchPoppedEvent), 'on_sns_touch_popped_event')

	local time_passed = 0

	while self.sns_popped == false and time_passed < 1.75 do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera_util.cancel_shake()

	if self.sns_popped == false then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSPopEvent.Instance)
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SNSTouchPoppedEvent))

	wait_for_sec(1)
	witch.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'maiden_phone')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(witch, { name = 'twohand_idle' }, { name = 'smile'})
	sfx_phone:Stop()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	-- 오구오구, 우리 공장장님이 무슨 일이에요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_19', skip = true })
	-- 충분히 쉬면서 일하고 있는 거지요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_20', skip = true })
	-- 으으응? CCTV 를 봐줬음 한다고요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_21', skip = true })

	witch.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	character_util.remove_anim(witch)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
	character_util.jump_move(witch, witch.Position + vector(0, -0.5, 1), 4, 0.7, true, 'up')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	character_util.move_waypoint(witch, {
		vector(witch.Position.x,0,-25 + 0.3),
		vector(33.9,0,-25 + 0.3)
	}, 3, false, nil, nil, 'left')
	camera_util.move(neva.Position + vector(0,0,1), 1, { ignorecameragrids = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'up')
	character_util.show_emoticon(neva, nil, 'question')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(witch, 'left')

	-- 그래, 어디 보자, 어디 보자…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_38', skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')

	character_util.set_position(witch, witch.Position + vector(4,0,0))
	character_util.set_position(neva, witch.Position + vector(-4,0,0))
	character_util.set_direction(witch, 'right')
	witch.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'maiden_phone')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(witch, { name = 'twohand_idle' }, { name = 'mad'})

	character_util.set_direction(dragon_boy, 'left')

	camera_util.move(dragon_boy.Position + vector(-1.5,0,-1), 0, { ignorecameragrids = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(call_employee)
	call_employee.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	end

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(employee[1])

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_24', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(witch, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'smile'})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(witch, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s5_25', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(witch)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')

	camera_util.cancel_shake()
	character_util.remove_anim(witch)
	character_util.remove_anim(neva)

	effect:Dispose()

	self.witch_reset_pos = witch.Position
	self.neva_reset_pos = neva.Position

	for i = 1, 3 do
		get_field_object('bulletin_board_' .. i).ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled
	end

	-- 사무실 출구 직접 제어하도록 Interactable 변경
	local office_stair = self.get_runway_entrance()
	office_stair.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	stage.BattleManager:AddToNoAssassination(witch)
	self:convert_to_chasing_state(witch)
end

--- 마녀한테 잡혔을 때
function local_class:catch_by_witch()
	-- 현재 배틀 강제 종료
	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	local witch = self.get_witch()
	local neva = user_party.Leader

	character_util.convert_to_npc(witch)

	character_util.look_at(neva, witch)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim(neva, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	-- 일시 정지 버튼을 눌렀을 때 페이드 아웃이 진행되지 않도록 하기 위함
	wait_for_sec(0.01)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	-- 페이드 인 아웃 세팅
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_direction(witch, 'left')
	witch.Position = self.witch_reset_pos
	witch.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.remove_anim(neva)
	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'right')
	neva.Position = self.neva_reset_pos
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	self:convert_to_chasing_state(witch)

	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.talk_with_witch
end

--- 식당을 떠났을 때 이벤트
function local_class:leave_office()
	self.get_runway_exit().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	-- 현재 배틀 강제 종료
	stage.BattleManager:ForceEndBattles()

	local witch = self.get_witch()
	character_util.convert_to_npc(witch)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_in_teleport_01')

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')

	-- 파티원이 네바 하나 뿐이라 다른 파티원은 따로 계산하지 않음
	-- FIXME : 배경이 보이지 않는 다른 구역 사이로 이동하는 경우 다른 곳으로 나갔다 오면 해결되므로 임시로 이렇게 수정

	character_util.spine_scale(user_party.Leader, unity_class.vector3.zero, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')

	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.6, 'ease_in_out_sine')

	self:run_away_from_witch(true)
end

-- 컨베이어벨트
function local_class:work_conveyor_belt(zone_name, turn_on)
	local zone = field:GetZone(zone_name)

	local fo_list = CS.Oak.LuaCollisionUtil.GetFieldObjectsCollidedBy(unity_class.vector3.zero, zone.Bounds)

	for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
		local fo = fo_list[i]
		if table_util.contain_value(self.belt_gimmick_name, fo.Name) then
			local animator = fo:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
			if turn_on then
				animator:Play('xmas_belt_rolling')
				animator.speed = 3
			else
				animator:Play('empty')
				animator.speed = 1
			end
		end
	end
	fo_list:Dispose()
end

function local_class:activate_factory()
	local create_soup_delay = 2
	while self.deactive_factory_event == false do
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.create_soup, self, 1 ))
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.create_soup, self, 2 ))

		wait_for_sec(create_soup_delay)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:employee_jump()
	local employee = { self.get_employee(1), self.get_employee(2), self.get_employee(3), self.get_employee(4)}
	while self.deactive_factory_event == false do
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(employee[2])
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(employee[3])
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(employee[1])
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_jump_01')
		character_util.normal_jump(employee[4])
		wait_for_sec(0.3)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:create_soup(belt_index)
	local soup = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = self.belt_start_pos[belt_index],
	                                         itemid = 20316, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
	local fade_duration = (self.belt_end_pos[belt_index].x - self.belt_start_pos[belt_index].x - 3 ) / 2

	soup.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)
	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(soup, 0, 0)
	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_in_async(soup, 0.5)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.moving_soup, self, soup, belt_index))

	wait_for_sec(fade_duration)

	drop_item_util.alpha_fade_async(soup, 0, 0.8)

	wait_for_sec(2)
	drop_item_util.dispose_item(soup)
end

function local_class:moving_soup(soup, belt_index)
	local duration = (self.belt_end_pos[belt_index].x - self.belt_start_pos[belt_index].x) / 2
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(self.belt_start_pos[belt_index], self.belt_end_pos[belt_index], (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / duration)

		soup:SetPosition(cur_pos)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:dragon_boy_eating_soup()
	local dragon_boy = self.get_dragon_boy()
	character_util.set_locked_dir(dragon_boy, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	while self.deactive_factory_event == false do
		character_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, { name = 'run' })
		character_util.move_to_async(dragon_boy, self.dragon_boy_belt_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0), 1.04)
		if self.dont_play_eat_sfx == false then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
			self.eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
					{ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', loop = false, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npcs' })
		end
		character_util.set_anim(dragon_boy, { name = 'eat' })
		character_util.move_to_async(dragon_boy, self.dragon_boy_belt_pos, 1)
		if self.eat_sfx ~= nil then
			self.eat_sfx:Stop()
		end
		self.eat_sfx = nil
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	character_util.set_locked_dir(dragon_boy, 'none')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(dragon_boy)
end

--- 마녀로부터 도망가는 연출
function local_class:run_away_from_witch(first)
	local neva = user_party.Leader
	local witch = self.get_witch()

	witch.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'signboard_staff')

	local out_office_event_func = function(target)
		local duration = 0.5
		character_util.spine_scale(target, unity_class.vector3.one, duration)
		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, scale = 100 })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
		character_util.jump(target, 1, duration)
		character_util.move_to_async(target, target.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), duration)

		character_util.remove_anim(target)
	end

	local jump_tile = self.get_runaway_jump_tile()
	local jump_tile_center = vector_util.get_x0z(jump_tile.Bounds.center)

	-- 통로에서 나오는 네바 연출
	out_office_event_func(neva)

	self.neva_run_speed = 4
	character_util.move_waypoint(neva, jump_tile_center, self.neva_run_speed, true,
		nil, nil, nil, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if not first then
		-- bgm_transition: Muted -> Event(bgm_ride)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_ride', state = 'event' })
	end

	-- 통로에서 나오는 마녀 연출
	out_office_event_func(witch)

	-- 첫 번째 qte 지역까지 이동
	local qte_pos_1 = self.get_runaway_qte_pos(1)

	-- 첫 번째 qte 이벤트
	local clear = self:runaway_qte_routine('right', qte_pos_1)

	if not clear then
		return
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.9)

	character_util.remove_anim(witch)

	-- 두 번째 qte 지역까지 이동
	local qte_pos_2 = self.get_runaway_qte_pos(2)

	-- 두 번째 qte 이벤트
	clear = self:runaway_qte_routine('right', qte_pos_2)

	if not clear then
		return
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(witch)

	character_util.move_waypoint(witch, jump_tile_center, 5)
	character_util.set_anim(witch, { name = 'twohand_run' })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.stop(witch)
	character_util.stop(neva)

	local move_duration = 1.5

	-- 점프 타일가지 달려가는 마녀
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	local witch_target_pos = jump_tile_center + vector(-0.7, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_anim(witch, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false, scale = 0.65 })
	character_util.jump(witch, 1.5, move_duration)
	character_util.move_waypoint(witch, witch_target_pos,
		(witch_target_pos - witch.Position).magnitude / move_duration)

	-- 점프 타일까지 달려가는 네바
	local neva_target_pos = jump_tile_center + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_waypoint(neva, neva_target_pos,
		(neva_target_pos - neva.Position).magnitude / move_duration, true)

	wait_for_sec(move_duration)

	character_util.set_anim(witch, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false, scale = 0 })

	character_util.stop(witch)
	character_util.stop(neva)

	character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(neva, { name = 'embarrassed' })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_evolution_01')

	-- 점프 타일 작동
	local jump_tile_animator = jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	jump_tile_animator:Play('on')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_jumptile_01')
	local blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })

	character_util.set_active_shadow(neva, false)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(witch, false)

	local height = 3
	local dist = 10
	local duration = 2

	-- 점프 타일 밟고 날라가는 네바
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local time_passed = 0

		local start_pos = neva.Position
		local end_pos = neva.Position + vector(dist, 0, 0)

		self.neva_jump_end = false

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI / 2 * progress) * height

			neva.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, cur_y, 0)

			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

			neva.Position = cur_pos

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.neva_jump_end = true
	end))

	-- 점프 타일 밟고 날라가는 마녀
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		local time_passed = 0

		local start_pos = witch.Position
		local end_pos = witch.Position + vector(dist + 0.4, 0, 0)

		self.witch_jump_end = false

		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress_1 = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInSine(time_passed, 0, 1, duration))
			local progress_2 = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)
			local progress = (progress_1 + progress_2) / 2

			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI / 2 * progress) * height

			witch.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, cur_y, 0)

			local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

			witch.Position = cur_pos

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		self.witch_jump_end = true
	end))

	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	jump_tile_animator:Play('off')

	wait_for_sec((duration / 2) - 0.1)

	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.2, 'jump')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')

	clear = self:qte_routine('down', witch, self.qte_kind_enum.jump)

	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('jump')

	while not self.neva_jump_end or not self.witch_jump_end do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	camera_util.move_async(neva.Position, 0)

	local witch_start_pos = witch.Position
	local witch_end_pos = witch.Position + vector(dist, 0, 0)

	duration = 1.5

	-- 실패했을 때
	if not clear then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_teatan_scream_01')

		character_util.set_anim(witch, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false, scale = 2 })
		self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(
			neva.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 3), unity_class.quaternion.identity, neva.Transform)

		character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'hurt' })
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(neva)

		local time_passed = 0

		local neva_start_pos = neva.Position
		local neva_end_pos = neva.Position + vector(dist, 0, 0)

		-- 마녀랑 네바 둘 다 화면 밖으로 날아감
		while time_passed < duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

			local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI / 2 + unity_class.mathf.PI / 2 * progress) * height

			neva.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, cur_y, 0)
			witch.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, cur_y, 0)

			local neva_cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(neva_start_pos, neva_end_pos, progress)
			neva.Position = neva_cur_pos

			local witch_cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(witch_start_pos, witch_end_pos, progress)
			witch.Position = witch_cur_pos

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(2)

		self:witch_follow_reset(true)

		return
	end

	character_util.set_emotion(witch, { name = 'surprise' })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(neva)

	-- 성공했을 때

	-- 네바 공중 회전 연출
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')

		local rotate_duration = 0.4
		character_util.spine_rotate(neva, -360, rotate_duration)
		character_util.move_to_async(
			neva, neva.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), rotate_duration)

		character_util.set_anim(neva, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false, scale = 2 })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.move_to_async(
			neva, neva.Position + vector(0, 0, -10), duration - rotate_duration - 0.5)

		neva.SpineController.SpineOffset = unity_class.vector3.zero
	end))

	local time_passed = 0

	-- 마녀는 화면 밖으로 날아감
	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / duration)

		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Sin(unity_class.mathf.PI / 2 + unity_class.mathf.PI / 2 * progress) * height

		witch.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, cur_y, 0)

		local witch_cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(witch_start_pos, witch_end_pos, progress)
		witch.Position = witch_cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(2)

	-- bgm_transition: Event(bgm_ride) -> Muted
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	-- 페이드 인 아웃 세팅
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	local start_pos = self.get_train_chasing_start_pos()
	neva.Position = start_pos
	neva.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, 15, 0)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(neva, true)

	local train = self.get_chasing_train()
	character_util.set_active_state(train, 'enabled')

	character_util.set_active_shadow(witch, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(witch)

	self.following_witch_with_train = true
	character_util.stop(witch)
	witch.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	witch.SpineController:SetSortingLayer('Default', 1)
	character_util.remove_anim(witch)
	character_util.set_direction(witch, 'left')

	camera_util.move_async(start_pos, 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 낙하 연출

		fall_cal:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local cur_y = unity_class.mathf.Max(fall_cal:GetDistance(), 0)
		neva.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, cur_y, 0)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_01')
	self.get_viking_effect():Instantiate(neva.Position + vector(1 ,0, 0))
	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(neva)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 좌우 두리번 두리번
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(neva, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'tired' })
	-- 따돌린 건가...?

	character_util.remove_emotion(neva)

	character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(neva, '01_player_jump_01')

	blizzard_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	self.train_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_train_02', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })
	camera_util.move_async(neva.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), 1)

	character_util.set_emotion(witch, { name = 'mad' })

	character_util.move_waypoint(train, train.Position + vector(-5, 0, 0), 2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_train_01')
	-- bgm_transition: Muted -> Event(bgm_run), 2

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(witch, { name = 'bomb_attack', count = 2 })

	-- 이 할미가 놓칠 것 같으냐!

function local_class:runaway_qte_routine(swipe, qte_pos)
	local witch = self.get_witch()
	local neva = user_party.Leader

	character_util.set_anim(witch, { name = 'twohand_run' })
	local qte_start_pos = qte_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0)
	character_util.move_to_async(witch, qte_start_pos, nil, 4.7)

	local witch_speed = 5.5
	local target_pos = neva.Position + vector(4, 0, 0)
	local duration = (target_pos.x - qte_start_pos.x) / witch_speed

	character_util.set_anim(witch, { name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false, scale = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.jump(witch, 1, duration)
	character_util.move_waypoint(witch, target_pos, witch_speed)
	wait_for_sec(duration / 2)

	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.2, 'run')

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time

	local clear = self:qte_routine(swipe, witch, self.qte_kind_enum.runaway)

	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('run')

	local miss_duration = duration / 3

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration / 2 do
		if clear and unity_class.time.time - cur_time > miss_duration then
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(neva, vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.2)
			miss_duration = 999
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 틀렸을 때
	if not clear then
		character_util.stop(neva)
		character_util.set_emotion(neva, { name = 'hurt' })
		character_util.set_anim(neva, { name = 'frustration', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01' })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_01')

		self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(neva.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0.5))
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(neva)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(neva)

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		self:witch_follow_reset(false)

		return false
	end

	-- 성공했을 때
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('run')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')

	return true
end

--- QTE 실행 루틴
function local_class:qte_routine(swipe, target, qte_kind)
	local neva = user_party.Leader

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')

	-- 스와이프 결과
	local swipe_value = 'none'

	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
				swipe_value = 'left'
				return true
			end

			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
				swipe_value = 'right'
				return true
			end

			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
				swipe_value = 'down'
				return true
			end

			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
				swipe_value = 'up'
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe(swipe)

	if qte_kind == self.qte_kind_enum.runaway then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')

		while swipe_value == 'none' and neva.Position.x - target.Position.x > 1 do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

	elseif qte_kind == self.qte_kind_enum.jump then
		while swipe_value == 'none' and (not self.neva_jump_end or not self.witch_jump_end) do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

	elseif qte_kind == self.qte_kind_enum.train then
		while swipe_value == 'none' and target.Position.x - neva.Position.x > 2 do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	local result = swipe_value == swipe

	if result then
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)
	else
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	return result
end

function local_class:get_overlapped_xz_area(bounds1, bounds2)
	local min_x = math.max(bounds1.min.x, bounds2.min.x)
	local min_z = math.max(bounds1.min.z, bounds2.min.z)
	local max_x = math.min(bounds1.max.x, bounds2.max.x)
	local max_z = math.min(bounds1.max.z, bounds2.max.z)

	return math.max(0, max_x - min_x) * math.max(0, max_z - min_z);
end

function local_class:move_train()
	local train = self.get_chasing_train()
	train.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(1.5, 1, 4))

	-- 열차 다시 이동
	local cb = function(waypoint_index)
		if waypoint_index == 0 then
			-- 콜백이 먼저 불려서 충돌이 발생하여 stop이 불리면 waypoints가 null이 돼서 다음으로 이동하기까지 대기
			-- 좀더 나은 방법으로 개선 생각
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				while train.Direction ~= CS.Oak.Direction.Left do
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				train.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(3.5, 1, 1.5))
			end))
		end
	end

	local chasing_end_pos_1 = self.get_train_chasing_end_pos(1)
	local chasing_end_pos_2 = self.get_train_chasing_end_pos(2)

	local waypoint = {
		chasing_end_pos_1 + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
		chasing_end_pos_2 + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
	}

	character_util.move_waypoint(train, waypoint, self.chasing_train_speed, false,
		nil, nil, 'left', false, nil, cb)
end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))

	self.first_wave_monsters = nil
	self.second_wave_monsters = nil
	self.wave_markers = nil
	self.event_markers = nil
	self.shoot_helpers = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then
		return false
	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then
		return false
	end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.meet_zone_name and self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.first_meet_dragon_boy, self)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == 'wave_battle_1' then
		sp_util.play_battle_end_screenplay(self.first_battle_end, self)
	elseif e.BattleGroupName == 'wave_battle_2' then
		if self.wave_count == 1 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.next_wave_battle, self))
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.second_battle_end, self))
		end
	end
	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:next_wave_battle()
	self.wave_count = self.wave_count + 1

	-- 마지막 몬스터의 완전 사망 처리까지 잠시 대기
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_minotaurs_jump_01')
	-- 윗치 그랜마의 웨이브 전투일 경우
	for i, monster in ipairs(self.first_wave_monsters) do
		if i <= 8 then
			character_util.set_position(monster, vector(999, 0, 999))
			character_util.convert_to_npc(monster)
			character_util.reset_all_state(monster)
			coroutine.yield()

			-- 힐
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.sender = nil
			heal_info.target = monster
			heal_info.heal = monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP
			heal_info.isRevive = true
			command_util.execute_heal(heal_info)

			local marker = self.event_markers[i]
			local start_pos = marker.position - CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(marker.direction) * 10
			local end_pos = marker.position

			if random_util.get_random_int(0, 1) then
				character_util.set_direction(monster, 'left')
			else
				character_util.set_direction(monster, 'right')
			end

			character_util.set_locked_dir(monster, monster.Direction)
			character_util.set_position(monster, start_pos)
			character_util.set_anim(monster, { name = 'get' })
			character_util.jump_move(monster, end_pos, 10, 5, false)
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	local witch_grandma = self.get_witch_grandma()
	witch_grandma.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.remove_anim(witch_grandma)
	character_util.convert_to_monster(witch_grandma, 'wave_battle_2')
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(witch_grandma, user_party.Leader, 'battle')

	stage.BattleManager.PlayBattleVoiceAndFanfare = true
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async(
			{ state = 'field', name = 'ondemand/v2_14_dragon/audio:bgm_neva_main' })

	-- 윗치 그랜마 : 이 답답한 놈들! 할미가 직접 나서야 겠느냐!!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(witch_grandma, { key = 'shortstory_dragon_main_s6_32_0' })

	for i, monster in ipairs(self.first_wave_monsters) do
		if i <= 8 then
			character_util.remove_anim(monster)
			character_util.set_locked_dir(monster, 'none')
			character_util.convert_to_monster(monster, 'wave_battle_2')
			command_util.execute_monster_notice(monster, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
		end
	end
end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music( { state = 'muted', mix = 0})

	while user_party.Leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.IsDead do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.75, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- battle_gate 오픈
	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_count do
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. i, false))
	end

	for i = 1, self.battle_gate_count do
		get_field_object(self.battle_gate_name .. i).Position = vector(999,0,999)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	for i, monster in ipairs(self.first_wave_monsters) do
		if i <= 3 then
			character_util.set_position(monster, vector(999, 0, 999))
			character_util.convert_to_npc(monster)
			character_util.reset_all_state(monster)
			coroutine.yield()

			-- 힐
			local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
			heal_info.sender = nil
			heal_info.target = monster
			heal_info.heal = monster.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP

	local neva = self.get_neva()

function local_class:air_spin(target, direction)
	local air_direction = lua_helper.get_or_default(direction, vector(1, 0, 0))

	character_util.remove_emotion(target)
	local air_spin_state = CS.Oak.CharacterAirSpinState.Create(target,
			air_direction, 1, 0.25, true)
	local sce = CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(air_spin_state)
	target.CharacterBehaviour:OnEvent(sce)
end

function local_class:shake_move(fos, dist)
	local pos_list = {}
	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(fos) do
		local fo = fos[i]
		character_util.shake(fo, 0.02, 9999)
		table.insert(pos_list, fo.Position)
	end


	local time_passed = 0
	while not self.shake_end do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local sin_val = unity_class.mathf.Sin(time_passed) * dist

		for i = 1, table_util.get_size(fos) do
			local fo = fos[i]
			fo.Position = pos_list[i] + vector(sin_val, 0, 0)
		end
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	for i = 1, table_util.get_size(fos) do
		local fo = fos[i]
		character_util.move_to(fo, pos_list[i], 0.2)
	end

	pos_list = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

	self.beat_loop = true

	self.talk_name = 'shortstory_lahn_main_pre_'

function local_class:enter()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Dash_Smoke')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit_small')
end

function local_class:start()
	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.stage_intro, self)
end

function local_class:beating_halbal(halbal, civ_1, civ_2, civ_3)
	local timer = 0

	civ_1.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	civ_2.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	civ_3.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	local state = 1
	local hit_state = true

	while self.beat_loop do
		if timer > 0.2 and hit_state then
			hit_state = false
			if state == 1 then
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(civ_1, {name = 'attack', count = 1})
				character_util.spine_deviate_local(civ_1, vector(0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
			elseif state == 2 then
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(civ_2, {name = 'attack', count = 1})
				character_util.spine_deviate_local(civ_2, vector(0, 0, -0.2), 0.3, 0.2)
			elseif state == 3 then
				character_util.set_animation_n_times(civ_3, {name = 'attack', count = 1})
				character_util.spine_deviate_local(civ_3, vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
			else
				self.beat_loop = false
			end
		end

		if timer > 0.5 and not hit_state then
			hit_state = true
			timer = 0
			local x = random_util.get_random_int(-5, 5) * 0.1
			local y = random_util.get_random_int(-2, 4) * 0.1
			local get_random_pos = vector(x,0.01,y)
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Dash_Smoke'):Instantiate(halbal.Position + get_random_pos)
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(halbal.Position + get_random_pos)
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_hit_npc_01')
			character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(halbal)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(halbal)

			state = state + 1
			if state > 3 then state = 1 end
		end

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 1.5
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.event_state_enum = {
		init = 1,
		entrance = 2,
		after_ask = 3,
	}
	self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.init

	self.talk_name = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s1_'

	self.pos_name = 'village_npc_'
	self.innuit_name = 'village_innuit_'
	self.snowman_name = 'village_snowman_'

	self.asks = {
		false,
		false,
		false,
	}
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	self.lahn = self.controller.lahn()
	self.village_marker = field:GetMarker('village_entrance')

	self.civ_1 = get_character(self.innuit_name .. 1)
	self.civ_2 = get_character(self.innuit_name .. 2)
	self.civ_3 = get_character(self.snowman_name .. 1)

	character_util.set_position(self.civ_1, field:GetMarker(self.pos_name .. 1).position)
	character_util.set_direction(self.civ_1, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.civ_1, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_position(self.civ_2, field:GetMarker(self.pos_name .. 2).position)
	character_util.set_direction(self.civ_2, 'down')
	character_util.set_position(self.civ_3, field:GetMarker(self.pos_name .. 3).position)
	character_util.set_direction(self.civ_3, 'right')

	local civ_4 = get_character(self.snowman_name .. 3)
	local civ_5 = get_character(self.snowman_name .. 4)

	character_util.set_position(civ_4, self.village_marker.position + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(civ_5, self.village_marker.position)

	character_util.set_direction(civ_4, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(civ_5, 'left')

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.village_marker.position)
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		-- 마을에 첫 입장
		if e.Zone.Name == 'whole_village_zone' and e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.lahn) then
			if self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.init then
				self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.entrance

function local_class:on_event(e)

		self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_lupina_in_billboard_room, self)

	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	-- 퀘스트 마커 처리
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none and self.is_showing_stair_marker then
		for i = 1, #self.quest_marker_finding.zone_name do
			local finding_zone_name = self.quest_marker_finding.zone_name[i]
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, finding_zone_name) then
				local marker_target = get_field_object(self.quest_marker_finding.target_name[i])
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, marker_target, true)
				return true
			end
		end

		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'mushroom_cave_zone') then
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
			return true
		end
	end

	-- 어두운 복도 진입 이벤트
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'goods_room_tint_zone') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		-- 해당 오브젝트만 tint가 적용되지 않게 하기 위해 material 새로 만들어서 넣어줌
		local goods_1 = self.get_goods(1)
		local renderers = goods_1:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Renderer))
		local copy_material = CS.UnityEngine.Material(renderers.sharedMaterial)
		copy_material.hideFlags = CS.UnityEngine.HideFlags.HideAndDontSave

		self.origin_material = renderers.sharedMaterial
		renderers.sharedMaterial = copy_material

		-- 굿즈 아이템들 까맣게
		for _, item in pairs(self.controller.goods_room_items) do
			local item_sprite = item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
			item_sprite.TintColor = unity_class.color.black
			item_sprite:Rebuild()
		end

		-- 밖으로 못 나가도록 출구 막음
		local goods_room_exit = self.get_goods_room_exit()
		self.origin_interactable = goods_room_exit.Interactable
		goods_room_exit.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

		local goods_1_pos = self.get_goods_pos(1) + vector(0, 1.5, 0)
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, goods_1_pos, true)

		return true
	end

	-- 불 꺼지는 존 진입 이벤트
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.in_goods_room then
		local tint_color = { 0.7, 0.4, 0.03 }
		for _, progress in pairs(self.burn_progress_enum) do
			if self.current_burn_progress == progress and
				type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'goods_room_burn_event_' .. progress) then

				self.current_burn_progress = self.current_burn_progress + 1

				if progress == self.burn_progress_enum.none then
					-- bgm_transition: Field(bgm_shivering_record_main) -> Muted, 2
					music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
				end

				if progress < 4 then
					-- 화로 처리
					for index = 1, 2 do
						local brazier = self.get_brazier(progress, index)
						command_util.execute_extinguish(user_party.Leader, brazier)
					end

					local color = tint_color[progress]
					field:Tint(nil, unity_color({ color, color, color }), 0.5)
				else
					-- 가고일 석상 처리
					local gagoyle_statue = self.get_gagoyle_statue(progress - 3)
					local animator = gagoyle_statue:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
					animator:Play('start')
					music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
				end

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	-- 굿즈방 진입 이벤트
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.in_bottleneck and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'goods_room_talking_with_lupina') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_lupina, self)

		return true
	end

	-- 피규어방 진입 이벤트
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.talking_with_lupina and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'figure_room_talking_with_lupina') then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_lupina_in_figure_room, self)

		return true
	end

	-- 등신대방 진입 이벤트
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.in_figure_room and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'billboard_room_out') then

		self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(function()
			local leader = user_party.Leader
			local lupina = self.get_lupina()

			character_util.remove_anim(lupina)

			character_util.set_direction(lupina, 'left')
			character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'attack' })
			-- 이리 와서 이걸 보거라!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina,
				{ key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_60', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_emotion(lupina)
			character_util.set_direction(lupina, 'right')

--- ZoneLeaveEvent
function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if not self.is_showing_stair_marker and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none and
		type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader, 'lupina_main_room') then

		self.is_showing_stair_marker = true

		local hidden_stair = self.get_hidden_stair()
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, hidden_stair)
	end

	-- 어두운 복도 나가는 이벤트
	if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.in_goods_room and
		zone_name == 'goods_room_tint_zone' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then

		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1

		-- 더 어둡게 변경
		-- field:Tint(nil, unity_color({ 0.03, 0.03, 0.03 }), 0.5)

		return true
	end

	-- 굿즈방 나가는 이벤트
	if not self.all_interact_goods and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.talking_with_lupina and
		zone_name == 'goods_room_interacting_goods' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then

		self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(function()
			local lupina = self.get_lupina()
			local leader = user_party.Leader

			character_util.look_at(lupina, leader)
			character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.normal_jump(lupina)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			-- 어딜 가느냐! 전부 기록하고 가거라!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina,
				{ key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_42', skip = true })

			-- 뒤로 후퇴하는 플레이어
			local marker
			if leader.Position.z > e.Zone.Bounds.center.z then
				local pos = self.get_goods_room_out_left()
				marker = vector(pos.x + 0.5, 0, leader.Position.z)
			else
				local pos = self.get_goods_room_out_down()
				marker = vector(leader.Position.x, 0, pos.z + 0.5)
			end

			character_util.move_waypoint_async(leader, marker, 2)

			character_util.remove_emotion(lupina)
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- InteractEvent
function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	for i = 2, 4 do
		local goods = self.get_goods(i)
		if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, goods) then
			self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_goods, self, goods, i)
			return true
		end
	end

	local goods_room_exit = self.get_goods_room_exit()
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, goods_room_exit) then
		self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(function()
			-- 아직 기록을 끝마치치 못했다.
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_1_1', mintotalduration = 1 })

			local leader = user_party.Leader
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(
				leader, vector(leader.Position.x + 1, 0, leader.Position.z), 2)
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

		local cur_color = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, 1, progress)

--- 굿즈 상호작용 했을 때
function local_class:interact_goods(goods, index)
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local lupina = self.get_lupina()

	goods.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	quest_marker_util.remove(goods.Name)

	local dir = { nil, 'left', 'right', 'left' }

	local goods_pos = self.get_goods_pos(index)
	local align_pos = goods_pos - 1.2 * direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_direction(dir[index]))

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(
				leader, align_pos, 2, false, nil, nil, dir[index])

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_writing_02')
			character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'librarian/writing' })
		end),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
			lupina, align_pos + vector(0, 0, 1), 2, false, nil, nil, dir[index])
	})

	if index == 2 then
		self:interact_cup_goods()
	elseif index == 3 then
		self:interact_hair_band_goods()
	elseif index == 4 then
		self:interact_pillow_goods()
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	self:party_follower_lupina()

	self.interacting_goods[index - 1] = true

	goods.Interactable = self.goods_origin_interactable[goods]

	for i = 1, #self.interacting_goods do
		if not self.interacting_goods[i] then
			return
		end
	end

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'librarian/writing' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 란 도감 등록
	self.controller:set_book_data_on_screenplay(3, 3, 1)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'librarian/reading' })
	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	character_util.remove_anim(leader)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	self.all_interact_goods = true

	local figure_room_center = self.get_figure_room_center()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, figure_room_center)
end

--- 플레이어 선택지 이벤트
function local_class:choose_event()
	local leader = user_party.Leader
	local lupina = self.get_lupina()

	local fail_event = function()
		-- bgm_transition: Field(bgm_shivering_record_main) -> Muted, 2
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })

		local earthquake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_earthquake_04', loop = true })
		camera_util.shake(0.2, 999)
		character_util.remove_emotion(lupina)
		character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'attack' })
		-- 루피나 (left, attack, idle) : 분명히… 잘 기록하라고 했을텐데…
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_86_1', skip = true })

		character_util.remove_emotion(lupina)

		character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'mad' })
		-- 루피나 (left, mad, idle) : 대가는… 너도 알고 있겠지!?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_86_2', skip = true })

		earthquake_sfx:Stop()
		camera_util.cancel_shake()

		character_util.remove_anim(leader)

		character_util.set_emotion(leader, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'embarrassed' })

		character_util.set_animation_n_times(lupina, { name = 'attack' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_blizzard_02')
		-- 루피나 (left, mad, attack 1회) : [shout] 얼어붙어라!!!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(lupina,
			{ key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_87', bubble_type = 'shout' })
		yield_return_func(self.controller.turn_on_blizzard, self.controller)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(lupina)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)

		yield_return_func(self.controller.turn_off_blizzard, self.controller, true, false)

		-- bgm_transition: Muted -> Field(bgm_shivering_record_main)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

		screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
	end

	-- 란 (emoticon_bubble_silence) 후 nod 2회
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(leader, nil, 'silence')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(leader, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })

	character_util.set_anim(leader, { name = 'librarian/reading' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
	-- 란 (right, idle, reading) : 란은 얼음 마녀의 질문에 답할 준비가 되었다고 전하였다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(leader, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_71', skip = true })

	-- 루피나 (left, idle, idle) : 그래? 그렇다면 루피나의 굿즈 중에…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_72', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(lupina, { name = 'attack', count = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	-- 루피나 (left, attack, attack 2회) : 물 한 모금조차 나를 두려워하며 마시게 하는 것은 무엇이더냐!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_73', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(lupina)

	-- 첫 번째 선택지
	local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 루피나 머그컵
		{ 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_74', 'mercy' },
		-- 카마존 전동 안마기
		{ 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_75', 'brutal' },
		-- Lv.1 아마로크
		{ 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_76', 'brutal' }
	})

	if player_choice ~= 1 then
		fail_event()
		return false
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(lupina)

	-- 루피나 (emoticon_bubble_happy)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(lupina, nil, 'happy')

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(lupina, { name = 'nod', count = 2 })
	-- 루피나 (left, idle, nod, 2회) : 제대로 기록했구나, 하지만 아직이다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_77', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(lupina)

	-- 루피나 (left, idle, idle) : 한 가지 더 물어보겠다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_78', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(lupina, { name = 'attack', count = 2 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	-- 루피나 (left, attack, attack 2회) : 작지만 나의 매력을 보여주는 것은 무엇이더냐!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_79', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(lupina)

	-- 두 번째 선택지
	player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		-- 루피나 인형
		{ 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_80', 'mercy' },
		-- 얼음 마녀의 작은 마음
		{ 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_81', 'brutal' },
		-- 영웅 초기화 스톤
		{ 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_82', 'brutal' }
	})

	if player_choice ~= 1 then
		fail_event()
		return false
	end

	character_util.remove_emotion(lupina)

	-- 루피나 (emoticon_bubble_happy)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(lupina, nil, 'happy')

	character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'smile' })
	-- 루피나 (left, smile, idle) : 정답이다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_83', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(lupina)

	character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'doyagao' })

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then

	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_lupina()) then
		if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.none then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.first_talk
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lupina_first_talk, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target,  self.get_diorama_npc_door()) then
		if self.current_progress == self.event_progress.first_talk then
			self.current_progress = self.event_progress.diorama_first
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_diorama_ice_block, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_diorama_npc(2, 13)) and
			0 == (self.diorama_story_state & self.diorama_story_check.igloo) then
		self.diorama_story_state = self.diorama_story_state | self.diorama_story_check.igloo
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_igloo_npc, self)
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_soccer_wall()) and
			0 == (self.diorama_story_state & self.diorama_story_check.soccer) then
		self.diorama_story_state = self.diorama_story_state | self.diorama_story_check.soccer
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_soccer_ball, self))
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_diorama_npc(2, 14)) or
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_diorama_npc(2, 15)) then
		if self.current_igloo_progress == self.igloo_progress.igloo then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_igloo_family, self)
			return true
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target,  self.get_diorama_pyramid()) and
			0 == (self.diorama_story_state & self.diorama_story_check.pyramid) then
			self.diorama_story_state = self.diorama_story_state | self.diorama_story_check.pyramid
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_pyramid, self))
			return true
	elseif type_util.is_interacted_target(e, self.get_goods_room_exit()) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(function()
			-- 아직 기록을 끝마치치 못했다.
			field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s10_1_1', mintotalduration = 1 })

			local leader = user_party.Leader
			character_util.move_waypoint_async(
					leader, vector(leader.Position.x + 1, 0, leader.Position.z), 2, false,
					nil, nil, 'up')

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(leader)
		end)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.diorama_in_zone_name) and
		self.current_progress == self.event_progress.first_talk and not self.tint_check then
		self.tint_check = true
		field:Tint(nil, self.back_tint_color, 0.5)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_light_turn_off_01')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.diorama_out_zone_name) and
			self.current_progress == self.event_progress.first_talk and self.tint_check then
		self.tint_check = false
		field:Tint(nil, self.origin_color, 0.5)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'field', mix = 2 })
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.diorama_next_zone_name) and
			self.current_progress == self.event_progress.diorama_first then
		self.current_progress = self.event_progress.diorama_second
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.close_npc_door, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.igloo_out_zone_name) and
			self.current_igloo_progress == self.igloo_progress.igloo then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.return_igloo_zone, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.igloo_end_zone_name) and
			self.current_igloo_progress == self.igloo_progress.saw_innuit then
		self.current_igloo_progress = self.igloo_progress.igloo_end
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.igloo_event_end, self))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 's13_quest_marker_lupina_basement_exit')
			and not self.in_check then
		local lupina = self.get_lupina()
		quest_marker_util.remove('hidden_stair')
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, lupina.Name, lupina)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)

			self.current_igloo_progress == self.igloo_progress.igloo then
		quest_marker_util.remove('igloo_in')

		self.igloo_out_exit_interactable = self.get_igloo_out_exit().Interactable
		self.get_igloo_out_exit().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		return true
	end
	return false
end

		self.qte_complete = true
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- 진입로 얼음에 interact 했을 때
function local_class:interact_diorama_ice_block()
	local lahn = self.get_lahn()
	local lupina = self.get_lupina()
	local door_npc_up = self.get_diorama_npc(1, 1)
	local door_npc_down = self.get_diorama_npc(1, 2)

	local door = self.get_diorama_npc_door()
	door.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	door.Position = vector(999,0,999)

	quest_marker_util.remove(door_npc_down.Name)
	party_util.align_to_target(door_npc_down, 'right', 1, 'linear')
	character_util.set_anim(lahn, { name = 'idle' })

	-- 란 (left, idle, idle) (emoticon_bubble_question)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(lahn, nil, 'question')
	character_util.remove_anim(lahn)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(lahn, lahn.Position - vector(0.5,0,0), 1,
			false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')

	local next_check = false
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		camera_util.resize_to(3, 2)
		wait_for_sec(2)
		next_check = true
	end))

	-- 란 (left, tired, push) : 무언가 차갑고 단단한 것으로 길이 란은 더 이상 앞으로 나아갈 수가 없다.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(lahn, { name = 'push' }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lahn, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_15', skip = true })

	while not next_check do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	door_npc_down.SpineController:RemoveColor(door_npc_down.Name, 1.5)
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 란 (left, idle, jump 1회) 후 (left, tired, idle)로 뒷걸음질 2타일.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(lahn, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(lahn, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_dark_magician_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_cave_main', state = 'event', mix = 2})
	field:Tint(nil, self.origin_color, 2)
	camera_util.resize_to_default(2)
	for i = 1, 12 do
		local cur_npc = self.get_diorama_npc(1, i)
		if cur_npc ~= door_npc_down then
			cur_npc.SpineController:RemoveColor(cur_npc.Name, 2)
		end
	end

	for i = 5, 12 do
		local cur_npc = self.get_diorama_npc(1, i)

		local ice_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_red_ice'):Instantiate(cur_npc.Position)
		ice_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.2

		local animation = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(ice_effect.transform, 'fx'):GetComponent(
				typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state
		animation:SetAnimation(0, 'ice', false)
		table.insert(self.red_ice_effect_list, ice_effect)
	end

	local ice_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_red_ice'):Instantiate(
			self.get_diorama_npc(1, 3).Position + vector(0.25,0,0))
	ice_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.7
	local animation = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(ice_effect.transform, 'fx'):GetComponent(
			typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state
	animation:SetAnimation(0, 'ice', false)
	table.insert(self.red_ice_effect_list, ice_effect)

	local sprite = self.green_ticket.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	if sprite ~= nil then
		sprite:SetSortingLayer(true)
		sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0, 1, 0, 1 })
		sprite:Rebuild()
	end

	character_util.set_anim(lahn, { name = 'walk' , scale = 0.7 })
	character_util.move_to_async(lahn, lahn.Position + vector(1.5,0,0),
			nil, 0.75, false, false)
	character_util.set_anim(lahn, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_emotion(lahn, { name = 'tired' })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(lahn, nil, 'silence')

	character_util.set_emotion(lahn, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.remove_emotion(lahn)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 란 (left, tired, writing) : 란의 앞을 막고 있던 것은 얼어붙은… 이누이트였음을 확인하였다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_writing_02')
	character_util.set_anim(lahn, { name = 'librarian/writing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lahn, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_16', skip = true })

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.set_emotion(lahn, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	camera_util.move_async(lahn.Position - vector(5,0,0), 1.5)

	-- 란 (left, tired, writing) : 그리고 그 앞에는 수많은 이누이트의 얼어붙어 있었다고 란은 목격한 것을 기록하였다.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(lahn, { name = 'librarian/writing' }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lahn, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_17',
														skip = true, screen_pos = vector(-250, 200) })

	-- 루피나 (left, idle, idle) : [shout] 하하! 꽤나 당황했구나!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_18'
						, bubble_type = 'shout', skip = true, screen_pos = vector(150, 200) })

	character_util.set_position(lupina, lahn.Position + vector(10,0,1))
	character_util.move_to_async(lupina, lahn.Position + vector(0,0,1),
			2, nil, true, true)

	-- 상단 대사와 함께 카메라 좌측으로 살짝 이동하여 얼어붙은 사람들 보여줌.
	--상단 대사는 화면 우측에서 출력. 화면 밖에서 들려오는 느낌으로 진행
	--우측 화면 밖에서 루피나 살짝 뜬 채로 날아와 란 2타일 뒤에 착지.


	--루피나 (left, idle, idle) : 루피나님의 극적인 기록을 위해 연출을 좀 가미했는데. 벌써 겁먹은 건 아니겠지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_18_1', skip = true })

	--란 (right, idle, idle) : 그대의 질문에 란은 부정이라 답한다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lahn, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_18_2', skip = true })

	--루피나 (left, ) : 흥. 재미없는 반응이군.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_18_3', skip = true })

	character_util.set_anim(lahn, { name = 'idle' })

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(lupina, { name = 'attack' })

	local rock_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_push_rock_01',
												type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object'})
	character_util.move_to(door_npc_up, door_npc_up.Position + vector(0,0,1),
			1, nil, false, false)
	character_util.move_to_async(door_npc_down, door_npc_down.Position - vector(0,0,1),
			1, nil, false, false)
	rock_sfx:Stop()

	-- 루피나 (left, doyagao, idle) : 내가 가장 아끼는 공간이니 천천히 감상하거라.
	character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'doyagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_19', skip = true })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lupina)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lahn)

	lupina.Interactable.Talk = nil
	self:party_follower_lupina()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('lupina_goods_door', true))

	-- 3개의 퀘스트 마커 추가

	local igloo_npc = self.get_diorama_npc(2, 13)
	local soccer_wall = self.get_soccer_wall()

	pyramid.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(5, 1, 1.2))
	soccer_wall.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	character_util.add_listener(igloo_npc, self.controller)

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'soccer_wall', soccer_wall)
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'igloo', igloo_npc)

-- 이글루 입구 이누이트에게 인터렉트 했을 시
function local_class:interact_igloo_npc()
	local lahn = self.get_lahn()
	local lupina = self.get_lupina()
	local igloo_npc = self.get_diorama_npc(2, 13)

	quest_marker_util.remove('igloo')
	lupina:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	lupina.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	character_util.move_to(lupina,
			igloo_npc.Position + vector(1,0,-1), 1, nil, true, true)

	character_util.move_to(lahn,
			igloo_npc.Position + vector(0,0,-1), 1, nil, true, true)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_direction(lahn, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(lupina, 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(lahn, { name = 'idle' })

	-- 란 (up) : 란은 당장이라도 달려들 듯한 이누이트 남성이 얼어붙어 있는 것을 발견하였다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lahn, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_28_1', skip = true })

	-- 루피나 (left, idle, idle) : 이것도 재미있는 작품 중 하나지.
	character_util.look_at(lahn, lupina)
	character_util.look_at(lupina, lahn)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_28_2', skip = true })

	--루피나 (left, smile, idle) : 난 이 남자를 보고 딱 이 단어가 떠올라 지금까지 그렇게 부르고 있지.
	character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_29', skip = true })

	--루피나 (left, smile, idle) : 내가 무슨 단어가 떠올렸는지, 알 수 있겠느냐?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_29_1', skip = true })

	-- 선택지 : 이누이트의 격렬한 인사.
	-- 선택지 : 전투 준비 태세.
	-- 선택지 : 무념무상.
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event(
			{ { 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_30', 'intellect' },
			  { 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_31', 'mercy' },
			  { 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_32', 'brutal' } })

	if result == 1 then
		-- 루피나 (left, idle, idle) : 너는 저게 인사로 보이느냐.
		character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'idle' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_33', skip = true })


	elseif result == 2 then
		-- 루피나 (left, attack, idle) : 이 루피나를 상대로 말이냐?
		character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'attack' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_34', skip = true })

	else
		-- 루피나 (left, annoy, idle) : 시시한 대답이구나.
		character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'doyagao' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_35', skip = true })
	end

	local ice_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_red_ice'):Instantiate(vector(6.5,0,147))
	ice_effect.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 1.5
	local animation = CS.Utils.FindChildRecursively(ice_effect.transform, 'fx'):GetComponent(
			typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.SkeletonAnimation)).state
	animation:SetAnimation(0, 'ice', false)
	table.insert(self.red_ice_effect_list, ice_effect)

	-- 루피나 (left, idle, attack 1회) 후 얼려진 이누이트 좌측으로 1타일 밀림
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_push_rock_unit_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'idle' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(lupina, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.move_to_async(igloo_npc, igloo_npc.Position - vector(1,0,0),
			0.5, nil, false, false)
	-- 루피나 (left, doyagao, idle) : 정답은 네가 들어가서 직접 확인해 보거라.
	character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'doyagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_36', skip = true })

	lupina.Interactable.Talk = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_36'
	character_util.remove_relate_event(igloo_npc, self.controller)

	local igloo_npc_l = self.get_diorama_npc(2, 14)
	local igloo_npc_r = self.get_diorama_npc(2, 15)
	character_util.add_listener(igloo_npc_l, self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(igloo_npc_r, self.controller)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lahn)

	self.current_igloo_progress = self.igloo_progress.igloo
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'igloo_in', self.get_igloo_in_exit())
end

	local lupina = self.get_lupina()

			1, nil, true, true)

	character_util.set_anim(lahn, { name = 'idle' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 루피나 (left, idle, idle) : 저놈이 얼어붙기 직전에 지껄이던 말이 생각나는구나.
	character_util.set_direction(lupina, 'left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_40', skip = true })

	--루피나 (left, doyagao, idle) : 루피나에게 이 안은 절대 못 들어간다고 했었지…
	character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'doyagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_41', skip = true })

	--루피나 (left, smile, idle) : [shout] 한낱 인간 따위가 말이야!!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina,
			{ key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_42', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	--란 (down, tired, idle) (emoticon_bubble_silence)
	character_util.set_emotion(lahn, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(lahn, nil, 'silence')

	--란 (right, tired, writing) : 란은 얼음 마녀의 증언을 통해 이누이트 남성의 마지막 발언을 기록하였다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_writing_02')
	character_util.set_direction(lahn, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(lahn, { name = 'librarian/writing' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lahn, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s11_43', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lupina)

	if self.diorama_story_state == self.diorama_story_check.all_clear then
		self:event_finish()
		return
	end

	self:party_follower_lupina()
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

	-- 루피나 (left, awesome, gauntlet_kick) : [shout] 슛!
	character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'awesome' })

	local next_check = false

	local npc_hit_func = function(npc)
		character_util.spine_deviate_local(npc, vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(npc, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 0.3, 0.5)
		character_util.jump(npc, 1.5, 0.7)
		character_util.spine_rotate(npc, 360, 0.7)
		character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc, { name = 'prostrate' }, { name = 'damaged' })

		local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
				"physics", true, vector(-1,0,
						unity_class.random.Range(-0.5, 0.5)), 10000, 0.05,
				CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)

		local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(npc, knock_back_info)
		npc.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
	end

	local ball_move_func = function(shutter)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times(shutter, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', count = 1 })
		wait_for_sec(0.16)
