local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLahnMainSection13')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLahnMain @
		Comment = 란과 루피나 섹션 13 @
		Index = 12 @
		NextSections = 13 @
#end
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 퀘스트 마커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = 'lahn_main_section_13'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.scream_zone_name = 'scream_zone'
	self.lupina_house_zone_name = 'lupina_house'

	-- 그리드 이름
	self.hunting_grid_name = 'hunting'

	-- 아이템 스펙 이름
	self.paper_piece_item_spec_name = 'paper_piece'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_lahn = controller.lahn
	self.get_lupina = controller.lupina
	self.get_costume_lupina = controller.lupina
	self.get_snowman = function(num) return get_character('lupina_hunt_snowman_' .. num) end

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_paper_piece = function() return get_field_object('lupina_paper_piece') end
	self.get_left_house_exit = function() return get_field_object('left_house_exit') end
	self.get_section13_ice = function() return get_field_object('section13_ice') end

	-- 마커를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_lupina_bed_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('lupina_bed') end
	self.get_lupina_chair_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('lupina_chair') end
	self.get_lupina_desk_front_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('lupina_desk_front') end
	self.get_lupina_desk_marker = function() return field:GetMarker('lupina_desk') end
	self.get_section_marker = function(num) return field:GetMarker('s13_' .. num) end

	-- 이펙트 풀을 가져오는 함수
	self.get_red_ice_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_red_ice') end
	self.get_fx_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end

	-- 아이템
	self.paper_piece_item = nil

	-- 이펙트
	self.red_ice_effect_list = {}

	self.blizzard_sfx = nil

	-- 섹션 내부 progress
	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		read_paper = 1,
		scream = 2,
		hunting = 3,
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	self.get_red_ice_effect()
	self.get_fx_hit()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 12 then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/short_story_lahn/audio:bgm_shivering_record_night', state = 'event', mix = 1 })
	end

	sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.lupina_room_screenplay, self)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'hide_rabbit' }))
	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'hide_rabbit' }))

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress ~= 12 then
		local witch_bed = get_field_object('witch_bed')
		witch_bed.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	character_util.set_active_state(get_character('village_innuit_1'), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(get_character('village_innuit_2'), 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(get_character('village_snowman_1'), 'disabled')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_event')

	if self.paper_piece_item then
		self.paper_piece_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.paper_piece_item = nil
	end

	if self.red_ice_effect_list then
		for i = 1, #self.red_ice_effect_list do
			local red_ice_effect = self.red_ice_effect_list[i]
			red_ice_effect:Dispose()
			self.red_ice_effect_list[i] = nil
		end

		self.red_ice_effect_list = nil
	end

	if self.blizzard_sfx then
		self.blizzard_sfx:Stop()
		self.blizzard_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
		return self:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local paper_piece = self.get_paper_piece()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, paper_piece) and self.current_progress < self.progress.read_paper then
		self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_paper_piece, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == self.scream_zone_name and self.current_progress < self.progress.scream then
				self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.scream_screenplay, self)
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.lupina_house_zone_name and self.current_progress < self.progress.read_paper then
				-- 책상 위 편지(paper_piece)에 마킹
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, self.paper_piece_item.Position)
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.lupina_house_zone_name and self.current_progress >= self.progress.read_paper then
				-- 루피나 방 왼쪽 위 C 통로에 마커 표시
				local left_house_exit = self.get_left_house_exit()
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, left_house_exit, true)
				return true
			elseif string.sub(e.Zone.Name, 1, 17) == 's13_quest_marker_' then
				local string_len = string.len(e.Zone.Name)
				local object_name = string.sub(e.Zone.Name, 18, string_len)
				local position = nil

				for x, y, z in string.gmatch(object_name, 'vector%((-*%d+),%s*(-*%d+),%s*(-*%d+)%)') do
					x = tonumber(x)
					y = tonumber(y)
					z = tonumber(z)
					position = vector(x, y, z)
				end

				if position then
					quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, position, true)
				else
					local marker_object = get_field_object(object_name)
					quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, marker_object, true)
				end

				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:string_split(str, pat)
	local t = {}
	local fpat = "(.-)" .. pat
	local last_end = 1
	local s, e, cap = str:find(fpat, 1)

	while s do
		if s ~= 1 or cap ~= "" then
			table.insert(t,cap)
		end
		last_end = e+1
		s, e, cap = str:find(fpat, last_end)
	end

	if last_end <= #str then
		cap = str:sub(last_end)
		table.insert(t, cap)
	end

	return t
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.hunting_grid_name) and self.current_progress < self.progress.hunting then
		self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.hunting_screenplay, self)
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'village') then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.turn_on_blizzard, self.controller, 0.4))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'village') then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.turn_off_blizzard, self.controller, true))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:thorw_paper_piece_item()
	local lupina = self.get_lupina()
	local desk_marker = self.get_lupina_desk_marker()
	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
	local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(self.paper_piece_item_spec_name).Id
	local paper_piece = self.get_paper_piece()
	paper_piece.Position = vector_util.get_x0z(desk_marker.position, 0)

	self.paper_piece_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = lupina.Position, itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
	local item_sprite = self.paper_piece_item.SpriteTransform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	item_sprite.TintColor = unity_color({ 0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 1 })
	item_sprite:Rebuild()

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration  = 0.5
	local height = 1
	local start_position = self.paper_piece_item.Position
	local end_position = desk_marker.position + vector(0, 0.32, 0)
	local rotation = 360 * 5

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_position, end_position, progress)
		local offset_y = math.sin(math.pi * progress) * height

		position.y = position.y + offset_y
		self.paper_piece_item.Position = position

		local rortation_angle = rotation * progress
		self.paper_piece_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right)
			* unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(rortation_angle, unity_class.vector3.forward)


		coroutine.yield()

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.paper_piece_item.Position = end_position
	self.paper_piece_item.SpriteTransform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.AngleAxis(90, unity_class.vector3.right)
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLahnMainSection10')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLahnMain @
		Comment = 란과 루피나 섹션 14 @
		Index = 13 @
		NextSections = 14 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.event_state_enum = {
		starting = 1,
		init = 2,
		hunting_1 = 3,
		passing_1 = 4,
		hunting_2 = 5,
		passing_2 = 6,
		hunting_3 = 7,
		end_hunt = 8
	}

	self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.init

	-- 란 도감
	self.lahn_book = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/ShortStoryLahnBook')

	-- 이벤트 존 이름들
	self.hunting_zone_names = {
		's14_hunting_pre',
		's14_hunting_1',
		's14_hunting_2',
		's14_hunting_3'
	}
	-- Npc 이름 prefix
	self.victim_name = 'victim_14_'

	self.lupina_house_zone_name = 'lupina_house'

	-- 대사 스트링 키 prefix
	self.main_script = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s14_'

	-- 이펙트 이름
	self.hit_effect_name = 'FX_hit'

	-- prologue 이벤트를 실행중인지 확인하기 위한 플래그
	self.is_playing_prologue = false

	-- 아마로크 ID
	self.witch_coco_cwp_id = 47

	-- 스테이지 재시작시 사용할 마커
	self.marker_name = 's14_marker'

	self.is_staying_pre_event_zone = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	-- 개발 용
	--message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent), 'on_stage_start_event')

	-- 루피나 초기화
	local lupina = self.controller.lupina()
	character_util.set_active_state(lupina, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(lupina, field:GetMarker('lupina_s14_init_pos').position)
	character_util.set_direction(lupina, 'down')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lupina);
	lupina:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
			CS.Oak.Item.Create(CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetByName('cwp_witchcoco_epic')))

	-- 사냥감들 초기화
	local victim_1 = get_character(self.victim_name .. 1)
	character_util.set_active_state(victim_1, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(victim_1, field:GetMarker('victim_1_s14_init_pos').position)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(victim_1)
	character_util.set_direction(victim_1, 'up')
	character_util.shake(victim_1, 0.025, 99999)

	--message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageStartEvent))

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if (zone_name == self.hunting_zone_names[1]) then
		-- is_playing_prologue가 true이면 이미 실행중인 코루틴이 있다는 의미이므로, 새로운 코루틴 생성을 방지한다.
		if (self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.init)
				and self.is_playing_prologue == false and self.is_staying_pre_event_zone == false then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.play_hunting_prologue_event, self))
		end
	elseif (zone_name == self.hunting_zone_names[2]) then
		if (self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.init) then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
		end

		-- prologue 이벤트가 실행중이었다면 취소시킴.
		self.is_playing_prologue = false

		-- 카메라 고정
		if (self.event_state < self.event_state_enum.passing_1) then
			local fixed_camera_pos = vector(-58, 0, 20)
			stage_camera:Move(fixed_camera_pos, 1)
		end

		if (self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.init) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.play_lupina_hunting_1, self))
		end
	elseif (zone_name == self.hunting_zone_names[3]) then
		if (self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.passing_1) then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)
		end
		-- 카메라 고정
		if (self.event_state < self.event_state_enum.passing_2) then
			local fixed_camera_pos = vector(-59.5, 0, 6.5)
			stage_camera:Move(fixed_camera_pos, 1, nil, true)
		end

		if (self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.passing_1) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.play_lupina_hunting_2, self))
		end
	elseif (zone_name == self.hunting_zone_names[4]) and (self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.passing_2) then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name)

		self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.play_lupina_hunting_3, self)
	elseif e.Zone.Name == self.lupina_house_zone_name and self.event_state >= self.event_state_enum.init then
		-- 루피나 방 왼쪽 위 C 통로에 마커 표시
		local left_house_exit = get_field_object('left_house_exit')
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_name, left_house_exit, true)

	elseif string.sub(e.Zone.Name, 1, 17) == 's13_quest_marker_' then
		local lupina = self.controller.lupina()
		local position = lupina.Position + vector(0, 0, -1)

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_name, position, true)
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave or not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if (zone_name == self.hunting_zone_names[1]) then
		self.is_staying_pre_event_zone = false
	elseif (zone_name == self.hunting_zone_names[2]) or (zone_name == self.hunting_zone_names[3]) then
		stage_camera:CancelMove()
		-- 카메라가 플레이어 따라감
		stage_camera:Move(user_party.Leader, 0.3, user_party.Leader)
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_start_event(e)
	local lahn = self.controller.lahn()
	character_util.set_position(lahn, vector(-66.66806, 0, 27.74478))
	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

end

-- 자동 이벤트 시작 전
function local_class:play_hunting_prologue_event()
	self.is_staying_pre_event_zone = true
	self.is_playing_prologue = true

	local each_event_interval = 6
	local initial_time_passed = 0
	local time_passed = each_event_interval

	while (self.is_staying_pre_event_zone == true) do
		if (time_passed >= each_event_interval) then
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_boss_intro', state = 'event', mix = 2 })
			-- 루피나 (down, idle, attack 1회) : 두려움에 떨어라!
			local lupina = self.controller.lupina()
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(lupina, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = self.main_script .. 48, skip = false })

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
			-- 사냥감 : 제, 제발 살려주세요…!
			local prey = get_character(self.victim_name .. 1)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(prey, { key = self.main_script .. 49, skip = false })

			-- 루피나 (smile) : 아하하하하!
			character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'smile' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lupina, { key = self.main_script .. 50, skip = false })
			character_util.set_emotion(lupina, { name = 'idle' })


			time_passed = initial_time_passed
		end

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.is_playing_prologue = false
end

	self.get_snowman_start_pos = function(num) return field:GetMarker('section15_snowman_' .. num).position end
	self.get_innuit_start_pos = function(num) return field:GetMarker('section15_innuit_' .. num).position end

		true,	-- kid_boy_b
		true,	-- male
		true,	-- female
		false,	-- kid_girl_b
		false,	-- kid_boy
		true,	-- elder
	}
	self.snowman_use_data = {
		true,	-- male
		true,	-- female
		false,	-- male
		false,	-- no_hat
		false,	-- kid_boy
		true,	-- no_muffler
		true,	-- begger

	self.enter_zone_count = 3

	self.battle_zone_name = 'section15_invader_battle'

	self.battle_gate_name = 'section15_battle_gate_'
	self.battle_gate_count = 6

	self.event_state = {
		before_enter = 0,
		before_battle = 1,
		battle_started = 2,
		battle_end = 3,
	}
	self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_enter

	self.marker_key = 'section15'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
end

function local_class:start()
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key, field:GetMarker('village_center').position)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'whole_village_zone')
			and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.before_enter then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.before_battle
		self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.scene_before_battle, self)
		return true
	end

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'main_field_zone') then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key,
				field:GetMarker('village_center').position, true)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, user_party.Leader,'main_field_zone') then
		if field:GetZone('mushroom_cave_zone'):Contains(user_party.Leader.Position) then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.marker_key,
					get_field_object('exit_mushroom_cave_outer_b'), true)
		else
			quest_marker_util.remove(self.marker_key)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name and self.current_event_state == self.event_state.battle_started then
		self.current_event_state = self.event_state.battle_end
		for i = 1, self.battle_gate_count do
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name .. i))
		end
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_after_battle, self))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:get_red_ice_info()
	for index, info in pairs(self.pooled_red_ice_infos) do
		if not info.using then
			self.pooled_red_ice_infos[index].using = true
			return self.pooled_red_ice_infos[index]
		end
	end

	return {}
end

function local_class:shoot_red_ice(start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
			util.cs_generator(self.shoot_red_ice_async, self, start_pos, target_pos, duration))
end

function local_class:shoot_red_ice_async(start_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local red_ice_item = self:get_red_ice_info()
	local time_passed = 0
	local shoot_dir = target_pos - start_pos

	red_ice_item.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(vector_util.get_x0z(shoot_dir))
			* unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		red_ice_item.transform.localPosition = target_pos * progress + start_pos * (1 - progress)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	red_ice_item.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.one * 999

	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_ice_ridge_01')
	self:instantiate_red_ice_effect(target_pos)

	red_ice_item.using = false
end

function local_class:instantiate_red_ice_effect(target_pos, scale)
	local effect = self.get_fx_red_ice():Instantiate(target_pos)
	if scale ~= nil then
		effect.transform.localScale = scale
	end
	table.insert(self.red_ice_effect_list, effect)
end

function local_class:custom_air_spin(fo, offset)
	local start_pos = fo.Position

	local time_passed = 0
	local duration = 2

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration
		local air_spin_pos = start_pos + offset * progress
		fo.Position = air_spin_pos + unity_class.vector3.up * (-3.5 * time_passed * (time_passed - duration))
		fo.SpineController:Rotate(progress * 360 * 3)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime * 1.5
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	fo.SpineController:Rotate(0)
	character_util.set_direction(fo, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(fo, {name = 'prostrate'})

	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(fo)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(fo)
end

return local_class

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

		init = 1,
		bridge_call = 2,
		bridge_end = 3
	}
	self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.init

	self.talk_name = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s2_'

	self.blizzard_sfx = nil
	self.on_word_event = false
	self.word_speed = 1

	self.right_blocked = false

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	self.effects_start = {
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_lahn_text_black_a_start_loop'),
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_lahn_text_black_b_start_loop'),
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_lahn_text_black_c_start_loop'),
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_event_lahn_text_black_d_start_loop'),
	}

	self.lahn = self.controller.lahn()
	self.bridge_marker = field:GetMarker('secret_entrance')

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.bridge_marker.position)
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	quest_marker_util.remove('lahn_main')

	if self.blizzard_sfx ~= nil then
		self.blizzard_sfx:Stop()
		self.blizzard_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	-- 루피나 굴로 향하는 다리 생성 조건 > 이후 InteractEvent 로 수정해야 함
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == 'bridge_entrance'
				and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.lahn)
				and e.FullEnter
				and self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.init then
			self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.bridge_call
			self.blizzard_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player' })
			self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.bridge_event, self)
		end
	end
	return false
end

			text.Label.alpha = (cur_time / transition)
			if text.Label.alpha <= 0 then break end
			coroutine.yield(nil)

		text.Label.alpha = 1

		cur_time = 0
		while cur_time < transition do
			cur_time = cur_time + unity_class.time.unscaledDeltaTime
			text.Label.alpha = 1 - (cur_time / transition)
			if text.Label.alpha <= 0 then break end
			coroutine.yield(nil)

function local_class:npcs_of_past()
	self.on_past_passage = true
	local optimized_npcs = load_util.create_optimized_npcs_async({
		pass_1 = 'lahn_snowman_begger',
		pass_2 = 'lahn_snowman_female',
		pass_3 = 'lahn_snowman_male',
		pass_4 = 'lahn_innuit_elder',
		pass_5 = 'lahn_innuit_female',
		pass_6 = 'lahn_innuit_male',
	})
	local dirs = {
		true,
		false,
		false,
		true,
		false,
		true,
	}
	local npcs = {}

	local sepia = unity_color({ 0.5, 0.4, 0.3, 1 })
	for n, c in pairs(optimized_npcs) do
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(c, 0.75, 0)
		c.SpineController:AddColor('word_to_past', sepia, 1, 0)
		character_util.set_position(c, vector(999, 0, 999))
		local data = {
			name = n,
			npc = c,
			using = false,
		}
		table.insert(npcs, data)
	end

	local count = 1
	while self.on_past_passage do
		local up = (count % 2 == 1)
		local succeed = false

		if not npcs[count].using then
			if dirs[count] and not self.left_blocked then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_character, self, npcs[count], true, up))
				succeed = true
			elseif not dirs[count] and not self.right_blocked then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.move_character, self, npcs[count], false, up))
				succeed = true
			end
		end

		count = count + 1
		if count > 6 then count = 1 end

		if succeed then
			wait_for_sec(0.1)
		else
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end

	function clean_up_npcs(targets)
		local char_count = 0
		for _, character in pairs(targets) do
			character.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			char_count = char_count + 1
		end

		while true do
			local cleaned_count = 0
			for _, character in pairs(targets) do
				if character.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentAction == CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped then
					cleaned_count = cleaned_count + 1
				end
			end

			if char_count == cleaned_count then
				break
			end

			coroutine.yield()
		end

		load_util.dispose_optimized_npcs(targets)
	end

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(clean_up_npcs, optimized_npcs))
end


function local_class:move_character(target, is_left, go_up)
	target.using = true
	local npc = target.npc
	local upper_pos = field:GetMarker('secret_exit').position
	local center_pos = field:GetMarker('secret_center').position
	local left_pos = field:GetMarker('secret_left').position
	local right_pos = field:GetMarker('secret_right').position

	local initpos
	local route = {}
	if is_left then
		if go_up then
			initpos = left_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5)
			route = {
				center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0.5),
				upper_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1),
			}
		else
			initpos = upper_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 1)
			route = {
				center_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5),
				left_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5),
			}
		end
	else
		if go_up then
			initpos = right_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5)
			route = {
				center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5),
				upper_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 1),
			}
		else
			initpos = upper_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 1)
			route = {
				center_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0.5),
				right_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			}
		end
	end

	if is_left then self.left_blocked = true
	else self.right_blocked = true end

	character_util.set_position(npc, initpos)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(npc, route[1], 20, false)

	if not go_up then
		if is_left then self.left_blocked = false
		else self.right_blocked = false end
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(npc, route[2], 20, false)
	character_util.set_position(npc, vector(999, 0, 999))

	if go_up then
		if is_left then self.left_blocked = false
		else self.right_blocked = false end
	end

	target.using = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLahnMainSection4')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLahnMain @
		Comment = 란과 루피나 섹션 4 @
		Index = 3 @
		NextSections = 4 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.lupina_entrance_grid = 'lupina_entrance'
	self.lupina_room_zone = 'lupina_main_room'
	self.lupina_room_center = 'lupina_room_center'
	self.bridge_grid = 'bridge_site'

	self.event_state_enum = {
		starting = 1,
		init = 2,
		talk_event = 3,
		costume = 4
	}
	self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.init

	self.in_lupina_house = false

	self.talk_name = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s4_'

	self.writing_sfx = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	self.center = field:GetMarker('lupina_room_center')
	self.origin = field:GetMarker('lupina_costume_origin')
	self.house_marker = field:GetMarker('lupina_main_outer')

	self.lahn = self.controller.lahn()
	self.lupina = self.controller.lupina()

	self.costume = function(index)
		return self.controller.lupina(index)
	end

	self.section_start_from = (self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 3)

	if not self.section_start_from then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s4_intro, self))
	else
		self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.starting
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.house_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 2), true)
		character_util.set_position(self.lupina, self.center.position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
		character_util.set_direction(self.lupina, 'down')
	end
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if self.writing_sfx then
		self.writing_sfx:Stop()
		self.writing_sfx = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	-- 루피나의 집에 입장/퇴장시 마커 처리
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.talk_event then
			if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.lupina_entrance_grid) and not self.in_lupina_house then
				self.in_lupina_house = true
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', vector(-15.5, 0, 115), true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.bridge_grid) and self.in_lupina_house then
				self.in_lupina_house = false
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.house_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 2), true)
			end
		end
		if self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.starting then
			if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.lupina_entrance_grid) and not self.in_lupina_house then
				self.in_lupina_house = true
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.lupina, true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.bridge_grid) and self.in_lupina_house then
				self.in_lupina_house = false
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.house_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 2), true)
			end
		end
		--
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.lahn, self.lupina_room_zone) and self.in_lupina_house and self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.starting then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s4_intro, self))
			return true
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.talk_event then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.lupina) then
				self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.introduce_costume, self)
				return true
			end
		elseif self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.costume then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.lupina) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.choose_costume, self, 1))
				return true
			else
				for i = 1, 4 do
					if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.costume(i)) then
						coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.choose_costume, self, i))
						return true
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

	if self.section_start_from then

	--란 (left, idle, reading) : 하지만 의복을 골라주는 것뿐이라면 그리 어렵지 않을 것이라 예상된다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lahn, {key = self.talk_name .. 26, skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lahn)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	--루피나는 left, idle, idle 자세로 인터렉트 가능 상태로 변경되고, 머리 위로 파랑 마킹 출력.
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lupina_origin', self.lupina, true)
	--나머지 세 가지 코스튬 모두 인터렉트 가능 상태로 변경되고, 머리 위로 파랑 마킹 출력.
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lupina_dragon', self.costume(2), true)
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lupina_suit', self.costume(3), true)
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lupina_xm', self.costume(4), true)

	character_util.add_listener(self.costume(1), self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(self.costume(2), self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(self.costume(3), self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(self.costume(4), self.controller)
	--이후 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.

	self.controller.before_costume = false
end

function local_class:choose_costume(index)

	yield_return_func(self.controller.wait_until_book_ui_on, self.controller)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	target = self.costume(index)
	pos = target.Position

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, self.lupina) then
		party_util.align_to_target(target, 'left', 1, 'linear')
	else
		party_util.align_to_target(target, 'down', 1, 'linear')
	end

	local result

	if index == 1 then
		--루피나 : 어서 고르지 않고 뭐하고 있느냐.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. '35_1', life_time = 0, skip = true})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. '35_1', life_time = 9999, type_speed = 0})

		--선택지 : 현재 복장을 권유한다.
		--선택지 : 설명을 다시 듣고 싶다.
		result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{self.talk_name .. '35_2', 'mercy'},
			{self.talk_name .. '35_3', 'normal'}
		})

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.lupina)

		if result == 1 then
			--루피나 : 음? 이 옷이 가장 어울린단 말이냐?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 36, life_time = 0, skip = true})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 36, life_time = 9999, type_speed = 0})

			--선택지 : 그렇다.
			--선택지 : 다시 생각한다.
			result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
				{self.talk_name .. 37, 'mercy'},
				{self.talk_name .. 38, 'normal'}
			})

			speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.lupina)

			if result == 1 then
				quest_marker_util.remove('lupina_origin')
				quest_marker_util.remove('lupina_dragon')
				quest_marker_util.remove('lupina_suit')
				quest_marker_util.remove('lupina_xm')

				character_util.remove_relate_event(self.costume(1), self.controller)
				character_util.remove_relate_event(self.costume(2), self.controller)
				character_util.remove_relate_event(self.costume(3), self.controller)
				character_util.remove_relate_event(self.costume(4), self.controller)

				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. '36_1', skip = true})
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lahn, {name = 'librarian/writing'}, {name = 'idle'})

				wait_for_sec(0.5)

				self.controller.is_book_open = true

				local lahn_book = self.controller.lahn_book
				lahn_book:set_book_data_async(3, 2, 1)

				while self.controller.is_book_open do
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end

				character_util.set_anim(self.lahn, {name = 'librarian/reading'})
				wait_for_sec(0.4)
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
				character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })
				character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lahn)

				-- 다음 섹션으로
				lahn_book:save_data_async_only()
				yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

				return
			else
				--루피나 (mad) : 확실히 정하면 말하거라!
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 40, skip = true})

				party_util.reset_controllers()
				field_ui_manager:Show()
				return
			end

		else
			--루피나 : 이 몸에게 어울리는 가장 아름다운 옷을 고르거라.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. '35_4', skip = true})

			party_util.reset_controllers()
			field_ui_manager:Show()
			return
		end
	else
		--각 코스튬에 인터렉트 시 선택지 출력.
		--해당 코스튬으로 선택하시겠습니까?
		stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()
		yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, 'SetNarration',
				game_string:GetString(self.talk_name .. 31), 0, 0)

		--예
		--아니오

		result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{self.talk_name .. 32, 'mercy'},
			{self.talk_name .. 33, 'normal'}
		})

		yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, 'HideAnimation')
	end


	if result == 1 then
		if index ~= 1 then
			move_wait = {
				util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, self.lupina, {
					vector(target.Position.x + 1, 0, self.lupina.Position.z),
					target.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)

				util.cs_generator(party_util.align_to_target, target, 'left', 1, 'linear')
			}

			wait_all(move_wait)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 34, skip = true})
			--플레이어가 해당 코스튬 선택지에서 ‘예’ 를 선택 시, 란은 코스튬의 1타일 왼쪽으로 이동 후 right를 바라봄.
			--루피나 해당 코스튬의 1타일 우측으로 이동한 뒤, left,를 바라봄.
			--루피나 (left, question) : 흠~ 이 옷이 확실하겠지?
			--루피나 eat 모션 2초 후 해당 코스튬으로 변경됨.
			local equipping_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
			character_util.set_anim(self.lupina, {name = 'eat'})

			wait_for_sec(1)

			screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			character_util.remove_anim(self.lupina)
			--self.lupina.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
			self.controller:update_costume_routine(index)
			self.lupina = self.costume()
			character_util.set_position(self.lupina, self.origin.position)
			character_util.set_direction(self.lupina, 'left')
			character_util.remove_anim(self.lupina, true)
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lupina)
			equipping_sfx:Stop()

			character_util.set_position(self.lahn, self.origin.position + vector(-2.5, 0, 0))

			quest_marker_util.remove('lupina_origin')
			quest_marker_util.remove('lupina_dragon')
			quest_marker_util.remove('lupina_suit')
			quest_marker_util.remove('lupina_xm')

			character_util.remove_relate_event(self.costume(1), self.controller)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(self.costume(2), self.controller)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(self.costume(3), self.controller)
			character_util.remove_relate_event(self.costume(4), self.controller)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_equip_finish_01')
			character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lahn, {name = 'librarian/writing'}, {name = 'idle'})
			screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_writing_02')
			wait_for_sec(0.5)

			self.controller.is_book_open = true

			local lahn_book = self.controller.lahn_book
			lahn_book:set_book_data_async(3, 2, 1)

			while self.controller.is_book_open do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			character_util.set_anim(self.lahn, {name = 'librarian/reading'})
			wait_for_sec(0.4)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party.Leader, { name = 'nod', count = 1 })
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lahn)

			-- 다음 섹션으로
			lahn_book:save_data_async_only()
			yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
			return
		end
	end

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLahnMainSection5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLahnMain @
		Comment = 란과 루피나 섹션 5 @
		Index = 4 @
		NextSections = 5 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.event_state_enum = {
		starting = 1,
		init = 2,
		talk_event = 3,
		before_hunt = 4,
		hunting = 5,
		end_hunt = 6,
	}
	self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.init

	self.in_cave_path = false
	self.in_lupina_house = false
	self.on_outland = false

	self.talk_name = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s5_'

	self.lupina_entrance_grid = 'lupina_entrance'
	self.lupina_room_zone = 'lupina_main_room'
	self.dress_room_grid = 'lupina_dress_room'
	self.lupina_room_center = 'lupina_room_center'
	self.bridge_grid = 'bridge_site'

	self.hunting_zone_name = 'hunting_zone_1'
	self.hunting_grid_name = 'hunting_zone_a'
	self.path_grid_name = 'side_path_a'
	self.lupina_pos_name = 'lupina_hunting_pos_a'
	self.victim_pos_name = 'victim_pos_a_1'
	self.victim_hide_name = 'victim_pos_a_2'
	self.victim_name = 'victim_1_'

end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	self.origin = field:GetMarker('lupina_costume_origin')
	self.house_marker = field:GetMarker('lupina_main_outer')

	self.lupina_pos = field:GetMarker(self.lupina_pos_name).position
	self.victim_pos = field:GetMarker(self.victim_pos_name).position
	self.hide_pos = field:GetMarker(self.victim_hide_name).position

	self.lahn = self.controller.lahn()
	self.lupina = self.controller.lupina()

	self.costume = function(index)
		return self.controller.lupina(index)
	end

	self.victim_1 = get_character(self.victim_name .. 1)
	self.victim_2 = get_character(self.victim_name .. 2)

	self.section_start_from = (self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 4)

	if not self.section_start_from then
		self.in_lupina_house = true

		self.controller:set_costume_narration(true)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s5_intro, self))
	else
		self.on_outland = true
		self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.starting
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.house_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 2), true)
		--character_util.set_position(self.lupina, self.origin.position)
		--character_util.set_direction(self.lupina, 'left')
	end
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.section_start_from then
		self.lupina = self.controller.lupina()
		character_util.set_position(self.lupina, self.origin.position)
		character_util.set_direction(self.lupina, 'left')
		character_util.add_listener(self.lupina, self.controller)

		--character_util.set_position(self.lahn, self.house_marker.position)

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end
end

function local_class:s5_intro()
	if self.section_start_from then

		yield_return_func(self.controller.wait_until_book_ui_on, self.controller)

		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		party_util.align_to_target(self.lupina, 'left', 1, 'linear')
	end

	self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.talk_event

	if self.controller.current_costume == 1 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. '0_1', skip = true})
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. '0_2', skip = true})
	end
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 0, skip = true})

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.lupina, {
		vector(self.lupina.Position.x, 0, self.origin.position.z + 0.5),
		self.origin.position + vector(1.5, 0, 0.5)
	}, 3, false, nil, nil, 'right', false)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.lupina, {name = 'attack', count = 1})

	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
	yield_return_func(self.controller.toggle_path_blocker_routine, self.controller, 'a', false, false)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.lupina, {
		self.origin.position + vector(6.5, 0, 0.5)
	}, 3, false, nil, nil, 'right', false)

	self.lupina.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.lupina, 0, 1)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_position(self.lupina, self.lupina_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(self.lupina, 'down')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.lupina, 1, 0)
	self.lupina:SetEquipment(CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.Weapon1,
			CS.Oak.Item.Create(CS.Oak.ItemSpec.GetByName('cwp_witchcoco_epic')))

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	self.lupina.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false

	-- 희생자 설정
	character_util.set_position(self.victim_1, self.victim_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(self.victim_2, self.victim_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_direction(self.victim_1, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(self.victim_2, 'up')

	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.lupina, self.controller)
	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_house_exit'), true)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if self.event_state < self.event_state_enum.talk_event then
			if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.lupina_entrance_grid) and not self.in_lupina_house then
				self.in_lupina_house = true
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.lupina, true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.bridge_grid) and self.in_lupina_house then
				self.in_lupina_house = false
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.house_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 2), true)
			end
		elseif self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.hunting then
			if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.hunting_grid_name) then
				self.in_lupina_house = false
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.victim_1, true)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.turn_on_blizzard, self.controller, 0.2))
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.bridge_grid) then
				self.in_lupina_house = false
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.house_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 2), true)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.turn_on_blizzard, self.controller, 0.2))
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.lupina_entrance_grid) and not self.in_lupina_house then
				self.in_lupina_house = true
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_house_exit'), true)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.turn_off_blizzard, self.controller, true, true))
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.path_grid_name) then
				self.in_lupina_house = true
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_hunting_path_exit'), true)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.controller.turn_off_blizzard, self.controller, true, true))
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.dress_room_grid) then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_house_exit'), true)
			end
		elseif self.event_state < self.event_state_enum.before_hunt then
			if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.hunting_grid_name) then
				self.in_lupina_house = false
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.victim_1, true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.bridge_grid) then
				self.in_lupina_house = false
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.house_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 2), true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.lupina_entrance_grid) and not self.in_lupina_house then
				self.in_lupina_house = true
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_house_exit'), true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.path_grid_name) then
				self.in_lupina_house = true
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_hunting_path_exit'), true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.dress_room_grid) then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_house_exit'), true)
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.hunting_zone_name
				and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.lahn)
				and self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.talk_event then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hunting_event_1, self))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.lupina) and self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.starting then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.s5_intro, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.victim_1) and self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.hunting then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hunting_event_2, self))
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:hunting_event_1()

	yield_return_func(self.controller.wait_until_book_ui_on, self.controller)

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(nil, { 'hide_record_emoticon' }))

	self.lupina.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	self.victim_1.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true

function local_class:ease_slide(target, pos, duration)
	local ice = self.controller:call_add_ice('victim_1_1', target.Position)
	local timer = 0
	local origin = target.Position

	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(target)

	while timer < duration do
		local dt = unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local proc = (timer / duration) * math.pi / 2
		local temp_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(origin, pos, math.sin(proc))

		character_util.set_position(target, temp_pos)
		ice.fx.transform.position = temp_pos
		ice.fo.Position = temp_pos
		timer = timer + dt
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(target, pos)
	ice.fx.transform.position = pos
	ice.fo.Position = pos
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.hunting_zone_name
				and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.lahn)
				and self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.init then
			self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.hunting
			self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.hunting_event, self)
		elseif e.Zone.Name == self.ice_zone_name
				and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.lahn)
				and self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.hunting then
			self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.ice_break
			self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.ice_break, self)
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.init then
			if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.hunting_grid_name) then
				self.in_lupina_house = false
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.victim_3, true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.bridge_grid) then
				self.in_lupina_house = false
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.house_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 2), true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.lupina_entrance_grid) and not self.in_lupina_house then
				self.in_lupina_house = true
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_house_exit'), true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.path_grid_name) then
				self.in_lupina_house = true
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_hunting_path_exit'), true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.dress_room_grid) then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_house_exit'), true)
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLahnMainSection7')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLahnMain @
		Comment = 란과 루피나 섹션 7 @
		Index = 6 @
		NextSections = 7 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.event_state_enum = {
		init = 1,
		hunting = 2,
		couples = 3,
		section_end = 4,
	}
	self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.init

	self.in_cave_path = false
	self.in_lupina_house = false
	self.on_outland = false

	self.talk_name = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s7_'

	self.lupina_entrance_grid = 'lupina_entrance'
	self.lupina_room_zone = 'lupina_main_room'
	self.dress_room_grid = 'lupina_dress_room'
	self.lupina_room_center = 'lupina_room_center'
	self.bridge_grid = 'bridge_site'

	self.hunting_zone_name = 'hunting_zone_3'
	self.hunting_grid_name = 'hunting_zone_a'
	self.path_grid_name = 'side_path_a'
	self.victim_pos_name = 'victim_pos_a_6'
	self.block_pos_name = 'victim_pos_a_5'
	self.victim_name = 'victim_1_'

	self.main_field_zone_name = 'main_field_zone'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	self.victim_pos = field:GetMarker(self.victim_pos_name).position
	self.block_pos = field:GetMarker(self.block_pos_name).position
	self.house_marker = field:GetMarker('lupina_main_outer')

	self.lahn = self.controller.lahn()
	self.lupina = self.controller.lupina()

	character_util.set_position(self.lupina, self.victim_pos + vector(0, 0, -3))

	self.costume = function(index)
		return self.controller.lupina(index)
	end

	self.victim_4 = get_character(self.victim_name .. 4)
	self.victim_5 = get_character(self.victim_name .. 5)

	self.section_start_from = (self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 6)

	self.on_outland = true

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.victim_pos + vector(5, 1, -5), true)

	self.controller:call_add_ice('town_blocker_1', self.block_pos + vector(0, 0, 1.5))
	self.controller:call_add_ice('town_blocker_2', self.block_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5))
	self.controller:call_add_ice('town_blocker_3', self.block_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.5))
	self.controller:call_add_ice('town_blocker_4', self.block_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5))
end

function local_class:start()
	if self.section_start_from then
		self.lupina = self.controller.lupina()
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(stage_launch_util.default_launch_with_marker_name, 'path_a_exit_outer', true))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.hunting_zone_name
				and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.lahn)
				and self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.init then
			self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.hunting
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hunting_event_1, self))
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, self.main_field_zone_name)
				and self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.hunting then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.controller.turn_on_blizzard, self.controller))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.lupina) and self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.hunting then
			self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.couples
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hunting_event_2, self))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if self.event_state < self.event_state_enum.section_end then
			if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.hunting_grid_name) then
				self.in_lupina_house = false
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.lupina, true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.bridge_grid) then
				self.in_lupina_house = false
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.house_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 2), true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.lupina_entrance_grid) and not self.in_lupina_house then
				self.in_lupina_house = true
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_house_exit'), true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.path_grid_name) then
				self.in_lupina_house = true
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_hunting_path_exit'), true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.dress_room_grid) then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_house_exit'), true)
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_leave(e, self.lahn, self.main_field_zone_name)
			and self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.hunting then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.controller.turn_off_blizzard, self.controller, true, true))
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lahn, {key = self.talk_name .. 15, skip = true})

	character_util.set_direction(self.victim_5, 'down')
	character_util.move_to_async(self.victim_5, self.victim_5.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), nil, 4, true, true)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.victim_5, {name = 'release'}, {name = 'mad'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.victim_5, {key = self.talk_name .. 16, skip = true})
	--주민1 (right, mad, release) : 누가 희생하겠대? 마녀님! 이쪽이에요!
	character_util.remove_anim(self.victim_4)
	character_util.set_direction(self.victim_4, 'down')
	character_util.move_to_async(self.victim_4, self.victim_4.Position + vector(0, 0, -2), nil, 4, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(self.victim_4, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.victim_4, {name = 'release'}, {name = 'mad'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.victim_4, {key = self.talk_name .. 17, skip = true})
	--루피나 (up) : 싸우지 않아도 이 루피나가 사이좋게 둘 다 얼려주마.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 18, skip = true})
	--주민1 (down, scared, idle) : 뭐?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.victim_4, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'scared'})
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.victim_5, {name = 'embarrassed'}, {name = 'scared'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.victim_4, {key = self.talk_name .. 19, skip = true})
	--주민2 (down, scared, idle) : 잠깐…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.victim_5, {key = self.talk_name .. 20, skip = true})
	--루피나 (up, attack 1회) 후 주민1,2 얼어붙음.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.lupina, {name = 'attack', count = 1})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_ice_ridge_01')
	self.controller:call_add_ice('victim_1_4', self.victim_4.Position)
	self.controller:call_add_ice('victim_1_5', self.victim_5.Position)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.victim_4, {name = 'embarrassed', loop = false}, {name = 'scared', loop = false})
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.victim_5, {name = 'embarrassed', loop = false}, {name = 'scared', loop = false})
	--루피나 (right, smile, victory_extra) : 아하하하! 오늘 사냥은 여기까지다!

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 22, skip = true})

	character_util.set_anim(self.lahn, {name = 'librarian/writing'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lahn, {key = self.talk_name .. '22_1_1', skip = true})

	else

	end

	while self.controller.is_book_open do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. '23_1', skip = true})

	character_util.set_anim(self.lahn, {name = 'idle'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_paper_01')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.lahn, nil, 'question')

	self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.section_end
	--wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lupina, {name = 'shoot'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. '23_2', skip = true})

	--페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_03')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music(
			{ name = 'ondemand/short_story_lahn/audio:bgm_shivering_record_night', state = 'event', mix = 0.8 })
	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0.8, 'linear')

	self.controller:call_remove_ice('town_blocker_1', true)
	self.controller:call_remove_ice('town_blocker_2', true)
	self.controller:call_remove_ice('town_blocker_3', true)
	self.controller:call_remove_ice('town_blocker_4', true)

	character_util.set_position(self.lupina, vector(999, 0, 999))
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)
	character_util.remove_anim(self.lahn)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lupina)

	self.lupina.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')

	lahn_book:save_data_async_only()
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

return local_class

	self.lahn.SpineController:RemoveColor(self.tint_name, 0)

--[[QuestAttribute

		QuestName = ShortStoryLahnMain @

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

		init = 1,
		wake_up = 2,
		section_end = 3,
	}
	self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.init

	self.in_lupina_house = true

	self.talk_name = 'shortstory_lahn_main_s9_'

	self.lupina_entrance_grid = 'lupina_entrance'

	self.tint_name = 'lupina_night'

	self.path_grid_name = 'side_path_a'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.house_marker = field:GetMarker('lupina_main_outer')
	self.center_pos = field:GetMarker(self.lupina_room_center).position
	self.bed_pos = field:GetMarker(self.bed_pos_name).position + vector(0.5, 0, -0.5)
	self.couch_pos = field:GetMarker(self.couch_pos_name).position

	self.lahn = self.controller.lahn()
	self.lupina = self.controller.lupina(1)

	self.costume = function(index)
		return self.controller.lupina(index)
	end

	self.section_start_from = (self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 8)

end

function local_class:start()
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.good_morning, self))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.init then
			if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.hunting_grid_name) and self.in_lupina_house then
				self.in_lupina_house = false
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_hunting_path_entrance'), true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.bridge_grid) and self.in_lupina_house then
				self.in_lupina_house = false
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.house_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 2), true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.lupina_entrance_grid) and not self.in_lupina_house then
				self.in_lupina_house = true
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.lupina.Position + vector(0.7, 1, 0))
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.path_grid_name) then
				self.in_lupina_house = true
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', get_field_object('right_house_entrance'), true)
			elseif type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.dress_room_grid) then
				quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lahn_main', self.lupina.Position + vector(0.7, 1, 0))
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.lupina) and self.event_state == self.event_state_enum.init then
			self.event_state = self.event_state_enum.wake_up
			self.controller:play_normal_screenplay(self.wake_up_lupina, self)
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:wake_up_lupina()
	self:remove_record_emoticon()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(self.lupina, self.controller)
	quest_marker_util.remove('lahn_main')

	--늦잠자는 루피나와 기록중인 란
	--루피나 상호작용 시 플레이어 해당 위치에 정렬.
	local route = {
		self.bed_pos + vector(3.5, 0, 0)
	}
	local z_pos
	if self.lahn.Position.z >self.bed_pos.z - 0.5 then
		z_pos = 1.5
	else
		z_pos = -1.5
	end

	if self.lahn.Position.x < self.bed_pos.x + 1 then
		table.insert(route, 1, self.bed_pos + vector(3.5, 0, -0.5 + z_pos))
		if self.lahn.Position.x < self.bed_pos.x - 0.5 then
			table.insert(route, 1, self.bed_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, -0.5 + z_pos))
		end
	end
	--right, sleep, sleep 상태인 루피나의 침대 옆에 정렬하여 해당 모습을 left, idle, cross_arm 상태로 바라보는 란.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_sleep_02')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.lahn, route, 3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(self.lahn, {name = 'cross_arm'})
	--루피나의 머리 위로 emoticon_bubble_sleep 말풍선 출력.
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.lupina, nil, 'sleep')
	--란 (left, idle, cross_arm) : 일찍 자고 일찍 일어나는 마녀가 악명을 떨친다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lahn, {key = self.talk_name .. 1, skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(self.lahn)
	--란 (left, idle, writing) : 그러나 아직 수면 중인 것을 보니 일찍이라는 개념이 인간과 다른 것으로 추정.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_writing_02')
	character_util.set_anim(self.lahn, {name = 'librarian/writing'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lahn, {key = self.talk_name .. 3, skip = true})
	--루피나 (right, tired, seat) : 으음…
	character_util.shake(self.lupina, 0.05, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.shake(self.lupina, 0.05, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lupina, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 4, skip = true})
	wait_for_sec(1)
	--루피나 (right, attack, seat) (emoticon_bubble_exclamation)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lupina, {name = 'seat'}, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.lupina, nil, 'notice')

	--이후 침대에서 down, jump로 내려오는 루피나.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lupina, {name = 'jump'}, {name = 'attack'})
	character_util.set_direction(self.lupina, 'down')
	character_util.jump_move(self.lupina, self.bed_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 3, 0.7, true, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lupina)
	--루피나 (right, attack, idle) : 어디로 들어온 쥐새끼냐! 겁도 없이 이 루피나…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lupina, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 5, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	--루피나 (right, annoy, idle) : 너는…
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lupina, {name = 'annoy'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 6, skip = true})
	--란 (left, idle, idle) : 얼음 마녀의 전설을 기록하기 위해 찾아온 기록실 서기 란이라 하였다.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
	character_util.remove_anim(self.lahn)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lahn, {key = self.talk_name .. 7, skip = true})
	--란 (left, idle, writing) : 란은 얼음 마녀에게 다시금 인사를 전하였다.
	local writing_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{sfx_name = '01_writing_loop_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'player'})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lahn, {key = self.talk_name .. 8, skip = true})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 9, skip = true})
	--루피나 (right, doyagao, idle) : 나의 전설을 기록하고 전 세계에 이 루피나의 악명을 알리고 싶다며 찾아왔었지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 10, skip = true})
	--란 (left, tired, idle) (emoticon_bubble_question)
	writing_loop_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lahn, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_anim(self.lahn, {name = 'librarian/writing', loop = false})
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.lahn, nil, 'question')
	--란 (left, idle, writing) : [small] 하룻밤 사이에 얼음 마녀의 기억이 왜곡되어 있는 것을 란은 확인하였다.
	writing_loop_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
			{sfx_name = '01_writing_loop_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'player'})
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.lahn)
	character_util.set_anim(self.lahn, {name = 'librarian/writing', loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lahn, {key = self.talk_name .. 11, skip = true})
	--루피나 (left, idle, idle) : 어제는 사냥으로 인간들이 나를 얼마나 두려워하는지 보여줬으니

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 12, skip = true})
	--루피나 (right, idle, idle) : 오늘은 다른 것을 보여줘야겠구나.
	character_util.remove_anim(self.lahn)
	--루피나 up, idle, attack을 1회 실행하자, 침대가 1타일 right로 이동됨. 이동한 공간에는 ‘[GIMMICK]stair_down’ 오브젝트가 배치되어 있음.
	character_util.set_direction(self.lupina, 'up')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_cast_magic_05')
	writing_loop_sfx:Stop()
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.lupina, {name = 'attack', count = 1})

	local bed_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_push_rock_01',
								type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object'})
	self.controller:reveal_bed_stair()
	bed_sfx:Stop()

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--루피나 (right, idle, idle) : 지금부터 이 아래에 있는 것들은 하나도 빼먹지 말고 전부 기록하거라.
	character_util.set_direction(self.lupina, 'right')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 14, skip = true})
	--루피나 (right, doyagao, idle) : 만약 도중에 도망가려 한다면 그 자리에서 얼리겠다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 15, skip = true})
	--란 (left, sleep_deep, idle) (emoticon_bubble_silence)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.lahn, nil, 'silence')
	--란 (left, idle, reading) : 란은 기록을 관장하는 서기 가문의 후예이자 현 기록실 서기.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lahn, {key = self.talk_name .. 16, skip = true})
	--란 (left, idle, release 2회) : 기록 대상으로부터 눈을 돌리는 일은 없다고 란은 명확하게 말하였다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lahn, {key = self.talk_name .. 17, skip = true})

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lupina, {key = self.talk_name .. 19, skip = true})
	--대화 종료 시 루피나 up, walk를 이용하여 계단을 내려간다. 계단으로 마킹 출력되는 상태. 플레이어 컨트롤 복귀.
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.lupina, {
		vector(self.bed_pos.x - 0.5, 0, self.lupina.Position.z),
		self.bed_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, -0.5),
	}, 2, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'up')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.lupina, 0, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_position(self.lupina, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.lupina, 1, 0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)


	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end
