function local_class:dispose()
	-- 테이블 이모티콘 일괄 삭제
	for i = 1, #self.record_table do
		if self.record_table[i].emoticon ~= nil then
			self.record_table[i].emoticon:Clear()
			self.record_table[i].emoticon = nil
		end
	end
	self.record_table = nil

	-- 저장해두 스프라이트 일괄 삭제
	for i = 1, #self.record_item_sprite_table do
		self.record_item_sprite_table[i]:ConsumeComplete()
	end
	self.record_item_sprite_table = nil

	-- 극지 강난사콩 슈터 헬퍼 해제
	self.shoot_helper_list:Clear()
	self.shoot_helper_list = nil

	self.rabbit_cave_interactable = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.HoldUpEvent) then
		return self:on_hold_up_event(e)
	elseif e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.ThrowEvent) then
		return self:on_throw_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	-- 설표 햄 인터랙트
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fo('record_snowcat_ham')) then
		self:play_normal_screenplay(self.get_ham, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 물범 스코프 인터랙트
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fo('record_seal_scope')) then
		self:play_normal_screenplay(self.record_seal, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 시체 인터랙트
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fo('record_dead_man_inv')) then
		self:play_normal_screenplay(self.record_blue_mushroom_2, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 토끼 인터랙트
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fo('record_rabbit_inv')) then
		self:play_normal_screenplay(self.record_rabbit, self)
		return true
	end

	-- 움직이는 냉천 원숭이 인터랙트
	local monkey_idx = { 5, 7, 8 }
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local monkey =  self.get_character('record_monkey_' .. monkey_idx[i])
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_character('record_monkey_' .. monkey_idx[i])) then
			self:play_normal_screenplay(self.monkey_move, self, monkey, monkey_idx[i])
			return true
		end
	end

	-- 새끼 설표 눈더미 인터랙트
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fo('record_snowcat_snow')) then
		if self.is_get_ham then
			self:play_normal_screenplay(self.appear_record_snowcat, self)
		else
			self:play_normal_screenplay(self.record_snowcat_without_ham, self)
		end
		return true
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_character('record_heavy_knight')) then
		self:play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_heavy_knight, self, self.get_character('record_heavy_knight'))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	if e:GetParamAt(0) == 'hide_record_emoticon' then
		self:hide_all_record_emoticon()
		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'show_record_emoticon' then
		self:show_all_record_emoticon()
		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'interacting' then
		for i = 1, #self.record_table do
			local record = self.record_table[i]
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Sender, self.get_fo(record.name)) then
				self:play_normal_screenplay(record.cb, self, self.get_fo(record.name), record.record_idx)
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'LahnBookClose' then
		self.is_book_open = false
		self.is_book_ui_on = false
		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'lahn_book_opened' then
		self.is_book_ui_on = true
		return true
	elseif e:GetParamAt(0) == 'hide_rabbit' then
		self:hide_rabbit()
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'monster_rabbit_zone' and e.FullEnter and not self.monster_rabbit_is_chasing_user and
			self.get_character('record_monster_rabbit').ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_monster_rabbit_zone, self))
		return true
	end

	if zone_name == 'heavy_knight_zone' and self.monster_rabbit_is_chasing_user and
			self.get_character('record_heavy_knight').ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Enabled and
			lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader)then
		-- QTE 시작 조건 체크
		if self:check_qte_event(5) == false then
			return false
		end
		self.catch_block = true
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_qte_event, self))
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'peashooter_grid') then
		-- 극지 강난사콩 그리드에 입장했을 때 부터 탄 쏘는 로직 시작
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.peashooter_shoot_routine, self))
	end

	-- 원숭이 쉐이크 켜기
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, 'monkey_grid') then
		for i = 1, 8 do
			self.get_character('record_monkey_' .. i):Shake(0.015, 99999)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'peashooter_grid') then
		-- 극지 강난사콩 그리드 떠날 시 로직 stop
		self.is_peashooter_shoot_routine = false
	end

	-- 원숭이 쉐이크 끄기
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, 'monkey_grid') then
		for i = 1, 8 do
			character_util.stop_shake(self.get_character('record_monkey_' .. i))
		end
	end

	-- 괴물 토끼가 유저 추적 중이었다면
	if self.monster_rabbit_is_chasing_user == true then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.monster_rabbit_stop_chasing, self))
		return true
	end
end

function local_class:on_stage_end_event(e)
	self.is_peashooter_shoot_routine = false
	self.is_shake_snow = false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	-- 새끼 설표 얼음
	if self.snowcat_ham ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.get_fo('record_snowcat_ice_block')) and self.is_find_ham == false then
		self.is_find_ham = true
		self.get_fo('record_snowcat_ham').Position = vector(8.5,1,39)
		self.get_fo('record_snowcat_ham').Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if self.snowcat_ham ~= nil and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fo('record_snowcat_ice_block')) and self.is_find_ham == false then
		self.is_find_ham = true
		self.get_fo('record_snowcat_ham').Position = vector(8.5,1,39)
		self.get_fo('record_snowcat_ham').Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fo('rabbit_braizer_2')) then
		self.rabbit_braizer_2.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None
	end
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_fo('rabbit_braizer_2')) then
		self.rabbit_braizer_2.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.is_use_qte then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
			self.is_qte_success = true
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local info = e.Info

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.get_character('record_yeti'), info.target) and not self.is_show_big_yeti_event then
		-- 폭탄 대미지를 받았을 때
		if info.type == CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap | CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick then
			self.is_show_big_yeti_event = true
			self:play_normal_screenplay(self.run_big_yeti, self)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 도감이 닫힐 때 까지 기다려줌
-- sp_util.play_normal_screenplay를 사용하지 않고 컨트롤을 뺏는 연출을 진행할 때는 연출 코루틴 시작 부분에서 이 함수 호출
function local_class:wait_until_book_ui_on()
	while self.is_book_ui_on do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- Interact 또는 ZoneEnter 등으로 연출이 진행되는 경우 도감이 열려있을 수 있음
-- 도감이 닫힐 때 까지 기다리고 sp_util.play_normal_screenplay를 실행하도록 함
function local_class:play_normal_screenplay(func, ...)
	local args =  {...}
	local routine = function()
		self:wait_until_book_ui_on()

		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		local cached_leader = user_party.Leader
		if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
			cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:AddStatsOptionRequest(
					stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
		end

		yield_return_func(func, table.unpack(args))

		if cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour ~= nil then
			cached_leader.CharacterStatsBehaviour:RemoveStatsOptionRequest(
					stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CharacterStatsOptions.Invincible)
		end

		party_util.reset_controllers()
		field_ui_manager:Show()
	end

	return coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(routine))
end

-- 연출 도중에 도감에 데이터를 추가하는 경우, 도감이 닫힐 때 까지 기다려줌
-- set_book_data_async의 인자 중 open_book이 false인 경우에는 무한정 대기하므로 사용하지 말 것
function local_class:set_book_data_on_screenplay(...)
	self.is_book_open = true
	self.lahn_book:set_book_data_async(...)

	while self.is_book_open do
		coroutine.yield()
	end
end

-- 란 이모티큔 띄우기
function local_class:show_lahn_emoticon(record_idx, offset_vec)
	for i = 1, #self.record_table do
		local record = self.record_table[i]
		if record.record_idx == record_idx then
			record.emoticon = character_util.show_emoticon_with_data(
					self.get_fo(record.name).transform, nil, 'custom', 'emoticon_bubble_record_lahn.png',
					{no_time_limit = true, offset = offset_vec })
		end
	end
end

-- 란 이모티큔 삭제
function local_class:remove_lahn_emoticon(record_idx)
	for i = 1, #self.record_table do
		local record = self.record_table[i]
		if record.record_idx == record_idx and record.emoticon ~= nil then
			record.emoticon:Clear()
			record.emoticon = nil
		end
	end
end

-- npc or fo 상호작용 삭제
function local_class:remove_interactable(record_idx)
	for i = 1, #self.record_table do
		local record = self.record_table[i]
		if record.record_idx == record_idx then
			self.get_fo(record.name).Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		end
	end
end

-- 해당 도감 이벤트가 이미 클리어인지 체크
function local_class:check_clear_record(record_idx)
	local book_data = self.lahn_book:get_book_data()
	local category = math.floor(record_idx / 100)
	local index = math.floor((record_idx % 100) / 10)
	local set = record_idx % 10

	if book_data ~= nil and book_data[category][index] >= set then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- 새끼 설표 눈 쉐이크
function local_class:shake_snowcat_snow()
	local snow = self.get_fo('record_snowcat_snow')
	local time = 0
	while self.is_shake_snow do
		snow:Shake(0.1, 0.1)
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_flower_hit_01', parent = snow, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc', max_distance = 6 })
		time = 0
		while time < 3 do
			if self.is_shake_snow == false then
				return
			end
			time = time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

-- 새끼 설표 등장
function local_class:appear_record_snowcat()
	local snowcat = self.get_character('record_snowcat')
	local snow = self.get_fo('record_snowcat_snow')
	party_util.align_party(snow.Position + vector( -2,0,0), 'left')

	local wait = true
	local select = 0
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	-- 조용히 지켜본다.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('shortstory_lahn_record_2_4_1'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
			select = 1
		end })
	-- 햄을 던져준다.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('shortstory_lahn_record_2_4_2'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
			select = 2
		end })
	-- 떠난다.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString('shortstory_lahn_record_2_4_3'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end })

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if select == 0 then
		return
	elseif select == 1 then
		character_util.set_anim(user_party.Leader, { name = 'cast' })
		wait_for_sec(2)
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({key = 'shortstory_lahn_record_2_4_4'})
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party.Leader)
		return
	end

	snow.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	character_util.remove_relate_event(snow, self.controller)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_throw_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, { name = 'throw', count = 1 })
	self.snowcat_ham = drop_item_util.create_item(
			{itemid = self.ham_idx, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.7, skip_text = true,
			 pos = user_party.Leader.Position, target = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0.8,0,0), showoncharacter = false })

	self.is_shake_snow = false

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_cat_purr_01')
	snowcat.Position = snow.Position
	character_util.move_to_async(snowcat, snowcat.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			1, nil, true, true)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(snowcat, { name = 'happy', count = 5 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(snowcat, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	character_util.move_to_async(snowcat, snowcat.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0),
			0.5, nil, true, false)

	self.snowcat_eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_eat_01', parent = snowcat, type_priority = 'event', loop = false  })
	character_util.set_anim(snowcat, { name = 'eat' })

	self.get_fo('record_snowcat_inv').Position = snowcat.Position
	self:show_lahn_emoticon(221, vector(0,0,1))

-- 극지 강난사콩 ShootHelper 세팅
function local_class:set_shoot_helper()
	self.shoot_helper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.ShootHelper)

	-- 프로젝타일 스팩 세팅
	local spec = CS.Oak.GameDataService.GetData('ProjectileData'):GetSpec('projectile_lahn_peashooter')
	local pattern_Info = CS.Oak.ShootPatternInfo()
	pattern_Info.columns = 1
	pattern_Info.spreadDistance = 1
	pattern_Info.parallel = true

	-- ShootHelper 설정
	-- 강난사콩 first_name
	local peashooter_name = 'record_peashooter_'

	-- 앞라인 강난사콩 세팅
	for i = 1, 12 do
		local peashooter = self.get_character(peashooter_name .. i)
		local shooter = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, peashooter)
		self.shoot_helper_list:Add(CS.Oak.ShootHelper(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional,
				shooter, spec, pattern_Info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShoot, 0.8))
	end
end

-- 극지 강난사콩 총알 쏘는 로직
function local_class:peashooter_shoot_routine()
	self.is_peashooter_shoot_routine = false
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 강난사콩 캐릭터 이름
	local peashooter_name = 'record_peashooter_'

	-- 다음 웨이브까지의 대기시간
	local wait_wave_time = 1.5

	-- 총알 쏘는 로직
	local shoot_bullet = function(start_index, end_index)
		for i = start_index, end_index do
			local peashooter = self.get_character(peashooter_name .. (i + 1))
			character_util.set_anim(peashooter, { name = 'attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'idle', scale = 2 })
			local shoot_pos = peashooter.Bounds.center + unity_class.vector3(0.5, 0.2, 0)
			self.shoot_helper_list[i]:ShootDirectionAtPosition(shoot_pos, vector(-1, 0, 0), 999, -1, nil, false, 0)
			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_dark_magician_shoot_01', parent = peashooter, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		end
	end

	self.is_peashooter_shoot_routine = true

	local max_start_index = self.shoot_helper_list.Count - 4
	local cur_start_index = 0
	while self.is_peashooter_shoot_routine do
		local start_index = cur_start_index
		local val = start_index + 3
		local end_index = unity_class.mathf.Clamp(val, 0, self.shoot_helper_list.Count)
		shoot_bullet(cur_start_index, end_index)

		-- n초 대기 후 다른 웨이브 강난사콩 발사
		wait_for_sec(wait_wave_time)
		cur_start_index = cur_start_index >= max_start_index and 0 or cur_start_index + 4
	end
end

-- 강난사콩 프로젝타일 명중 처리
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	local lahn = user_party.Leader

	-- 란이 강난사콩에 맞았을 때
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, lahn) then
		-- 피격 이팩트
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(lahn.Bounds.center)
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(lahn, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(lahn, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.2)

		local type = field:GetTileInfoAt(lahn.Position).types
		if (type & CS.Tilemaps.TileTypes.Sliding) ~= CS.Tilemaps.TileTypes.None then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.hit_peashooter_in_slider, self, lahn))
		else
			-- 일반 필드에서 맞았으면 왼쪽으로 살짝 밀림
			local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info("physics", true, vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
					22000, 0.05, CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
			message_system:Send(lahn.FieldObjectBehaviour,
					CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(lahn, knock_back_info)))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:hit_peashooter_in_slider(lahn)
	lahn:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateResetEvent.Instance)
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- sliding 타일에서 맞았다면 왼쪽으로 강제 슬라이딩 시킨다.
	message_system:Send(lahn.CharacterBehaviour,
			CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(CS.Oak.SlideState.Create(lahn
			, unity_class.vector3.left)))
end

				monster_rabbit, 1, 5, true))

function local_class:rabbit_chase_user(fo, distance, speed, show_emoticon)

	fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'run' })

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_die_ant_01')

	if show_emoticon == true then
		character_util.show_emoticon(fo, nil, 'angry')
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	local come_down_floor = false
	local go_up_floor = false

	fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.3, 0.7, 0.3))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_distance, self, fo, distance))

	while self.monster_rabbit_is_chasing_user == true do

		local plan_path_done = false
		local plan_path = nil
		if user_party.Leader.Position.y <= 0 and self.chase_check_y == false then
			come_down_floor = false
			field.PathFinder:FindNormalPath(fo, user_party.Leader.Position, 100, fo, 0,
					nil,
					function(path, req_key)
						if req_key == 0 then
							plan_path_done = true
							plan_path = path
						end
					end)

			while not plan_path_done do
				coroutine.yield(nil)
			end

			local wp = {}
			for i = 0, plan_path.Count - 1 do
				wp[i + 1] = plan_path[i]
			end
			wp_util.move_way_points_async(fo, {waypoints = wp, speed = 7, run = true, play_sfx = false})
		else

			local temp_pos = user_party.Leader.Position
			if (fo.Position.x > -36 and fo.Position.x < -34) and (fo.Position.z < 65 and fo.Position.z > 61.5)  and go_up_floor == false then
				if self.chase_check_y == false then
					character_util.stop(fo)
					coroutine.yield(nil)
					character_util.move_to_async(fo, vector(-35, 0, 62.5), nil, 5, false, true)
				end
				self.chase_check_y = true
				fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
				temp_pos = vector(-37, 1, 62.5)

			elseif user_party.Leader.Position.y <= 0 and come_down_floor == false and go_up_floor == true then
				come_down_floor = true
				character_util.stop(fo)
				coroutine.yield(nil)
				character_util.move_to_async(fo, vector(-38, 1, 62), nil, 5, true, true)
				character_util.set_direction(fo, 'left')
				wait_for_sec(0.3)
				temp_pos = fo.Position
			end

			if fo.Position.y == 1 and come_down_floor == false then
				go_up_floor = true
			end

			local direction = (temp_pos - fo.Position)
			fo.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(direction.normalized)

			CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(fo, direction.normalized, speed * unity_class.time.deltaTime)

			if user_party.Leader.Position.y <= 0 and come_down_floor == true then
				self.chase_check_y = false
				go_up_floor = false
				fo.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
				character_util.jump_move(fo, vector(-40, 0, 62), 5, 0.8, false)
				while fo.Position ~= vector(-40, 0, 62) do
					if fo.Position.x < -39.7 then
						break
					end
					coroutine.yield(nil)
				end
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:check_distance(fo, distance)

	while self.monster_rabbit_is_chasing_user == true do
		local xz_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(user_party.Leader.Position - fo.Position)
		local magnitude = xz_vector.magnitude

		if magnitude < distance then
			-- QTE 중일때...
			if self.is_use_qte and not self.is_qte_success then
				self.is_use_qte = false
				CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
				CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('qte')
			elseif self.is_use_qte and self.is_qte_success then
				character_util.stop(fo)
				self.monster_rabbit_is_chasing_user = false
				return
			elseif self.catch_block then
				character_util.stop(fo)
				self.monster_rabbit_is_chasing_user = false
				return
			end
			self.monster_rabbit_is_chasing_user = false
			yield_return_func(self.catch, self)
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	fo.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(1.1, 0.7, 1.1))
end

-- 붙잡혔을 때 연출
function local_class:catch()
	local monster_rabbit = self.get_character('record_monster_rabbit')
	local heavy_knight = self.get_character('record_heavy_knight')

	self.monster_rabbit_caught = true

	-- 괴물 토끼에게 당한 위치
	self.pos_of_damage = user_party.Leader.Position

	self:wait_until_book_ui_on()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')
	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'scared' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'embarrassed' })

	character_util.stop(monster_rabbit)
	character_util.set_anim(monster_rabbit, { name = 'walk', scale = 0.3 })
	character_util.jump_move(monster_rabbit, user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5, 0.8, false)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_camera_emphasize_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.2)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_dark_magician_01')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

	field:RemoveTint(nil, 0.5)

	-- 괴물 토끼 원위치
	monster_rabbit.Position = vector(-40.5, 0, 64)
	character_util.set_direction(monster_rabbit, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim(monster_rabbit)
	character_util.stop(monster_rabbit)

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	local braizer
	if user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState ~= nil and
			lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState, CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState) then
		braizer = user_party.Leader.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		if braizer ~= nil then
			character_util.release_hold_object(user_party.Leader, braizer)
		end
	end

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(monster_rabbit)

	character_util.set_position(user_party.Leader, vector(-44, 0, 61))
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'damaged'})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.red, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_player_popup_01')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)

	character_util.move_to(heavy_knight, vector(-34.5, 0, 72), nil, 2, false, true)

	self.chase_check_y = false

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	character_util.add_listener(heavy_knight, self.controller)

	self.monster_rabbit_caught = false

	local rabbit_cave = get_field_object("rabbit_cave")
	if rabbit_cave ~= nil then
		rabbit_cave.Interactable = self.rabbit_cave_interactable
	end

	monster_rabbit.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- stage bgm restart
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'ondemand/short_story_lahn/audio:bgm_shivering_record_main', state = 'field' })
end

function local_class:check_qte_event(check_range)
	local monster_rabbit = self.get_character('record_monster_rabbit')
	local leader_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

	if leader_pos.x - check_range < monster_rabbit.Position.x and leader_pos.x + check_range > monster_rabbit.Position.x and
			leader_pos.z - check_range < monster_rabbit.Position.z and leader_pos.z + check_range > monster_rabbit.Position.z then
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- QTE - 성공 : 흑기사와 출동 후 자리 변경, 실패 : 괴물 토끼에게 공격 당함
function local_class:start_qte_event()
	local monster_rabbit = self.get_character('record_monster_rabbit')
	local heavy_knight = self.get_character('record_heavy_knight')

	self:wait_until_book_ui_on()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local arrive_pos = heavy_knight.Position + 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.right

	character_util.move_to(heavy_knight, heavy_knight.Position + 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.back, nil, 1, false, true)
	-- 흑기사 : 넌 못 지나간…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(heavy_knight, { key = 'shortstory_lahn_record_2_7_5', skip = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Mod(0.15, 'qte')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('up')

	self.monster_rabbit_is_chasing_user = false
	character_util.stop(monster_rabbit)
	character_util.remove_anim(monster_rabbit)
	character_util.set_anim(monster_rabbit, { name = 'run', scale = 0.3 })

	local duration = 0.3
	local time_passed = 0
	self.is_use_qte = true
	self.is_qte_success = false

	while time_passed < duration and not self.is_qte_success do
		coroutine.yield(nil)

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
	end

	self.is_use_qte = false
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	CS.GlobalTimeManager.Instance:Unmod('qte')

	if self.is_qte_success then
		self.monster_rabbit_is_chasing_user = false

		heavy_knight.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

		character_util.stop(monster_rabbit)
		character_util.move_to(monster_rabbit, vector(-36, 0, 70.5), 1, nil, true, true)

		time_passed = 0
		local check = false
		while time_passed < 1 do
			coroutine.yield(nil)

			if time_passed > 0.1 and check == false then
				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_twohand_stomp_jump_01')
				character_util.jump_move(user_party.Leader, arrive_pos,1.5, 0.5, false, 'right')
				check = true
			end

			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		character_util.set_direction(monster_rabbit, 'right')

		while true do
			if user_party.Leader.Position.z + 0.1 >= heavy_knight.Position.z then
				character_util.stop(heavy_knight)
				coroutine.yield(nil)
				character_util.set_direction(heavy_knight, 'right')
				character_util.move_to_async(heavy_knight, heavy_knight.Position + 0.3 * unity_class.vector3.left, nil, 1.5, false, true)

				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_trip_01')
				character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'right')
				character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'damaged'})
				break
			end
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		wait_for_sec(1.5)

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.record_monster_rabbit, self))
	else
		self.catch_block = false
		self.monster_rabbit_is_chasing_user = true
		character_util.remove_anim(monster_rabbit)
		character_util.set_anim(monster_rabbit, { name = 'run' })
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rabbit_chase_user, self,
				monster_rabbit, 1, 5, false))
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	local items = self.grandma_event.item.holder
	if items ~= nil then
		for i = 1, table_util.get_size(items) do
			if items[i] ~= nil then
				items[i]:ConsumeComplete()
				items[i] = nil
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent), 'on_camera_grid_leave_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local cur_state = quest_util.get_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_key)
	self.prerequisite_states = cur_state ~= -1 and cur_state or 0

	if not self:is_all_prerequisite_event_cleared() then
		if not self:is_prerequisite_event_cleared(self.prerequisite_event.elf.num) then
			self:toggle_prerequisite_event_state(self.prerequisite_event.elf, true)
		end

		if not self:is_prerequisite_event_cleared(self.prerequisite_event.succubus.num) then
			self:toggle_prerequisite_event_state(self.prerequisite_event.succubus, true)
		end

		if not self:is_prerequisite_event_cleared(self.prerequisite_event.blacksmith.num) then
			self:toggle_prerequisite_event_state(self.prerequisite_event.blacksmith, true)
			local golem = get_character(self.prerequisite_event.blacksmith.npc.golem)
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(golem, 0, 0.0)
			field_ui_manager:HideTargetUI(CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats, golem)
		end
	else
		self.cur_progress = self.progress.prerequisite_event_cleared
		self:set_monologue_event()
	end

end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	for _, v in pairs(self.prerequisite_event) do
		if v.fx ~= nil then
			for _, v2 in pairs(v.fx) do
				unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(v2)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	local leader = user_party.Leader

	-- 모든 선행 퀘스트가 끝났으면 독백 이벤트 부터 진행 가능
	if self.cur_progress >= self.progress.prerequisite_event_cleared then
		local data = self.grandma_event

		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, data.zone.monologue) then
			if self.cur_progress == self.progress.prerequisite_event_cleared then
				-- 모든 선행 퀘스트 npc를 꺼준고, 독백 이벤트 실행
				self:toggle_all_prerequisite_event_except(nil, false)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.monologue_event, self))
				return true
			end
		elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, data.zone.grandma) then
			if self.cur_progress == self.progress.monologue_event_end then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.old_woman_house_event, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	else
		local data = self.prerequisite_event

		-- 동시에 한 가지 이벤트만 진행 가능
		if not self.event_playing then
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, data.elf.zone) and
					not self:is_prerequisite_event_cleared(data.elf.num) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.elf_event, self))
				return true
			elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, data.succubus.zone) and
					not self:is_prerequisite_event_cleared(data.succubus.num) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.succubus_event, self))
				return true
			elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, leader, data.blacksmith.zone) and
					not self:is_prerequisite_event_cleared(data.blacksmith.num) then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.blacksmith_event, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.grandma_event.grid.name) then
		self.grandma_event.grid.staying = true
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_camera_grid_leave_event(e)
	if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.grandma_event.grid.name) then
		self.grandma_event.grid.staying = false
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:monologue_event()
	local data = self.grandma_event
	local alef = get_character(data.npc.alef)

	self.cur_progress = self.progress.monologue_event_start

	-- 마지막으로 나의 특별한 레이디를 만나러 갈 차례군.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(alef, { key = 'short_story_lina_alefiod_39' })

	if self:reset_monologue_event() then
		return
	end
	self:pause_event_if_not_watching({ alef })

	-- 후후… 정말이지 기대되는 걸?
	character_util.set_emotion(alef, { name = 'doyagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(alef, { key = 'short_story_lina_alefiod_40' })

	if self:reset_monologue_event() then
		return
	end
	self:pause_event_if_not_watching({ alef })

	character_util.set_emotion(alef, { name = 'smile' })

	alef.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	local dest_pos = field:GetMarker(data.marker.house_entrance).position
	local waypoints = {
		dest_pos,
		dest_pos + vector(0, 0, 1)
	}
	character_util.set_anim(alef, { name = 'walk', loop = true })
	character_util.move_waypoint(alef, waypoints, 2.5, false, 'stop', 'floor')

	while true do
		if self:reset_monologue_event() then
			return
		end

		if (alef.Position - waypoints[2]).magnitude < 0.01 then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local fade_pos = alef.Position + vector(0, 0, 1)
	local fade_time  = 1 / 2.5

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_door_push_01', parent = alef, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(alef, 0, fade_time)
	character_util.set_anim(alef, { name = 'walk', loop = true })
	character_util.move_waypoint(alef, fade_pos, 2.5, false, 'stop', 'floor')
	wait_for_sec(fade_time)

	while true do
		if self:reset_monologue_event() then
			return
		end

		if (alef.Position - fade_pos).magnitude < 0.01 then
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim(alef)

	-- 할머니 집으로 이동
	local inside_pos = field:GetMarker(data.marker.house_inside).position
	character_util.set_position(alef, inside_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(alef, 'right')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(alef, 1, 0)

	alef.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	self.cur_progress = self.progress.monologue_event_end
end

--region 유틸 함수
-- 특정 선행 이벤트가 끝났는지 리턴해주는 함수

--region prerequisite_event related
function local_class:is_prerequisite_event_cleared(event_num)
	if self.prerequisite_states & event_num == event_num then
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

-- 모든 선행 이벤트가 끝났는지 리턴해주는 함수
function local_class:is_all_prerequisite_event_cleared()
	for _, v in pairs(self.prerequisite_event) do
		if not self:is_prerequisite_event_cleared(v.num) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function local_class:update_and_check_prerequisite_states(event_data)
	self.prerequisite_states = self.prerequisite_states | event_data.num
	quest_util.set_custom_state(self.quest_progress, self.custom_key, self.prerequisite_states)

	if self:is_all_prerequisite_event_cleared() then
		self.cur_progress = self.progress.prerequisite_event_cleared

		-- 지금 처다보고 있는 이벤트를 제외한 모든 이벤트를 제거하고,
		-- 마지막 이벤트 존 갔을 때 지금의 이벤트도 제거 해야함
		self:toggle_all_prerequisite_event_except(event_data, false)
		self:set_monologue_event()
	else
		self:toggle_all_prerequisite_event_except(event_data, true)
	end
end

function local_class:toggle_prerequisite_event_state(event_data, toggle)
	-- toggle이 true라도 이미 본 이벤트는 켜주지 않는다.
	if toggle and self.prerequisite_states & event_data.num == event_data.num  then
		return
	end

	for k, v in pairs(event_data.npc) do
		local character = get_character(v)
		if character ~= nil then
			if toggle then
				local pos = field:GetMarker(event_data.marker[k]).position
				character_util.set_position(character, pos)
			else
				character_util.set_position(character, vector(999, 0, 999))
			end
		end
	end
end

-- event_data 를 제외한 모든 선행 이벤트를 toggle
-- nil을 event_data에 넣으면 모든 이벤트를 toggle 가능
function local_class:toggle_all_prerequisite_event_except(event_data, toggle)
	local num = nil

	if event_data ~= nil then
		num = event_data.num
	end

	for _, v in pairs(self.prerequisite_event) do
		if num ~= v.num then
			self:toggle_prerequisite_event_state(v, toggle)
		end
	end
end

-- 해당 이벤트에 있는 npc를 하나라도 보고 있으면 이벤트 보고있는 것으로 간주
function local_class:is_player_watching_event(event_data)
	local far_npc_num = 0
	local npc_num = table_util.get_size(event_data.npc)
	for _, v in pairs(event_data.npc) do
		local character = get_character(v)
		if character ~= nil then
			if not screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(character.Position, { bonus_distance = 2 }) then
				far_npc_num = far_npc_num + 1
			end
		end
	end

	if far_npc_num == npc_num then
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- 이벤트 일시 정지
function local_class:pause_prerequisite_event(event_data)
	while true do
		if self:is_player_watching_event(event_data) then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end
--endregion

--region 선행 퀘스트 이후 이벤트에 사용되는 함수
-- npcs들을 처다보고 있지 않으면 이벤트 일시정지 시키는 함수
function local_class:pause_event_if_not_watching(npcs)
	local npc_num = table_util.get_size(npcs)

	while true do
		local watching = false
		for i = 1, npc_num do
			local npc = npcs[i]
			if npc ~= nil then
				if screen_util.is_fo_in_screen(npc.Position, { bonus_distance = 2 }) then
					watching = true
					break
				end
			end
		end

		if watching then
			break
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	item.ShadowTransform.localScale = 0.01 * unity_class.vector3.one

	end

		end
		local size = unity_class.vector3.one * progress * max_size

		item.ShadowTransform.localScale = size
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.event_state = {
		init = 0,
		scene_1 = 1,
		scene_2 = 2,
		scene_3 = 3
	}
	self.current_state = self.event_state.init
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.lina = self.controller.get_lina()
	self.goury = self.controller.get_goury()
	self.amelia = self.controller.get_amelia()
	self.zelgadis = self.controller.get_zelgadis()
	self.xellos = self.controller.get_xellos()
	self.eva = self.controller.get_eva()

	self.garv = self.controller.get_garv()
	self.seigram = self.controller.get_seigram()
	self.kanzel = self.controller.get_kanzel()
	self.mazenda = self.controller.get_mazenda()
	self.fibrizo = self.controller.get_fibrizo()

	self.start_section = (self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 0)

	self.start_pos = field:GetMarker('default_start').position
	self.boss_pos = field:GetMarker('boss_room_center').position
	self.mid_pos = field:GetMarker('mid_boss_center').position
	self.hide_point = field:GetMarker('main_s1_hide_point').position

	character_util.set_position(self.garv, self.boss_pos)
	character_util.set_position(self.kanzel, self.boss_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, -2))
	character_util.set_position(self.mazenda, self.boss_pos + vector(0, 0, -2))
	character_util.set_position(self.seigram, self.boss_pos + vector(1.5, 0, -2))

	character_util.set_direction(self.garv, 'down')
	character_util.set_direction(self.kanzel, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(self.mazenda, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(self.seigram, 'up')

	-- 이벤트 진행을 위해 ExitInteractable -> PublishInteractable
	self.controller:changed_exit_interact_fo()

	character_util.set_position(self.fibrizo, vector(999, 0, 999))

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opening_scene, self))
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller:restore_exit_interact_fo()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.lina) and e.FullEnter then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'main_s1_1' and self.current_state == self.event_state.init then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.scene_1
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.watch_garv_1, self)
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'main_s2_1' and self.current_state == self.event_state.scene_1 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.scene_2
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.boss_room_entrance, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if self.controller.exit_interact_fo == nil then
			return false
		end

		for i = 1, #self.controller.exit_interact_fo do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.exit_interact_fo[i]) then
				self.controller:teleport_party_for_marker_routine(i)
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

	self.boss_pos = field:GetMarker('mid_boss_center').position

	character_util.set_direction(self.garv, 'down')

	character_util.set_position(self.mazenda, self.boss_pos + vector(0, 0, -2))

	character_util.set_direction(self.seigram, 'up')
	character_util.set_position(self.seigram, self.boss_pos + vector(1.2, 0, -2))

		local zaco = get_character('mid_boss_zaco_' .. i)
		character_util.set_active_state(zaco, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_direction(zaco, 'up')
		character_util.set_position(zaco, self.boss_pos + vector(-3.75 + i * 1.5, 0, -3.5))
	end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opening_scene, self))
	else

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.triple_rematch, self))
	end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller:restore_exit_interact_fo()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.lina) and e.FullEnter then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'main_s2_1' and self.current_state == self.event_state.init then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.boss_battle
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.triple_rematch, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if self.controller.exit_interact_fo == nil then
			return false
		end

		for i = 1, #self.controller.exit_interact_fo do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.exit_interact_fo[i]) then
				self.controller:teleport_party_for_marker_routine(i)
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == "mid_boss_battle" then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.after_battle
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.mid_boss_cleared, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

	}

	character_util.set_position(self.lina, end_pos + offsets[1])

	--세이그람 (right, idle, prostrate) (청색1)
	--칸젤 (right, damaged, prostrate) (청색2)
	--마젠다 (left, damaged, prostrate) (청색3)

	character_util.set_direction(self.seigram, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(self.seigram, end_pos + vector(-1.5, 0, 1))

	local mid_bos = { self.kanzel, self.mazenda, self.seigram }
	character_util.set_group_anim(mid_bos, { name = 'prostrate' })

	--페이드 인 시 정렬 상태.
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 세이그람: 크윽…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.shake(self.seigram, 0.05, 0.5)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.seigram, { key = self.talk_name .. 6, skip = true })

	-- 마젠다: 가브… 님…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_ghost_disappear_03')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.mazenda, { key = self.talk_name .. 7, skip = true })

	--중간 보스들 시체 검은 틴트, 이후 알파 페이드로 사라짐.
	character_util.add_color(self.seigram, 'dead_tint', unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)
	character_util.add_color(self.kanzel, 'dead_tint', unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)
	character_util.add_color(self.mazenda, 'dead_tint', unity_class.color.black, 1, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_02')
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.seigram, 0, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.kanzel, 0, 1)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.mazenda, 0, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_position(self.seigram, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(self.kanzel, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.set_position(self.mazenda, vector(999, 0, 999))

	character_util.remove_color(self.seigram, 'dead_tint', 1)
	character_util.remove_color(self.kanzel, 'dead_tint', 1)
	character_util.remove_color(self.mazenda, 'dead_tint', 1)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, { key = self.talk_name .. 8, skip = true })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field', mix = 2 })

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaBossSection3')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.talk_name = 'short_story_sl_boss_s3_'
	self.boss_title_script = 'short_story_sl_boss_s3_garv_title'
	self.boss_subtitle_script = 'short_story_sl_boss_s3_garv_subtitle'

	self.event_state = {
		init = 0,
		boss_battle = 1,
		after_battle = 2,
		scene_3 = 3
	}
	self.current_state = self.event_state.init

	-- 퀘스트 마커 위치가 바뀌었는지
	self.changing_quest_marker_pos = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	self.lina = self.controller.get_lina()
	self.goury = self.controller.get_goury()
	self.amelia = self.controller.get_amelia()
	self.zelgadis = self.controller.get_zelgadis()
	self.xellos = self.controller.get_xellos()
	self.eva = self.controller.get_eva()

	self.garv = self.controller.get_garv()
	self.seigram = self.controller.get_seigram()
	self.kanzel = self.controller.get_kanzel()
	self.mazenda = self.controller.get_mazenda()
	self.fibrizo = self.controller.get_fibrizo()

	self.start_section = (self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 2)

	self.reset_pos = field:GetMarker('main_s3_reset_pos').position
	self.boss_pos = field:GetMarker('mid_boss_center').position
	self.garv_pos = field:GetMarker('boss_room_top').position + vector(0,0,-2)
	self.center_pos = field:GetMarker('boss_room_center').position

	-- 이벤트 진행을 위해 ExitInteractable -> PublishInteractable
	self.controller:changed_exit_interact_fo()

	-- 가브에게 퀘스트 마커
	local quest_marker_pos = field:GetMarker('quest_marker_main_3').position
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.controller.quest_marker_name, self.quest_spec.QuestId, true, quest_marker_pos)

	self:change_marker_target(quest_marker_pos)

	self.garv.Position = self.garv_pos
	character_util.set_direction(self.garv, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(self.garv, {name = 'twohand_idle'})
	if self.start_section then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.opening_or_reset, self))
	end
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	screen_util.preload_boss_title()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_viking_stomp')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead')
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller:restore_exit_interact_fo()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.lina) and e.FullEnter then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'main_s3_entrance' and self.current_state == self.event_state.init then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.boss_battle
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.meet_the_garv, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == "boss_garv" then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.after_battle_with_garv, self))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if self.controller.exit_interact_fo == nil then
			return false
		end

		for i = 1, #self.controller.exit_interact_fo do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.controller.exit_interact_fo[i]) then
				self.controller:teleport_party_for_marker_routine(i)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:opening_or_reset()
	-- 스테이지 진입시 처리
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 배치 세팅
	party_util.align_party(self.reset_pos, 'left', 0, 'arc')

	-- 보스 세팅
	screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/castletown/audio:bgm_slayers_cave', state = 'field' })
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(stage.Name), 1.5)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false}, {name = 'smile'})

	wait_for_sec(1.7)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:meet_the_garv()
	quest_marker_util.remove(self.controller.quest_marker_name)

	--2층에서 내려오면(초록선) 이벤트 시작, 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local offset = vector(0, 0, 0)
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.garv)
	self.lina.Position = self.garv_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5) + offset
	self.goury.Position = self.garv_pos + vector(-1, 0, -2) + offset
	self.xellos.Position = self.garv_pos + vector(1, 0, -2) + offset
	self.eva.Position = self.garv_pos + vector(0, 0, -2.5) + offset

	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(self.goury, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(self.xellos, 'up')
	character_util.set_direction(self.eva, 'up')

	camera_util.move(self.garv.Position + vector(0, 0, -1), 0)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	--페이드 인 시 정렬 상태.

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_boss_intro', state = 'event' })
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--가브 (down, idle, idle): 침입자란 것은…
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.garv)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.garv, {key = self.talk_name .. 0, skip = true})

	--가브 (down, smile, idle): 역시 네놈들이었나, 애송이.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.garv, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.garv, {key = self.talk_name .. 1, skip = true})
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.garv)

	--리나 (up): 가브…!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 2, skip = true})

	--가브 (down, idle, idle) : 아니 솔직한 심정으로는…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.garv, {key = self.talk_name .. 3, skip = true})

	--가브 (down, idle, idle) : 진심으로 반갑다는 기분이야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.garv, {key = self.talk_name .. 4, skip = true})

	--가브 (down, idle, idle) : 이런 정체를 알 수 없는 세계에서 힘이 돌아오는 것을 지루하게 기다리기만 했으니 말이지.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.garv, {key = self.talk_name .. 5, skip = true})

	--가브 (down, smile, idle) : 조금은 손맛이 있는 적을 만난다는 것은 큰 행운이야.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.garv, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.garv, {key = self.talk_name .. '5_1', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.garv)

	--리나(up) : 모처럼 삼도천을 도로 건너왔는데.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. '5_2', skip = true})

	--리나(up) : 러브 & 피스하게 살아갈 생각은 안 해봤어?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 6, skip = true})

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.goury)
	character_util.set_direction(self.goury, 'up')
	--가브 (down, idle, idle): 그런 삶에 어떤 의미가 있다고 하는 거지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.garv, {key = self.talk_name .. 7, skip = true})

	--가브 (down, smile, idle) : 나 참… 말해놓고 보니 나도 인간이 다 된 모양이군.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.garv, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.garv, {key = self.talk_name .. '7_1', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.garv)

	--가브 (down, idle, idle): 뭐 아무래도 좋아, 너희와는 다시 한번 싸워보고 싶었다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.garv, {key = self.talk_name .. 8, skip = true})

	--가브 (down, idle, idle) : 난 이번에야말로…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.garv, {key = self.talk_name .. '8_1', skip = true})

	--가브 (down, idle, idle): 이 세계에서 끝없이 투쟁하며…
	character_util.set_emotion(self.garv, {name = 'smile'})
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function ()
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_01')
		self.garv:HideWeapon(true)
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.garv, {name = 'attack', count = 1})
		self.garv:HideWeapon(false)
		character_util.set_anim(self.garv, {name = 'twohand_idle'})
	end))

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.garv, {key = self.talk_name .. 9, skip = true})

	--가브 (down, smile, idle) : [shout] 마음껏 삶을 즐겨주겠어!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_count_final_01')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2 })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.garv, {key = self.talk_name .. 10, skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})

	character_util.set_anim(self.garv, {name = 'twohand_attack4', loop = false})
	wait_for_sec(0.366)

	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(32, 8, 0, 0)
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local shadow_move_time = 0.3
	local start_pos = self.garv.Position

	local scale_time = 0.3
	local start_scale = 1
	local end_scale = 0

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_boss_rise_01')
	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < shadow_move_time do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local cur_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(self.garv, start_pos + vector(0, cur_y, 0), true)

		if unity_class.time.time - cur_time < scale_time then
			local cur_scale = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale,
					(unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / scale_time)
			self.garv.Transform.localScale = vector(1 * cur_scale, 1, 1 * cur_scale)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_anim(self.garv, {name = 'twohand_idle'})

	camera_util.move_async(self.garv_pos + vector(0, 0, -1.5), 0.2)

	free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(0, 20, 20, 0)
	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	start_pos = self.garv.Position + vector(0, 0, -1.5)
	local free_fall_time = 0.5

	start_scale = 0
	end_scale = 1

	local time_offset = 0.2

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < free_fall_time do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local cur_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(self.garv, vector(start_pos.x, cur_y, start_pos.z), true)

		if unity_class.time.time - cur_time < scale_time + time_offset and
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time > time_offset then

			local cur_scale = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_scale, end_scale,
					(unity_class.time.time - cur_time - time_offset) / scale_time)

			self.garv.Transform.localScale = vector(1 * cur_scale, 1, 1 * cur_scale)
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_battle_boss', state = 'combat', mix = 0 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_minotaurs_stomp_01')
	character_util.set_position(self.garv, vector_util.get_x0z(start_pos))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_m_viking_stomp'):Instantiate(self.garv.Position)
	self.garv.Transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one

	camera_util.shake(0.5, 1)
	character_util.shake(self.garv, 0.03, 1)

	for i = 1, 4 do
		local char = user_party[i - 1]
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
				function ()
					unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_dead'):Instantiate(char.Position)

					local dir_vector = vector(0, 0, -1)
					local knockback_info = character_util.knockback_info('linear', false, dir_vector,
							nil, nil, nil,
							false, nil, 0.3, 3)
					local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(char, knockback_info)
					char.FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))

				end
		))
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	--보스 타이틀 “마룡왕 가브의 사념”
	--서브 타이틀 “배신한 마왕의 5 대 심복”
	--music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'ondemand/castletown/audio:bgm_slayers_battle', state = 'combat', mix = 0 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_boss_title_01')
	screen_util.show_boss_title(self.boss_title_script, self.boss_subtitle_script, 2)
	wait_for_sec(2)

	--이후 전투.

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.ShowBossHPEvent.Create(self.garv))

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.garv)
	character_util.convert_to_monster(self.garv, 'boss_garv', 'final_boss_zone')
	character_util.set_death_type(self.garv, 'none')
	character_util.remove_anim(self.garv)
	command_util.execute_monster_notice(self.garv, user_party.Leader, 'battle')
end

function local_class:after_battle_with_garv()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	character_util.set_immortal(user_party.Leader, true)

	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.garv)
	--전투 승리 시 페이드 아웃.
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_boss_intro', state = 'event' })
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	--섹션 넘김
	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
end

function local_class:change_marker_target(target)
	self.controller.marker_fo_list[2] = target
	self.controller.marker_fo_list[3] = target
	self.controller.marker_fo_list[6] = target
	self.controller.marker_fo_list[7] = target
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaBossSection5')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLinaMain @
		Comment = 리나 2스테이지 section 5 @
		Index = 4 @
		NextSections = 5 @
]]
function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 스크립트 키
	self.script_key = 'short_story_sl_boss_s5_'
	self.boss_title = 'lina_boss_s5_title'
	self.boss_subtitle = 'lina_boss_s5_subtitle'

	-- 배틀 그룹 및 존 이름들
	self.boss_battle_group_name = 'distorted_area'
end

function local_class:enter()
	self.lina = self.controller.get_lina()
	self.goury = self.controller.get_goury()
	self.amelia = self.controller.get_amelia()
	self.zelgadis = self.controller.get_zelgadis()
	self.xellos = self.controller.get_xellos()
	self.eva = self.controller.get_eva()

	self.garv = self.controller.get_garv()
	self.seigram = self.controller.get_seigram()
	self.kanzel = self.controller.get_kanzel()
	self.mazenda = self.controller.get_mazenda()
	self.fibrizo = self.controller.get_fibrizo()
	self.fibrizo_boss = self.controller.get_fibrizo_boss()

	self.get_aura_black_effect = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_phibrizzo_darkaura_loop_p2') end

	-- 해당 섹션내에서 필요한 이벤트들 구독
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_field_object_revived_event')

	-- 보스전용 타이틀 어셋 미리 로딩
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.battle_with_hellmaster, self))
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_boss_phibrizzo_backstage_fx')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_Blockaura_Char_black')
end


function local_class:exit()
	-- 구독해놓은 메시지들 전부 구독 해제
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))

	-- 해당 섹션내 캐싱 해놓은 것들 nil 처리
	self.lina = nil
	self.goury = nil
	self.amelia = nil
	self.zelgadis = nil
	self.xellos = nil
	self.eva = nil

	self.garv = nil
	self.seigram = nil
	self.kanzel = nil
	self.mazenda = nil
	self.fibrizo = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if string.find(e.BattleGroupName, self.boss_battle_group_name) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_ready_for_next_battle, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
		local area_center_pos = field:GetMarker('distorted_area_center').position
		camera_util.move(area_center_pos, 0, { end_target = user_party.Leader })
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:battle_with_hellmaster()
	-- 스테이지 진입시 처리
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()


	if (self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 4) then
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_in_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

		-- 스테이지 카메라 피봇의 위치를 강제로 변경.
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		local boss_room_center = field:GetMarker('distorted_area_center').position
		camera_util.move_async(boss_room_center, 0)
		self.controller:set_boss_phase_2_battlefield()

		character_util.set_position(self.lina, field:GetMarker('lina_s4_distorted').position)
		character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'left')

		character_util.set_position(self.goury, field:GetMarker('goury_s4_distorted').position)
		character_util.set_direction(self.goury, 'left')

		character_util.set_position(self.xellos, field:GetMarker('xellos_s4_distorted').position)
		character_util.set_direction(self.xellos, 'left')

		character_util.set_position(self.eva, field:GetMarker('eva_s4_distorted').position)
		character_util.set_direction(self.eva, 'left')

		character_util.set_position(self.fibrizo, field:GetMarker('fibrizo_s4_distorted').position)
		character_util.set_direction(self.fibrizo, 'right')

		if self.controller.cached_fx_blockaura == nil then
			self.controller.cached_fx_blockaura = self.get_aura_black_effect():Instantiate(self.fibrizo.Position)
			self.controller.cached_fx_blockaura.transform.parent = self.fibrizo.Transform
			self.controller.cached_fx_blockaura.transform.localPosition = unity_class.vector3.zero
		end

		if self.controller.boss_sfx == nil then
			self.controller.boss_sfx = music_player:PlaySfx({ sfxName = '01_amb_boss_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2 })
		end
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(1, 'linear')
	end

	-- 제로스 (left, idle, idle): 확실히 명왕 피브리조 님은 제 상사고 명령에는 복종해야 하지만…
	character_util.set_direction(self.xellos, 'left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, { key = self.script_key .. 1, skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(self.xellos, { name = 'doyagao' })
	-- 제로스 (left, doyagao, idle) : 당신, 본인이 아니라 그냥 찌꺼기일 뿐이잖아요?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_03')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, { key = self.script_key .. 2, skip = true })

	-- 제로스 (left, doyagao, idle) : 잊으신 것은 아니겠죠.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, { key = self.script_key .. 3, skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(self.xellos)
	-- 제로스 (left, idle, idle) : 우리들이 바라는 멸망은 온전히 우리들 자신의 의지와 힘으로 행하는 것.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, { key = self.script_key .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 제로스 (left, smile, idle): 찌꺼기의 손에 멸망이 이뤄지면 마족 망신이라며 혼나거든요~
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.xellos, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, { key = self.script_key .. 5, skip = true })

	--피브리조 (right, idle, idle) (emoticon_bubble_silence)
	character_util.set_direction(self.fibrizo, 'right')
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.fibrizo, nil, 'silence')

	-- 피브리조 (right, idle, idle): …완전하지 못하다 해서 우습게 보인 모양이네.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.fibrizo, { key = self.script_key .. 6, skip = true })

	-- 피브리조 (right, doyagao, idle): 그렇다면 보여주지.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.fibrizo, { name = 'doyagao' })

function local_class:float_eva()
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local float_duration = 1.5

	local start_pos = self.eva.Position
	local end_pos = self.eva.Position + vector(0, 3, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < float_duration do
		local cur_y = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.y, end_pos.y - start_pos.y, float_duration)

		character_util.set_position(self.eva, vector(start_pos.x, cur_y, start_pos.z), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_position(self.eva, end_pos)

	wait_for_sec(2.8)
end

function local_class:shoot_fire_ball(shooter, target)
	local shooter_pos = shooter.Position
	local target_pos = target.Position
	character_util.set_anim(shooter, { name = 'attack', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.remove_anim(shooter)

	local magic_ball = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fire_ball_fx[shooter.Name]['fire'])
			:Instantiate(shooter.Position + unity_class.vector3.up * 2)

	magic_ball.transform.position = shooter_pos

	local move_distance = (shooter_pos - target_pos).magnitude
	local speed = 12

	local timer = 0
	local duration = move_distance / speed

	while timer < duration do
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local current_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(shooter_pos, target_pos, 1 - ((duration - timer) / duration))

		magic_ball.transform.position = current_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 피격
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.fire_ball_fx[shooter.Name]['hit'])
			:Instantiate(target_pos + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	camera_util.shake(0.25, 0.1)

	magic_ball.transform.position = vector(999, 0, 999)
	magic_ball:Dispose()
end

function local_class:change_stage_camera_to(camera_state)
	self.stage_camera_cam = stage_camera.Transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	self.stage_camera_transform = stage_camera.Transform.parent

	if camera_state == self.camera_state.perspective then
		self.stage_camera_cam.orthographic = false
		self.stage_camera_cam.nearClipPlane = 0.01
		self.stage_camera_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(25, 0, 0))
		self.original_fov = self.stage_camera_cam.fieldOfView
		self.stage_camera_cam.fieldOfView = 22

	elseif camera_state == self.camera_state.orthographic then
		self.stage_camera_cam.orthographic = true
		self.stage_camera_cam.nearClipPlane = -20
		self.stage_camera_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(45, 0, 0))
		self.stage_camera_cam.fieldOfView = self.original_fov
	end
end

function local_class:throne_camera_work_routine()
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local end_y = 2
	local camera_time = 2

	camera_util.move_async(vector(139.5, 8, -103), camera_time)

	self.original_fov = self.stage_camera_cam.fieldOfView
	local start_size = self.stage_camera_cam.fieldOfView
	local end_size = 16
	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	camera_time = 2

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < camera_time do
		local progress = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / camera_time
		local cur_size = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_size, end_size, progress)

		self.stage_camera_cam.fieldOfView = cur_size

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:show_custom_speech_bubble(fo, script_key, shout)
	local param = speech_bubble.generate_param(fo, game_string:GetString(script_key))

function local_class:call_for_ragna_blade()

	local timer = 0
	local interval = 5
	local t_offset = 0

	while self.spell_state < 5 and not self.spell_interrupt do
		if timer > t_offset + interval then
			timer = 0
			t_offset = 0
			-- 리나의 라그나 블레이드 영창,

			--리나: 악몽의 왕의 한 조각이여
			--리나: 하늘의 금제를 해방시킨
			--리나: 얼어붙은 검은 허무의 칼날이여
			--리나: 내 힘, 내 몸이 되어
			--리나: 함께 멸망의 길을 걸을지니
			--리나: 신들의 영혼조차도 타파하는

			local voice_language = self:get_voice_language()

			if not self.spell_interrupt then
				self.spell_state = self.spell_state + 1
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(voice_language .. '0' .. self.spell_state)
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_subtitle, self, self.spell_name .. self.spell_state))
			end
		end
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.spell_state >= 5 then
		wait_for_sec(5)

		self.spell_interrupt = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.spell_ragana_blade, self))
	end
end

function local_class:change_effect_size(transform, start_size, end_size, duration)
	local vector_one = vector(1, 1, 1)
	local time_passed = 0
	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		transform.localScale =
		unity_class.vector3.Lerp(vector_one * start_size, vector_one * end_size, time_passed / duration)
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:move_effect(transform, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0

	local start_pos = transform.position

	while time_passed <= duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		transform.position = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, progress)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

		end

function local_class:create_white_tint()
	self.white_tint_obj = load_util.load_prefab_async(self.res_holder,
			'ondemand/castletown/theatres', 'white_tint_background')

	self.white_tint_renderer = self.white_tint_obj:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.SpriteRenderer))
	self.white_tint_renderer.sortingLayerName = 'Under Effects'
	self.white_tint_renderer.sortingOrder = -100

	self.white_tint_obj.transform.localScale = unity_class.vector3.one * 40
	self.white_tint_obj:SetActive(false)
end

function local_class:white_tinting(from, to, duration)
	self.white_tint_obj:SetActive(true)

	self.white_tint_renderer.color = unity_color({1, 1, 1, from})

	local time_passed = 0

	while time_passed < duration do
		local progress = time_passed / duration

		self.white_tint_renderer.color = unity_color({1, 1, 1, from * (1 - progress) + to * progress})

		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.white_tint_renderer.color = unity_color({1, 1, 1, to})
end

function local_class:throne_camera_work_routine()
	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local end_y = 2
	local camera_time = 2

	camera_util.move_async(vector(139.5, 8, -103), camera_time)

	self.original_fov = self.stage_camera_cam.fieldOfView
	local start_size = self.stage_camera_cam.fieldOfView
	local end_size = 16
	cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	camera_time = 2

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < camera_time do
		local progress = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / camera_time
		local cur_size = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(start_size, end_size, progress)

		self.stage_camera_cam.fieldOfView = cur_size

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

function local_class:change_stage_camera_to(camera_state)
	self.stage_camera_cam = stage_camera.Transform:GetComponentInChildren(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Camera))
	self.stage_camera_transform = stage_camera.Transform.parent

	if camera_state == self.camera_state.perspective then
		self.stage_camera_cam.orthographic = false
		self.stage_camera_cam.nearClipPlane = 0.01
		self.stage_camera_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(25, 0, 0))
		self.original_fov = self.stage_camera_cam.fieldOfView
		self.stage_camera_cam.fieldOfView = 22

	elseif camera_state == self.camera_state.orthographic then
		self.stage_camera_cam.orthographic = true
		self.stage_camera_cam.nearClipPlane = -20
		self.stage_camera_transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(vector(45, 0, 0))
		self.stage_camera_cam.fieldOfView = self.original_fov
	end
end

function local_class:show_custom_speech_bubble(fo, script_key, shout)
	local param = speech_bubble.generate_param(fo, game_string:GetString(script_key))
	param.Speaker = fo.Transform
	param.Offset = vector(2, 1.75, 0)
	param.BubbleDirection = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleDirection.RightTop
	param.ClickToProceed = true
	param.Scale = 0.7
	param.EulerAngle = vector(25, 0, 0)
	param.IgnoreOrthographicSize = true

	if shout then
		param.BubbleType = CS.Oak.SpeechBubbleNew.BubbleType.Shout
	end

	coroutine.yield(speech_bubble.instance:ShowSpeechBubbleAsync(param))
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaKidGuardianSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLinaKidGuardian @
		Comment = 어린 기사를 쫓아서 연구실 까지 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.cave_secret_area_zone_name = 'cave_secret_area'
	self.cave_puzzle_zone_name = 'cave_puzzle_'

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_kid_guardian = controller.get_kid_guardian
	self.get_researcher = controller.get_researcher

	-- 오브젝트를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_rock = function(num) return get_field_object('cave_rock_' .. num) end
	self.get_cave_switch = function(num) return get_field_object('cave_switch_' .. num) end

	self.progress = {
		none = 0,
		broken_rock = 1,
		fall_hole_1 = 2,
		open_cave_door_1 = 3,
		fall_hole_2 = 4,
		into_cave_puzzle_2 = 5,
	}
	self.current_progress = self.progress.none

	self.is_turn_on_switch_1 = false
	self.is_turn_on_switch_2 = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_event')

	local kid_guardian = self.get_kid_guardian()

	character_util.set_emotion(kid_guardian, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.remove_anim(kid_guardian)
	kid_guardian.Position = vector(56, 0, -50)
	character_util.move_waypoint(kid_guardian, { vector(53, 0, -50), vector(53, 0, -52), vector(56, 0, -52), vector(56, 0, -50) }, 7, true, 'loop', nil, nil, true)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('lab_door', false))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create('lab_door2', false))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent), 'on_event')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		return self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.SwitchOnOffEvent) then
		return self:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if self.current_progress < self.progress.broken_rock then
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local rock = self.get_rock(i)

			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, rock) then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.broken_rock, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if self.current_progress < self.progress.fall_hole_1 and e.Zone.Name == self.cave_secret_area_zone_name .. 1 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fall_hole_1, self))
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress < self.progress.fall_hole_2 and e.Zone.Name == self.cave_secret_area_zone_name .. 2 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fall_hole_2, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == self.cave_secret_area_zone_name .. 3 then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.into_the_lab, self))
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress < self.progress.into_cave_puzzle_2 and e.Zone.Name == self.cave_puzzle_zone_name .. 2 then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.into_cave_puzzle_2, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_switch_on_off_event(e)
	local cave_switch_1 = self.get_cave_switch(1)
	local cave_switch_2 = self.get_cave_switch(2)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, cave_switch_1) then
		self.is_turn_on_switch_1 = e.IsTurningOn
		self:check_cave_switch()
		return true
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.SwitchObject, cave_switch_2) then
		self.is_turn_on_switch_2 = e.IsTurningOn
		self:check_cave_switch()
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

	self.current_progress = self.progress.broken_rock
