	character_util.set_direction(researcher_1, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(researcher_2, 'left')

	character_util.set_emotion(researcher_1, { name = 'tired' })

	kid_guardian.Position = vector(167.5, 0, -46)
	researcher_1.Position = vector(169, 0, -45.5)
	researcher_2.Position = vector(169, 0, -46.5)

	party_util.remove_emotion()
end

function local_class:into_the_lab()
	local kid_guardian = self.get_kid_guardian()
	local researcher_1 = self.get_researcher(1)
	local researcher_2 = self.get_researcher(2)

	while lua_helper.type_compare(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 연구원들과 어린 가디언에게로 카메라 패닝
	camera_util.move_async(researcher_1.Position, 1)

	-- 가디언 위쪽의 도어는 열려 있는 상태.

	-- 연구원1 (left, tired, cross_arm) : 허가된 외출 시간보다 5분 45초 늦었어.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(researcher_1, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher_1, { key = 'short_story_lina_kid_guardian_1', skip = true })

	-- 연구원1 (left, tired, idle) : 얼마나 걱정했는 줄 알아?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.remove_anim(researcher_1)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher_1, { key = 'short_story_lina_kid_guardian_2', skip = true })

	-- 연구원1 (left, tired, idle) : 무슨 일 생기면 우리까지 곤란해진다고.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher_1, { key = 'short_story_lina_kid_guardian_3', skip = true })

	-- 어린 기사 rigjt, smile, jump 1회 실행. 이후 awesome 표정으로 dance 좌우 2회 실행.(좌, 우, 좌, 우). 이후 right, smile, victory_get 실행.
	character_util.normal_jump_async(kid_guardian, '01_player_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.set_direction(kid_guardian, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(kid_guardian, { name = 'awesome' })
	character_util.set_anim(kid_guardian, { name = 'dance' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	character_util.set_direction(kid_guardian, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(kid_guardian, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(researcher_1, nil, 'question')

	-- 연구원1 (left, tired, cross_arm) : 제대로 듣고 있는 거야?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_anim(researcher_1, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher_1, { key = 'short_story_lina_kid_guardian_4', skip = true })

	-- 연구원1 (left, idle, cross_arm) : 계속 이러면 외출 시간을…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher_1, { key = 'short_story_lina_kid_guardian_5', skip = true })

	-- 연구원2 (left, idle, idle) : 그쯤해둬. 알아들었을 거야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher_2, { key = 'short_story_lina_kid_guardian_6', skip = true })

	-- 연구원1 down, attack 표정 지어보인 후,
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.look_at(researcher_1, researcher_2)
	character_util.set_emotion(researcher_1, { name = 'attack' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 연구원1 : 칫, 늘 나만 나쁜 부모 역할이지.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher_1, { key = 'short_story_lina_kid_guardian_7', skip = true })

	-- 연구원1 up 방향으로 전환.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(researcher_1, 'up')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(researcher_1)

	-- 연구원2 (left, smile) : 자아아, 오늘 모험은 어땠니? 재밌었니?
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(researcher_2, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher_2, { key = 'short_story_lina_kid_guardian_8', skip = true })

	-- 어린 가디언 awesome 표정으로 점프 1회.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(kid_guardian, { name = 'awesome' })
	character_util.remove_anim(kid_guardian)
	character_util.normal_jump_async(kid_guardian, '01_small_jump_01')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 연구원2 (left, smile, nod) : 그래, 즐거웠나보구나.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(researcher_2, { name = 'nod' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher_2, { key = 'short_story_lina_kid_guardian_9', skip = true })

	-- 연구원2 (left, smile, release) : 그럼 오늘은 그만하고 내일 또 놀까?
	character_util.set_anim(researcher_2, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher_2, { key = 'short_story_lina_kid_guardian_10', skip = true })

	-- 어린 가디언 right, tired, idle 실행하고 해당 애니메이션 1초 정도 실행 후 다음 진행.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(kid_guardian, { name = 'tired' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 연구원2가 한발짝 앞으로 나서면 어린 가디언 up 방향으로 전환해 도어 안으로 들어가고, 연구원2가 따라올라가서 연구원 1 옆에 up 방향으로 멈춤.
	character_util.remove_anim(researcher_2)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(researcher_2, researcher_2.Position + vector(-1.5, 0, 0), 4, false, nil, nil, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.move_waypoint(researcher_2, researcher_2.Position + vector(0, 0, 1), 2, false, nil, nil, 'up')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(kid_guardian, { vector(167.5, 0, -43), vector(169, 0, -43) }, 2, false, nil, nil, 'right')

	-- 도어 닫히고, 어린 기사는 아래 이미지의 위치로 이동해서 right, tired, seat
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('lab_door', false))
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(kid_guardian, vector(171, 0, -43), 2, false, nil, nil, 'right')

	-- 도어 닫히고, 어린 기사는 아래 이미지의 위치로 이동해서 right, tired, seat
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(kid_guardian, { name = 'tired' })
	character_util.set_anim(kid_guardian, { name = 'seat' })

	-- 연구원들 옆으로 이동해 아래 이미지의 위치에 up 방향으로 섬.
	-- 이때 카메라는 연구원 둘 사이에 오도록 패닝.
	camera_util.move(vector(171, 0, -45.5), 0.5)
	character_util.move_waypoint(researcher_1, vector(172, 0, -45.5), 4, false, nil, nil, 'up')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(researcher_2, vector(170, 0, -45.5), 4, false, nil, nil, 'up')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 연구원1 (up) : 체중 15kg, 모든 면역 반응 정상. 목표 스탯까지 순조롭게 성장 중.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher_1, { key = 'short_story_lina_kid_guardian_11', skip = true })

	-- 연구원2 (up)  : 돌발 행동이 잦은 상태지만… 일정에는 문제 없겠어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(researcher_2, { key = 'short_story_lina_kid_guardian_12', skip = true })

	-- 하단의 도어 하락되어 있는 상태. 이후 연구원들 하단으로 이동하고, 문을 끝까지 지나오는 지점에서 도어 상승.
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(researcher_2, researcher_2.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')

	character_util.move_waypoint(researcher_1, researcher_1.Position + vector(0, 0, -5.5), 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(researcher_2, researcher_2.Position + vector(0, 0, -5.5), 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorCloseEvent.Create('lab_door2', false))

	character_util.move_waypoint(researcher_1, researcher_1.Position + vector(0, 0, -3), 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(researcher_2, researcher_2.Position + vector(0, 0, -3), 4, false, nil, nil, 'down')

	character_util.set_active_state(researcher_1, 'disabled')
	character_util.set_active_state(researcher_2, 'disabled')

	-- 이후 이벤트 종료. 카메라 플레이어에게 돌아온 후 컨트롤 풀림.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaMainSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLinaMain @
		Comment = 리나 1스테이지 section 1 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.quest_state = {
		pre = -1,
		on_going = 0,
		done = 1,
	}

end

function local_class:enter()
	if not self.controller.is_stage_valid('shortstory_sl_1') then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent), 'on_event')

	self.lina = self.controller.get_lina()
	self.goury = self.controller.get_goury()
	self.amelia = self.controller.get_amelia()
	self.zelgadis = self.controller.get_zelgadis()
	self.xellos = self.controller.get_xellos()

	self.start_pos = field:GetMarker('default_start').position

	-- [PS-7741] 확실하게 presection이 아닌 서브 퀘스트에 위탁하여 초기 마커를 설정해줌.
	if self:quest_checker(7000804) < self.quest_state.on_going then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('lina_main_tower', 7000809, false, get_character('tower_engineer'))
	end
	if self:quest_checker(7000805) < self.quest_state.on_going then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('lina_main_trash', 7000809, false, get_character('trash_janitor'))
	end
	if self:quest_checker(7000806) < self.quest_state.on_going then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('lina_main_mansion', 7000809, false, get_character('mansion_owner'))
	end
	--세가지 선행 퀘스트 1.마력탑, 2.쓰레기, 3.강철집
	--처음엔 세 곳에 전부 마킹 띄워진 상태.
	--
	--1은 퀘스트 수락 후 다른 마력탑에 마킹 표시 없음,
	--맵을 돌아다니며 마력탑을 찾아 인터렉트,액티비티 하는 것을 7회,
	--완료 시 이후 연출을 위한 마킹 표시.
	--(이때 2,3을 클리어하지 않았다면 2,3의 마킹은 해제, 이벤트 진행 불가하도록 설정)
	--
	--2,3은 퀘스트 수락 시 다른 지역 이탈 불가
	--(수락 후 해당 퀘스트 완료까지 일자 진행),
	--해당 퀘스트 완료 전까지 다른 메인 퀘스트 진행 불가
	--(2와 3의 경로 상에 마력탑이 없기에 2,3 플레이 도중 1 완료 불가)

	self.start_section = (self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 0)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.subquest_all_clear, self, true))
end

function local_class:renew_character_cache()
	self.lina = self.controller.get_lina()
	self.goury = self.controller.get_goury()
	self.amelia = self.controller.get_amelia()
	self.zelgadis = self.controller.get_zelgadis()
	self.xellos = self.controller.get_xellos()
end

function local_class:start()
	if not self.controller.is_stage_valid('shortstory_sl_1') then
		return
	end


end

function local_class:exit()
	if not self.controller.is_stage_valid('shortstory_sl_1') then
		return
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent))
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if not self.controller.is_stage_valid('shortstory_sl_1') then
		return false
	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.QuestClearedEvent) then
		local target = {7000804, 7000805, 7000806}
		for _, n in ipairs(target) do
			if e.QuestId == n then
				if self:is_all_quest_cleared(n) then
					-- 섹션 진행
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.subquest_all_clear, self, false))
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:is_all_quest_cleared(current)
	current = lua_helper.get_or_default(current, 0)
	local valid = 0
	local target = {7000804, 7000805, 7000806}
	for _, n in ipairs(target) do
		if n ~= current then
			valid = (self:quest_checker(n) > self.quest_state.on_going) and valid + 1 or valid
		else
			valid = valid + 1
		end
		--CS.UnityEngine.Debug.LogError('quest cleared')
	end
	CS.UnityEngine.Debug.Log('current cleared quest count : ' .. valid)
	return valid > 1
end

function local_class:quest_checker(n)
	local qid = n
	local qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(qid)
	if qp == nil then
		return self.quest_state.pre
	elseif not qp.IsComplete then
		return self.quest_state.on_going
	end
	return self.quest_state.done
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	local slum_half_line = field:GetMarker('tower_pos_7').position + vector(-2, -1, 0)
	-- 슬럼가 그리드
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.lina, 'slum_area') then
		if user_party.Leader.Position.x < slum_half_line.x then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_s2', get_field_object('slum_exit'), true)
		else
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_s2', get_field_object('slum_exit_B'), true)
		end
		-- 동굴 그리드
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.lina, 'cave_area') then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_s2', get_field_object('cave_exit_c_outer'), true)

	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and e.Zone.Name == self.charity_entrance_name then
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
				self.is_player_in_entrance = true
				if self.current_state < self.event_state.all_paid then
					sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.try_entrance, self)
					return true
				end
			elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.church_passagers[5]) then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.payment
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.tavern_entrance) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.scene_event, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.coinbox) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.charity_check, self)
		end
	end
	return false
end

		character_util.set_emotion(npc, {name = 'tired'})
		npc.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
		table.insert(routines, util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async, npc, {
			vector(self.center_pos.x + x_offset, 0, npc.Position.z),
			vector(self.center_pos.x + x_offset, 0, self.church_guard_pos.z - 4.5),
			vector(self.center_pos.x + x_offset, 1, self.church_guard_pos.z - 3.5),

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 13, skip = true})

		character_util.set_direction(self.church_guard, 'right')
		camera_util.move_async(vector(self.coinbox.Position.x, 0, self.lina.Position.z), 1)
		wait_for_sec(1)
		camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
		character_util.set_direction(self.church_guard, 'down')

		self.current_state = self.event_state.on_paying

		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_s2', self.coinbox)
	end

	self.is_player_in_entrance = false
	--신앙을 증명하는 방법, 아시리라 믿습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.church_guard, {key = self.talk_name .. 14, skip = true})

	character_util.move_to_async(self.lina, self.lina.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),
	0.5, nil, true, true)

end

function local_class:charity_check()
	party_util.align_party(self.coinbox.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.2), 'down', 0.5, 'arc')

	self:renew_character_cache()
	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()

	--성스럽고 자애로운 신앙 측정기
	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "SetNarration",
			game_string:GetStringWithReservedKeywords('short_story_sl_main_paybox_1'), 0, 1)

	if self.current_state < self.event_state.on_paying then
		yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "HideAnimation")
		return
	end

	if self.current_state > self.event_state.on_paying then
		--이미 충분히 증명하였다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_sl_main_paybox_2' })
		return
	end

	local payment = 0
	local result = choose_util.play_choose_event({
		--1000 골드를 낸다.
		{self.talk_name .. 15, 'mercy', function() payment = 1000 end},
		--100 골드를 낸다.
		{self.talk_name .. 16, 'mercy', function() payment = 100 end},
		--그만둔다.
		{self.talk_name .. 17, 'normal'},
	})

	yield_return(stage.FieldUINarrationBox, "HideAnimation")

	--골드가 모자랄 때 연출
	local gold_table = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/ShortStoryLinaGold')
	if gold_table:get_dollar() < payment then

		--이런, 가지고 있는 돈이 모자라잖아?
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, {key = self.talk_name .. 20, skip = true})
		return
	end

	if payment == 0 then
		return
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.church_guard, 'right')

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party.Leader, vector(0, 0, 0.3), 0.27, 0.23)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party.Leader, {name = 'attack', count = 1})

	wait_for_sec(0.25)
	self.coinbox:Shake(0.04, 0.2)
	gold_table:remove_dollar(payment, true)
	self.charity_count = self.charity_count + payment
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)

	if self.charity_count < self.charity_threshold then
		if result == 1 then

			--좋은 자세입니다, 신앙을 조금만 더 보여주시길.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.church_guard, {key = self.talk_name .. 18, skip = true})
		elseif result == 2 then

			--0이 부족하면 증명을 여러 번 할 수밖에 없습니다.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.church_guard, {key = self.talk_name .. 19, skip = true})
		end
		character_util.set_direction(self.church_guard, 'down')
		return
	else
		--훌륭합니다! 당신은 충분히 증명하였습니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.church_guard, {key = self.talk_name .. 21, skip = true})

		--들어가셔도 좋습니다.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.church_guard, {key = self.talk_name .. 22, skip = true})

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.church_guard, self.church_guard_pos,
		2, false, nil, nil, 'down')

		self.current_state = self.event_state.all_paid

		gold_table:apply_temporary_dollar_async()

		quest_marker_util.remove('lina_main_s2')
		yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
	end

end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaMainSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLinaMain @

end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()

function local_class:on_event(e)
	self:renew_character_cache()

	local slum_half_line = field:GetMarker('tower_pos_7').position + vector(-2, -1, 0)
	-- 슬럼가 그리드
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.lina, 'slum_area') then
		if user_party.Leader.Position.x < slum_half_line.x then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_s3', get_field_object('slum_exit'), true)
		else
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_s3', get_field_object('slum_exit_B'), true)
		end
		-- 동굴 그리드
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.lina, 'cave_area') then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_s3', get_field_object('cave_exit_c_outer'), true)

	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.lina) and e.Zone.Name == 'main_s3_entrance'
				and self.current_state == self.event_state.init then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.scene
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.event_scene, self))
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:event_scene()
	self:renew_character_cache()

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local priest = self.controller.priest
	local npcs = self.controller.church

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({state = 'muted', mix = 2})
	local buzz_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', loop = true})
	quest_marker_util.remove('lina_main_s3')
	--해당 섹션 도중 종료 후 재접속 시 주점 앞에서 서큘러 페이드 인, victory_get 모션하며 시작, 마킹은 예배당에 찍힌 상태.
	--진입 시 트리거 존 이벤트 시작.(붉은선)

	party_util.align_party(self.center_pos + vector(0, 0, 2.5), 'down', 1, 'linear')

	--리나와 가우리 우측으로 이동. 제로스는 정지.
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.xellos)
	character_util.stop(self.xellos)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.xellos)

	local seat_pos = field:GetMarker('main_s3_side_pos_6').position

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(function()
			wait_for_sec(0.5)
			--리나와 가우리가 이동 후 up 바라봄, 제로스는 좌우 본 뒤 화면 아래로 걸어감.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
			character_util.set_direction(self.xellos, 'down')
			character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.xellos, nil, 'silence')
			character_util.move_to_async(self.xellos, self.center_pos + vector(0, 0, -6),
					1.5, nil, true, true)

			character_util.set_position(self.xellos, vector(999, 0, 999))
		end),
		util.cs_generator(
				character_util.move_waypoint_async, self.lina, {
					vector(self.lina.Position.x, seat_pos.y, seat_pos.z),
					seat_pos + vector(0.5, 0, 0)
				}, 2, false, nil, nil, 'up'
		),
		util.cs_generator(
				character_util.move_waypoint_async, self.goury, {
					vector(self.goury.Position.x, seat_pos.y, seat_pos.z),
					seat_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(priest, {key = self.talk_name .. 3, skip = true})

	--가우리, 그게 무슨 소리야?

	--리나: 우리가 여기 온 것도 한 달 전…?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 23, skip = true})
	--리나: 가우리!!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 24, skip = true})
	--리나: 우리가 처음 이 세계에 전이된 순간을 기억해?
	character_util.set_direction(self.goury, 'right')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 25, skip = true})
	--가우리 (emoticon_bubble_question)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.goury, nil, 'question')
	--가우리: 음… 눈앞이 막 빙글거리고
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, {key = self.talk_name .. 26, skip = true})
	--가우리: 몸이 엄청 흔들거렸었지…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, {key = self.talk_name .. 27, skip = true})
	--리나: 그거야! 여기 사람들은 지진으로 알고 있지만
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 28, skip = true})
	--리나: 사실은 불안정한 차원의 균열에서 발생한 파장이야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 29, skip = true})
	--리나: 그러니까 지진 이후로 갑자기 실종되고 있는 게 아니라…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 30, skip = true})

	character_util.set_anim(self.lina, {name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 31, skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim(self.lina)
	--가우리 (emoticon_bubble_exclamation)
	character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.goury, nil, 'notice')
	--가우리 (right, sleep_deep, question) : 그 말은 설마…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, {key = self.talk_name .. 32, skip = true})
	--리나 (left, attack, nod 2회)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.nod_twice(self.lina)

	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'damaged'})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, {key = self.talk_name .. 33, skip = true})

	character_util.shake(self.lina, 0.04, 0.3)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 35, skip = true})

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if not e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.lina)
				and e.Zone.Name == 'main_s4_blocker' then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.not_the_way, self)
			return true
		elseif e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.lina) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'main_s4_entrance' and self.current_state == self.event_state.init
					and self.eva_state == self.event_state.scene_1 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.scene_1
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.eva_run_routine, self))
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'main_s4_chasing_1' and self.current_state == self.event_state.scene_1 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.scene_2
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'main_s4_chasing_2' and self.current_state == self.event_state.scene_2 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.scene_3
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'main_s4_chasing_3' and self.current_state == self.event_state.scene_3 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.scene_4
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'main_s4_chasing_4' and self.current_state == self.event_state.scene_4 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.scene_5
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'main_s4_catch_zone' and self.current_state == self.event_state.scene_5 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.scene_6
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.find_the_stalker_2, self)
				return true
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'main_s4_last_zone' and self.current_state == self.event_state.scene_6 then
				self.current_state = self.event_state.scene_7
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.xellos_is_back, self)
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.xellos) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.here_is_xellos, self)
			return true
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.eva_boss) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.catch_the_stalker, self))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == 'battle_with_eva' then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.after_battle_against_eva, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:jump_tile_activate(index, target)
	local jump_tile = get_field_object('church_jump_tile_' .. index)
	local jump_tile_animator = jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	local jump_tile_data = jump_tile.FieldObjectBehaviour

	if not lua_helper.type_compare(jump_tile_data, CS.Oak.JumpTileBehaviour) then
		return
	end

	jump_tile_animator:Play('on')

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		jump_tile_animator:Play('off')
	end))

	local jump_dir = direction_util.to_vector3(jump_tile.Direction)
	local dir = jump_tile_data.HorizontalSpeed * jump_dir + jump_tile_data.JumpSpeed * unity_class.vector3.up

	local jumpInfo = CS.Oak.JumpInfo()
	jumpInfo.jumper = target
	jumpInfo.jumpSource = jump_tile
	jumpInfo.jumpType = CS.Oak.JumpType.JumpTileJump
	jumpInfo.speed = dir.magnitude
	jumpInfo.direction = dir.normalized
	jumpInfo.jumpStartPos = target.Position
	jumpInfo.jumpTimeScale = 1.75
	jumpInfo.gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity

	local cmd = CS.Oak.JumpCommand.Create(jumpInfo)

	command_util.publish_cmd(jumpInfo.jumper.Owner, cmd)

	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	while lua_helper.type_compare(target.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.CharacterJumpState) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
end

	--마킹은 에바 따라다님.

	-- +---+   ㅁㅁ					X
	--		   ㅁㅁ				 ^	X

	--		  X				  X	 3	X
	-- __2__  X				  X		X
	-- | > |  X		-3->	  X		X
	-- +---+  X				  X		X
	--	 ^	  X				  X__1__X
	--	 3	  X		<-2-	  X| < |X
	--		  X				  X+---+X

	--		  X				  X		X

		jump_tiles[1].Bounds.center
	}, 7, true, nil, nil, 'left')

	yield_return_func(self.jump_tile_activate, self, 1, self.eva)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.eva, {
		jump_tiles[2].Bounds.center + vector(0, 0, -1)
	}, 7, true, nil, nil, 'down')





	self.eva_state = self.event_state.scene_3

	while self.eva_state > self.current_state do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.eva, {
		jump_tiles[2].Bounds.center
	}, 7, true, nil, nil, 'right')

	yield_return_func(self.jump_tile_activate, self, 2, self.eva)

	local rock_pos = field:GetMarker('main_s4_eva_jump_over').position

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.eva, {

	}, 8.5, true, nil, nil, 'down')





	self.eva_state = self.event_state.scene_4

	while self.eva_state > self.current_state do

	end

		rock_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0)
	}, 8.5, true, nil, nil, 'left')

	character_util.move_waypoint(self.eva, {
		rock_pos + vector(-8, 0, 0)
	}, 8, true, nil, nil, 'left')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(self.eva, 'left', 5/8, 1)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.eva, {
		jump_tiles[3].Bounds.center
	}, 7, true, nil, nil, 'down')

	yield_return_func(self.jump_tile_activate, self, 3, self.eva)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.eva, {
		jump_tiles[4].Bounds.center
	}, 7, true, nil, nil, 'down')

	yield_return_func(self.jump_tile_activate, self, 4, self.eva)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.eva, {
		vector(self.eva.Position.x, 1, lev_pos.z),
	}, 7, true, nil, nil, 'up')





	self.eva_state = self.event_state.scene_5

	while self.eva_state > self.current_state do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.eva, {
		lev_pos + vector(-11, 0, 0)
	}, 7, true, nil, nil, 'right')

	character_util.move_waypoint(self.eva, {
		lev_pos + vector(-6, 0, 0)
	}, 7, true, nil, nil, 'right')
	character_util.mario_jump_async(self.eva, 'right', 5/7, 1.3)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.eva, {
		lev_pos
	}, 7, true, nil, nil, 'right')





	self.eva_state = self.event_state.scene_6

	while self.eva_state > self.current_state do
		coroutine.yield()
	end

function local_class:find_the_stalker_2()

	local lev_pos = field:GetMarker('main_s4_levitation').position
	local land_pos = field:GetMarker('main_s4_landing').position

	self.eva.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil
	self.eva.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance

	--만약 폭탄통을 들고 있었다면 내려놓도록 처리
	self.controller:release_holdup(self.lina)

	--검은선 진입 시 트리거 존 이벤트 시작, 붉은점에 정렬.
	camera_util.move(lev_pos + vector(-2, 0, 0), 0.5)
	party_util.align_party(lev_pos + vector(-3, 0, 0), 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_fade_out_01')
	character_util.remove_color(self.eva, nil, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.eva, 'left')

	local arrow
	local trail

	--리나 캐스팅 자세 취함.
	character_util.remove_anim(self.lina)
	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(self.lina, {name = 'bow_attack_ready_start', count = 1,
													 end_call_func = function()
														 character_util.set_anim(self.lina, {name = 'bow_attack_ready_loop'})
														 self.flame_arrow_start:Instantiate(self.lina.Position + vector(0.5, 0.4, 0))
														 arrow = self.flame_arrow:Instantiate(self.lina.Position + vector(0.3, 0.4, 0))
														 trail = self.flame_arrow_trail:Instantiate(self.lina.Position + vector(0.6, 0.4, 0))
													 end})

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	--리나: 이제 끝이다, 플레임 애로우!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 19, skip = true})
	--화염구 따라 카메라 패닝, 에바 화염구 맞기 전 슬로우, 우측으로 마리오 점프 자세를 취함.

	--fx_m_lina_arrow_fire
	--fx_m_lina_arrow
	--fx_m_lina_arrow_trail
	--fx_m_lina_arrow_end

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	camera_util.move(lev_pos + vector(1, 0, 0), 0.33)
	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(3, 0.33)

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.lina, {name = 'bow_attack', count = 1, keep_anim = true,
													 end_call_func = function()
														 wait_for_sec(0.2)
														 time_util.mod('fire_ball', 0.3)

														 character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.eva, {name = 'staff_cast'}, {name = 'attack'})
													 end})

	--플레임 애로우 쏘고, 에바 뒷걸음질 치다가 마력 방어막으로 튕겨내고 뒤로 날아가는 것으로 수정.

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lina_fire_cast_01')
	self.flame_arrow_start:Instantiate(self.lina.Position + vector(0.6, 0.4, 0))

	local barrier = nil


	local timer = 0
	local duration = 1
	while timer < duration do
		local arrow_pos = vector_util.lerp(
				self.lina.Position + vector(0.3, 0.4, 0),
				lev_pos + vector(-1.2, 0.5, 0), timer / duration)
		arrow.transform.position = arrow_pos
		trail.transform.position = arrow_pos + vector(-0.6, 0, 0)

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer > 0.8 and barrier == nil then
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_spear_01')
			character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, {name = 'surprise'})
			barrier = self.shield:Instantiate(self.eva.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.eva.Transform)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.eva, false)
	--뒷걸음질 하는 에바, 플레임 애로우 날아오다가 슬로우 모션,
	--맞기 전에 (left, attack, get) 자세 취하면서 방어막 활성화.(이펙트 아래 두개 중 하나 혹은 더 좋아보이는 것 사용해도 좋음)

	--피격 시 슬로우 해제, 플레임 애로우 튕겨내면서 방어막 사라지고 에바 뒤로 날아감.(카메라 에바 따라감.)
	--건너편에 떨어진 에바 일어나서 우측으로 달리다가 슬로우.
	--제로스(보라색) 순간이동으로 나타나며 하단 대사
	--제로스: 아까의 실패를 만회…
	--에바와 제로스 부딪히면 슬로우 해제, 제로스 뒤로 밀리고 에바는 아래로 떨어짐, 떨어진 에바에게 마킹.
	--제로스 뒤로 밀릴 때 엎어지지 않는 것으로 수정, (left, damaged, damaged2)로 넉백 후 (left, damaged, idle) 상태
	--이후 카메라 리나에게 돌아옴.

	time_util.unmod('fire_ball')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lina_ds_shoot_01')
	self.fire_explosion:Instantiate(arrow.transform.position)
	self.flame_arrow_end:Instantiate(arrow.transform.position)
	arrow:Dispose()
	trail:TriggeredDispose()
	--fire_ball:Dispose()
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)

	camera_util.resize_to_default(0.3)
	camera_util.move(land_pos + vector(2, 0, 0), 1.3)

	character_util.spine_rotate(self.eva, 360, 1.3)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		timer = 0
		duration = 1.3
		local init_pos = self.eva.Position
		local dist = land_pos - lev_pos
		local height = vector(0, 1.3, 0)
		while timer < duration do
			local prog = timer / duration
			local pos = init_pos + height * math.sin(prog * math.pi) + dist * prog
			character_util.set_position(self.eva, pos, true)

			timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

			--if timer > 0.3 and barrier == nil then
			--	barrier = self.shield:Instantiate(self.eva.Position, unity_class.quaternion.identity, self.eva.Transform)
			--end

			coroutine.yield()
		end
	end))


	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.eva, {name = 'damaged', loop = false}, {name = 'attack'})
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.eva, {name = 'jingak', loop = false}, {name = 'attack'})

	while timer < duration do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.spine_rotate(self.eva, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.eva)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.eva, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_grass_slide_02')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	timer = 0
	duration = 1
	local smoke_delay = 1

	while timer < duration do
		local prog = (timer / duration) - 1
		local pos = land_pos + (1 - (prog * prog)) * vector(3, 0, 0)

		character_util.set_position(self.eva, pos)

		if math.abs(prog) < smoke_delay and timer < duration * 0.9 then
			smoke_delay = smoke_delay - 0.2
			self.dash_smoke:Instantiate(self.eva.Position + vector(0, 0.01, 0))
		end

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end

	self.xellos.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = true
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.xellos, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(self.xellos, 'left')

	local xellos_pos = field:GetMarker('main_s4_xellos_pos').position

	local dist = xellos_pos.x - 0.5 - self.eva.Position.x

	--에바 일어나서 우측으로 달리다가 슬로우.
	character_util.remove_anim(self.eva)
	camera_util.move(xellos_pos, 0.5, {use_unscaled_time = true})
	character_util.move_waypoint(self.eva, xellos_pos + vector(-0.5, 0, 0),
			dist / 1.2, true, nil, nil, 'right')
	--제로스(보라색) 순간이동으로 나타나며 하단 대사
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_object_warp_01')
	time_util.mod('xellos_crash', 0.2)
	self.teleport:Instantiate(xellos_pos)
	character_util.set_position(self.xellos, xellos_pos)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.xellos, 1, 0.3)

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	--제로스: 아까의 실패를 만회…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.xellos, {key = self.talk_name .. '24_1', skip = true, type_speed = 0.02})
	wait_for_sec(0.4)
	--에바와 제로스 부딪히면 슬로우 해제, 제로스 뒤로 밀리고 에바는 아래로 떨어짐.
	time_util.unmod('xellos_crash')

	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.xellos)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 3})
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_hit_big_01')
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_linda_scream_01')
	character_util.stop(self.eva)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.eva, false)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.eva, {name = 'damaged2'}, {name = 'damaged'})
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.eva)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.eva)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_air_spin_01')
	character_util.spine_rotate(self.eva, 1440, 1)
	character_util.jump(self.eva, 2, 1, 0)
	character_util.move_to(self.eva, field:GetMarker('main_s4_eva_down_pos').position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1, nil, false, false)

	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.xellos, {name = 'damaged2'}, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.xellos)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.xellos)

	timer = 0
	duration = 0.7
	while timer < duration do
		local prog = (timer / duration) - 1
		local pos = xellos_pos + (1 - (prog * prog)) * vector(2, 0, 0)
		character_util.set_position(self.xellos, pos)
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end


	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.xellos)
	character_util.set_direction(self.xellos, 'down')

	character_util.spine_rotate(self.eva, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.eva, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'damaged'})
	character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(self.eva)
	character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(self.eva)
	character_util.set_active_shadow(self.eva, true)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_02')

	character_util.set_position(self.lina, lev_pos + vector(-1, 0, 0))
	character_util.set_position(self.goury, lev_pos + vector(-1.7, 0, 0))

	camera_util.move_async(lev_pos,1)


	character_util.set_position(self.eva_boss, self.eva.Position)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.eva_boss, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'damaged'})
	character_util.set_position(self.eva, vector(999, 0, 999))

	quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_s4', self.eva_boss, true)

	--
	character_util.move_to_async(self.lina, lev_pos, 0.5, nil, true, true)
	--전력이 아니었다곤 해도 내 마법을…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(self.lina, {name = 'question', loop = false})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 20, skip = true})
	--뭐 하는 녀석인지 알아야겠어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 21, skip = true})
	--리나: 레비테이션!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lina_ds_cast_01')
	character_util.set_anim(self.lina, {name = 'bomb_idle'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, {key = self.talk_name .. 22, skip = true})
	--리나 공중에 떠오름 천천히 우측으로 이동.(가우리 제외)

	local lev_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_lina_ds_cast_01', loop = true, fade_in_time = 1 })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_prologue_wind_01')
	self.dash_smoke:Instantiate(self.lina.Position + vector(0, 0.02, 0))

	timer = 0
	duration = 0.5
	local goury_offset = nil
	while timer < duration do
		local prog = (timer / duration)
		local pos = lev_pos + (1 - math.cos(prog * math.pi)) * 0.5 * vector(0, 1, 0)
		character_util.set_position(self.lina, pos, true)
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if timer > 0.2 and goury_offset == nil then
			--가우리 점프하여 공중에 떠있는 리나에게 매달림.
			character_util.set_position(self.goury, self.goury.Position, true)
			character_util.move_to(self.goury, lev_pos + vector(-0.3, 0.5, 0),
					0.3, nil, false, false)
			character_util.jump(self.goury, 1, 0.3, 0)
			character_util.set_anim(self.goury, {name = 'get'})

			goury_offset = vector(-0.3, -0.5, 0)
		end

		coroutine.yield()
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')

	camera_util.move(land_pos,1)

	timer = 0
	duration = 1

	while timer < duration do
		local prog = (timer / duration)
		local pos = lev_pos + vector(0, 1, 0)
				+ (math.sin(prog * math.pi)) * vector(0, 0.5, 0)
				+ prog * (land_pos - lev_pos)
		character_util.set_position(self.lina, pos, true)
		character_util.set_position(self.goury, pos + goury_offset, true)
		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield()
	end


	--반대편에 도착.
	camera_util.move(land_pos, 0.5, {end_target = user_party.Leader})
	character_util.mario_jump_new(self.lina, 'right', 0.5, 0.5)
	character_util.mario_jump_new(self.goury, 'right', 0.3, 0.5)
	character_util.move_to(self.lina, land_pos,
	0.5, nil, false, false)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.goury, land_pos + vector(-0.7, 0, 0),
	0.3, nil, false, false)

	lev_sfx:Stop()
	lev_sfx = nil

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.goury)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_land_01')

	character_util.add_listener(self.eva_boss, self.controller)

	character_util.set_position(self.lina, self.lina.Position, false)
	character_util.set_position(self.goury, self.goury.Position, false)


	--이벤트 종료, 에바에게 마킹, 컨트롤 풀림.
	self.xellos.SpineController.AlwaysUpdateSpine = false
end

function local_class:xellos_is_back()
	--이후 리나가 우측으로 이동하면 계단 앞 짧은 트리거 존 이벤트로 제로스 일어나서 파티 합류, 이벤트 종료, 컨트롤 풀림, 에바에 마킹.
	--트리거 존 진입 시 이벤트, 제로스 표정 idle로 바뀌고 리나 앞에 정렬함.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.xellos)

	--합류하면서 제로스 대사
	character_util.move_to_async(self.xellos, self.lina.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0),
			0.5, nil, true, true)
	character_util.set_direction(self.xellos, 'left')

	--오늘따라 민망한 꼴을…
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, {key = self.talk_name .. '24_2', skip = true})
	--하지만 결과적으로 저도 한 건 했네요?

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
	local wind_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_blizzard_04', fade_in_time = 1.0, loop = true})

	self.house_exit = field:GetMarker('kid_girl_house_inner').position

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	self:renew_character_cache()

	local slum_half_line = field:GetMarker('tower_pos_7').position + vector(-2, -1, 0)
	-- 슬럼가 그리드
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.lina, 'slum_area') then
		if user_party.Leader.Position.x < slum_half_line.x then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_s5', self.house_entrance + vector(0, 0, 2), true)
		else
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_s5', get_field_object('slum_exit_B'), true)
		end
		-- 동굴 그리드
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.lina, 'cave_area') then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_s5', get_field_object('cave_exit_a_inner'), true)

	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	self:on_camera_grid_enter_event(e)

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.kid) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_to_kid, self))
		elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, get_field_object('slum_kid_house_exit')) then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.exit
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent) then
		if type_util.is_player_enter_to_cam_grid(e, self.kid_house_grid_name) then
			self.current_state = self.event_state.in_house
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_s5', self.kid, true)
			return true
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridLeaveEvent) then
		if type_util.is_player_leave_to_cam_grid(e, self.kid_house_grid_name) then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_s5', self.house_entrance + vector(0, 0, 2), true)
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaMansionPostSection')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.npc_name = 'mansion_npc_'
	self.talk_name = 'short_story_sl_mansion_s1_'
	self.post_talk_name = 'short_story_sl_mansion_post_'
	self.wall_gimmick_name = 'mansion_wall_'

	self.npcs = {}
end

function local_class:enter()

	local after_pos = field:GetMarker('mansion_after_pos').position
	local talk_index = { 69, 67, 66 }
	local emotion = { 'surprise', 'damaged', 'idle' }
	local add_pos = { vector(0, 0, -6), vector(1, 0, -6), vector(-2, 0, -3) }
	local indexes = {3, 2, 1}

	local owner = get_character('mansion_owner')
	owner.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	owner.Interactable.Talk = self.post_talk_name .. 1
	character_util.set_direction(owner, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(owner)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(owner, { name = 'idle' }, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_position(owner, after_pos)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local escape_npc = get_character(self.npc_name .. indexes[i])
		character_util.set_active_state(escape_npc, 'enabled')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(escape_npc)
		character_util.set_direction(escape_npc, 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(escape_npc, { name = emotion[i] })
		character_util.set_position(escape_npc, after_pos + add_pos[i])
		escape_npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
		escape_npc.Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. talk_index[i]
	end


	local pre_pos = field:GetMarker('mansion_pre_pos').position

	local npc = get_character(self.npc_name .. 6)
	character_util.set_position(npc, pre_pos + vector(6, 0, 19.5))
	character_util.set_direction(npc, 'right')
	npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	npc.Interactable.Talk = self.post_talk_name .. 2
	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')

	npc = get_character(self.npc_name .. 7)
	character_util.set_position(npc, pre_pos + vector(7, 0, 19.5))
	character_util.set_direction(npc, 'left')
	npc.Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	npc.Interactable.Talk = self.post_talk_name .. 3
	character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')

	-- 저택 disable
	local mansion = get_field_object('mansion_fo')
	mansion.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	self.controller:set_active_buildings(false)

end

end

	local event_type = e:GetType()
	return false
end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaMansionPreSection')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.talk_name = 'short_story_sl_mansion_pre_'
	self.wall_gimmick_name = 'mansion_wall_'

	self.npc_name = 'mansion_npc_'
	self.npcs = {}

	self.pre_offsets = {
		vector(2.75, 0, 1),
		vector(4, 0, 1.25),
		vector(4, 0, -1.25),
		vector(2.6, 0, -0.7),
		vector(3.5, 0, 0),

		-- 원라인 대사 npc 좌표
		vector(6, 0, 19.5),
		vector(7, 0, 19.5),
	}

	self.state_enum = {
		none = 0,
		init = 1,
		talk = 2,
	}
	self.current_state = self.state_enum.none
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent), 'on_camera_grid_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	self.lina = self.controller.get_lina()
	self.goury = self.controller.get_goury()
	self.amelia = self.controller.get_amelia()
	self.zelgadis = self.controller.get_zelgadis()
	self.xellos = self.controller.get_xellos()
	self.eva = self.controller.get_eva()
	self.owner = get_character('mansion_owner')

	self.mansion_pos = field:GetMarker('mansion_pre_pos').position

	-- 저택 주인 세팅
	character_util.set_position(self.owner, self.mansion_pos)
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, 'right')

	-- 주민들 세팅
	for i = 1, 7 do
		local npc = get_character(self.npc_name .. i)
		if i < 6 then
			character_util.set_direction(npc, 'left')
		end

		character_util.set_active_state(npc, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_position(npc, self.mansion_pos + self.pre_offsets[i])
		table.insert(self.npcs, npc)
	end

	-- 파괴 잔해 disable
	for i = 1, 15 do
		local wall = get_field_object(self.wall_gimmick_name .. i)
		wall.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	end
end

function local_class:renew_character_cache()
	self.lina = self.controller.get_lina()
	self.goury = self.controller.get_goury()
	self.amelia = self.controller.get_amelia()
	self.zelgadis = self.controller.get_zelgadis()
	self.xellos = self.controller.get_xellos()
end


function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.CameraGridEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	self.lina = nil
	self.goury = nil
	self.amelia = nil
	self.zelgadis = nil
	self.xellos = nil
	self.owner = nil

	self.npcs = nil
end

--message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

function local_class:show_marker(name, target, immediately)
	-- 마커 관리가 시작되는 시점은 메인 프롤로그가 진행된 이후여야 한다.
	local main_qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(7000801)

	if main_qp == nil then
		return
	end

	if immediately then
		quest_marker_util.remove(name)
	end
	-- 서브 마커로서 관리되기 위해서는 확실하게 progress가 nil이 아니고 서브퀘스트여야 한다.
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(name, 7000809,
			false, target)

		self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('slum_kid_house_exit'), true)

		self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('old_woman_house_exit'), true)

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local marker_name = 'lina_main_mansion'

	self:renew_character_cache()

	local slum_half_line = field:GetMarker('tower_pos_7').position + vector(-2, -1, 0)
	-- 슬럼가 그리드
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'slum_area') then
		if user_party.Leader.Position.x < slum_half_line.x then
			self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('slum_exit'), true)
		else
			self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('slum_exit_B'), true)
		end
		-- 동굴 그리드
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'cave_area') then
		self:show_marker(marker_name, get_field_object('cave_exit_c_outer'), true)

	end

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) and not e.FullEnter then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'mansion_pre_event_zone' and
					self.current_state == self.state_enum.none then
				self.current_state = self.state_enum.init
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.one_line_pre_event, self))
			elseif e.Zone.Name == 'mansion_s1_event_zone' and self.current_state == self.state_enum.init then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.pre_event_scene, self))

		end
	end
	return false

	})

	character_util.set_emotion(self.owner, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 카메라 강철집으로 패닝, 전체 모습을 보여준 뒤 저택 주인에게 돌아옴.

	camera_util.move_async(camera_pos, 0.75)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 5, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.owner)

	character_util.set_emotion(self.npcs[2], { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.npcs[2], { key = self.talk_name .. 7, skip = true })

	-- 저택 주인 (right, idle, idle): 정말 그럴까요, 여러분도 요즘 느끼시지 않나요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 8, skip = true })

	-- 저택 주인 (right, attack, shoot): 치안이 안 좋을 때 가장 안전한 곳은 자신의 집뿐이란걸!

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 9, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.owner)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_crowd_shout_05')
	buzz_sfx:FadeOut(1)
	buzz_sfx = nil

	-- 주민들 (left, scared, idle 진동)
	for i = 1, 5 do
		character_util.shake(self.npcs[i], 0.05, 0.5)
		character_util.set_emotion(self.npcs[i], { name = 'scared' })
	end
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 주민3 (left, scared, idle 진동 ): 확실히 한 달 전 왕녀 님의 생일 행사 때 큰 지진이 일어난 뒤로…
	character_util.shake(self.npcs[4], 0.05, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.npcs[4], { key = self.talk_name .. 10, skip = true })

	-- 주민2 (left, scared, idle 진동 ) : 지진도 잦고 실종 사건에 도적들까지, 치안이 안 좋아지긴 했지…
	character_util.shake(self.npcs[2], 0.05, 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.npcs[2], { key = self.talk_name .. 11, skip = true })

	-- 저택 주인이 말하는 것과 동시에 표정 remove
	for i = 1, 5 do
		character_util.remove_emotion(self.npcs[i])
	end

	-- 저택 주인 (right, smile, get): 캔터베리 깡촌에서 이보다 안전한 집은 없을 겁니다!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.owner, { name = 'get', loop = false }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 12, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim(self.owner)

	-- 저택 주인 (right, smile,release): 절대 안전 보장! 목숨 값을 생각하면 오히려 저렴한 편이죠.
	character_util.set_anim(self.owner, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 13, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.owner)

	-- 주민1(left, tired, idle) : …겉만 튼튼해 보이고 그런 건 아니겠지?
	character_util.set_emotion(self.npcs[1], { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.npcs[1], { key = self.talk_name .. 14, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.npcs[1])

	-- 저택 주인 (right, doyagao, cross_arm): 후후, 그렇다면 내기를 하죠.
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.owner, { name = 'cross_arm', loop = false },
			{ name = 'doyagao' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 15, skip = true })

	-- 검은 선 트리거 존 이벤트가 끝나기전에 activate_quest가 호출될 가능성이 있으므로 여기서도 원라인 NPC의 Interactable을 바꿔준다.
	self:change_npc_interactable()

	-- 이하 다음 섹션으로 바로 이어지도록
	yield_return_func(quest_util.activate_quest, self.controller)
end

-- 원라인 대사하는 npc들 대사 세팅
function local_class:change_npc_interactable()
	if self.npcs == nil then
		return
	end

	self.npcs[7].Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	self.npcs[7].Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. 1

	self.npcs[6].Interactable = CS.Oak.NPCInteractable.Create()
	self.npcs[6].Interactable.Talk = self.talk_name .. 2
end

return local_class

		table.insert(self.npcs, npc)
	end

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 0 then
		self.current_state = self.state_enum.init

	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'slum_area') then
		if user_party.Leader.Position.x < slum_half_line.x then
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_mansion', get_field_object('slum_exit'), true)
		else
			quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_mansion', get_field_object('slum_exit_B'), true)
		end
		-- 동굴 그리드
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'cave_area') then
		quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, 'lina_main_mansion', get_field_object('cave_exit_c_outer'), true)
	end


	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'mansion_s1_event_zone') and
		self.current_state == self.state_enum.none then
		-- 첫 이벤트 시작
		self.current_state = self.state_enum.first_event
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.break_the_mansion, self, false))
		return true
	elseif type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.goury, 'mansion_evacuate_zone') then
		if self.current_state == self.state_enum.dragon_slave_event then
			-- 가우리가 드래곤슬레이브 영창 중에 나가려고 할 때
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.run_dragon_slave_chant, self, false))
		elseif self.current_state == self.state_enum.try_mansion_break then
			-- 가우리가 건물 부수기 도전할 때 나가려고 하면
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.zone_leave_try_mansion_break, self, false))
		end
		return true
	end

	-- 드래곤 슬레이브 영창 중에 구해줘야할 시민 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state_enum.dragon_slave_event then
		if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, self.owner, 'mansion_evacuate_zone') then
			self.owner.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
				util.cs_generator(self.safe_zone_enter_escape_npc, self, self.owner, 0))
			return true
		end

		-- 구출 시민 확인
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local escape_npc = get_character(self.npc_name .. i)
			if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, escape_npc, 'mansion_evacuate_zone') then
				escape_npc.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject,
					util.cs_generator(self.safe_zone_enter_escape_npc, self, escape_npc, i))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_hold_up_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.state_enum.dragon_slave_event then
		return false
	end

	-- 건물주인 들어 올려졌는지 확인
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.owner) then
		self:hold_up_escape_npc(self.owner, 50)
		return true
	end

	-- 구출해줘야하는 인원 올려졌는지 확인
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local index = 50 + i
		local escape_npc = get_character(self.npc_name .. i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, escape_npc) then
			self:hold_up_escape_npc(escape_npc, index)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:hold_up_escape_npc(escape_npc, index)
	-- 뭐, 뭡니까! 갑자기…! / 우왓! 갑자기 뭐야? / 꺄악? / 이, 이거 놔…!
	self:remove_quest_marker()
	ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('escape_point', self.quest_id, false, vector(191.5, 0, 154))

	if index == 50 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
	elseif index == 51 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	elseif index == 52 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_linda_scream_01')
	elseif index == 53 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_victim_scream_01')
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(escape_npc)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(escape_npc, { name = 'prostrate' }
	, { name = 'surprise' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(escape_npc, { key = self.talk_name .. index, life_time = 1 })
end

function local_class:on_throw_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.state_enum.dragon_slave_event then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.owner) then
		self:set_quest_marker_to_npc()
		return true
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local escape_npc = get_character(self.npc_name .. i)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, escape_npc) then
			self:set_quest_marker_to_npc()
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.state_enum.try_mansion_break then
		return false
	end

	local mansion = get_field_object(self.mansion_name)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, mansion) then
		if not self.is_shake_mansion then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
				music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_mech_stomp_02')
				mansion:Shake(0.15, 0.2)
				wait_for_sec(0.4)
			end))
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:get_voice_language()
	local voice_language = '01_voice_lina_'

	if music_player.UseCurrentVoiceLanguageForCollab then
		if music_player.CurrentVoiceLanguage == 'ko' then
			voice_language = '03_voice_lina_'
		--elseif music_player.CurrentVoiceLanguage == 'en' then
		--	voice_language = '05_voice_lina_'
		end
	end

	return voice_language
end

function local_class:dispose_save_zone_line()
	if self.save_zone_line == nil then
		return
	end

	self.save_zone_line:Hide()
	CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.save_zone_line)
	self.save_zone_line = nil
end

-- 시민을 안전한 곳으로 던졌을 때
function local_class:safe_zone_enter_escape_npc(npc, index)
	local number = 54 + index
	self.save_npc_count = self.save_npc_count + 1

	self:remove_quest_marker()
	self:set_quest_marker_to_npc()

	-- FieldObjectIdleState이 될때까지 대기
	while not lua_helper.type_compare(npc.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState, CS.Oak.FieldObjectIdleState)
			and not self.is_game_over do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	wait_for_sec(0.05)

	if self.is_game_over then
		return
	end

	-- 이게 무슨 짓이야! / 여기는 왜?  / 어머, 자세히 보니 잘생겼네… / 뭐하는 놈이야? 저건!
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(npc)
	local emotion = { 'attack', 'idle', 'love', 'attack' }
	character_util.set_direction(npc, 'down')
	if index == 2 then
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_bad_fairy_01')
	end
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(npc, { name = 'idle' }, { name = emotion[index + 1] })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(npc, self.talk_name .. number)
end

-- 드래곤 슬레이브 영창 중에 가우리가 나가려고하면
function local_class:run_dragon_slave_chant()
	-- 이미 전원 구조가 완료되었다면 그대로 액티비티 종료
	if self.save_npc_count >= 4 then
		self.time_passed = self.activity_time
		self.save_npc_count = self.save_npc_count + 1
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('escape_point')
		return
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	-- 남은 사람들이 없나 찾아봐야 해!
	character_util.set_direction(self.goury, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.goury, { name = 'attack' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, { key = self.talk_name .. 68, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.goury)

	if self.is_game_over then
		return
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.goury, self.goury.Position + unity_class.vector3.back, 2, false)

	if self.is_game_over then
		return
	end

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:break_the_mansion(continued)
	-- 시작전에 에바 합류할 수 있는 상황이 있을 수도 있으니 에바 합류 체크
	self.controller:update_join_eva()

	if not continued then
		self:renew_character_cache()

		field_ui_manager:Hide()
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

		self.controller:release_holdup(self.lina)

		quest_marker_util.remove('lina_main_mansion')
		camera_util.move(vector(189.5, 0, 142), 0.5)

		wait_all({
			util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
					self.lina, self.mansion_pos + vector(1, 0, 2.5),
					4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down'),
			util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
					self.goury, self.mansion_pos + vector(0, 0, 2.5),
					4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down'),
			util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
					self.xellos, self.mansion_pos + vector(-1, 0, 2.5),
					4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down'),
			util.cs_generator(function()
				-- 에바가 있다면 정렬
				if self.controller.is_join_eva then
					character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.eva, self.mansion_pos + vector(-2, 0, 2.5)
					, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'down')
				end
			end),
		})
	end

	self.cached_goury = self.goury
	self.goury = get_character(self.cached_goury.Name .. '_manual')

	character_util.set_active_state(self.goury, 'enabled')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.goury)
	character_util.set_position(self.goury, self.cached_goury.Position)
	character_util.set_position(self.cached_goury, vector(999, 0, 999))

	-- 저택 주인(right, smile, cast2) : 지금부터 폭탄! 화약! 어떤 방식을 사용해도 상관없으니
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.owner)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.owner, { name = 'cast2' }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 0, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.owner)

	-- 저택 주인(right, idle, idle) : 제 저택에 흠집이라도 내는 사람에겐 큰 상금을 드리겠습니다.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 1, skip = true })

	-- 리나에게 카메라 복귀.
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0.5)

	-- 리나(down, smile, jump 1회): 방금 들었어? 큰 상금을 준대!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.normal_jump(self.lina, true)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, { key = self.talk_name .. 2, skip = true })

	-- 제로스(down, idle, idle): 엄청난 자신감이군요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.xellos, { key = self.talk_name .. 3, skip = true })

	-- 리나 (left, smile, idle): 가우리! 네가 가서 바로 조각조각 내버려!
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, { key = self.talk_name .. 4, skip = true })

	-- 가우리 (right, surprise, idle): 내가?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_direction(self.goury, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.goury, { name = 'surprise' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, { key = self.talk_name .. 5, skip = true })
	character_util.set_direction(self.goury, 'down')
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.goury)

	-- 리나 (down, smile2, idle ): 여기! 우리가 한번 해볼게!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, { name = 'smile2' })
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(character_util.normal_double_jump, self.lina, true))
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, { key = self.talk_name .. 6, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.lina)

	-- 저택 주인 (up): 오~ 마침 도전자가 나왔군요, 좋습니다.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.owner)
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, 'up')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 7, skip = true })

	-- 저택 주인 (left, idle, release): 제한 시간 동안 흠집이라도 낸다면 성공으로 해드리죠.
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, 'left')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.owner, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 8, skip = true })

	-- 가우리(down, idle, idle): 그렇게까지 말하면 나도 궁금해지는걸?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, { key = self.talk_name .. 9, skip = true })


	-- 가우리 앞으로 리나 제로스 저택 주인 뒤로
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				self.lina, self.mansion_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 0.5),
				3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				self.xellos, self.mansion_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 1.5),
				3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				self.owner, self.mansion_pos + vector(1.5, 0, -0.5),
				3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(character_util.move_waypoint_async,
				self.goury, self.mansion_pos - vector(2, 0, 0),
				3, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left'),
		util.cs_generator(function()
			-- 에바가 있다면 정렬
			if self.controller.is_join_eva then
				character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.eva, self.mansion_pos + vector(1.5, 0, 2.5)
				, 4, false, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
			end
		end),
	})

	-- 가우리(left, smile, victory_get): 어디 얼마나 단단한지 한번 볼까!
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 1.0 })
	camera_util.move(self.goury.Position, 0.5, { end_target = self.goury })
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.goury, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.goury, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false }, { name = 'smile' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, { key = self.talk_name .. 10, skip = true })
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.goury)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_battle_normal', state = 'combat'})

	-- 가우리를 리더리 나머지 인원은 파티원에서 제외
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.HidePreviousParty = false
	param.MoveCamera = false
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.goury, param)

	-- 저택 데미지 받는 상태로 바꾸고 가우리를 메뉴얼 캐릭터로 변경
	self.current_state = self.state_enum.try_mansion_break

	-- 강철집이 공격 받을 수 있도록 변경
	local mansion = get_field_object(self.mansion_name)
	mansion.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NoneAttackableDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	mansion.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Enemy

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	-- 20초 타이머 시작
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
	timer_util.start_timer({ duration = self.goury_attack_time, handler = self, callback = 'end_try_mansion_break' })
end

function local_class:zone_leave_try_mansion_break()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	--리나: 어딜 가는 거야! 가우리!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, { key = self.talk_name .. 11, bubble_type = 'shout'
	, screen_pos = vector(-100, -200), skip = true })

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.goury, self.goury.Position + unity_class.vector3.back
	, 2, false)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

function local_class:end_try_mansion_break()
	-- 타이머 종료
	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)

	-- 리나에게 바톤 터치 이벤트
	self.current_state = self.state_enum.baton_touch
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.baton_touch, self))
end

--페이드 인 시 리나와 마주하고 있는 가우리.
function local_class:baton_touch()
	-- 가우리가 스크린 플레이 중일 때 (나가려고 할 때 리나가 잡으면)는 잠시 기다린다.
	while lua_helper.type_compare(self.goury.FieldObjectController.CurrentState,
			CS.Oak.CharacterControllerScreenplayState) do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local voice_language = self:get_voice_language()

	-- 맨션 원래 상태로
	local mansion = get_field_object(self.mansion_name)
	mansion.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	mansion.EntityGroup = CS.Oak.EntityGroups.Obstacle

	-- 20초가 지나면 가우리 그 자리에서 정지(side, tired, idle) 페이드 아웃.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.goury, { name = 'tired' })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2.0 })
	-- 페이드 아웃/인 하면서 위치 세팅
	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	camera_util.move(self.lina.Position, 0, { end_target = self.lina })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.goury)
	character_util.set_direction(self.goury, 'right')
	character_util.set_position(self.goury, self.mansion_pos + unity_class.vector3.left)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
	character_util.set_direction(self.lina, 'left')
	character_util.set_position(self.lina, self.mansion_pos)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/castletown/audio:bgm_slayers_castletown', state = 'field', mix = 1.0})
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.25)

	-- 리나(left, mad, release): 뭐 하는 거야, 가우리! 제대로 하라고!
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, { name = 'mad' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.lina, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, { key = self.talk_name .. 12, skip = true })

	-- 가우리 (right, idle, idle): 그렇게 말해도 저 호텔…  생각보다 더 단단하다고.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.goury, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, { key = self.talk_name .. 13, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.goury)

	-- 리나 (left, tired, idle): 정말… 비켜봐, 내가 한번 해볼게.
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.lina)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, { name = 'tired' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')

function local_class:chant_dragon_slave_routine()
	-- 가우리 left, up, right 바라본 뒤 <ㅡ (이후 액티비티 실패 시 재시작 지점)
