	wait_for_sec(1)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(self.goury, 'right')
	wait_for_sec(1)

	while not self.gourry_act_token do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 세이프 존 라인 세팅
	self.save_zone_line = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(vector(191.5, 0.001, 155.5), self.obj_target_size,
			CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 76), CS.UnityEngine.Color32(53, 255, 70, 153))

	self.save_zone_line:Show()

	self.is_game_over = true
	self.is_play_activity = true

	self.dragon_slave_count = 0
	self.time_passed = 0
	self.dragon_slave_time = 4.5
	while self.is_play_activity
			and self.current_state == self.state_enum.dragon_slave_event do
		if self.is_game_over then
			-- 게임오버 / 첫 시작 때 초반 연출 시작
			self.save_npc_count = 0
			self.time_passed = 0
			self.dragon_slave_time = 4.5
			self.dragon_slave_count = 0

			-- 가우리(down, idle, idle): 이 사람들이 정말…!
			character_util.set_emotion(self.goury, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_direction(self.goury, 'down')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, { key = self.talk_name .. 47, skip = true })

			-- 가우리(left, attack, idle): 리나가 드래곤 슬레이브를 사용하기 전에 내보내는 수밖에 없겠어!
			character_util.set_direction(self.goury, 'left')
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, { key = self.talk_name .. 49, skip = true })
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.goury)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gimmick_ticking_01')
			timer_util.start_timer({ duration = self.activity_time, handler = self, callback = 'timer_finished' })
			self.is_game_over = false

			party_util.reset_controllers()
			field_ui_manager:Show()
		else
			self.time_passed = self.time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			self.dragon_slave_time = self.dragon_slave_time + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		end

		-- 5초에 한번 리나가 주문을 외운다.
		if self.dragon_slave_time >= 5 and self.dragon_slave_count <= 5 then
			--FIXME: 리나 드래곤 슬레이브 영창 보이스 추가해야 함. music_player:PlayVoice
			local voice_language = self:get_voice_language()

			local index = 58 + self.dragon_slave_count
			self.spell_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = voice_language .. '0' .. (self.dragon_slave_count + 3), loop = false })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.lina, { key = self.talk_name .. index })
			self.dragon_slave_time = 0
			self.dragon_slave_count = self.dragon_slave_count + 1
		end

		-- 시간 다되면 분기에 따라 처리
		-- 기획 변경으로, 가우리 본인까지 탈출을 해야 성공으로 변경 (npc4 + 가우리1)
		if self.time_passed >= self.activity_time then
			if self.save_npc_count >= 5 then
				-- 성공
				self.is_play_activity = false
				break
			else
				-- 실패
				self:shot_dragon_slave(false)
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 세이프존 라인 dispose
	self:dispose_save_zone_line()

	-- 성공의 드래곤 슬레이브 연출
	self:shot_dragon_slave(true)
end

function local_class:timer_finished()
	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)
end

function local_class:wait_for_spell(sfx_name, sb_key, duration)
	if self.spell_sfx ~= nil then
		self.spell_sfx:FadeOut(0.5)
		self.spell_sfx = nil
	end
	self.spell_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = sfx_name, loop = false })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.lina, { key = sb_key, life_time = duration })
	wait_for_sec(duration)
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.lina)
end

function local_class:shot_dragon_slave(is_clear)
	self.is_game_over = true

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	timer_util.end_timer(self, true)

	self:remove_quest_marker()

	local voice_language = self:get_voice_language()

	-- 카메라가 리나쪽으로
	camera_util.move_async(self.lina.Position, 0.5)

	if self.dragon_slave_time < 2 then
		wait_for_sec(2 - self.dragon_slave_time)
	end

	if is_clear then
		-- 제한 시간보다 빨리 끝냈다면 리나가 남은 주문을 영창한다.
		while self.dragon_slave_count <= 5 do
			--FIXME: 리나 드래곤 슬레이브 영창 보이스 추가해야 함. music_player:PlayVoice

			local index = 58 + self.dragon_slave_count
			self:wait_for_spell(voice_language .. '0' .. (self.dragon_slave_count + 3), self.talk_name .. index, 2)
			self.dragon_slave_count = self.dragon_slave_count + 1

			wait_for_sec(0.3)
		end
	end

	-- 리나(left, sleep_deep, staff_cast): 다 같이 파멸을 부여할 것을
	self:wait_for_spell(voice_language .. '09', self.talk_name .. 64, 3)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	-- 리나(left, attack, staff_cast): [shout] 드래곤 슬레이브!!!
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.lina)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, { name = 'attack' })
	if self.ds_sfx ~= nil then
		self.ds_sfx:FadeOut(1)
		self.ds_sfx = nil
	end

	if is_clear then
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2.0 })
	end

	if self.spell_sfx ~= nil then
		self.spell_sfx:FadeOut(0.5)
		self.spell_sfx = nil
	end
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot(voice_language .. '10')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, { key = self.talk_name .. 65, bubble_type = 'shout'
	, skip = true, bubble_direction = 'lt', scale = 1.5 })


	character_util.set_anim(self.lina, {name = 'lina/attack3', scale = 0.7, loop = false})

	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	local init_pos = self.lina.Position + vector(-0.8, 0.4, 0)
	local target_pos = self.lina.Position + vector(-6, 0.4, 0)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lina_ds_shoot_01')

	local ds_cast = self.get_fx_dragon_cast():Instantiate(init_pos, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0), nil)
	--local ds_screen = self.get_fx_dragon_screen():Instantiate(self.lina.Position)
	local ds_fire = self.get_fx_dragon_fire():Instantiate(init_pos, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0), nil)
	local ds_proj = self.get_fx_dragon_proj():Instantiate(init_pos, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0), nil)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
			self.linear_lerp, self, { ds_proj }, init_pos, target_pos, 0.3
	))

	camera_util.move(target_pos, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_lina_ds_explosion_01')
	ds_proj:Dispose()
	local ds_hit = self.get_fx_dragon_hit():Instantiate(target_pos + vector(0, 1, -1), unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 180, 0), nil)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(
			self.scale_linear_lerp, self, { ds_hit }, 1, 2.5, 2
	))

	-- 카메라 격하게 쉐이크, 화이트 페이드 아웃.
	screen_util.fade_out(2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	--camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 2)

	camera_util.shake(0.07, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.13, 0.3)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)
	camera_util.shake(0.2, 0.4)
	wait_for_sec(0.4)
	camera_util.shake(0.25, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 0.5)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)


	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	ds_cast:Dispose()
	ds_hit:Dispose()

	-- 가우리 들고있던 물체 내려놓음
	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.goury.FieldObjectBehaviour.CurrentActionState,
			typeof(CS.Oak.CharacterHoldUpState)) then
		local hold_target = self.goury.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentActionState.HoldTarget
		character_util.release_hold_object(self.goury, hold_target)
	end

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.goury, {key = '0'})
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.goury)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.owner, {key = '0'})
	speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(self.owner)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local escape_npc = get_character(self.npc_name .. i)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(escape_npc)
	end


	if is_clear then
		-- 엔딩
		self:ending()
	else
		-- 구출 npc들 세팅
		self:set_escape_npc()

		-- 가우리 초기 좌표로
		character_util.set_direction(self.goury, 'down')
		party_util.align_party(self.mansion_pos + vector(2.5, 0, 2), 'up', 0, 'linear')
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

		-- 리나 원래 표정으로
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
		character_util.set_anim(self.lina, { name = 'staff_cast' })
		character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, { name = 'shadow' })
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		if self.ds_sfx == nil then
			self.ds_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_lina_loop_01', loop = true, volume = 0.7, play_pos = self.lina.Position})
		end
		screen_util.fade_in_async(2, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'bgm_suspense_theme', state = 'field', mix = 0.0})
	end
end

function local_class:set_escape_npc()
	-- 건물주인 holdable로 수정
	self.owner.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, 'left')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.owner)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.owner, { name = 'doyagao' })
	character_util.set_position(self.owner, self.mansion_pos + vector(1.5, 0, -0.5))
	self.owner.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.6, 1, 0.6))

	local dir = { 'right', 'right', 'left', }
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local escape_npc = get_character(self.npc_name .. i)
		escape_npc.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(escape_npc)
		if i == 3 then
			character_util.set_anim(escape_npc, { name = 'seat' })
		end
		character_util.set_active_state(escape_npc, 'enabled')
		character_util.set_direction(escape_npc, dir[i])
		character_util.set_position(escape_npc, self.get_escape_npc_marker(i).position)
		escape_npc.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.6, 1, 0.6))
	end

	self:set_quest_marker_to_npc()
end

function local_class:set_quest_marker_to_npc()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('escape_point')

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local escape_npc = get_character(self.npc_name .. i)
		if lua_helper.type_compare(escape_npc.Holdable, typeof(CS.Oak.Holdable)) then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('escape_npc_' .. i, self.quest_id, false, escape_npc)
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(self.owner.Holdable, typeof(CS.Oak.Holdable)) then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO('escape_npc_' .. 0, self.quest_id, false, self.owner)
	end

	if self.save_npc_count >= 4 then
		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint('escape_point', self.quest_id, false, vector(191.5, 0, 154))
	end
end

function local_class:remove_quest_marker()
	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('escape_point')

	ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('escape_npc_' .. 0)
	for i = 1, 3 do
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('escape_npc_' .. i)
	end
end

function local_class:ending()
	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key, 0)

	local escape_npc = {
		self.npcs[3], self.npcs[2], self.npcs[1], }

	local after_pos = field:GetMarker('mansion_after_pos').position
	self:remove_quest_marker()

	-- 저택 주인 붉은점 (right, cry, seat)
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, 'right')
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.owner)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.owner, { name = 'seat' }, { name = 'cry' })
	character_util.set_position(self.owner, after_pos)

	-- 바꿔치기한 리더용 가우리 다시 해제
	character_util.set_position(self.cached_goury, self.goury.Position)
	character_util.set_position(self.goury, self.cached_goury.Position)
	character_util.stop(self.goury)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.goury)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.goury, 'disabled')

	self.goury = self.cached_goury

	-- 다시 리나를 파티 리더로
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.HidePreviousParty = false
	character_util.convert_to_npc(self.goury)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.lina)
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(self.lina, param)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.goury)
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.goury, user_party, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.xellos)
	character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.xellos, user_party, true)
	if self.controller.is_join_eva then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.eva)
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(self.eva, user_party, true)
	end

	party_util.align_party(after_pos, 'right', 0, 'arc')

	-- npc들 좌표 세팅
	local emotion = { 'surprise', 'damaged', 'idle' }
	local add_pos = { vector(0, 0, -6), vector(1, 0, -6), vector(-2, 0, -3) }
	for i = 1, #escape_npc do
		character_util.set_active_state(escape_npc[i], 'enabled')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(escape_npc[i])
		character_util.set_direction(escape_npc[i], 'down')
		character_util.set_emotion(escape_npc[i], { name = emotion[i] })
		character_util.set_position(escape_npc[i], after_pos + add_pos[i])
	end

	-- 기존에 위쪽에 있던 npc들은 아래보고 surprise
	character_util.set_direction(self.npcs[7], 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.npcs[7], { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_direction(self.npcs[6], 'down')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.npcs[6], { name = 'surprise' })

	-- 파괴 잔해 enabled
	for i = 1, 15 do
		local wall = get_field_object(self.wall_gimmick_name .. i)
		wall.ActiveState = active_state('enabled')
	end

	-- 저택 disable
	local mansion = get_field_object(self.mansion_name)
	mansion.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	self.controller:set_active_buildings(false)

	-- 카메라를 아래쪽부터
	camera_util.move_async(after_pos + vector(1, 0, -7), 0, {ignorecameragrids = true})

	-- 연기 이팩트 시작
	self.fire_smoke_effect = self.get_fx_fire_smoke():Instantiate(vector(190, 0, 155))
	self.fire_smoke_effect.transform.localScale = vector(1, 0.5, 0.7)

	local buzz_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crowd_buzz_01', loop = true, volume = 0.7, fade_in_time = 2.5})
	-- 주택가 그리드에서 페이드 인.
	screen_util.fade_in(2.5, unity_class.color.white, 'linear')

	-- 주민1,2가 중심에 있게 페이드 인, 아래 대사 출력하며 천천히 위로 카메라 패닝.
	camera_util.move(after_pos + unity_class.vector3.right, 9, { end_target = self.lina, ignorecameragrids = true })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 주민1 (down, surprise, idle): 절대 안 무너진다더니 완전히 가루가 됐잖아?!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(escape_npc[1], { key = self.talk_name .. 66, life_time = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(3)

	-- 주민2 (down, damaged, idle): 콜록콜록! 먼지 때문에 들어갈 수가 없어…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_cough_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(escape_npc[2], { key = self.talk_name .. 67, life_time = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(0.7)
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_cough_01', loop = false, pitch = 0.9 })
	wait_for_sec(2.3)

	-- 주민3 (right,idle, idle) : 방금 엄청 큰 소리가 들렸는데, 뭐였지?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(escape_npc[3], { key = self.talk_name .. 69, life_time = 1 })
	wait_for_sec(3)

	buzz_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	buzz_sfx = nil

	self:dispose_fire_effect()

	-- 저택 주인 (right, cry, seat): 나의… 나의 저택이…!
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 70, skip = true })

	-- 리나(left, idle, idle): 흠집이라도 내면 큰 상금을 준댔지?
	-- 리나 상단 대사할 때 저택 주인(right, tired, seat)
	character_util.set_emotion(self.owner, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, { key = self.talk_name .. 71, skip = true })

	-- 리나(left, wink, idle): 말한대로 큰 흠집을 내줬으니 어서 상금 줘~
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_positive_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, { name = 'wink' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, { key = self.talk_name .. 72, skip = true })

	-- 저택 주인(right, tired, sing): 저, 저기… 제가 지금 집이 없어져서…
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.owner)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.owner, { name = 'sing' }, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 73, skip = true })

	-- 리나(left, mad2, idle): 그래서 못 주겠단 거야, 지금?
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.lina)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	character_util.set_emotion(self.lina, { name = 'mad2' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, { key = self.talk_name .. 74, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_emotion(self.lina)

	-- 저택 주인(right, surprise, embarrassed): 아, 아뇨! 드리겠습니다!
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.owner)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_runaway_01')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.owner, { name = 'embarrassed' }, { name = 'surprise' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 75, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.owner)

	-- 저택 주인(right, tired, idle): ……
	character_util.set_emotion(self.owner, { name = 'tired' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.owner, { key = self.talk_name .. 76, skip = true })
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.owner)

	-- 저택 주인 right, damaged, attack 1회, goblin_thief_bag 던져줌.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.owner, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(self.owner, { name = 'attack', count = 1 })

	self.controller.data_table:add_dollar(5000, false, { pos = self.owner.Position, target_pos = self.lina.Position })
	wait_for_sec(2)

	-- 리나(left, idle, idle): 돈도 받았으니 이제 다른 곳으로 갈까?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.lina, { key = self.talk_name .. 77, skip = true })

	-- 가우리(left, idle, idle): 파괴하고 다니는 본성은 어딜 가지 않는구나…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.goury, { key = self.talk_name .. 78, skip = true })

	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	-- 에바 합류 전 저택 퀘스트를 진행했다면 정렬 후 컨트롤 풀리기 전에 아래 이벤트 실행.
	if not self.controller.is_join_eva then
		-- 카메라 제로스에게 포커싱.
		camera_util.move_async(self.xellos.Position, 0.5)

		-- 제로스 (emoticon_bubble_exclamation)
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_notice_01')
		character_util.show_emoticon_async(self.xellos, nil, 'notice')

		-- 제로스가 우측을 보면 카메라 우측으로 패닝하여 성벽 위의 에바(분홍점) 보여줌.에바는 검게 틴트 먹인 상태.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
		character_util.set_direction(self.xellos, 'right')
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({name = 'ondemand/castletown/audio:bgm_slayers_cave', state = 'event', mix = 0})

		-- 에바를 위로 달려서 화면 밖으로 사라짐.

function local_class:ease_in_lerp(targets, init_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local timer = 0

	if not type_util.is_array(targets) then
		-- 대상이 하나일때
		targets = {targets}
	end

	while timer < duration do
		local prog = timer / duration
		local pos = vector_util.lerp(init_pos, target_pos, prog * prog)

		for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
			target.transform.position = pos
		end

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
		target.transform.position = target_pos
	end
end

function local_class:linear_lerp(targets, init_pos, target_pos, duration)
	local timer = 0

	if not type_util.is_array(targets) then
		-- 대상이 하나일때
		targets = {targets}
	end

	while timer < duration do
		local prog = timer / duration
		local pos = vector_util.lerp(init_pos, target_pos, prog)

		for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
			target.transform.position = pos
		end

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
		target.transform.position = target_pos
	end
end

function local_class:scale_linear_lerp(targets, init_size, target_size, duration)
	local timer = 0
	local init_scale = unity_class.vector3.one * init_size
	local target_scale = unity_class.vector3.one * target_size

	if not type_util.is_array(targets) then
		-- 대상이 하나일때
		targets = {targets}
	end

	while timer < duration do
		local prog = timer / duration
		local scale = vector_util.lerp(init_scale, target_scale, prog)

		for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
			target.transform.localScale = scale
		end

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
		target.transform.localScale = target_scale
	end
end


function local_class:dispose_fire_effect()
	if self.fire_smoke_effect == nil then
		return
	end

	self.fire_smoke_effect:Dispose()
	self.fire_smoke_effect = nil
end

-- 앞에 선행 퀘스트 두 종류중 하나라도 깼는지 체크하는 함수
function local_class:is_all_quest_cleared()
	local valid = 1
	local target = { 7000804, 7000805 }
	for _, i in ipairs(target) do
		valid = self:quest_checker(i) and valid + 1 or valid
	end
	return valid > 1
end

function local_class:quest_checker(i)
	local qid = i
	local qp = user_progress:GetStartedQuest(qid)
	if qp == nil or not qp.IsComplete then
		return false
	end
	return true
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaOniGirlRacingSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLinaOniGirlRacing @
		Comment = ShortStoryLinaOniGirlRacing 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- npc
	self.get_oni_girl_mother = function() return get_character('onigirl_racing_mother') end
	self.get_oni_girl = function() return get_character('onigirl_racing_oni_girl') end

	-- 기믹
	self.get_push_block = function(index) return get_field_object('onigirl_racing_push_block_' .. index) end

	-- 이펙트
	self.get_fx_hit = function() return unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit') end

	-- 마커
	self.get_oni_girl_waypoint = function(part, index)
		return field:GetMarker('onigirl_racing_oni_girl_' .. part .. '_' .. index).position
	end

	self.cached_gourry = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	return true
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadActivityClear()
	self.get_fx_hit()
end

function local_class:start()
	local oni_girl_mother = self.get_oni_girl_mother()
	self.oni_girl_mother_origin_pos = oni_girl_mother.Position

	-- 시작 progress에 따른 처리
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress < 0 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self, true))
	else
		character_util.add_listener(oni_girl_mother, self.controller)
		quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(oni_girl_mother)
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if self.touch_handler then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
		self.touch_handler = nil
	end

	time_util.unmod('qte')

	if self.push_block_sfx then
		self.push_block_sfx:Stop()
		self.push_block_sfx = nil
	end

	self.lina = nil
	self.gourry = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--- OnEvent
function local_class:on_event(e)
	local oni_girl_mother = self.get_oni_girl_mother()
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, oni_girl_mother) then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_race, self, false))
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- ZoneEnterEvent
function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not self.is_changed_leader and
		type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'onigirl_racing_changed_line') then

		self.is_changed_leader = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.change_leader, self)
		return true
	end

	if not self.winner and type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party.Leader, 'onigirl_racing_goal_line') then
		self.winner = user_party.Leader
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 경주 연출
function local_class:start_race(immediately)
	local oni_girl_mother = self.get_oni_girl_mother()
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()

	self.lina = user_party.Leader
	self.gourry = user_party[1]
	local lina = self.lina
	local gourry = self.gourry

	local party_member = {}
	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		table.insert(party_member, user_party[i])
	end

	if not immediately then
		party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
		field_ui_manager:Hide()

		character_util.remove_relate_event(oni_girl_mother, self.controller)
		quest_icon_util.remove(oni_girl_mother)
		self.controller.stop_speech_mother = true

		if self.controller.dash_sfx then
			self.controller.dash_sfx:Stop()
			self.controller.dash_sfx = nil
		end

		party_util.align_to_target(oni_girl_mother, 'left', 1, 'arc')

		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(oni_girl_mother)
		character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl_mother)

		character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'left')

		-- 라라 (right, smile, idle) : 다시 도전할 준비는 됐어?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl_mother,
			{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_25', skip = true })

		-- 선택: 도전한다. / 지금은 됐어.
		local player_choice = choose_util.play_choose_event({
			{ 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_26', 'mercy' },
			{ 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_27' }
		})

		-- 지금은 됐어. 선택 시
		if player_choice == 2 then
			-- 라라 (right, smile, idle) : 언제든 도전해도 좋지만, 서두르는 게 좋을 걸?
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl_mother,
				{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_23', skip = true })

			character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.normal_jump(oni_girl_mother, true)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_ready_01')
			-- 라라 (right, attack, jump 1회) : 우리 딸은 지금도 조금씩 빨라지고 있으니까!
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl_mother,
				{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_24', skip = true })

			character_util.remove_emotion(oni_girl_mother)

			character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'right')
			character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'smile' })

			self.controller.stop_speech_mother = false
			character_util.add_listener(oni_girl_mother, self.controller)
			quest_icon_util.set_quest_notice(oni_girl_mother)
			field_ui_manager:Show()
			party_util.reset_controllers()
			return
		end
	end

	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'shoot' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_china_01')
	-- 라라, 꼬마 라나 (각자 side, attack, shoot) : [shout] 자, 시작하자!!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl_mother,
		{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_19', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- bgm_transition: Field(bgm_slayers_castletown) -> Muted
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	-- 리더용 가우리 바꿔치기
	self.cached_gourry = self.gourry
	self.gourry = get_character(self.cached_gourry.Name .. '_manual')
	character_util.set_active_state(self.gourry, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(self.cached_gourry, vector(999, 0, 999))
	gourry = self.gourry

	-- 페이드 인 아웃 세팅
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.HidePreviousParty = false
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(gourry, param)

	oni_girl_mother.Position = field:GetMarker('onigirl_racing_mother_start').position
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_mother)
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'victory_extra' })

	character_util.stop(oni_girl)
	oni_girl.Position = field:GetMarker('onigirl_racing_oni_girl_start').position
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile' })

	lina.Position = field:GetMarker('onigirl_racing_lina_start').position
	character_util.set_direction(lina, 'left')
	character_util.set_emotion(lina, { name = 'attack' })
	character_util.set_anim(lina, { name = 'victory_extra' })

	gourry.Position = field:GetMarker('onigirl_racing_gourry_start').position
	character_util.set_direction(gourry, 'left')

	camera_util.resize_by_ratio(5, 0)

	lina:HideWeapon(true)
	gourry:HideWeapon(true)

	self.is_changed_leader = false
	self.controller.stop_round = true
	wait_for_sec(1)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
	-- 라라 : [shout] 가지고 있는 봉을 다음 사람한테 건네주고, 먼저 돌아오면 이기는 거야!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl_mother,
		{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_28', skip = true,
		 world_pos = gourry.Position + vector(-5, 0, 1), bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 라나 바톤 아이템
	local baton_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = oni_girl.Position, itemid = 20477, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		  sprscale = 0.75, showoncharacter = true })

	baton_item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local bone_follower = self:bone_follower(baton_item, oni_girl, 1)

	-- 가우리 바톤 아이템
	local gourry_baton_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = gourry.Position, itemid = 20476, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		  sprscale = 0.75, showoncharacter = true })

	gourry_baton_item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local gourry_bone_follower = self:bone_follower(gourry_baton_item, gourry, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
	-- 꼬마 라나 (left, smile, victory_get) : [shout] 응! 알았어!
	wait_all({
		util.cs_generator(speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async, oni_girl,
			{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_28_1', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout' }),
		util.cs_generator(
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, oni_girl, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true }),
		util.cs_generator(
			character_util.set_animation_n_times_async, gourry, { name = 'victory_get', keep_anim = true })
	})

	character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl)
	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(bone_follower)
	baton_item:ConsumeComplete()

	character_util.remove_anim(gourry)
	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(gourry_bone_follower)
	gourry_baton_item:ConsumeComplete()


	character_util.set_immortal(gourry, true)
	character_util.set_immortal(lina, true)

	-- 라라 : [shout] 3… 2… 1… 출발!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl_mother,
		{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_29', skip = true,
		  world_pos = gourry.Position + vector(-5, 0, 1), bubble_type = 'shout' })

	-- 이동, 달리기 제외 컨트롤 불가능하도록 설정
	local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	player_state:DisableControls(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All) ~
		(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Move) +
			CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash)))
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 달리기 할 때 사용하지 못하는 버튼 숨기기
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton |
		CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	party_util.reset_controllers()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_gun_shoot_01')

	-- bgm_transition: Muted -> Event(bgm_lana), 0
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_lana', state = 'event', mix = 0 })

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.oni_girl_action, self))

	-- 승자가 있을 때까지 대기
	while not self.winner do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_activity_clear_01')

	-- bgm_transition: Event(bgm_lana) -> Muted
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted' })

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, lina) then
		character_util.stop(oni_girl_mother)

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowActivityClear()

		character_util.set_direction(lina, 'left')
		character_util.set_anim(lina, { name = 'victory_extra' })
		wait_for_sec(2)
	else
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_whistle_01')

		character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'left')
		character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'smile' })
		character_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'victory_extra' })
		camera_util.move_async(oni_girl_mother.Position, 1)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_drown_01')
	end

	screen_util.fade_out_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	character_util.set_immortal(gourry, false)
	character_util.set_immortal(lina, false)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_mother)
	oni_girl_mother.Position = self.oni_girl_mother_origin_pos
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'left')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)
	oni_girl.Position = oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl, 'left')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lina)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(gourry)

	lina:HideWeapon(false)
	gourry:HideWeapon(false)

	if not self.is_changed_leader then
		param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
		param.HidePreviousParty = false
		character_util.convert_to_manual_character(lina, param)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	character_util.set_position(self.cached_gourry, self.gourry.Position)
	character_util.set_position(self.gourry, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.stop(self.gourry)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.gourry)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.gourry, 'disabled')

	self.gourry = self.cached_gourry
	gourry = self.gourry

	for i = 1, #party_member do
		character_util.convert_to_party_member(party_member[i], user_party)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	party_util.align_to_target(oni_girl_mother, 'left', 0, 'arc')
	camera_util.resize_to_default(0)
	camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

	party_util.set_direction('right')
	wait_for_sec(0.8)

	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, lina) then
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		self:success_action()
	else
		-- bgm_transition: Muted -> Field(bgm_slayers_castletown)
		music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })

		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		self:fail_action()
	end
end

-- 라나, 라라 경주 액션
function local_class:oni_girl_action()
	local oni_girl_mother = self.get_oni_girl_mother()
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()

	local oni_girl_speed = 5.5
	local oni_girl_mother_speed = 8.5

	-- 라나와 라라 이동 동선
	local waypoint_index = { 5, 2, 3, 5, 1, 1, 1, 2, 10, 1 }
	local oni_girl_waypoint = {}
	for part = 1, #waypoint_index do
		local waypoints = {}
		for index = 1, waypoint_index[part] do
			local waypoint = self.get_oni_girl_waypoint(part, index)
			table.insert(waypoints, waypoint)
		end
		table.insert(oni_girl_waypoint, waypoints)
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(oni_girl,
		oni_girl_waypoint[1], oni_girl_speed, true, nil, nil, 'left')

	-- 점프 타일1
	self:jump_action(1, oni_girl, 13)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(oni_girl,
		oni_girl_waypoint[2], oni_girl_speed, true, nil, nil, 'left')

	-- 블럭1
	self:push_block_action(1, oni_girl, 1)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(oni_girl,
		oni_girl_waypoint[3], oni_girl_speed, true, nil, nil, 'up')

	-- 1층으로 내려오는 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01', parent = oni_girl })
	character_util.jump_move(oni_girl,
		oni_girl.Position + vector(0, -1, 2), oni_girl_speed, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_land_01', parent = oni_girl })

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(oni_girl,
		oni_girl_waypoint[4], oni_girl_speed, true, nil, nil, 'up')

	-- 점프 타일2
	self:jump_action(2, oni_girl, 11)

	local changed_pos = vector(field:GetMarker('onigirl_racing_changed_pos').position.x, 1, oni_girl.Position.z)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(oni_girl, changed_pos, oni_girl_speed, false)

	-- 라나 넘어지는 연출
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_slide_01', parent = oni_girl, volume = 0.5 })
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, { name = 'cliff' })
	character_util.move_to_async(oni_girl,
		oni_girl.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), nil, oni_girl_speed / 2)

	-- 놀라는 라라
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_mother)
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'surprise' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_player_jump_01', parent = oni_girl_mother, volume = 0.5 })
	character_util.normal_jump(oni_girl_mother)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'damaged' })
	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, { name = 'unique/falldown', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', parent = oni_girl, volume = 0.5 })

	-- 바톤 아이템 떨어뜨림
	local baton_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = oni_girl.Position, target = oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0.5),
		  itemid = 20477, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.75 })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_air_spin_02', parent = baton_item, volume = 0.5 })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(oni_girl_mother,
		oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(-3, 0, 0), oni_girl_speed)

	-- shake 후 일어나는 라나
	character_util.shake(oni_girl, 0.05, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_emotion(oni_girl_mother)
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'smile' })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01', parent = oni_girl, volume = 0.5 })
	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clap_02', parent = oni_girl_mother, volume = 0.5 })
	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'clap' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(oni_girl_mother)

	-- 바톤 주으러 가는 라라
	local oni_girl_mother_waypoint = {
		oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
		oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(1, 0, 0.5)
	}

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(oni_girl_mother, oni_girl_mother_waypoint, oni_girl_speed)

	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	baton_item.ConsumeTarget = oni_girl_mother
	baton_item = nil
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl_mother)

	baton_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = oni_girl_mother.Position, itemid = 20477, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		  sprscale = 0.75, showoncharacter = true })

	baton_item.ShadowTransform.gameObject:SetActive(false)

	local bone_follower = self:bone_follower(baton_item, oni_girl_mother, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_stage_intro_jump_01', parent = oni_girl_mother, volume = 0.5 })
	character_util.set_anim(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(oni_girl_mother)
	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(bone_follower)
	baton_item:ConsumeComplete()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, user_party.Leader) then return end

	-- 달리기 시작하는 라라
	for i = 5, 7 do
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(oni_girl_mother, oni_girl_waypoint[i], oni_girl_mother_speed, true)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, user_party.Leader) then return end

		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', parent = oni_girl_mother })
		character_util.jump_move(oni_girl_mother,
			oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(3, 0, 0), oni_girl_mother_speed, 1.5)

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, user_party.Leader) then return end
	end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(oni_girl_mother,
		oni_girl_waypoint[8], oni_girl_mother_speed, true, nil, nil, 'down')

	-- 1층으로 점프
	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_jump_01', parent = oni_girl_mother })
	character_util.jump_move(oni_girl_mother,
		oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(0, -1, -2), oni_girl_speed, 1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_land_01', parent = oni_girl_mother })

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, user_party.Leader) then return end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(oni_girl_mother,
		oni_girl_waypoint[9], oni_girl_mother_speed, true, nil, nil, 'left')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, user_party.Leader) then return end

	-- 점프 타일3
	self:jump_action(3, oni_girl_mother, 11)

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, user_party.Leader) then return end

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(oni_girl_mother,
		oni_girl_waypoint[10], oni_girl_mother_speed, true, nil, nil, 'left')

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.winner, user_party.Leader) then return end

	-- 플레이어 선슈 교체하는 동안 대기
	while self.is_changing_leader and not self.controller.end_game do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.winner = oni_girl_mother
end

--- 플레이어 승리 연출
function local_class:success_action()
	local oni_girl = self.get_oni_girl()
	local oni_girl_mother = self.get_oni_girl_mother()

	character_util.normal_jump(oni_girl_mother, '01_player_jump_01')
	-- 라라 (right, idle, jump 1회) : 뭐?!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl_mother,
		{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_35', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'attack' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(oni_girl_mother, 'right')
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'attack' })
	-- 라라, 꼬마 라나 (각자 side, tired, idle) : <b>우리가</b> 졌다고?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl_mother,
		{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_36', skip = true,
		  world_pos = oni_girl_mother.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0) })

	character_util.remove_emotion(oni_girl_mother)
	character_util.remove_emotion(oni_girl)
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'tired' })
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
	-- 꼬마 라나 (left, tired, idle) : 엄마는 내가 세상에서 제일… 빠르다고 했는데…….
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl,
		{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_37', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'tired' })
	-- 라라 (right, tired, idle) : 딸… 이건 그러니까…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl_mother,
		{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_38', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(oni_girl)
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'sleep_deep' })
	-- 꼬마 라나 (left, sleep_deep, idle) : ……
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(oni_girl,
		{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_39', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(oni_girl_mother)
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl_mother, { name = 'smile' })

	-- bgm_transition: Muted -> Event(bgm_heroic_moment)
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_heroic_moment', state = 'event' })

	character_util.remove_emotion(oni_girl)
	character_util.set_emotion(oni_girl, { name = 'smile' })

	character_util.set_direction(gourry, 'right')
	local baton_item = drop_item_util.create_item(
		{ pos = gourry.Position, itemid = 20476, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter',
		  sprscale = 0.75, showoncharacter = true })

	local bone_follower = self:bone_follower(baton_item, gourry, 2)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(gourry,
		gourry.Position + vector(3.5, 0, 0), 5, true)

	-- 카메라 이동 + 슬로우
	camera_util.move(lina.Position, 0.6)
	time_util.mod('qte' , 0.3)
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 0.5)
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_qte_action_wind_02')
	character_util.set_anim(gourry, { name = 'gauntlet_handskill2', loop = false, scale = 0.3 })
	wait_for_sec(0.6)

	character_util.set_anim(gourry, { name = 'gauntlet_handskill2', loop = false, scale = 0 })

	-- 스와이프 결과
	local swipe_value = 'none'

	self.touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
				swipe_value = 'left'
				return true
			end

			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeRight then
				swipe_value = 'right'
				return true
			end

			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeDown then
				swipe_value = 'down'
				return true
			end

			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeUp then
				swipe_value = 'up'
				return true
			end

			return false
		end
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_tap_guide_01')
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTESwipe('right')

	-- 가우리 (right, attack, sword_attack 정지) : 리나!!!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(gourry,
		{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_30', type_speed = 0 })

	while swipe_value == 'none' do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	local success = swipe_value == 'right'

	if success then
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QTEComplete, 0)
	else
		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(bone_follower)
	baton_item.Position = gourry.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5)

	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_normal_slash_02')
	character_util.set_anim(gourry, { name = 'gauntlet_handskill2', loop = false, scale = 2 })
	time_util.unmod('qte')

	-- 선수 교체
	local param = CS.Oak.CharacterConvertParam:ManualDefault()
	param.HidePreviousParty = false
	character_util.convert_to_manual_character(lina, param)

	if success then
		-- qte 성공

		self:item_move(baton_item, lina.Position + vector(-0.8, 0, 0.4), 0.3)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lina)
		character_util.set_anim(lina, { name = 'gauntlet_boong_attack_ready', loop = false, scale = 100 })

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_npc_01')
		bone_follower = self:bone_follower(baton_item, lina, 1)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)

		character_util.remove_anim(gourry)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lina)

		character_util.set_anim(lina, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_stage_intro_jump_01')
		-- 리나 (left, smile, victory_get) : 잘했어 가우리!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina,
			{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_31', type_speed = 0, life_time = 2 })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lina)
		character_util.set_direction(lina, 'right')

		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(bone_follower)
		baton_item:ConsumeComplete()

		character_util.set_emotion(gourry, { name = 'attack' })
		character_util.set_anim(gourry, { name = 'cast2' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
		-- 가우리 (right, attack, cast2) : 달려 리나! 이겨버려!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gourry,
			{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_31_1', type_speed = 0, life_time = 2 })
	else
		-- qte 실패

		self:item_move(baton_item, lina.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 0.6), 0.3)

		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_hit_comic_01')
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lina)
		self.get_fx_hit():Instantiate(lina.Position + vector(-0.3, 1, 0.3))
		character_util.spine_damage_squish_default(lina)
		character_util.spine_damage_red_pulse(lina)
		character_util.set_emotion(lina, { name = 'damaged' })
		character_util.set_anim(lina, { name = 'hurt' })

		sp_util.sine_move(baton_item,
			{ from = baton_item.Position, to = lina.Position + vector(1.5, 0, 0.5), duration = 0.5 })

		character_util.remove_anim(gourry)

		wait_for_sec(1)

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lina)

		character_util.set_emotion(lina, { name = 'mad' })
		character_util.set_anim(lina, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
		-- 리나 (left, mad, release) : 가----우----리----!!!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina,
			{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_32', type_speed = 0, life_time = 2 })

		character_util.remove_anim(lina)

		character_util.set_emotion(gourry, { name = 'tired' })
		character_util.set_anim(gourry, { name = 'cast' })
		character_util.normal_jump(gourry, true)
		-- 가우리 (right, tired, cast, jump 1회) : 리, 리나! 지금은 경기에 집중해!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(gourry,
			{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_33', type_speed = 0, life_time = 2 })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(gourry)

		character_util.normal_jump(lina, '01_jump_01')
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_angry_01')
		-- 리나 (left, mad, jump 1회) : …경기 끝나고 각오해 둬!!!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina,
			{ key = 'short_story_lina_oni_girl_racing_34', type_speed = 0, life_time = 2 })

		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(lina)

		local waypoint = {
			lina.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.5),
			lina.Position + vector(1, 0, 0.5)
		}
		character_util.move_waypoint_async(lina, waypoint, 4)

		character_util.set_direction(lina, 'right')
		local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01', loop = true })
		character_util.set_anim(lina, { name = 'eat' })
		wait_for_sec(1)

		eat_sfx:Stop()
		character_util.remove_anim(lina)

		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(bone_follower)
		baton_item:ConsumeComplete()
	end

	self.is_changing_leader = false
	music_player_util.change_stage_music_volume('event', 1)

	-- 이동, 달리기 제외 컨트롤 불가능하도록 설정
	local player_state = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerManualTouchState.Create(user_party.Leader, false)
	player_state:DisableControls(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.All) ~
		(CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Move) +
			CS.System.Convert.ToInt32(CS.Oak.DisabledControls.Dash)))
	message_system:SendSync(user_party.Leader.FieldObjectController, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(player_state))

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	-- 달리기 할 때 사용하지 못하는 버튼 숨기기
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(user_party.Leader, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.SkillButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ClassButton |
		CS.Oak.FieldUiType.RoleButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.ModeChangeButton | CS.Oak.FieldUiType.TeamCombinationButton)
end

--- 아이템 이동
function local_class:item_move(item, target_pos, duration)
	local time_passed = 0
	local start_pos = item.Position

	while time_passed < duration do
		time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		local cur_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(start_pos, target_pos, time_passed / duration)
		item.Position = cur_pos

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	item.Position = target_pos
end

--- 점프 타일 밟고 날아가는 연출
function local_class:jump_action(jump_tile_index, target, jump_speed)
	local jump_tile = get_field_object('onigirl_racing_jump_tile_' .. jump_tile_index)

	-- 점프 타일 밟고 날아감
	local jump_info = CS.Oak.JumpInfo()
	jump_info.jumper = target
	jump_info.jumpSource = jump_tile
	jump_info.speed = jump_speed
	local end_pos = field:GetMarker('onigirl_racing_jump_end_' .. jump_tile_index).position
	local xz_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(end_pos - target.Position).normalized
	jump_info.direction = (xz_dir + 1.5 * unity_class.vector3.up).normalized
	jump_info.jumpStartPos = jump_tile.Position
	jump_info.jumpTimeScale = 1.75
	jump_info.gravity = CS.Oak.Constants.JumpGravity

	local cmd = CS.Oak.JumpCommand.Create(jump_info)
	command_util.execute_cmd(cmd)

	-- 점프 타일 애니메이션 실행
	local jump_tile_animator = jump_tile:GetComponent(typeof(CS.UnityEngine.Animator))
	jump_tile_animator.speed = 1.5
	jump_tile_animator:Play('on')
	wait_for_sec(1.75)

	jump_tile_animator:Play('off')
end

--- 블럭 미는 연출
function local_class:push_block_action(push_block_index, target, push_duration)
	local push_block = self.get_push_block(push_block_index)

	character_util.set_emotion(target, { name = 'tired'})
	character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'push', upper = true })
	character_util.shake(target, 0.02, 999)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local dir = direction_util.to_vector3(vector_util.to_direction(push_block.Position - target.Position))

	for _ = 1, 2 do
		local block_start_pos = push_block.Position
		local target_start_pos = target.Position
		local push_dist = 1 * dir

		local time_passed = 0

		wait_for_sec(0.3)

		character_util.set_anim(target, { name = 'walk' })

		if not self.push_block_sfx then
			self.push_block_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{ sfx_name = '01_push_rock_01', parent = target,
				  loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
		end

		while time_passed < push_duration do
			time_passed = time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime
			local progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(time_passed / push_duration)

			local cur_block_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(block_start_pos, block_start_pos + push_dist, progress)
			push_block.Position = cur_block_pos

			local cur_target_pos = unity_class.vector3.Lerp(target_start_pos, target_start_pos + push_dist, progress)
			target.Position = cur_target_pos

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if self.push_block_sfx then
			self.push_block_sfx:Stop()
			self.push_block_sfx = nil
		end

		push_block.Position = block_start_pos + push_dist
		target.Position = target_start_pos + push_dist

		character_util.remove_anim(target)
	end

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(target, true)
	character_util.stop_shake(target)
end

function local_class:bone_follower(item, target, weapon_index)
	local bone_follower = item.SpriteTransform.parent.gameObject:AddComponent(typeof(CS.Spine.Unity.BoneFollower))
	bone_follower.followBoneRotation = false
	bone_follower.SkeletonRenderer = target.SpineController.SkeletonAnimation
	bone_follower:SetBone('[base]weapon' .. weapon_index .. '_side')

	return bone_follower
end

return local_class

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if self.is_navigate_to_book_seller then
				if string.sub(e.Zone.Name, 1, 18) == 'sslp_quest_marker_' then
					local string_len = string.len(e.Zone.Name)
					local object_name = string.sub(e.Zone.Name, 19, string_len)
					local position = nil

					if object_name == 'hide' then
						quest_marker_util.remove(self.quest_marker_name)
						return true
					end

					for x, y, z in string.gmatch(object_name, 'vector%((-*%d+),%s*(-*%d+),%s*(-*%d+)%)') do
						x = tonumber(x)
						y = tonumber(y)
						z = tonumber(z)
						position = vector(x, y, z)
					end

					if position then
						quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, position, true)
					else
						local marker_object = get_field_object(object_name)
						if marker_object == nil then
							marker_object = get_character(object_name)
						end

						quest_marker_util.show(self.controller, self.quest_marker_name, marker_object, true)

	character_util.set_direction(lina, 'up')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_54', skip = true })

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(desertelf_female, { name = 'nod' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(desertelf_female, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_55', skip = true })

	-- 아내 (down, smile, cast2) : 그 집 문앞에는 위조범이 애지중지 하는 검은 고양이가 앉아 있거든요.
	character_util.set_anim(desertelf_female, { naem = 'cast2' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(desertelf_female, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_56', skip = true })

	-- 리나 (up, nod) : 흐음… 그렇단 말이지.
	music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_direction(lina, 'left')
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(lina, { name = 'nod' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(lina, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_57', skip = true })

	-- 아내 (down, smile, nod x1) : 그럼, 부디 성공하길 바랄게요.
	character_util.set_animation_n_times(desertelf_female, { name = 'nod' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(desertelf_female, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_58', skip = true })

	character_util.set_direction(desertelf_male, 'right')
	character_util.set_direction(desertelf_female, 'left')

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(desertelf_male)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(desertelf_female)

	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller, 2)
end

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaPassportSection3')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLinaPassport @
		Comment = ShortStoryLinaPassport 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 2 @
		NextSections = 3 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)

	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.get_blackcat = controller.get_blackcat

end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()

	local blackcat = self.get_blackcat()

end

	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil

--region event

	end

	local blackcat = self.get_blackcat()

	-- 퀘스트 받고 고양이에게 상호작용 하면, 고양이가 길게 한 번 울고, SFX
	-- 고양이 : 냐아아아아옹~ (sfx 처리 예정)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

local local_class = newclass('ShortStoryLinaPassportSection4')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = ShortStoryLinaPassport @
		Comment = ShortStoryLinaPassport 퀘스트/이벤트 섹션 @
		Index = 3 @
		NextSections = 4 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 아이템 스펙 이름
	self.passport_item_spec_name = controller.passport_item_spec_name

	-- 필요한 골드 금액
	self.need_gold_amount = controller.need_gold_amount

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_lina = controller.get_lina
	self.get_book_seller = controller.get_book_seller

	self.is_talked_book_seller = false
end

function local_class:on_pre_load()
end

function local_class:enter()
	local book_seller = self.get_book_seller()
	character_util.add_listener(book_seller, self.controller)
	book_seller.Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(vector(0.5, 0, 0.5), vector(2, 1, 4))

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	local book_seller = self.get_book_seller()
	character_util.remove_relate_event(book_seller, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

--region event
function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local book_seller = self.get_book_seller()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, book_seller) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_book_seller, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:interact_book_seller()
	local lina = self.get_lina()
	local book_seller = self.get_book_seller()

	-- 탁자에 상호작용하면 이벤트 발생.

	if not self.is_talked_book_seller then
		-- 위조꾼 : 용케 찾아왔군.
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(book_seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_60', skip = true })

		-- 위조꾼 (down, nod) : 역시 우리 키티 덕분이겠지.
		music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
		character_util.set_anim(book_seller, { name = 'nod' })
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(book_seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_61', skip = true })
	end

	self.is_talked_book_seller = true

	-- 위조꾼 (down, cast2) : 자, 원하는 위조 증명서가 있으면 뭐든 말해봐.
	character_util.set_anim(book_seller, { name = 'cast2' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(book_seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_62', skip = true })

	-- 선택지 출력
	-- 여행 증명서 (1000G) / 사막 통행증 (1000G) / 영웅 자격증 (1000G) / 라 제국 통행증 (1000G) / 그만 둔다.
	choose_result = choose_util.play_choose_event({ { 'short_story_lina_passport_62_1', 'mercy' },
													{ 'short_story_lina_passport_62_2', 'intellect' },
													{ 'short_story_lina_passport_62_3', 'forced' },
													{ 'short_story_lina_passport_62_4', 'brutal' },
													{ 'short_story_lina_passport_62_5', 'normal' } })

	local gold_table = get_or_create_global_table('stageeventcontrollers/ShortStoryLinaGold')
	local dollar = gold_table:get_dollar()

	if choose_result ~= 5 and dollar < 1000 then
		-- 소지금이 부족할 때

		-- 소지금이 부족해 구입할 수 없다.
		field_ui_util.show_narration_async({ key = 'short_story_lina_passport_62_6' })

		-- 위조꾼 : 이건 애들 장난이 아냐. 비즈니스라고!
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(book_seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_62_7', skip = true })
	else
		if choose_result == 1 then
			-- 여행 증명서 (1000G)
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_drop_gold_01')
			character_util.remove_anim(book_seller)

			gold_table:remove_dollar_async(self.need_gold_amount)
			yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)

			local gold = drop_item_util.create_gold({ pos = lina.Position, target = book_seller.Position + vector(-0.5, 0, 0), amount = self.need_gold_amount, wait_time = 0, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
			wait_for_sec(1)

			gold.ConsumeTarget = book_seller
			wait_for_sec(1)

			-- 위조꾼 (down, idle, release x2) : 여행 증명서야말로 내 작품들 중 최고의 품질을 자랑하지.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_emphasize_01')
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(book_seller, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(book_seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_64', skip = true })

			-- 위조꾼 : 잠깐만 기다려, 가장 잘 만든 걸로 줄 테니.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(book_seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_65', skip = true })

			-- 리나가 돈 던지고 위조꾼이 획득, 플로팅 텍스트.
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(lina, { name = 'throw' })
			wait_for_sec(0.125)

			-- 이후 사막민이 left, eat 모션 후 down, 증명서 던짐.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_01')
			character_util.set_direction(book_seller, 'right')
			character_util.set_anim(book_seller, { name = 'eat' })
			wait_for_sec(1.2)

			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(book_seller)
			character_util.set_direction(book_seller, 'down')
			wait_for_sec(1)

			character_util.set_animation_n_times(book_seller, { name = 'throw' })
			wait_for_sec(0.125)

			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_turn_page_02')
			local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
			local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(self.passport_item_spec_name).Id
			local passport_item = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = book_seller.Position, target = lina.Position, itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter' })
			passport_item.ConsumeTarget = lina
			wait_for_sec(2)
			-- 리나 획득.
		elseif choose_result == 2 then
			-- 사막 통행증 (1000G)
			-- 위조꾼 : 미안해, 이건 동포들을 위한 상품이야.
			character_util.set_anim(book_seller, { name = 'cross_arm' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(book_seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_66', skip = true })

			-- 위조꾼 : 사막민들에게만 판매하고 있어.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(book_seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_67', skip = true })
		elseif choose_result == 3 then
			-- 영웅 자격증 (1000G)
			-- 위조꾼 : 아 그게… 겉표지에 박아 넣어야 하는 금박 재료가 떨어졌어.
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_tipsy_01')
			character_util.set_anim(book_seller, { name = 'cross_arm' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(book_seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_68', skip = true })

			-- 위조꾼 : 그게 꼭 필요하면 나중에 다시 오라고.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(book_seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_69', skip = true })
		elseif choose_result == 4 then
			-- 라 제국 통행증 (1000G)
			-- 위조꾼 : 미안한데, 라 제국이랑은 웬만하면 엮이지 않으려고 하거든.
			character_util.set_anim(book_seller, { name = 'cross_arm' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(book_seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_70', skip = true })

			-- 위조꾼 : 그건 그냥 포트폴리오로 생각해줘.
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(book_seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_71', skip = true })
		else
			-- 그만 둔다.
			-- 위조꾼 : 이건 애들 장난이 아냐. 비즈니스라고!
			music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
			character_util.set_emotion(book_seller, { name = 'attack' })
			character_util.set_animation_n_times(book_seller, { name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(book_seller, { key = 'short_story_lina_passport_62_7', skip = true })
		end
	end

	-- 거래 끝나면 이벤트 종료. 컨트롤 풀림.
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(book_seller)
end

return local_class
